passages.title: Reforging the Key
passages.text:
Delays, delays... the one thing we cannot afford right now!

As much as I hate to disturb Lord Surristrasz, he's our only hope of saving our beloved Evanor.

Bring him the key fragments and hope that his mood is favorable.

Hurry, <class>, our assault team is waiting.

passages.title: Reforging the Key
passages.text:
You dare approach me, mortal?

For the sake of your unborn children, pray that your cause is worthwhile.

passages.title: Reforging the Key
passages.text:
The frivolous games you play here are of no consequence....

You and your Dalaran allies pick at loose threads while the fabric of this world's future is being shredded.

Still, this may provide my drakes some needed amusement.

Show me this key....

passages.title: A Swift Message
passages.text:
Although we don't get much aid from Stormwind directly, I do have a contact in the city who helps supply us with armor. His name is Osric Strang. His shop, Limited Immunity, is in the Old Town of Stormwind.

Our supply of armor dwindles, and I must contact Osric for more. Can you take him this note?

The fastest way to Stormwind is through Bartlett the Brave, our gryphon master. He's just outside of the smithy; bring him my note, and then take a gryphon to Stormwind.

passages.title: A Swift Message
passages.text: You look like you're in a hurry.  Well, then you came to the right place!

passages.title: A Swift Message
passages.text: You have to get this note to Stormwind?  That's not a problem, you can take one of my gryphons!

passages.title: A Rock Amongst Many
passages.text:
<The ground trembles slightly, and the low, familiar voice of Diamant speaks as if from the stone itself.>

You've done as I've asked.

Turn back and escape the cave in one piece.

Don't forget the gemstone.

passages.title: A Rock Amongst Many
passages.text:
You're alive. This is good.

Is the gemstone with you?

passages.title: A Rock Amongst Many
passages.text:
Well done, fleshling!

The gyreworms are among our most dangerous enemies.

The other Stone Lords shall have trouble not turning their head to this accomplishment.

passages.title: Etched Letter
passages.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from dealing with the Blackrock spies, <name>. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Ashley Blank, our local hunter trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

passages.title: Etched Letter
passages.text: Hello, <name>. Is there something I can do for you?

passages.title: Etched Letter
passages.text: So you received my note? Excellent. You've proven yourself quite capable in dealing with those orcs. As you continue to grow in power, I will teach you some new techniques.

passages.title: A Little on the Side
passages.text:
You know, it's our moral obligation to save all of this Elementium from the shale spiders. Those creepy things eat the stuff!

What a waste!

So, what do you say? 90/10 my way?

passages.title: A Little on the Side
passages.text: How much do you think you can carry?

passages.title: A Little on the Side
passages.text:
<Goldmine slyly looks at the pile of Elementium shards.>

Hmm, I don't think that stuff's going to sell for much. I better give you your cut right now so you don't feel ripped off.

passages.title: Steal Magmolias
passages.text:
We've discovered a new species of flower growing in the Magma Springs to the north. Amazingly, they sustain themselves in pure molten lava!

Please go and retrieve some specimens for me. I'm sure that further study of these plants will shed some light on your little friend here.

Speaking of which, he seems quite eager to go with you. Let's hope he behaves himself.

passages.title: Steal Magmolias
passages.text: Fascinating! The more time I spend in the Firelands, the more I see there is an ecosystem at work here.

passages.title: Steal Magmolias
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. I will start analyzing these samples at once.

passages.title: Fire Flowers
passages.text:
My fellow druid, Choluna, has asked us to collect any specimens of plant life that we might find here in the Firelands...

...I don't know whose idea it was to bring scholars to a warfront.

Nevertheless, you will already be in the cave - killing things - so be on the lookout for anything growing out of the ground.

passages.title: Fire Flowers
passages.text: They could be growing anywhere. Keep your eyes open.

passages.title: Fire Flowers
passages.text:
These things never cease to amaze me. Whether they're actual plants, or just delicate stone formations, the fact that they can grow in such hostile conditions astounds me.

I'll have these sent to Avrilla for analysis right away.

passages.title: Fatty Goatsteak
passages.text:
You know what? I think I want to grill up some goatsteak today.

No, not from the puny little shaghorns they keep around here. They don't have nearly enough fat on them.

<The chef pats his voluminous belly.>

You think I got to this size eating no-fat-havin' goats?

Now, the shaghorns up on the Skyrange, to the west... those'll do just fine.

passages.title: Fatty Goatsteak
passages.text: <The chef is busy preparing spices and sauces for his imminent steaks.>

passages.title: Fatty Goatsteak
passages.text: Good choice of steaks, <name>. You've got a future as a butcher. You probably make a better <class>, though.

passages.title: Golgoss Hungers
passages.text:
Golgoss' strength is great, but he requires nutrition before he can use it.

The snarlthorn bushes in the Upper Sumprushes have heavy, fibrous branches. These should sate his appetite.

passages.title: Golgoss Hungers
passages.text: Golgoss' hunger is great.

passages.title: Golgoss Hungers
passages.text: We are one step closer to my goal.

passages.title: Arconiss Thirsts
passages.text:
Arconiss fights with unmatched fury, but his extended stay beneath the mists has left him weakened.

The rodents of the swamp are plentiful, and their bodies are filled with nourishing blood. Return with blood enough to reignite Arconiss' spirit.

passages.title: Arconiss Thirsts
passages.text: Our preparation will not take much longer.

passages.title: Arconiss Thirsts
passages.text: Yet another step closer to completing my mission.

passages.title: Rummaging Through the Remains
passages.text:
I do have another task for you, <name>, though it's a might grim. I really need to get to the bottom of this mantid poison, but to do that, I need more information directly from the source.

While you're down on the southern battlefield, could you bring me back some mantid limbs so that I can examine their intact poison glands.

passages.title: Rummaging Through the Remains
passages.text: I'm hoping to find a permanent counter to the mantid poison so that the men won't be afflicted in the first place. It may take some time to piece it together.

passages.title: Rummaging Through the Remains
passages.text:
These are in great condition! Thank you, <name>!

You know, I've managed to distil some of their poison into a form that we can apply readily. I've even come up with some methods for weaving it into spell-casting, if you believe it. Would you like to give some a try?

passages.title: In Skilled Hands
passages.text:
<name>, take these crossbow bolts and then bring them to Hawkmaster Nurong at Farwatch Overlook to the southwest.

Nurong is praised among all the Wukao for being a flawless shot. His efforts are credited with holding the line here for these many months. I'm hoping you can work with him and judge for yourself. He may be the final Shado-Pan we need for the hunt.

passages.title: In Skilled Hands
passages.text: Another wave of fliers approaches. Be ready.

passages.title: In Skilled Hands
passages.text: There's a lot of movement on the other side of the chasm... something big is coming.

passages.title: Blood of Ancients
passages.text:
Lya and I agree on one thing: "Blood of Ancients" is almost certainly the sap from the great trees of the area. I should know - I brew with the stuff all the time.

The most ancient tree of all is the one that Grand Empress Shek'zeer calls her home, now known as the Heart of Fear. Find some amber from that tree, and our brew should be complete.

passages.title: Blood of Ancients
passages.text: Any luck?

passages.title: Blood of Ancients
passages.text:
That should do it! Recipe... complete.

Now let's see how this beer tastes.

passages.title: Old Age and Treachery
passages.text:
Look, I ain't got reason to trust you, but there's a task I can't give to my crew.

I need you to search the wreck of our old ship, the Mist-Hopper, and bring back the charter. It'd be sealed up in a silver tube, in a footlocker.

It's sort of, uh... incriminating. I can't risk any of the crew finding it if they decide to visit the ol' girl. She's resting on the Shelf of Mazu, to the west.

I'd suggest riding a rip current out there, if you got the stomach. They're all over the shelf.

passages.title: Old Age and Treachery
passages.text:
To be honest, I hope a grouper ate the old charter.

Wait, then it might end up here anyway. Dang it!

passages.title: Old Age and Treachery
passages.text:
That's the charter tube, alright. I guess you'd like to know what all the fuss is about, eh?

<Soggy lets out a long sigh as he un-caps the tube.>

Might as well get it over with.

passages.title: Everything I Know About Cooking
passages.text:
I'm so glad you enjoy my food. Are you interested in the recipes? If so, you should learn them properly, from my teachers in Halfhill Market. Everything I know about the kitchen, I learned from them.

Say, if you happen to pass through there, would you deliver this note to Sungshin Ironpaw for me? She was my favorite teacher, and I want her to know that I miss her.

passages.title: Everything I Know About Cooking
passages.text: You have a letter for me?

passages.title: Everything I Know About Cooking
passages.text: My, that's so thoughtful. I love hearing from my old students.

passages.title: Lost Sheepie
passages.text:
Chee Chee's prize sheep, Sheepie, is missing!

That bad sheep is always wandering off the farm.

Stupid sheep! I looked everywhere and couldn't find him.

Can you help me, <race>?

passages.title: Lost Sheepie
passages.text: Did you find my Sheepie? Oh, I was so worried.

passages.title: Lost Sheepie
passages.text: Oh, you found him! Thank you!

passages.title: Lost Sheepie... Again
passages.text:
That stupid sheep! He wandered off again!

Can you find him for me again?

passages.title: Lost Sheepie... Again
passages.text: Oh, poor Sheepie. He's probably so scared and alone...

passages.title: Lost Sheepie... Again
passages.text: Sheepie, you make me so worried! Bad sheep! Chee Chee was so worried about you!

passages.title: Blades of the Anointed
passages.text:
The problem with the Scarlet Crusade is that they keep coming back, even after death.

Behind those resurrections is High Inquisitor Whitemane. With her death, so goes the Crusade.

To give her the final rest, we need two swords of legend, each with a lost but storied history.

Luckily for me... er, us, these two blades of the anointed are at rest here within the monastery.

Find them and once you've killed Whitemane, plunge the blades into her corpse to make the death permanent.

passages.title: Blades of the Anointed
passages.text:
<With one blade already in your possession, you move to take the other.>

<An inscription on the statue behind the sword reads, "The Hand of Providence".>

passages.title: Blades of the Anointed
passages.text:
<The second anointed blade floats just in front of the wet statue. Steam rises from the sword.>

<You get the uncanny feeling that the Hand of Providence has been waiting for you.>

passages.title: Seeking the Soulstones
passages.text:
<name>, take this - the journal of Jubeka Shadowbreaker.

Read the journal and use the information contained within to track down where she went.

Find her soulstones and use them to locate her.

passages.title: These Aren't Your Fatty Goatsteaks
passages.text:
I'm so excited, <name>. We've nearly mastered all the ingredients for noodle soup!

We have plenty of vegetables and spices here, but the Lin family had access to exotic meats not seen in Pandaria for some time. We need some nice, fatty meats.

Grandpa used to tell me of ancient turtles living off the shores of the Timeless Isle. Something that lives that long has to have some nice fatty meat on its bones.

Create a deluxe noodle cart and gather some fatty turtle steaks and we'll continue.

passages.title: These Aren't Your Fatty Goatsteaks
passages.text: I can just taste the soup now!

passages.title: These Aren't Your Fatty Goatsteaks
passages.text:
Ooh, these will do nicely, <name>.

Now for the final step: the Lin secret ingredient soup's secret ingredient.

That's a mouthful!

passages.title: Your First Blacksmithing Work Order
passages.text: Now that the forge is complete, we can start producing truesteel ingots for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

passages.title: Your First Blacksmithing Work Order
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Your First Blacksmithing Work Order
passages.text:
Let me unpack that for you.

I should let you know - while we managed to expedite this one, future work orders will take longer.

passages.title: Waruk the Frostforger
passages.text:
Many say my father was a legendary blacksmith, Waruk the Frostforger they called him. They will tell you tales of his mighty weapons, crafted with nothing more than ice and steel. Waruk the Lieforger, I call him.

He promised he wouldn't be gone long, "I must support our troops!" he said.

Why did he have to go? Why did they let him get captured!?

I have no more need for broken tools than I do broken promises. His grave is east of here, you can leave this with the rest of his unwanted belongings.

passages.title: Waruk the Frostforger
passages.text: Greetings <race>, what brings you to this old orc's grave?

passages.title: Waruk the Frostforger
passages.text: Where did you find this hammer!?

passages.title: Mending A Broken Heart
passages.text:
adventurer, thank you for avenging my death... but I have just one more favor to ask of you.

If you help me see this through, I will forever be in your debt.

Take these items and meet me at the forge in Stonefang Outpost.

I have imbued them with a portion of my essence, but we still need the aid of another to reforge the hammer.

It is time for me to reconcile with Kugra, so that we both may finally find peace....

passages.title: Mending A Broken Heart
passages.text: My father... but, how did you....

passages.title: Mending A Broken Heart
passages.text:
This entire time... I have been so consumed with my own grief.

I never once stopped to consider how much my father was suffering at the hands of our enemies.

Thank you so much, <class>, for helping him to return to me. Please, allow me to repair his hammer.

In exchange for everything you have done for us, I will teach you whatever you wish to know.

passages.title: Slow and Steady
passages.text:
Excellent!

When you've collected enough herbs from the local wildlife, return to me and I'll craft them into an ink for Master Ardule.

The sporebats and giants should have what you're looking for.

And remember, be careful!

passages.title: Slow and Steady
passages.text: Ah, these are just what I was looking for!

passages.title: Slow and Steady
passages.text:
That was fast, <name>! And such a generous delivery!

I've secured the ink in a vial for you, but please be careful.

passages.title: The Arakkoan Enchanter
passages.text: The arakkoa said it was going to investigate an anomaly in the Cracking Plains that might be related to another armor piece.

passages.title: The Arakkoan Enchanter
passages.text:
Greetings Enchanter. I can see you are acquainted with the art. 

Good, good. Perhaps you and I can help each other.

passages.title: The Arakkoan Enchanter
passages.text:
Do I also detect that you have in your possession an artifact of our land? 

Can I see it?

One of Oru'kai's bracers... Thank you!

passages.title: The Clothes on Their Backs
passages.text:
Such kindness you have shown me, perhaps I can ask for one more?

In our village, we salvage and reuse old cloth to patch clothes and light armor. Sadly, most of my supply was taken or destroyed in the recent attacks.

The Shadowmoon cultists might think twice about stealing from us if you were to relieve them of their own resources.

If you can collect some ceremonial Shadowmoon robes for me, I will demonstrate some of my favorite tailoring techniques for you.

passages.title: The Clothes on Their Backs
passages.text: Were you able to get the robes?

passages.title: The Clothes on Their Backs
passages.text:
Again, you show me great kindness.

Now, let us begin.

passages.title: Snatch 'n' Grab
passages.text:
We were able to map all of the data from the transponder you recovered! Now our location analyzer is complete!

We're just missing a few final pieces, then the real testing begins.

One of my pilots mentioned seeing a beached Iron Horde ship over by the shore. If you can salvage some parts we may just be able to get this thing up and running!

passages.title: Snatch 'n' Grab
passages.text: Don't worry. We're just borrowing these from the Iron Horde!

passages.title: Snatch 'n' Grab
passages.text:
Those supplies were just what I needed! I think I'm finally figuring out how to work with all these Draenor parts. I'd be happy to show you, commander. I should be able to fix it in a jiffy.

Oh... and remember, deep breaths!

passages.title: The Arakkoan Enchanter
passages.text: The arakkoa said it was going to investigate an anomaly along the Forgotten Shore that might be related to another armor piece.

passages.title: The Arakkoan Enchanter
passages.text:
Greetings Enchanter. I can see you are acquainted with the art. 

Good, good. Perhaps you and I can help each other.

passages.title: The Arakkoan Enchanter
passages.text:
Do I also detect that you have in your possession an artifact of our land? 

Can I see it?

One of Oru'kai's bracers... Thank you!

passages.title: No Pressure, No Diamonds
passages.text:
You wish to understand the secrets of our gems, <race>? In exchange for returning my pendant, I am willing to help.

I must warn you, however, that the materials will not be easy to obtain.

To the north, you will find magma pools that give birth to living lava creatures. Contained within these, you may find magnificent diamonds.

Please return to me with a few of these diamonds...

passages.title: No Pressure, No Diamonds
passages.text: Have you obtained the materials I asked for?

passages.title: No Pressure, No Diamonds
passages.text: This diamond is marvelous! I shiver at the mere thought of the massive creature this must have come from...

passages.title: Restoration
passages.text:
As mentioned, our larger defense crystals have been drained of power, creating gaps in our defenses. The crystal you brought me is only a reminder of the severity of this situation. It's Shadowmoon magic to blame, I'm sure of it.

One of our rangari scouts spotted an orc fleeing north, past Palemoon Village, and into the valley beyond. Go, find this orc, and see if you can't retrieve whatever vessel he's storing the power inside of. If we get it back, I'm sure I can restore the crystals.

passages.title: Restoration
passages.text: The crystal's power pulses as it is carried.

passages.title: Restoration
passages.text:
You've found it! This crystal is overflowing with energy. This is definitely what we were looking for.

I fear even thinking about what kind of ritual this orc was planning to undergo with the power from this crystal.

You've done a great thing for us, <class>. As promised, I would like to show you my appreciation by teaching you how to work with some of our native gems and crystals. I trust you will put the knowledge to good use.

passages.title: From Their Cold Dead Hands
passages.text:
Those ogres took all of my hexweave!

I kept it hidden at the bottom of my bag. How could they possibly know of its importance?

If they discover even a portion of hexweave's properties, it means trouble for us all.

<name>, this is a Frostwolf problem. It requires a Frostwolf solution.

Will you help me?

passages.title: From Their Cold Dead Hands
passages.text: Well, is it done?

passages.title: From Their Cold Dead Hands
passages.text: This looks to be all of the cloth, but it appears that they tried to rip and pull the magic out by physical force. I think I see teeth marks...

passages.title: "Spare" Parts
passages.text:
I've never seen anything like this before! No problem though, boss man. If it can be used to blow things up, I can get it working again.

We are definitely going to need some parts--some sort of ammunition wouldn't hurt either.

Sounds like those Iron Horde guys over yonder are no stranger to things that go boom.

Take these tools with you and let's see if we can't commandeer us some spare parts!

passages.title: "Spare" Parts
passages.text: Got the stuff yet boss?

passages.title: "Spare" Parts
passages.text: What did you think of my rapid disassembly tech? Pretty effective, yeah?

passages.title: Your First Alchemy Work Order
passages.text: Now that the alchemy lab is complete, we can start producing alchemical catalysts for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

passages.title: Your First Alchemy Work Order
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Your First Alchemy Work Order
passages.text:
Let me unpack that for you.

I should let you know - while we managed to expedite this one, future work orders will take longer.

passages.title: Your First Leatherworking Work Order
passages.text: Now that the tannery is complete, we can start producing burnished leather for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

passages.title: Your First Leatherworking Work Order
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Your First Leatherworking Work Order
passages.text:
Let me unpack that for you.

I should let you know - while we managed to expedite this one, future work orders will take longer.

passages.title: Your First Tailoring Work Order
passages.text: Now that the tailoring emporium is complete, we can start producing hexweave cloth for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

passages.title: Your First Tailoring Work Order
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Your First Tailoring Work Order
passages.text:
Let me unpack that for you.

I should let you know - while we managed to expedite this one, future work orders will take longer.

passages.title: Your First Jewelcrafting Work Order
passages.text: Now that the gem boutique is complete, we can start producing taladite crystals for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

passages.title: Your First Jewelcrafting Work Order
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Your First Jewelcrafting Work Order
passages.text:
Let me unpack that for you.

I should let you know - while we managed to expedite this one, future work orders will take longer.

passages.title: Your First Inscription Work Order
passages.text: Now that the scribe's quarters are complete, we can start producing war paints for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

passages.title: Your First Inscription Work Order
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Your First Inscription Work Order
passages.text:
Let me unpack that for you.

I should let you know - while we managed to expedite this one, future work orders will take longer.

passages.title: Your First Blacksmithing Work Order
passages.text: Now that the forge is complete, we can start producing truesteel ingots for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

passages.title: Your First Blacksmithing Work Order
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Your First Blacksmithing Work Order
passages.text:
Let me unpack that for you.

I should let you know - while we managed to expedite this one, future work orders will take longer.

passages.title: Your First Engineering Work Order
passages.text: Now that the engineering works is complete, we can start producing gearspring parts for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

passages.title: Your First Engineering Work Order
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Your First Engineering Work Order
passages.text:
Let me unpack that for you.

I should let you know - while we managed to expedite this one, future work orders will take longer.

passages.title: Your First Inscription Work Order
passages.text: Now that the scribe's quarters are complete, we can start producing war paints for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

passages.title: Your First Inscription Work Order
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Your First Inscription Work Order
passages.text:
Let me unpack that for you.

I should let you know - while we managed to expedite this one, future work orders will take longer.

passages.title: Your First Jewelcrafting Work Order
passages.text: Now that the gem boutique is complete, we can start producing taladite crystals for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

passages.title: Your First Jewelcrafting Work Order
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Your First Jewelcrafting Work Order
passages.text:
Let me unpack that for you.

I should let you know - while we managed to expedite this one, future work orders will take longer.

passages.title: Your First Tailoring Work Order
passages.text: Now that the tailoring emporium is complete, we can start producing hexweave cloth for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

passages.title: Your First Tailoring Work Order
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Your First Tailoring Work Order
passages.text:
Let me unpack that for you.

I should let you know - while we managed to expedite this one, future work orders will take longer.

passages.title: Hatecoil Hammerwork
passages.text:
There may be a way to jump-start our research into leystone.

I've heard reports of naga camps down in Azsuna. If they've been in Azsuna for long enough, their smiths have certainly started experimenting with leystone themselves.

Be on the lookout for some leystone armor on the naga... ideally something more elaborate than a bracer.

passages.title: Hatecoil Hammerwork
passages.text: I still marvel at how quickly those things can swim in plate armor.

passages.title: Hatecoil Hammerwork
passages.text:
Of course! They've found their way around the welding problem by simply crafting their armor out of one solid piece of metal.

The shoulderpads I should have figured out on my own, but their work on the breastplate really is remarkable.

Here, let me jot down a few patterns so you can make these yourself.

passages.title: Engineers: Not COMPLETELY Useless
passages.text:
Unfortunately, I have no idea how to access any information within this core. But I know someone who does.

Head over to "Like Clockwork", the engineering shop three doors down from here. Timofey Oshenko owes me a favor. He should be able to extract the memory out of the core.

passages.title: Engineers: Not COMPLETELY Useless
passages.text: You're here from Alard's shop? What does that musclehead want now?

passages.title: Engineers: Not COMPLETELY Useless
passages.text: Oh, a memory core? One moment.

passages.title: Not Just Weapons and Armor
passages.text:
You know, we aren't just limited to armorsmithing and weaponsmithing. I regularly make chisels for the scribes, crucibles for the alchemists, and even thimbles for the tailors.

They should sew in full plate gauntlets if they're really all that worried about their poor little thumbs.

Anyhow, I have a recipe I think an adventurer like you might be interested in. Let's try it out.

passages.title: Not Just Weapons and Armor
passages.text: Let's get to work. I think you'll enjoy this.

passages.title: Not Just Weapons and Armor
passages.text:
Let me take those bars, make a few adjustments and...

Ta da! Hoofplates for your mount!

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Hammered By The Storm
passages.text:
Your hammer looks weak, and would probably break upon striking the Firmament Stone.

The vrykul master blacksmiths of old were known for the strength of their hammers. The only way to get our hands on such a hammer would be to go where vrykul go when they die. To the Maw of Souls.

The goddess that resides over that realm is named Helya. She hoards the trinkets they bring for her own desires.

Defeat her and you may be able to acquire such a hammer.

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Hammered By The Storm
passages.text: Were you able to get your hands on one?

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Hammered By The Storm
passages.text:
<Barm examines the hammer, turning it slowly in his hands.>

Now THIS is a hammer!

passages.title: A Sweet Bargain
passages.text:
Reading over this research, I found an interesting method that I'd like you to try.

The method would require us to chill the metal to sub-freezing temperatures during the pre-tempering phase. Simple water quenching won't do.

Good thing you can't walk two steps in this city without bumping into a frost mage! See if you can recruit one for the shop, <name>.

passages.title: A Sweet Bargain
passages.text: Well done, <name>. Now let's put her to the test!

passages.title: A Needle Need
passages.text:
This shop has almost everything we need. Unfortunately, the quality of your sewing needles is lacking.

I do know where you can get better needles. The sprites of Val'sharah are covered with spines which, fortuitously, are perfect for the type of sewing we need.

I hate to be such a prickler stickler, but these needles really will make a difference.

passages.title: A Needle Need
passages.text: Your friend thinks these needles will make a difference?

passages.title: A Needle Need
passages.text:
Hmm... he may have a point.

These needles ARE quite strong, and they have a nice bounce to them. Still, I do take issue with their shape and feel. I have an idea.

passages.title: Meticulous Precision
passages.text:
The needles are sharp, but look at them closely. Some have a curve to them, others have a spur hanging off the side. Look at this one... it's got a ninety-degree crook in it! I have no desire to sew around a corner.

Tiffany Cartier in the jewelcrafting shop has a good eye for this sort of thing. Bring these needles to her, and she'll straighten them out.

passages.title: Meticulous Precision
passages.text: What's this, <name>?

passages.title: Meticulous Precision
passages.text:
Look at these! Strong, light, flexible, sharp, with a refined curve and a smooth edge. You've certainly put your Dalaran touch on it. It's the best of both worlds!

Enough fussing over our tools, now. Shall we sew?

passages.title: Lining Them Up
passages.text:
Since you're heading to Azsuna, you may as well gather some lining for our projects.

The bears of Azsuna are known for how soft, yet durable their fur is.

Hunt them in the woods around Llothien and bring their fur back with you.

passages.title: Lining Them Up
passages.text: Don't take them for easy prey. They're as vicious as they are cunning.

passages.title: Lining Them Up
passages.text: This will be plenty.

passages.title: Assault on Violet Hold: Into the Hold
passages.text:
With Lyndras being locked up in Violet Hold, you feel responsible for him and must discover the truth behind his actions.

Perhaps if you were able to speak with him, you could find a way to have him released from the hold and put back into your custody.

Go into Violet Hold and find out what happened to Lyndras.

passages.title: Assault on Violet Hold: Into the Hold
passages.text: Did you discover what happened to Lyndras?

passages.title: Assault on Violet Hold: Into the Hold
passages.text:
<Tanithria listens to your account of Lyndras' fate.>

I... I see. That's a shame.

I had grown to enjoy his company, you know. If you'll excuse me, I need a moment to think about him.

passages.title: Exotic Textiles
passages.text:
I'm risking my life and career to be here, tailor.

I've been curious about demonic cloth, and my attempts to obtain some through approved means have been met with resistance.

I simply must see this cloth for myself.

I don't wish to disrupt Azayna's pact with the demons, but you - you can attack the demons without drawing attention to our guild.

I'm particularly interested in a particular demon's set of robes. Bring me a scrap, and I'll teach you what I know.

passages.title: Exotic Textiles
passages.text: Probably better that you fight the thing, anyhow. I'm useless with a weapon.

passages.title: Exotic Textiles
passages.text: Excellent work. I will get to studying this fabric right away. As promised, I will teach you what I know. Are you acquainted with our patterns for gloves?

passages.title: Halls of Valor: The Right Question
passages.text:
One might ask what a leyweaver is doing standing over a dead vrykul's body. But such questions only stir up trouble.

Instead let us ask what can be learned from those who have passed on. A question like that promotes progress.

I assume you're here to learn from me, the pattern for Imbued Silkweave pants, yes?

If that's true, then I'll need something from one who has passed on. In the Halls of Valor the great guardian, Hymdall resides.

Bring me his loincloth and I will teach you my pattern.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: The Right Question
passages.text: Asking the right questions will get you far.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: The Right Question
passages.text:
<Tellumi takes the loincloth from you and gives you a sly smile.>

I trust you now see looking at a situation from a functional angle than a reactionary one will earn you far more knowledge.

passages.title: A Gruesome Task
Eye of Azshara: Put a Cork in It
passages.text:
A thought occurred to me recently, <name>. The naga have been known to hoard all manner of potions, so they might have the sort of corks we need.

In my educated opinion, I believe the best place to start searching is around the Eye of Azshara!

Try not to waste your time in there dealing with the naga's goings on, just look for some replacement corks.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: Put a Cork in It
passages.text: The sooner we get my supplies back, the quicker we can get back to real work.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: Put a Cork in It
passages.text: What's this? The spoils from another of your adventures, eh? Let's have a look.

passages.title: We Need More Powder!
passages.text:
The substance you brought me appears to be precipitating powder, a highly volatile reagent used by the vrykul in their recipes.

There are rumors that a vrykul elder named Katterin has built up quite a store of this powder. A substance this dangerous needs to be in our hands, not hers!

passages.title: We Need More Powder!
passages.text: Let's hope you find the powder we need...

passages.title: We Need More Powder!
passages.text:
The ghost of Svena appeared again? Seems she doesn't take kindly to our attempts to learn these vrykul recipes...

Thankfully, the satchel you recovered has all the precipitating powder we require for the alchemy table. Another victory for us!

passages.title: A Fragile Crucible
passages.text:
I have customers asking for alchemist stones, but I'm unable to make any until I replace my crucible.

In order to create a new one, we'll need a few things, but first we'll need a proper container. Something that can be augmented to withstand a demon's breath.

There's a place in Suramar which the Legion has occupied. There surely must be a device there we can take that will be suitable for our needs.

passages.title: A Fragile Crucible
passages.text: I trust you're strong enough to handle a few demons?

passages.title: A Fragile Crucible
passages.text:
You've found something quite intriguing here! Others have brought me fragments of such implements, but never so complete a sample.

This is going to require a lot of work...

passages.title: Flasking for a Favor
passages.text:
You know, this mixing flask didn't suffer terrible damage. I'm positive it can just be repaired.

I'm no expert in glass repair, but I've heard of someone who is--a tauren by the name of Barm Stonebreaker. He's a smith by trade, but those who know him say he was born to work glass.

Those tauren don't work for free, so you may be in for some work yourself.

passages.title: Flasking for a Favor
passages.text: You're looking for help? I hope you have something to offer my people in return, <race>.

passages.title: Flasking for a Favor
passages.text:
Your gift is a noble gesture, <race>. Smithing can be a surprisingly perilous profession.

Now let's see that flask.

Eh, that's not so bad. Give me a moment to fix it.

passages.title: Between the Hammer...
passages.text:
<name>, I fear that my spirit will remain bound to this place unless I am made whole again.

Long ago, I discovered a cave near the coast behind Black Rook Hold. I explored the cave only to find an abominable creature that attacked me, causing me to drop my hammer as I fled.

I need that hammer back if I am to be at peace.

passages.title: Between the Hammer...
passages.text: Any luck retrieving my hammer?

passages.title: Between the Hammer...
passages.text:
Thank you, <name>. Words cannot express what this means to me.

And as promised, here is a gift of knowledge to you.

passages.title: ...And the Anvil
passages.text:
If you truly wish to see my work then you'll have to go and retrieve it as my shop has been raided of everything I've made.

The breastplates of the Black Rook soldiers were one of my greatest accomplishments. They're light, yet strong and offer great mobility

Relinquish my cursed brethren of their breastplates and bring them back to me. I will explain the finer points of how I made them upon your return.

passages.title: ...And the Anvil
passages.text: Have you acquired any breastplates?

passages.title: ...And the Anvil
passages.text: These pieces will do fine as examples. Now, let me explain how I crafted them...

passages.title: Cloaked in Tradition
passages.text:
You have seen the ways of the tauren of Thunder Totem... speaking with the spirits, gathering from the land, and letting nothing go to waste. These are potent forces crucial to your quest to aid the Broken Isles.

Here, take this journal back to your enchanter friend. It contains the lessons I have imparted unto you.

Perhaps it will serve to help the greater cause of defeating the Legion.

passages.title: Cloaked in Tradition
passages.text: Welcome back, <name>. Did you make contact with the tauren?

passages.title: Cloaked in Tradition
passages.text:
I see you brought back a gift from Highmountain.

<Nalthanis thumbs through the pages.>

This is fascinating! Look here, <name>, some formulas for cloak enchantments. I believe these would come in handy for us at this point in time.

passages.title: Runes Within the Ruins
passages.text:
Unfortunately, Pallin's codex isn't complete. There are many symbols here that simply cannot be deciphered with what we've learned.

Looks like we'll need to go and collect more tablets down in the area that the vrykul call Haustvald.

passages.title: Runes Within the Ruins
passages.text: We need those tablets if we're to progress any further in deciphering their language.

passages.title: Runes Within the Ruins
passages.text:
I believe these have enough information for us to finish the codex. Excellent work, <name>.

If you don't mind me saying, it's nice to finally not be the one running errands.

passages.title: Right Tool for the Job
passages.text:
From what little I have been able to decipher, I know that the tablets are created using a special carving tool.

If we had one of those tools, along with a complete codex, we could easily create our own tablet.

That would also serve to prove that my deciphering of their language has been successful.

Retrieve one of those tools for me, <name>.

passages.title: Right Tool for the Job
passages.text: The knife is the final key to my research. Any luck finding one?

passages.title: Right Tool for the Job
passages.text:
Wow. It's much... bigger than I had expected.

Then again, vrykul are very large and I'm... well, I am not.

Still though, I believe I can work with this.

passages.title: Once a Scribe Like You
passages.text:
These sewers are something of a... "settling place" for many who can't cope with the stresses of regular Dalaran life. Take, for example, the target of this particular contract.

His name is Inkrot. He was once a scribe like you, but the stresses of dealing with the Professor drove him mad.

<Raethan hands you the contract.>

This says he's stolen a jewel from Cartier and Co. Bring me the jewel. Whatever else you find on him is yours.

passages.title: Once a Scribe Like You
passages.text: Did he give you much trouble?

passages.title: Once a Scribe Like You
passages.text:
You, <name>, are a godsend. I thought I'd never be rid of that nuisance.

As promised, here is the bounty for the contract.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Vision of Valor
passages.text:
I think it's time for another field trip, <name>. To the Halls of Valor!

The Valarjar are masters of all types of runecraft. Perhaps we can find something useful for a new recipe.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Vision of Valor
passages.text: Did you see any gods while you were there?

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Vision of Valor
passages.text: My stars... these are very nice indeed! In fact, this gives me an idea...

passages.title: Mass Milling Techniques
passages.text:
A number of my previous students have been vocal in their displeasure regarding milling. They find the process "repetitive", "mindless", and even "painful". Have they no respect for the time-honored traditions of inscription?

I suppose you count yourself among their number. Am I right? Very well. You've been a fine student so far, so I suppose there's no harm.

I have a book about mass milling somewhere around the shop here. Find it, and it's yours.

passages.title: Mass Milling Techniques
passages.text: Try not to make too big a mess.

passages.title: Mass Milling Techniques
passages.text:
That's it! Hmm... let's see...

<Pallin looks quickly through the pages of the old book.>

Not much in here that will help you with our Broken Isles herbs.

Wait, hold that thought. Look at this here...

passages.title: Arcane Thirst
passages.text:
My people have subsisted on the Nightwell for millennia. Ancient mana is our lifeblood - without it, we become... well, you saw them out there.

<Thalyssra holds her flask aloft, gently shaking free the last precious drops.>

I'm afraid I have been rather reckless today. 

Already, my senses are dulling. Without magic to feed upon, I will turn. 

Please... find me something to feed upon... anything...

passages.title: Arcane Thirst
passages.text: <Thalyssra's eyes have dulled and her body is shaking uncontrollably.>

passages.title: Arcane Thirst
passages.text: <Thalyssra takes the crystals with a trembling hand.>

passages.title: Shoulder the Burden
passages.text:
During one of our recent battles, my brother, Lohrumn, was slain. His armor was taken by the drogbar.

You would honor his memory by retrieving what has been stolen. I will make it worth your while, leatherworker.

passages.title: Shoulder the Burden
passages.text: My brother's armor... have you found it?

passages.title: Shoulder the Burden
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. As promised, let me teach you one of our crafts.

passages.title: Claw of the Land
passages.text:
Personal experience has taught me to use stronger materials when crafting armor pieces. They last longer, and you don't need quite as many of them.

For example, I utilize the claws of the pinerock stalkers. If you acquire some for me, perhaps I can show you how better materials can increase your efficiency.

passages.title: Claw of the Land
passages.text: Their claws are some of the strongest I've ever come across.

passages.title: Claw of the Land
passages.text:
You've gathered enough here to last me for many moons.

<Hrul begins to work with the claws. It's clear that he's using very little of each, but still able to make an excellent armor piece.>

I hope you were able to learn something from this, <name>.

passages.title: Reclaimed Cargo
passages.text:
The same ship that my brother was on also carried shipments of exceptional mail armor. Knowing the giants, they probably had no use for them and left them scattered around their caves.

If you could recover those shipments and bring them here, I can explain the techniques used to fashion them. That should give you a good idea of how to improve your processes.

passages.title: Reclaimed Cargo
passages.text: Were you able to recover any of the shipments?

passages.title: Reclaimed Cargo
passages.text:
They're a bit rusty, but at least they're intact. Let me explain how these were made...

<Celea begins to describe the method in which the armor was constructed.>

Tedious, yet efficient.

passages.title: Leather Legwork
passages.text:
Good news, <name>! Langrom's Leather and Links recently delivered a shipment of mail armor to me.

It's of the finest quality and I'd love to show it to ye, but it seems I've lost me crowbar and can't open the crate.

If ye could run over to their shop and grab an extra one fer me, we can get this crate opened and go over the construction.

passages.title: Leather Legwork
passages.text: Fer the life of me, I dunna know where I left the blasted thing!

passages.title: Leather Legwork
passages.text:
Well wouldn't ye know it, <name>. While ye were out, I found me crowbar! Isn't that great news?

Oh, ye were able to acquire one too? Ha ha!

Well why don't ye hold onto that fer yerself and have a look at these armor pieces with me.

passages.title: Playthings
passages.text:
Ok, so her ideas were a leash, a bed, and a FLAMING HOOP?!

It sounds like they want to start a circus or something. Regardless, I love all those ideas and we should get started as soon as you're ready.

Why don't you work on making the bed, and I'll work out the details for the flaming hoop.

passages.title: Playthings
passages.text: Make sure it's nice and cozy!

passages.title: Playthings
passages.text: Awww, my pets are going to look so cute sitting on this. Well, most of them will. Probably not all of them.

passages.title: Strength of the Past
passages.text:
As you know, the durability of your armor is only as strong as the materials you use to make them.

Long ago, the black dragon, Deathwing once inhabited this very mountain. In his quest for power, his body began to tear and he had creatures make metal scales to stitch his wounds.

His natural scales fell to the ground in his lair and have been there ever since. Go retrieve a scale and bring it to me.

This will take all your strength to accomplish.

passages.title: Strength of the Past
passages.text: True strength isn't determined by how much you can endure, but by continuing to endure when you lack the strength.

passages.title: Strength of the Past
passages.text:
You never cease to disappoint me, <name>.

And now I impart to you sacred knowledge which was once passed unto me.

passages.title: Evolution of the Past
passages.text:
As we make stronger armor, the creatures we battle adapt and learn to defeat us. We in turn create better armor, and they in turn learn to defeat it yet again.

For centuries, my people have battled the basilisks of the mesas below. They have adapted to us as thoroughly as we have to them.

Go, kill these basilisks and take from them their hides. Return them to me so I may show you how they have evolved.

passages.title: Evolution of the Past
passages.text: Do not fear change, for change is the only way to move forward.

passages.title: Evolution of the Past
passages.text:
See this, <name>? What was once a soft, simple scale...

...has evolved into a jagged weapon that can kill!

<He then indicates to the spined scales at the base of the creature's neck.

I trust you now understand the purpose of change.

passages.title: Scales of the Arcane
passages.text:
In my experience, dragon scale has been the strongest material I've ever had the privilege of working with. It's hard, durable and very little can go a long way.

I wish to work with it again, <name>. Being in this form, I'm bound to this area, unable to experience the world any longer.

I've heard rumor of the blue dragonflight occupying parts of Azsuna. Perhaps you can speak with them and see if they can shed a scale or two.

passages.title: Scales of the Arcane
passages.text: To work with dragon scale again would be a great honor.

passages.title: Scales of the Arcane
passages.text: Yes, these are perfect, <name>. As is fair, I will return this grand favor and impart more of my leatherworking knowledge to you.

passages.title: Scales of the Earth
passages.text:
While leather armor is strong on its own, integrating scales into the design is what truly sets it apart.

The type of scales you use will determine how many you'll need to fully protect the wearer. And one of the strongest type of scales are basilisk scales.

A fully matured basilisk has the strongest of course. Near the village of Llothien is a basilisk den. Kill the matriarch and return her scales to me.

passages.title: Scales of the Earth
passages.text: You may have to fight past a few of her brood to get to her.

passages.title: Scales of the Earth
passages.text:
The basilisk scale is thick. Even a thinned version of this is enough to repel any sword or spear attack.

That strength is what makes these scales so valuable to our craft.

passages.title: Hounds Abound
passages.text:
I'll invite him to tea. That'll show him! He'll see the leather doll and say, "When did SHE get here?!"

I mean... sorry, <name>. My mind goes to strange places. You want to know about the demons, the ones with durable hides?

Before I was exiled I saw such beasts roaming our cities. Fel hounds, they are called. Slay them and bring me their corpses.

We can discuss their hides afterwards.

passages.title: Hounds Abound
passages.text: We met on the lake. It was spring and she wore ley lilies...

passages.title: Hounds Abound
passages.text:
Hey <name>! Come here and listen. You hear it don't you? Come on, I know you hear it!

What are those infernal things you're dragging behind you? Fel hounds? For me?

You have a strange taste in gifts for your friends, <name>.

passages.title: A Touch of Magic
passages.text:
I always took great pride in my home... and my enchantments. Now it seems both have fallen into ruin.

I can sense the power of a potent enchanter in you, <name>. If you would but sprinkle a bit of magic dust on my once-enchanted belongings, I'm sure you can bring them to life again.

passages.title: A Touch of Magic
passages.text: Just the presence of such a vibrant enchanter gives my home the spark of life!

passages.title: A Touch of Magic
passages.text:
It pleases me that you have brought life to my beloved enchantments.

Once I could accomplish much more than mere parlor tricks... until the source of my power was stolen from me.

passages.title: The Lost Advisor
passages.text:
You may as well assist me while you are here. I require a potion to be made, one that will set things right.

I must conserve my energy until my task is finished, lest I become like these miserable wretches scrabbling at the cobblestones. There is coin in it for you, since I will not be needing it soon.

The harpies around here cannot resist cliffthorn. It is what drew them to Tel'anor in the first place. 

You should find plenty just outside this building.

passages.title: The Lost Advisor
passages.text: <Thaedris seems lost in thought as he gazes towards the city of Suramar.>

passages.title: The Lost Advisor
passages.text:
<Thaedris stirs from his thoughts as you approach.>

These will be sufficient, <race>.

 Cliffthorn is a deadly poison, and will be perfect for my needs.

passages.title: The Last Chapter
passages.text:
The next step of my journey requires a tome, but I find that I am still unable to idly sit by as this place continues to fall into disrepair.

I will tidy up the memorials while you go fetch me the tome. It is called the Encyclopedia Botanica and you can find it in the library near the main plaza.

passages.title: The Last Chapter
passages.text: Do you have the tome, <race>?

passages.title: The Last Chapter
passages.text:
Hmph. I suppose if you're assisting me with my task, I should learn your name.

<Thaedris reaches into the book and pulls out an unfamiliar, dried plant.>

Thank you for fetching me another one of the ingredients. Your assistance is... welcome, <name>.

passages.title: The Final Ingredient
passages.text:
The potion is complete, <name>. Soon our journey will be over. There is one last thing I would have you do for me, then you shall have your reward.

My wife's bow was kept here, but I have not been able to find it after searching everywhere. There is potent magic in it.

I fear one of the restless spirits may have taken it, but it would take a powerful force to pick up an item such as this. Be careful.

passages.title: The Final Ingredient
passages.text: What was that? I heard a familiar voice... it couldn't be.

passages.title: The Final Ingredient
passages.text:
You saw Latara? What happened?

... I see. I am so sorry I failed you, my love.

passages.title: Bite of the Sashj'tar
passages.text:
If I had been by Throndyr's side when he fought the naga, he might still be alive.

These serpents will regret the day that they decided to slither from their watery hole!

Killing them is not enough. No! I will honor Throndyr with a necklace of naga fangs!

passages.title: Bite of the Sashj'tar
passages.text: We will slay them all!

passages.title: Bite of the Sashj'tar
passages.text: I will wear this in honor of Throndyr!

passages.title: Pilfered Provisions
passages.text: The sea giants are sifting through the shipwrecks looking for treasure. Anything of value that can be found would be better off in the hands of the vrykul.

passages.title: Turtle Powered
passages.text:
In order to locate and purify the source of the corruption I am going to need an elemental focus.

The turtles around here have developed scales that can focus and amplify their innate magics. Bring back some snapper scales and we will have these waters purified in no time!

passages.title: Turtle Powered
passages.text: Remember, the scales need to be whole to be of any use as a focus.

passages.title: Turtle Powered
passages.text: These will do nicely.

passages.title: Final Preparations
passages.text:
We will need supplies for our trip into Suramar. We cannot exactly stop for refreshments at the gate with you two in tow, can we?

The water gardens were a place to socialize and relax. Before the patrols arrived it was rather trivial to hide some mana wine for later retrieval.

That's where you come in. Fetch some supplies and bring them to your friend, then meet me at the ruins north of the city. We will be ready to depart soon.

passages.title: Final Preparations
passages.text: Did you find the smuggler? What did they say?

passages.title: Final Preparations
passages.text:
Is that mana wine? For me?

<Iadreth hungrily gulps down the bottle.>

You and this Astoril have my thanks. I would surely have perished out here.

passages.title: Finishing Touches
passages.text:
Well, I've managed to repair the ring, but the gem still needs work.

Say... you're a gemcutter, <name>. You've got the tools, so cut those jewels!

passages.title: Finishing Touches
passages.text: How'd you do?

passages.title: Finishing Touches
passages.text:
Oh yes! That is a choice-lookin' skystone.

<Timothy pops the stone into the fixed ring.>

Like a painter or poet, I'm a master'n you know it!

Tell ya what, since you did all the legwork, I'll share the design for this ring with you.

passages.title: Finishing Touches
passages.text:
Well, I've managed to repair the ring, but the gem still needs work.

Say... you're a gemcutter, <name>. You've got the tools, so cut those jewels!

passages.title: Finishing Touches
passages.text: How'd you do?

passages.title: Finishing Touches
passages.text:
Oh yes! That is a choice-lookin' deep amber.

<Timothy pops the stone into the fixed ring.>

Like a painter or poet, I'm a master'n you know it!

Tell ya what, since you did all the legwork, I'll share the design for this ring with you.

passages.title: Finishing Touches
passages.text:
Well, I've managed to repair the ring, but the gem still needs work.

Say... you're a gemcutter, <name>. You've got the tools, so cut those jewels!

passages.title: Finishing Touches
passages.text: How'd you do?

passages.title: Finishing Touches
passages.text:
Oh yes! That is a choice-lookin' azsunite.

<Timothy pops the stone into the fixed ring.>

Like a painter or poet, I'm a master'n you know it!

Tell ya what, since you did all the legwork, I'll share the design for this ring with you.

passages.title: Making the Cut
passages.text:
Seeing as how you've been quite a reliable resource, I'm willing to teach you how to cut a Deadly Deep Amber.

We'll be using my cutting tool to do this, so whenever you're ready, go ahead and sit yourself in front of it.

passages.title: Making the Cut
passages.text: Make sure not to break the raw gem. We don't just have a stockpile of those lying around.

passages.title: Making the Cut
passages.text:
<Tiffany examines your work.>

I see. I would have ground this facet's angle differently... but your work is passable.

Why don't I write down my design for you. That way, you can try to be more like me.

passages.title: Making the Cut
passages.text:
Seeing as how you've been quite a reliable resource, I'm willing to teach you how to cut a Quick Azsunite.

We'll be using my cutting tool to do this, so whenever you're ready, go ahead and sit yourself in front of it.

passages.title: Making the Cut
passages.text: Make sure not to break the raw gem. We don't just have a stockpile of those lying around.

passages.title: Making the Cut
passages.text:
<Tiffany examines your work.>

I see. I would have ground this facet's angle differently... but your work is passable.

Why don't I write down my design for you. That way, you can try to be more like me.

passages.title: Making the Cut
passages.text:
Seeing as how you've been quite a reliable resource, I'm willing to teach you how to cut a Masterful Queen's Opal.

We'll be using my cutting tool to do this, so whenever you're ready, go ahead and sit yourself in front of it.

passages.title: Making the Cut
passages.text: Make sure not to break the raw gem. We don't just have a stockpile of those lying around.

passages.title: Making the Cut
passages.text:
<Tiffany examines your work.>

I see. I would have ground this facet's angle differently... but your work is passable.

Why don't I write down my design for you. That way, you can try to be more like me.

passages.title: Raising the Drogbar
passages.text:
Word travels fast around Dalaran, <name>. And the latest word is that there's a master jewelcrafter somewhere in Val'sharah.

I want you to go down there and find this master. Perhaps they have designs that can help bolster business here at the shop.

I've heard the name "Lasune Starblade" tied to these rumors. She might be a good place to start looking.

passages.title: Raising the Drogbar
passages.text: Those damned harpies ambushed Jabrul!

passages.title: Raising the Drogbar
passages.text: Jabrul thanks you, <name>.

passages.title: Lapidary Lessons
passages.text:
It's good to see you again, <name>.

It seems we've both been busy since last we spoke. I have something that you may be interested in.

A recent shipment of rare jewels called maelstrom sapphires have finally arrived here at the shop.

I came up with a beautiful design for them and would like to show you how to cut them into something useful.

passages.title: Lapidary Lessons
passages.text: I'd recommend keeping a steadier hand than usual with these jewels.

passages.title: Lapidary Lessons
passages.text:
<Tiffany looks over the gem and nods her head.>

Very good work, <name>. It seems your skills have improved since the last time you cut something for me.

Enjoy that design, it's one of my finest.

passages.title: Hidden Intentions
passages.text:
Word on the street is, yer a reliable resource for getting things done, let's say, discreetly.

So here's the job. I need a new set of lock picking tools. But not just any old lock picks will do.

I need something special, something that won't break if ye apply too much pressure.

I'm thinking a set of diamond lock picks might do the trick. That would be lock picks made out of diamond, not the ones shaped like a diamond.

Look, ye in or what?

passages.title: Hidden Intentions
passages.text: Try not to attract too much attention, okay?

passages.title: Hidden Intentions
passages.text:
<Clive looks over the lock picks.>

Not bad, not bad.

Listen, me friend, you've done me a great service today. I trust now that you have the design, should I ever need another set, I'll know who to contact.

<Clive gives you a sly wink of his eye.>

passages.title: Eyes of Nashal
passages.text:
Deadly eye of prophecy... a good choice. Before we can cut, though, we need gems.

Here stands a giant statue of Nashal, an ancient vrykul. Laid in its eye sockets are two of the stones we need.

Ascend the statue, take its jeweled eyes, and return them to Jabrul.

passages.title: Eyes of Nashal
passages.text: Jabrul is anxious to see these jewels up close.

passages.title: Eyes of Nashal
passages.text:
I hope these weren't too heavy for a small brul such as yourself to carry.

But these will be more than enough to show you a suitable design.

<Jabrul begins to carve one of the jewels into a design, instructing you how it's done as he works.>

passages.title: Eyes of Nashal
passages.text:
Quick dawnlight... a good choice. Before we can cut, though, we need gems.

Here stands a giant statue of Nashal, an ancient vrykul. Laid in its eye sockets are two of the stones we need.

Ascend the statue, take its jeweled eyes, and return them to Jabrul.

passages.title: Eyes of Nashal
passages.text: Jabrul is anxious to see these jewels up close.

passages.title: Eyes of Nashal
passages.text:
I hope these weren't too heavy for a small brul such as yourself to carry.

But these will be more than enough to show you a suitable design.

<Jabrul begins to carve one of the jewels into a design, instructing you how it's done as he works.>

passages.title: Eyes of Nashal
passages.text:
Masterful shadowruby... a good choice. Before we can cut, though, we need gems.

Here stands a giant statue of Nashal, an ancient vrykul. Laid in its eye sockets are two of the stones we need.

Ascend the statue, take its jeweled eyes, and return them to Jabrul.

passages.title: Eyes of Nashal
passages.text: Jabrul is anxious to see these jewels up close.

passages.title: Eyes of Nashal
passages.text:
I hope these weren't too heavy for a small brul such as yourself to carry.

But these will be more than enough to show you a suitable design.

<Jabrul begins to carve one of the jewels into a design, instructing you how it's done as he works.>

passages.title: Mysteries of Nature
passages.text:
Jabrul wants to show you his special crystals. Nobody knows what they do. Very mysterious.

If you want to learn how to make one, Jabrul would be happy to show you.

High in the mountains live storm drakes. They blast the cliffs with their lightning breath and sometimes blast so hard, they turn the rock to crystal.

Get a piece of that crystal and bring it back to Jabrul.

passages.title: Mysteries of Nature
passages.text: Got the stone?

passages.title: Mysteries of Nature
passages.text:
An excellent piece. Now watch carefully...

<Jabrul begins to carve the glass into a rather interesting shape, describing how the shape of the gem dictates its behavior.>

passages.title: To Dalaran, With Love
passages.text:
Jabrul was thinking that he'd like to come up to Dalaran and discuss jewel designs with the masters.

But Jabrul doesn't know how to get up to it. Jabrul did have an interesting idea that might work.

If you mailed Jabrul to Dalaran, then surely he'd arrive safe and sound.

passages.title: To Dalaran, With Love
passages.text: Jabrul is SO anxious!

passages.title: To Dalaran, With Love
passages.text:
That was a much rougher trip than Jabrul thought it would be. But nonetheless, Jabrul is here.

Jabrul can't wait to start working with the masters here!

passages.title: Turn Around, Nighteyes
passages.text:
Stranger, you must help me!

Nighteyes, my old friend... he was scouting ahead and I heard him cry out a warning. I tried to run after him, but in my carelessness I stepped in this trap.

He's so close, just on the other side of this ridge. Please find him!

passages.title: Turn Around, Nighteyes
passages.text: You must find Nighteyes!

passages.title: Turn Around, Nighteyes
passages.text: Thank you, <race>. I will tend to Nighteyes' wounds. Tell me what happened!

passages.title: A Different Source
passages.text:
I need you to fetch me something.

I think I might be on the verge of a breakthrough of a new source of magic, but I require tools. 

I can no longer access my workshop, but I have seen the smaller demons below using tools. Bring me one of their tools and I can save our people.

passages.title: A Different Source
passages.text: Did you find anything? I did not exactly get a chance to pack my things before I was exiled.

passages.title: A Different Source
passages.text: This was all you could find? I suppose it will have to do, although it is a primitive instrument.

passages.title: Power! Get The Power!
passages.text:
I need more power. I need more!

I can control the energies, and they are enough to sustain me. For now.

I will not end up withered, like those weaklings.

Go out into Felsoul Hold and slay the demons. Bring me their essence and make it quick!

passages.title: Power! Get The Power!
passages.text: Do you have the essence? I must have it!

passages.title: Power! Get The Power!
passages.text:
<Kyrtos greedily consumes the essence.>

Ahh, much better. My senses are focused and ready for research!

passages.title: Seeing Stars
passages.text:
You think those naga are good sport, little rabbit?

<Stokalfr chuckles.>

I would savor the chance to do battle with one of those barnacle-crusted behemoths.

If you want to impress me, bring me the stars from their heads. I might consider you a true <class> then.

passages.title: Jars for Jandvik
passages.text:
Last time we met, <race>, I was in a cage. You risked your life once before for my kin. Are you willing to aid me once again?

The serpents' attack has left many of us wounded. I require mending waters to perform my healing rituals.

I have seen the serpents use this water. Return any that you find to me.

passages.title: Discovery Requires Experimentation
passages.text:
I can sense residues of magic all over you. You will be useful.

I must study how the demon bodies can handle the fel energies in such large quantities. I have plenty of flesh to sample, but there must be something...

Go retrieve some spines from the nearby basilisks so that I may analyze their magical residues. No sense in both of us getting our hands dirty, is there?

passages.title: Discovery Requires Experimentation
passages.text: I hope you brought enough. I will require more energy before my studies are complete.

passages.title: Discovery Requires Experimentation
passages.text: Fel magic is... strange. Almost slippery like an oil, and it burns long and hot. Maybe there's a connection...

passages.title: The Black Tome
passages.text:
I have made a great discovery, <name>.

There is a powerful warlock in the Soul Engine, in possession of a powerful tome. It contains forbidden secrets to summoning the most powerful of demons.

Even the Legion is afraid to call on these fel lords, but now I possess knowledge beyond theirs.

Fetch me the tome and I will never want for magic again.

passages.title: The Black Tome
passages.text: The tome! Do you have it?

passages.title: The Black Tome
passages.text: Yes... Within these pages lies the secret to true mastery of this power.

passages.title: Redistribution
passages.text:
I would imagine you thought I would simply have wine to deliver.

<Deline chuckles.>

If it were that easy, his people would not be starving.

<Her expression becomes serious.>

These... loyalists, shall we say, enjoy abundance. They dance to the Magistrix's whims and so they have all that they need.

There is no Arcwine shortage. The Magistrix created one to keep us in line.

They will not miss a few bottles. They have plenty.

Search the square and bring as much as you can carry back.

passages.title: Redistribution
passages.text: Did you find enough?

passages.title: Redistribution
passages.text: I will see that this gets back to our friend safely. Good work.

passages.title: An Ancient Recipe
passages.text:
Suramar is... was... an intellectual's dream.

We studied everything in there, from alchemy and the arts to the very nature of magic itself. How could we be so foolish as to accept them in?

Look at me, lost in the clouds again when there is much to be done. My work requires some fairly difficult ingredients, <race>. Perhaps you would help me procure them?

I am going to need some harpy talons. Crushed into a powder, they will be a potent reagent.

passages.title: An Ancient Recipe
passages.text: Do you have what I require, <race>? We don't have much time to spare.

passages.title: An Ancient Recipe
passages.text: That should be plenty. Talondust loses its potency fairly quickly, so we must make haste.

passages.title: Casual Redistribution
Cling to Hope
passages.text:
Your kindness has inspired me, friend.

I thought I would wander forever among the empty husks of the Withered, but Thalyssra invited me in.

I have chosen to remain here with my people and together we will take back Suramar.

For now I have but one request.

Take this letter to my wife. She should know that I still live, among other things.

Give her the hope that you gave me.

passages.title: Cling to Hope
passages.text: <Noressa eyes you suspiciously.>

passages.title: Cling to Hope
passages.text: Absolon... is alive?

passages.title: In My Sights
passages.text:
I used up all me bullets on a wee invention of mine. I call it: Tha Deployable Bullet Dispenser!

Oh aye. It shoots in-der-scriminantly wit'out all that messy and time-consumin' "aiming" or "thinkin'" that us people-folk are wont ta do.

We had deployed quite a few of 'em east o' here when this swarm of plants came a'thrashin from tha trees.

I didn't 'ave time ta go back an' get me turrets. Would ye mind gettin' them back fer me? Or at least, what's left of 'em?

passages.title: In My Sights
passages.text: Those mean greenies better not've touched me dispensers!

passages.title: In My Sights
passages.text:
Ohhh me poor innocent bullet dispensers! Look what they've done ta yeh.

Well at least they went down shootin', tha's how I'd like ta go.

Ere's tha schematic fer 'em. Deploy 'em near somethun' yeh don't like!

passages.title: Bubble Baubles
passages.text:
Ol' Hobart wanted me ta gather up these shiny, glass trinkets the murlocs carry around, but those bloody buggers ain't willin' to jes' hand 'em over!

I tried the dip-ler-matic approach, but I don't speak murloc, so I just end up shootin' 'em.

Maybe you might have better luck gettin' them baubles.

passages.title: Bubble Baubles
passages.text:
Any luck?

Did yeh try shootin' 'em?

passages.title: Bubble Baubles
passages.text: Well lookie there! You managed to talk 'em outta their trinkets! Ye'll have to teach me their language someday.

passages.title: Keep Yer Powder Dry
passages.text:
So while we've got all tha parts for tha pack again, I'm afraid I'm all outta gunpowder.

This is the worst thing ta ever happen ta me.

But there's hope. Just o'er to tha north are caves filled with crashed ships. Chances are them sea giants crashed one or two ships with cannons. And cannons mean gunpowder, sweet gunpowder.

Search their caves fer sum powder an' bring it on back.

passages.title: Keep Yer Powder Dry
passages.text: Try not ta get it wet, I dunna feel like waitin' fer it ta dry out.

passages.title: Keep Yer Powder Dry
passages.text:
Oh aye, tha's plenty, lad. I made sum adjustments ta tha design fer tha gunpack.

You should probably hold on to 'em, seein as 'ow these inventions of Hobart keep explodin' on me.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Trigger Happy
passages.text:
In order to complete my latest invention, I need a special relic known as the Runestone of Vitality.

Odyn, king of the Halls of Valor is known to use it to breathe life into his constructs.

What I'm asking is no easy task, but I need to take the runestone from Odyn and bring it back to me.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Trigger Happy
passages.text: I'm glad you're the one going up against a god and not me.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Trigger Happy
passages.text:
Keep your fingers crossed, <name>, and let's hope this works.

Yes! YES! It's alive, ALIVE!

Now I can mass-market these gun parts as toys for children!

passages.title: Fresh Meat
passages.text:
This crater is infested with felfire basilisks.

They may not be the most cunning of creatures, but they are as vile and dangerous as any demon.

However, they may yet prove useful to us. Slay the basilisks, but return to me with chunks of their fel-infused flesh.

I have plans to make use of their freshly carved flesh...

passages.title: Fresh Meat
passages.text: Do you have the Fresh Fel-Flesh I require?

passages.title: Fresh Meat
passages.text:
I see that you have returned with the freshly carved remains of the fel basilisks.

Listen closely, and I will explain the purpose behind retrieving them...

passages.title: Grimwing the Devourer
passages.text:
You have my thanks for rescuing me from captivity, <class>.

However, Azoran is no mere demon. He is a powerful eredar who commands great rank within the Burning Legion.

If you wish to continue with me, I need proof of your strength.

Grimwing the Devourer is the strongest of the felbats and a suitable test of skill. Place the basilisk flesh upon the altar to the north and slay Grimwing when she appears.

Return to me with her head and I will not doubt your ability.

passages.title: Grimwing the Devourer
passages.text: What news do you bring of Grimwing the Devourer?

passages.title: Grimwing the Devourer
passages.text:
Grimwing was a formidable demon... I must say I am impressed with your skill, <name>.

There are many more demons here to kill. It is good to have someone capable at my side.

passages.title: Fel Bent for Leather
passages.text:
Ah, my faithful assistant. I have just the task for you.

As you have seen, fel power permeates living tissue and can easily be coaxed out.

Also, these damned bats are driving me to my wits' end. There is an opportunity to kill two bats with one blade, it seems. Your blade.

Take this crystal. It should rip those hellions from the sky and into your waiting arms.

You may as well bring back their hides, if only to shut up that fellow in the corner for a few moments.

passages.title: Fel Bent for Leather
passages.text: Have you obtained the hides?

passages.title: Fel Bent for Leather
passages.text: I can no longer hear their shrieking. Finally, peace and quiet!

passages.title: Symbols of Power
passages.text:
This demon has information that could lead us to those in charge.

Unfortunately, he is more fearful of his master than he is of us. We need to change his mind about that.

The most powerful Burning Legion soldiers often carry an emblem of their rank and status within the demon army.

Seek out the stronger demons in Felsoul Hold, slay them, and return to me with their emblems.

We will show this wyrmtongue servant who it is he should fear...

passages.title: Symbols of Power
passages.text: Do you have the Legion Emblems?

passages.title: Symbols of Power
passages.text:
I see you have returned with the emblems. Excellent.

Let's see how this wyrmtongue reacts when we show him what we've made of his comrades.

passages.title: Opening the Test Kitchen
passages.text:
I can cook, but I can't really hunt... or even fish, for that matter.

If you bring me ingredients, however, I will use them to research new recipes for you.

We can start with the few fish I managed to scrounge up. You'll find them in the barrel in the back of the kitchen.

passages.title: Opening the Test Kitchen
passages.text: Mackerel may not be extravagant, but it will fill your belly.

passages.title: Opening the Test Kitchen
passages.text:
We've done it! With this technique, we should be able to prepare dried mackerel strips much more efficiently.

I am certain that there is much more we can learn. Keep bringing me ingredients, and I will keep the oven on!

passages.title: King Forgalash's Burden
passages.text:
That sea witch spoke the truth.

I witnessed the Tidemistress confer with King Forgalash on several occasions.

Kill Forgalash and bring the prow from his shoulder to Fjolrik as proof of his demise.

I will meet afterwards in the center of Jandvik. I need to warm myself by its fires.

passages.title: Sigil Reclamation
passages.text:
The smooth square sigil weighs a fair amount more than its appearance would suggest. 

Handling it results in an intense tingling sensation in your palm- this is an object of focused, pure power. 

Such an advantage should not be so easily surrendered to the Nightborne.

passages.title: Sigil Reclamation
passages.text: What is this?

passages.title: Sigil Reclamation
passages.text: You were wise to keep these out of our enemies' hands, <class>. I believe you can be trusted.

passages.title: Shard of Vorgos
passages.text:
According to the wyrmtongue servant, there is a portal that will take you into the Burning Legion command ship. However, the portal is locked to those without the keys.

The first key shard is held by an Ered'ruin known as Vorgos. He resides within the Fel Breach, which is at the end of the Arcway.

Slay Vorgos and place the key shard into its position next to the portal.

passages.title: Shard of Vorgos
passages.text: <The Shard of Vargos pulses in your hand.>

passages.title: Shard of Vorgos
passages.text: <The Shard of Vorgos locks into position next to the portal. Swirling fel energy collects around the shard, filling the room with an ominous, dark presence.>

passages.title: Shard of Kozak
passages.text:
The demon leading the operation in Felsoul Hold is an eredar named Azoran. In order to get to him, we will need to open a portal to the Burning Legion command ship.

Azoran has a demon jailer in his service known as Kozak the Afflictor.

Kozak the Afflictor holds one of the key shards necessary to open a portal to the ship. He can be found in the prison quarters known as the Halls of the Eclipse in the lower portion of Felsoul Hold.

Slay Kozak and place his key shard next to the portal.
