Bridgeport is protected by a garrison of Proudmoore marines. The Ashvane Company has a lot of nerve moving illegal weapons right under their noses.

Come on, let's check it out.

passages.title: Under Their Noses
passages.text:
<Flynn pretends not to notice you, but whispers at you.>

Of course it's her.

passages.title: Wendigo Away
passages.text:
If the unearthly howls coming from the Highlands at night are any indication, the wendigos must have some sort of leader or alpha.

I tell you, it's the sort of sound that could only come from some sort of massive, hulking, flesh-eating abomination.

Definitely something that could tear us limb from limb, and munch on our frail bones, all without breaking a sweat. How exhilarating!

I'm sure it'll be no problem for us to handle though.

passages.title: Wendigo Away
passages.text: Marvelous! Slaying their leader ought to put some fear into 'em.

passages.title: Power of the Overseer
passages.text:
Overseer Nerzet is very cruel, and oh so easy to provoke! 

It makes her very angry when things go missing, or move, or change... my crew and I are having a yip of a time! That you got this device to work was certainly a bonus!

It will be much easier for us to finish up what we need to do here, with her out of the way. 

Um, and maybe go ahead and grab that neat power rock she carries. It could come in handy.

passages.title: Power of the Overseer
passages.text: Were you able to end her reign?

passages.title: Power of the Overseer
passages.text:
Hmmm. I am tempted to sell this stone, it must be quite valuable. 

However, with what you have shown us today, I think there may be more value in having it with us.

passages.title: Magic Decoder Device
passages.text:
We retrieved this device from the sethrak in the ruins to the east, but have not been able to use it.

When you approached, it started to glow. Something about you...

<Maaz pauses and eyes the stone on your neck.>

...or on you... is waking it up!

Please, <class>, use the scepter and examine the statues of the Keepers, in the central courtyard of the ruins. Something there got their overseer very excited.

passages.title: Magic Decoder Device
passages.text: What did you discover?

passages.title: Magic Decoder Device
passages.text: Oh, thank you, danger noodle. This will give us just the angle we need to get the most out of what we find here. Your arrival was most fortuitous!

passages.title: The Missing Handler
passages.text:
I just received word from Warbeast Kraal dat one of their handlers is missing.

Dis is not usually a problem, but dey are expecting a large hatching dis year. Dey will need all de hands dey can get!

Go on and see if you can find de handler, name of Bazo or something, and tell him to get back to de Kraal.

passages.title: The Missing Handler
passages.text: <Handler Bazkoji rests with his sword still held in hand. He died fighting.>

passages.title: The Secrets of Zul'Ahjin
passages.text:
You're not the only one who came to Zul'Ahjin looking for answers. The place is crawling with looters and assassins, all searching for something... 

So far, they've come up empty handed, but that's because they don't know where to look.

I do. 

Investigate the statue at the center of the ruins. It is the key to uncovering the city's ancient secrets.

passages.title: The Secrets of Zul'Ahjin
passages.text: <The ancient stones hum with magic.>

passages.title: An Explosive Opportunity
passages.text:
You there!

Do I have the most AMAZING opportunity for you? A gnome named Wulferd Fizzbracket is on the eve of a breakthrough and could use an intrepid business partner that's on the brawnier side. Such as a <class> like yourself.

Just follow the road east until you reach Fizzsprings Resort, the most fantastical wonder of nature. Wulferd is the type that stands out from the crowd.

passages.title: An Explosive Opportunity
passages.text: A willing assistant? Well I can't turn you down now, can I?

passages.title: The Hunters of Kennings Lodge
passages.text:
HELP WANTED!

As we turn into the busy season, Kennings Lodge is looking for recreational hunters to assist with fulfilling the ever growing list of orders from Boralus. These are short term positions which will be paid relative to performance. 

Kennings Lodge can be found by following the south road past the mining yard. Report to Alanna Holton on arrival.

passages.title: The Hunters of Kennings Lodge
passages.text: You came from Bridgeport? Let's get you working, then.

passages.title: Temple of Sethraliss: Avatar of the Loa
passages.text:
We cannot let Mythrax bring his destruction upon this world once more. 

We need our loa now more than ever, but she has yet to return to us.

The time of her rebirth has passed. Someone, or something, must be preventing her awakening.

Enter her resting place and see what you can uncover.

passages.title: Temple of Sethraliss: Avatar of the Loa
passages.text: We cannot let Mythrax bring his destruction upon this world once more.

passages.title: Temple of Sethraliss: Avatar of the Loa
passages.text: Behold, <name>. Sethraliss has returned.

passages.title: Back to the Lab
passages.text:
Our work here is done!

Well, at least until another one of my humble experiments goes horribly awry, rapidly spiraling out of control into a chain reaction of catastrophic failures.

But, let's worry about that another time, adventurer.

I'll meet you back at my lab!

passages.title: Back to the Lab
passages.text:
Well, we had quite the adventure <name>.

Let's try not to do that again anytime soon though!

passages.title: Sulthis' Stone
passages.text: <The ancient reliquary contains a single stone, humming with magic. Perhaps Serrik will know what it is?>

passages.title: Sulthis' Stone
passages.text: What have you found?

passages.title: Sulthis' Stone
passages.text: This stone... I've seen one like it before.

passages.title: To the Other Side
passages.text:
It looks like the coven is using Corlain as a base of operations. There's no way we'll be able to cut through this many of them without the rest of the Inquisitors.

They must still be stuck behind the wall. 

<class>, there are three smaller footmen gates along the walls into Corlain. See if you can get them open so our allies can make their way through.

passages.title: To the Other Side
passages.text: What news of the other inquisitors?

passages.title: To the Other Side
passages.text:
All here and accounted for?

Very well, we've no time to waste. We must ride to Waycrest Manor!

passages.title: Ruinous Rituals
passages.text:
Take a look in the city square, <class>.

<Marshal Reade gestures toward a ritual being performed by some disciples in the distance.>

It appears the coven has gone beyond dark constructs, and are now conjuring creatures of nightmare with their rituals. Let us not wait to see what these monsters are capable of. We should put an end to them right here.

Fortunately, the disciples seem too focused on their spell to notice us. Maybe you can use that to your advantage.

passages.title: Ruinous Rituals
passages.text: Have the monsters been abolished?

passages.title: Ruinous Rituals
passages.text: I am glad we were able to stop those things here, before the coven could unleash them on Drustvar's unsuspecting citizens.

passages.title: Hexecutioner
passages.text:
It would appear that this is where the coven is training their new acolytes. Our efforts may be for naught if they continue to expand their numbers.

I cannot leave Lucille's side in this place, but you have already shown yourself a formidable combatant. 

Cut them down.

passages.title: Hexecutioner
passages.text: The people of Drustvar will sleep more soundly with less witches in the world.

passages.title: The Fall of Corlain
passages.text:
<This discarded journal looks like it belonged to one of the residents of upper Corlain. Within it details some early signs of the Heartsbane's appearance in Corlain.

If you can find more writings like this, you might be able to piece together the events that led to Corlain's current state.>

passages.title: The Fall of Corlain
passages.text:
This tale... such a tragic fate to befall my home...

We must make this right, <class>!  For the people of Corlain and all of Drustvar!

passages.title: Storming the Manor
passages.text:
Now is our chance. Waycrest Manor is just up that hill, and hopefully inside we'll find my mother and father. 

If we also manage to find the "Mother" that's leading this horrible coven, then we will make her regret the day she ever set foot in Drustvar.

Are you with me, <class>?

passages.title: Storming the Manor
passages.text:
I'm sorry... this is all a bit too much...

Thank you, <class>, for protecting me.  I think I'm going to need a moment...

passages.title: A Bloody Mess
passages.text:
<The vial is filled with a viscous, bubbling substance. It bears a striking resemblance to the animated horrors around you.

It struggles against the container, as if trying to escape. Pike would surely be interested in more samples.>

passages.title: A Bloody Mess
passages.text: What is that you have there?

passages.title: A Bloody Mess
passages.text: This tideblood is saturated with dark magic. Thank you for bringing it to me.

passages.title: Beneath the Veil
passages.text:
We must board the Abyssal Melody and save the myriad souls in her decks before they too disappear into the Shrine. We will not be able to enter so long as the barrier surrounding it stands.

The tidesages are using forbidden magic to summon extensions of their will. It is these grasps that maintain the barrier.

Take my beacon and mark each grasp. I will rain vengeance down upon them from here.

passages.title: Beneath the Veil
passages.text: Have the grasps been dealt with?

passages.title: Beneath the Veil
passages.text: The Abyssal Melody lies unprotected. Now is our chance.

passages.title: No Quarter
passages.text:
We arrived just in time. These abominations have already taken control of the docks; we're all that's left to keep them at bay!

You need to cull their numbers before we're overwhelmed. We don't exactly have an army here!

passages.title: No Quarter
passages.text: We're holding out alright thanks to you, but Sam is still missing!

passages.title: Exterminate the Vermin
passages.text:
On top of the fury of the overseer, and this "key" not being here, we have a pest problem.

Sneaky little vulperan thieves keep ransacking our site. We have taken some prisoner.

We have them around the upper level of the dig site, working off their misdeeds. However, I believe a more permanent solution would be preferred. 

Please, oh mighty cobra, give us the honor of getting rid of our prisoners with your most potent venom!

passages.title: Exterminate the Vermin
passages.text: They had what?

passages.title: Exterminate the Vermin
passages.text: Well played on the rescue. I can't decide if you're clever, or they're stupid. I like your odds, though!

passages.title: Zandalari Empire
passages.text: Assist the Zandalari Empire in Zuldazar by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: Zandalari Empire
passages.text: Return to me when you have finished aiding da Zandalari Empire, <name>.

passages.title: Zandalari Empire
passages.text: Da Zandalari Empire thanks you.

passages.title: Order of Embers
passages.text: Assist the Order of Embers by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: Order of Embers
passages.text: Return to me when you have finished aiding the Order of Embers, <name>.

passages.title: Order of Embers
passages.text: The Order of Embers thanks you.

passages.title: Voldunai
passages.text: Assist the Voldunai by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: Voldunai
passages.text: Return to me when you have finished aiding the Voldunai, <name>.

passages.title: Voldunai
passages.text: The Voldunai thank you.

passages.title: Tortollan Seekers
passages.text: Assist the Tortollan by completing 3 world quests.

passages.title: Tortollan Seekers
passages.text: Return to me when you have finished aiding the Tortollans, <name>.

passages.title: Tortollan Seekers
passages.text: You young-shells continue to surprise me.

passages.title: Forbidden Rites
passages.text:
These k'thir have been hiding among us, sowing the seeds of their dark masters with us none the wiser.

With the barrier around the Abyssal Melody lowered I can peer within; its bowels toil with my own people giving themselves to the shadow!

Take my tidal kris; its blade is now coated in purified tideblood. Put an end to these fiends and their foul rituals.

passages.title: Forbidden Rites
passages.text: Good. Each death brings this valley one step closer to redemption.

passages.title: From the Maw of Madness
passages.text:
Sam is still out there somewhere. We can't just leave him to die!

If he wasn't in the assembly yard, he must be on that ship. You have to find him!

passages.title: From the Maw of Madness
passages.text: That was a tight spot you got me out of back there. I owe ya my life.

passages.title: Gathering Storm
passages.text:
This depravity goes against every oath we take as tidesages. To protect our people... to guide and sustain them... to make our ships strong.

This is nothing but darkness. It must all be destroyed.

Board the Abyssal Melody and place these focusing rods at any critical points you find. I will prepare the ritual.

passages.title: Gathering Storm
passages.text: Now to finish the deed.

passages.title: Storm's Vengeance
passages.text:
I know not what horrors await us ahead, but the Abyssal Melody must never follow its sister into the Shrine of the Storm.

We will deny these monsters all that they have wrought here by burning it with the very magic they seek to corrupt.

The ritual is ready, but requires a conduit to stabilize. If you are willing, I would have you guide my magic.

passages.title: Storm's Vengeance
passages.text: Whenever you are ready.

passages.title: Storm's Vengeance
passages.text: A pivotal step, but our work is far from finished.

passages.title: A House Divided
passages.text:
Not all of House Stormsong have followed my Lord down this dark path. They know not - I knew not - the truth of his depravity.

Sagehold looms above us. It is where all tidesages study to wield the sea's power.

We will build upon the Storm's Wake and make my shattered home whole once more. We will save all who are willing. 

The rest will perish.

passages.title: A House Divided
passages.text: With any luck we will end this matter here.

passages.title: Freedom for the Sea
passages.text:
The naga along this coast appear to be trying to push the shoreline up the hill here. We've been able to keep them back at the beach so far, but they've been binding more elementals than we can keep up with.

Without a tidesage, we have no way to free the elementals from their bindings, but we cannot allow them to push forward anymore. The spirit of the sea should not be contained by anything. Slay them, and let them return to the ocean.

passages.title: Freedom for the Sea
passages.text: For a people that live in the sea, the naga seem to have little respect for it.

passages.title: Freedom for the Sea
passages.text: That should slow down their progress quite a bit. You have my gratitude.

passages.title: A Bit of a Bind
passages.text:
The naga sorceress leading this excursion seems to be in the process of binding a larger elemental. If she succeeds, we will no doubt lose our foothold here.

Strike out at her, perhaps you can catch her off guard and interrupt the ritual. Remove the head from these snakes.

passages.title: A Bit of a Bind
passages.text: Is the seawitch dead?

passages.title: A Bit of a Bind
passages.text: I have no idea what this might be, but I don't like the looks of it.

passages.title: Atul'Aman
passages.text:
Jakra'zet and his troops attacked while we were away. 

Serrik fought well, but it wasn't enough. The keys are gone, and it's only a matter of time before the barrier is broken.

Your friends have already given chase. 

Jakra'zet must not be allowed to resurrect Mythrax the Unraveler. He must be stopped before it's too late!

We don't have much time. 

Meet me at Atul'Aman! We must catch up with Kaja and Rakera and stop the ritual!

passages.title: Atul'Aman
passages.text: We must hurry. Your friends are already inside!

passages.title: Caught in the Net
passages.text:
When the naga force first arrived, there were a handful of the local fishermen out on boats. One of our scouts reports that most of them have been captured and are currently being kept in cages around the beach.

Free any of them you happen to find and point them back here. We'll get them armed and remind the naga that you don't mess with sailors!

passages.title: Caught in the Net
passages.text: With these numbers, we should be able to hold our own here. Oars and fishing nets make surprisingly effective weapons.

passages.title: Deal's Off
passages.text:
There's one more farm left, far to the west. They're real close to the kraul.

Deal works the land by herself. If anyone got hit bad, it'd be her. It's just past the worst part of the collapse, so keep an eye out for the quilboar.

passages.title: Deal's Off
passages.text: I'm glad to know the others are safe. But not for long if we don't do something about these quilboar!

passages.title: The Shifting Tides
passages.text:
I'm no tidesage, but even I can tell that whatever you have there is probably not a good sign for the bastion. 

There's one of those Tortollans, Rikal, who's been helping us figure out a solution to whatever the naga are planning in front of the levee. He'd probably like to see this.

passages.title: The Shifting Tides
passages.text: Hmm.... This is concerning. Very concerning.

passages.title: Waycrest Manor: The Fallen Mother
passages.text:
This is all a lot to process...

The Marshal... gone? My mother... the leader of the coven? It's just too much...

...but we have come too far to turn back now. It is clear that my mother and father, as I knew them, are gone. It is time we cleansed the taint from this land.

We must take the inquisitors and find them in Waycrest Manor. We will end this, once and for all.

passages.title: Waycrest Manor: The Fallen Mother
passages.text: This must be done.

passages.title: Waycrest Manor: The Fallen Mother
passages.text:
I do not relish what we've done, but it was necessary for the good of Drustvar.

I only hope the sacrifices we've made will be worthwhile in the end...

passages.title: Break Their Ranks
passages.text:
This temple is our last bastion against the Faithless. We need every able fighter to defend its walls. 

If you're offering to help, we won't turn you away. 

Head into battle and do what you can to break their ranks!

passages.title: Break Their Ranks
passages.text: We must defend the temple at all costs!

passages.title: Break Their Ranks
passages.text: Our temple will not fall at the hands of the faithless!

passages.title: The Warchief Commands
passages.text:
Silithus. That has been the name of the game... or rather, that is what I wanted the Alliance to believe. 

Make no mistake, Azerite is just as powerful as it is rumored to be but I have bigger plans in mind.

High Overlord Saurfang is leading an army towards Silithus. By now, he should be in the Northern Barrens. I want you to intercept him and notify him that the preparations are complete.

Preparations for what, you ask? Why, we are going to capture the World Tree.

passages.title: The Warchief Commands
passages.text: I have been awaiting your arrival, <name>.

passages.title: Facing the Invaders
passages.text:
While we try to figure out what to do with those channelers, we'll have to take shots where we can get them.

Our men could use some assistance retaking parts of the lower walls. Kill some naga for me, would you?

passages.title: Facing the Invaders
passages.text: Each one you killed is one less my men have to worry about. Thanks.

passages.title: Eeling in a Big One
passages.text:
If you are up to it, I have an idea to give the naga an amusing surprise.

<Rikal slowly pulls out a scroll and waves it in your face.>

I need some teeth from marine predators to cast the spell though. Luckily, the naga brought some disgusting eels with them. Go gather their fangs, and bring them back to me.

passages.title: Eeling in a Big One
passages.text: I can't wait to see how this goes.

passages.title: Eeling in a Big One
passages.text: That's exactly what I'm looking for. Give me a bit of time to prepare the spell.

passages.title: A Quick Diversion
passages.text:
I have halted our march until I received word that we were ready to divert.

What comes next will be a coordinated, synchronized attack on key outposts in Ashenvale. If we act quickly, we will destroy the kaldorei's defenses and clear a path all the way to Darkshore. 

Stormwind will surely send reinforcements to stop us. We have to conquer Teldrassil before they arrive.

I will divert the troops. Meet with our operative, Lorash, outside Astranaar for further instruction.

passages.title: A Quick Diversion
passages.text: Saurfang says it's time? Excellent.

passages.title: Everybody Has a Price
passages.text:
Hundreds of rogues have already attacked kaldorei outposts in Ashenvale. On my signal, they will begin the next phase of this war: sowing chaos.

My colleague died not far from here, <name>, so I could use your help. If we stay out of sight, the town won't even know it's under attack before we have all of its guards down.

I have a poison that will kill them quickly and silently. If you signal to me which targets are safe to attack without being noticed, I will put them down.

What do you say?

passages.title: Everybody Has a Price
passages.text: We did it! Hopefully the other outposts fared as well as we did.

passages.title: Filching from Thieves
passages.text:
The naga oft take what they want with little care for who they are taking it from. Perhaps we should do the same for them.

The sorceresses use powerful beacons to assist with their spellcasting. I could use these relics to strengthen my own ritual.

passages.title: Filching from Thieves
passages.text: Make sure you don't drop any of the beacons. I cannot say I know what will happen.

passages.title: Filching from Thieves
passages.text: Ah! How powerful! These will be a great help.

passages.title: Reclaiming our Defenses
passages.text:
We were holding off the naga up until the latest attack. A few of our forces are still out there.

The tidemaidens seem to be slowly torturing them to death. If you could save as many as you can find, we'd be one step closer to gaining the upper ground again.

passages.title: Reclaiming our Defenses
passages.text: That should slow down their progress quite a bit. You have my gratitude.

passages.title: Risky Rescue
passages.text:
The Faithless incursion is just up ahead. 

We tried to get ahead of the siege by attacking their camp in the dead of night, but they knew we were coming. 

Our troops were quickly overwhelmed. 

We called for a retreat, but only a few of us made it out. The fate of those that didn't is unknown...

We don't have the numbers to attempt a rescue ourselves. We can't afford to lose any more fighters. 

You're their only hope.

passages.title: Risky Rescue
passages.text: We are in your debt, <name>.

passages.title: Two-Faced Pirate Scum
passages.text:
We've been holding the Irontide off for days, but now they've brought in an ettin for reinforcements. We can't let him attack the town. 

A few of my best men just went up the hill to try and kill him. You look pretty capable, they could sure use your help?

passages.title: Two-Faced Pirate Scum
passages.text: Hurry <name> you've got to kill the ettin.

passages.title: Two-Faced Pirate Scum
passages.text: You've got skills we could use. You want join us and find the treasure before the Irontide?

passages.title: Treasure Hunting
passages.text:
The workers are digging day and night out there to find the lost treasure. You'd get an equal share like everyone else, if ya wanna help out.

Talk to Nedly about joining up.

passages.title: Treasure Hunting
passages.text: I saw you killing those Irontide, you want in on our action?

passages.title: Piercing the Shield
passages.text:
I've been talking with Rikal, and the tortollan says that our problem in the delta can probably be solved by turning the naga's magic back on them.

A few of the sorceresses on the south coast have a channeling wand that we may be able to use to break the head priestesses' ritual channeling. Find one, and bring it back here.

passages.title: Piercing the Shield
passages.text: We cannot allow this fort to fall!

passages.title: Piercing the Shield
passages.text: Even I can feel how much power this thing contains.

passages.title: Not On Our Payroll
passages.text:
The workers are complaining about elementals coming into the area while they're digging for treasure. 

Just this morning, I had two people crushed to death! It's slowing down the hunt! 

You can earn your share by getting rid of those elementals!

passages.title: Not On Our Payroll
passages.text: I almost trust you <race>.

passages.title: A Bloody Mess
passages.text:
My order blesses every Kul Tiran ship within the halls of the Shrine of the Storm. Our blessings make our ships the strongest in all of Azeroth; the fleet of legend.

The ritual requires a substance known as tideblood. It is a viscous, powerful substance dredged from the depths of the sea and infused into the very hull of each ship.

Something has caused the tideblood here to become animate. Studying it may help us better understand our enemy.

passages.title: A Bloody Mess
passages.text: The more tideblood you can bring me, the better.

passages.title: A Bloody Mess
passages.text: Thank you. This will help us indeed.

passages.title: Fun With Magnets
passages.text:
My last time in Tol Barad I had to leave in a big hurry, but I grabbed a few gadgets on the way out. 

This device is one of my favorites, so don't break it! It'll suck the treasure right out of the mud. It may make you tingle some, that's just the radiation.

Find lost coins using the metal collector near the signs I've placed.

passages.title: Fun With Magnets
passages.text: I like gold, let's find some!

passages.title: Fun With Magnets
passages.text: You got the coins, and only mild radiation poisoning.

passages.title: Bomb Beats Rock
passages.text:
I stole an old treasure map off an Irontide pirate. The map marks several caves on it with circles. 

The caves are blocked by boulders, but now that you're here, we're going to open them up.

You get to do all the dangerous stuff, plant explosives, kill things, and cave exploring. I'll supervise.

passages.title: Bomb Beats Rock
passages.text: Boom!  Problem solved.

passages.title: Problem Solving with Gunpowder
passages.text:
Fort walls only go so far when it comes to defense. We've got cannons in position to fire if the naga get too close, but we need some fortifications further out.

There should be a few good areas to set up some traps further down the beach. Those naga will never know what hit them!

passages.title: Problem Solving with Gunpowder
passages.text: If you run across any other opportune spots, feel free to set up more mines.

passages.title: Worker's Rights
passages.text:
Hey, you! You lookin' for work?

I ain't got a job for ya, but I can tell ya to stay away from Algerson Lumber!

Algerson'll promise ya some solid labor work and decent pay, but it's a lie I tell ya!

The conditions are terrible, we're gettin' attacked, and Algerson ain't even battin' an eye!

He don't care 'bout us little people. I'd stay away if I were you!

passages.title: Worker's Rights
passages.text: Why hello! Welcome to Algerson Lumber. How may I help you?

passages.title: Drust in Time
passages.text:
A few days ago, a band of Alliance researchers that called themselves the "Explorers' League" took a contingent of Kul Tiran soldiers to the old Drust ruins down the road.

We haven't really heard from them since, and I'm growing a bit concerned. I can't leave my post, so can you check up on the team?

passages.title: Drust in Time
passages.text: We might have a wee problem on our hands.

passages.title: Informing the Horde
passages.text:
General Jakra'zet has been defeated, but his plan to summon Mythrax succeeded despite our best efforts.

Were it not for the mercy of Sethraliss, I doubt we would have made it out of Atul'Aman alive.

We must inform our allies of what has transpired in Vol'dun.

I'll speak with princess Talanji myself. You should go and speak with the Horde. We need all the help we can get now.

I'm sure our paths will cross again, <name>. It was an honor fighting with you.

passages.title: Informing the Horde
passages.text: I shall inform the Dark Lady of your activities in Vol'dun at once. She will know how to best proceed against this  new threat.

passages.title: Anchors Aweigh Too Much
passages.text:
I got a little deal on the side, selling used ship parts to Addington Shipyards.

While you're out looking for the treasure, see what sort of useful parts you can salvage from the mud: anchors, cannons, whatever!

We'll sell them to Addington and cut you in for a share of the profits.

passages.title: Anchors Aweigh Too Much
passages.text: See what you can find out in the mud.

passages.title: Anchors Aweigh Too Much
passages.text: We'll make good money off these. No one will know they are used parts.

passages.title: A Snake with Three Heads
passages.text:
Now that all of the preparation has been done, it's time to tackle the main threat.

You can use the channeling rod you just found in conjunction with this scroll I got from Rikal to break the shields around the naga leaders in the delta.

Hurry! Stop them before they finish their summoning!

passages.title: A Snake with Three Heads
passages.text: Well, the bubble seems to be gone, but I don't like the looks of that whirlpool.

passages.title: Clearing the Delta
passages.text:
The greatest of the Zeth'jir offensive sits within the delta as we speak, waiting for the summoning ritual to be finished. If we can clear out a number of them, we'll finally have the upper hand.

Get down there and cause as much chaos as you can!

passages.title: Clearing the Delta
passages.text: This fort will always stand in defense of Kul Tiras!

passages.title: Clearing the Delta
passages.text: Good work! That should deter the naga for now.

passages.title: A New Dawn
passages.text:
House Stormsong may be lost, but this valley still holds so much hope. 

Sam knew that from the beginning.

We have to continue to help the Storm's Wake in any way we can. There are still remnants of the fallen house everywhere, and whoever turned them to this darkness is out there as well.

Cyrus and the others will want to hear about everything that happened. We should tell them together.

passages.title: A New Dawn
passages.text: I've filled them in on most of the details already. The Storm's Wake will be an invaluable ally if we're to reunite Kul Tiras.

passages.title: A Timely Arrival
passages.text:
My end of the bargain is done, <race>. 

I am going to check on the other outposts to make sure none of my brothers and sisters are in trouble. Meet with the Warchief and inform her that Astranaar has been secured. If everything has gone according to plan, she should be well on her way.

Oh, and try not to hog all the glory, yeah? 

<Lorash smirks at you>.

passages.title: A Timely Arrival
passages.text: That was a perfectly executed strike, <name>.

passages.title: Missing Business
passages.text:
Poor little Coda has been in quite the tizzy since his friends vanished. 

I found him here, out cold, after a sting from one of those awful wasps. Just a tiny bit of our sandstinger remedy got Coda right up, though!

Take some with you, and keep an eye out for other little ones out there.

passages.title: Missing Business
passages.text: Did you find them all?

passages.title: Missing Business
passages.text:
Oh thank goodness! We'll have to keep these little guys away from anything with a big mean stinger out here. Man, I'm going to be busy. 

If you could protect Coda's little brother, that would help us out a lot!

This is Poda!

passages.title: Zoram'gar Outpost
passages.text:
Saurfang shall establish our troops here, now that Astranaar is ours. I shall continue my hunt for the only creature that can stop our march to victory: Malfurion Stormrage.

Our next order of business will be to establish a foothold at the base of Darkshore. Commander Grimfang of the Zoram'gar Outpost should be able to accommodate an incoming army.

Inform him of our arrival and ensure the necessary preparations are made.

passages.title: Zoram'gar Outpost
passages.text: A force this large has not moved in Ashenvale in a long time. I hope Zoram'gar is ready to accommodate the might of the Horde.

passages.title: Don't Turtle
passages.text:
There's a Tortollan who's trying to get our treasure! He's over on the west side of town. He's nosey and he may have found something!

Talk to Moxie. Come up with a plan to get rid of him.

passages.title: Don't Turtle
passages.text: You deal with that Tortollan yet?

passages.title: Don't Turtle
passages.text: Worm meat for the box full of treasures!  You sure you're not a Goblin?

passages.title: All Laid Out For Us
passages.text:
<This is all the treasure Calico McGee's found so far. Packed up and ready to move out. More like all laid out for you to take!

You'll need a few extra hands to carry this much loot. There should be some Treasure Hunters from Deadwash around.

Ask Big Find Balor, Toothless Eddard, and Chopper Darry to help.>

passages.title: All Laid Out For Us
passages.text: Plundered McGee's treasure? Who's the pirate now!

passages.title: The Immediate Problem
passages.text:
I sent one of my lieutenants, a woman by the name of Bauer, to the fishermen's hamlet just down the road. We received a few reports of naga activity spreading down the coast in that direction.

We need those forces back as soon as possible. I would ask that you join her in assisting the villagers of the hamlet.

passages.title: Infiltrating the Empire
passages.text:
The heart of the Faithless empire rests just beyond this ridge. We will need to move swiftly and quietly to avoid detection once inside.

Thankfully, my former dwelling is nearby. I know a passage that should allow us to advance into the fortress with minimal resistance. When you are ready, speak with me and I will show you the way.

<Vorrik looks around suspiciously.>

I expected the Faithless to patrol this area... Keep your eyes open for anything suspicious along the path.

passages.title: Infiltrating the Empire
passages.text:
It's unconventional, but I believe Sethraliss would be pleased to see her shrine used to protect innocents in need.

And if these vulpera are fighting the Faithless, they will be useful allies.

passages.title: Crater Conquered
passages.text:
I can take it from here, adventurer. I'll rally these vulpera and march through the trenches creating chaos. Korthek and his armies will be forced to deal with us!

If you and Vorrik are going to make a move, you should do it now.

passages.title: Crater Conquered
passages.text:
I can hear the vulpera battle cries from here. It seems your friends have given us a window of opportunity. We musn't waste it.

I have a plan.

passages.title: Don't Drop It... Yet
passages.text:
The Faithless are training pterrordaxes as mounts so that they can rain down death from the skies.

Their skycallers have developed a means of storing volatile lightning magic into fragile crystals. Lightning bombs, in the simplest sense. The magic behind it is quite brilliant, really.

The bombs will be exceptionally useful if we can secure the aid of Rakjan, the powerful and fierce pterrordax at the top of this mountain.

Acquire as many as you can carry, while I will do my best to recruit Rakjan.

passages.title: Don't Drop It... Yet
passages.text: There are no end to the Faithless, so grab as many as you can carry.

passages.title: Don't Drop It... Yet
passages.text: Excellent! Rakjan appears willing to aid us, so we will certainly make good use of these.

passages.title: Free Ride
passages.text:
One thing I've learned during my time in Vol'dun is to not stay in one place for too long. And doubly so when the Faithless are involved.

We've done our damage here. Let's move before we get caught.

I procured a mount to take us back to Meerah and the others in Vorrik's Sanctum quickly. Don't worry, this Faithless won't be needing it anymore.

passages.title: Free Ride
passages.text: I'll have some of the vulpera stable that krolusk outside, in case we need to use it again.

passages.title: Infuriating the Emperor
passages.text:
It seems I underestimated Korthek's cowardice. I expected him to be behind the barrier, ready to ambush us. Yet, still he hides.

That allows us a few moments to prepare. We musn't waste them.

While I siphon power off of these immense crystals, you must thin the numbers of the Faithless here. I will grant you a powerful boon to speed you in your task.

When Korthek arrives, he will require our full attention.

passages.title: Infuriating the Emperor
passages.text: Excellent. Now we may focus on Emperor Korthek without distractions.

passages.title: Sanctuary Under Siege
passages.text:
I fear that Emperor Korthek was not lying when he boasted of his foolish plan.

If General Jakra'zet attacked the Sanctuary of the Devoted while we were away, there is a good chance that he now has everything needed to resurrect Mythrax.

We must hurry to the Sanctuary and stop Jakra'zet. Mythrax must not be reborn!

passages.title: Sanctuary Under Siege
passages.text:
We're too late. The keys are gone. 

Sethraliss... What have I done?

passages.title: Earl-E Bot Gets the Worm
passages.text:
It could take you days to get that much meat, and I don't want to wait around. So, we'll use a Bot as bait! 

You send EARL-E towards any disturbances you see in the mud. He'll make enough noise to scare any worms out. 

Then kill the worms, get the meat. I'll watch from here.

passages.title: Earl-E Bot Gets the Worm
passages.text: Do you have the meat yet?

passages.title: Earl-E Bot Gets the Worm
passages.text: This will make a nice Mud Worm Soup. I wasn't liking this box anyway.

passages.title: A Meal for Birds
passages.text:
I don't know why I agreed to this. We weren't supposed to be scavenging. 

Kiro gave me specific instructions to head to the basin and feed the buzzards.

I can't go back to camp until they eat, but I'm not heading into that basin while the sethrak are still swarming. 

Have you ever fed a buzzard? It's easy, I promise. 

You kill it, they eat it. That simple.

passages.title: A Meal for Birds
passages.text: They still look hungry to me.

passages.title: A Meal for Birds
passages.text:
I don't think I've ever seen these buzzards so satiated. How much did you feed them exactly? 

Doesn't matter. You saved my tail, for sure.

passages.title: Untame Slaughter
passages.text:
The Faithless rely on their krolusks for everything. They are mounts, battle companions, beasts of burden, and often even food to fuel the sethrak empire.

If we can disrupt their krolusks, we'll disrupt their whole empire. One broken wheel stops the caravan, eh?

Take out as many of their krolusk tamers as you can. That'll have a longer impact than just killing the krolusks.

passages.title: Untame Slaughter
passages.text: The Faithless will be nursing that wound for awhile. Well done.

passages.title: Running Late
passages.text:
I beg your pardon, but I am a little concerned at Lord Waycrest's tardiness.

I'd hate to be a bother, but would you mind checking on him? The ceremony awaits his presence.

You can find him in the bride's room, at the top of the tower.

passages.title: Running Late
passages.text: It must be around here somewhere...

passages.title: Running Late
passages.text:
Splendid! I'll just need to take a few moments to go over this and I'll be right down.

Please let Lucy and Alexander know I will be ready shortly.

passages.title: From This Day Forward
passages.text:
Lord Waycrest is on his way? Excellent!

You have my thanks, <sir/madam>. Please, take a seat.

passages.title: From This Day Forward
passages.text: What is going on here!?

passages.title: Blood in the Chapel
passages.text:
<Sir/Madam>, you have helped me before and I beseech you to do so again.

My guards are clearly outnumbered by these brigands. I must stay here to protect Lucille, so I will need you to assist in protecting the guests.

Are you able?

passages.title: Blood in the Chapel
passages.text: We must rout these knaves!

passages.title: Blood in the Chapel
passages.text:
Well done! My guards seem to have gained the upper hand, thanks to you.

But wait... where is Meredith?

passages.title: The Lady's Fate
passages.text:
Meredith never joined the ceremony. She might be in trouble!

Lucy is in shock, and I cannot leave her here. You must go in my stead to the tower, and ensure the safety of your Lady.

Do this for me, and you will be rewarded.

passages.title: The Lady's Fate
passages.text: What have you found?

passages.title: The Lady's Fate
passages.text:
Her mother ordered the assassination!?

I had known that she didn't agree with Lucy marrying a merchant, but I would never suspect she would go so far to prevent it!

Thank you, <class>.

passages.title: One Last Request
passages.text:
I can feel my bonds to this place slipping, and I have you to thank.

I would like to ask one more favor of you though. Please bring the ring you found to Lucille. It was meant for her to hold, not my dusty bones.

And <class>, do not tell her what has transpired here. She has enough tragedy weighing down her heart. I do not wish to add to it.

passages.title: One Last Request
passages.text: What... what's this?

passages.title: One Last Request
passages.text:
This... this is the ring Alexander was to give me at our wedding.  I had thought it long lost...

I do not know how you found this, <class>, but words cannot say how grateful I am. Alexander was very dear to me, and this ring was a symbol of the strength of our love.

It is good to feel that again...

passages.title: The Stormwind Extraction
passages.text:
My lady is shrewd indeed. If we are to infiltrate Stormwind City, we will need the very best the Horde has to offer, and yet a team so small as to be able to infiltrate the heart of Alliance territory unseen.

<Nathanos peers at the gathered group, stroking his chin.>

Yes, I see.

The path ahead is clear. Speak to me when you are ready to undertake the Warchief's mission, <name>.

passages.title: The Stormwind Extraction
passages.text: We must not fail the Warchief.

passages.title: The Stormwind Extraction
passages.text: Well, here we are. Zuldazar. We had better stick with Talanji and Zul for now. The Warchief will be interested to know what happens next.

passages.title: Effective Antivenom
passages.text:
The salve is ready. 

I work fast. Hopefully faster than the scorpid poison. 

Take this antivenom to your friend and see that he swallows every last drop. 

You should know within moments if it's been effective.

passages.title: Effective Antivenom
passages.text: Thank you for saving my life. I'm afraid we don't have time for formal introductions.

passages.title: Calldown: Cleaner
passages.text:
With these dust blowin' siro-ma-whosits all over this beach front, it's a pain to get our cleaners out onto the nodes.

Some of the crew wanted to check somewhere else, but no way we're leaving without those rocks for Gallywix. 

Between you and me, <class>, we're gonna be gettin' some serious hazard pay for this gig.

passages.title: Calldown: Cleaner
passages.text: All the resources been harvested?

passages.title: Calldown: Cleaner
passages.text: Not bad, chief! The crew should be wrapping it up soon.

passages.title: On The Prowl
passages.text:
Do you see all of the wisps about? I have seen this once before, when the demon Archimonde was felled by the sting of hundreds - no - thousands of wisps.

This can mean only one thing. Malfurion is beckoning the aid of his ancestors.

The Warchief has already taken a scouting party ahead to Darkshore to intercept him. Please, <name>. Find the Warchief and see if she has yet caught her prey. 

We have secured all of Ashenvale, but we must keep the pressure on.

passages.title: On The Prowl
passages.text: You may approach, <name>.

passages.title: On The Prowl
passages.text: I've been tracking Malfurion's every movement. The lord of the forest cannot hope to outmatch one who served as Ranger-General of Silvermoon.

passages.title: You're a Shark
passages.text:
Have you ever been bitten by a shark? I have, numerous times. It stings.

Murlocs don't usually survive shark attacks.

The ritual I had in mind is ready to cast. Let me know when you're prepared.

passages.title: You're a Shark
passages.text: I can't wait to see how this goes.

passages.title: You're a Shark
passages.text: How did it feel to be a murloc's greatest fear?

passages.title: No Bot Left Behind
passages.text:
You left Earl-E behind, and a giant worm ate him! He's got sentimental, uh... monetary value. 

We don't leave any bots behind!

Kill that worm and get Earl-E back.

passages.title: No Bot Left Behind
passages.text: What? Earl-E isn't going to help himself!

passages.title: No Bot Left Behind
passages.text: You saved Earl-E! I am forever grateful <race>.

passages.title: Get Us Some Beach
passages.text:
These guys are running out of "ammo" faster than we can replace it! 

I tells 'em, we're on a beach, you're in a sandblaster, suck it up!

They says it's against the cleaner driver rules for their local chapter.

I'm not buyin' it.

Grab us some more sand. Them sand monsters have gotta be full of the stuff!

We'll make it worth your time.

passages.title: Get Us Some Beach
passages.text: Ya get us the dirt yet?

passages.title: Get Us Some Beach
passages.text:
That should fill us up a few more bags. If they run out again, I'll make 'em break out the pickaxes.

I bet then a little self-fueling won't sound so bad!

Ungrateful sons of bellybutton lint...

passages.title: The Storm Awakens
passages.text:
I must watch over Samuel for now. I fear for the darkness assaulting his mind.

The fallen men and women around us were defectors from the house. There will be more like them within Sagehold. 

Find them, and tell them 'the storm awakens'. Knowledge of our cause has spread; we need to bring all we can to our side.

passages.title: The Storm Awakens
passages.text: Find all you can who will stand with us. We are stronger united.

passages.title: The Storm Awakens
passages.text: I saw some of the defectors leaving. I'm glad we got to them before Lord Stormsong did.

passages.title: Twisted Intentions
passages.text:
Sails... in the fog...

A light below... in the darkness.

Water rising... given form... the pain... 

AHHHH, THE PAIN!

Make it stop. Make it stop. Make the pain stop!

passages.title: Twisted Intentions
passages.text: I know Sam is unwell, but I think he's onto something.

passages.title: Twisted Intentions
passages.text: Their rituals are growing bolder. Sooner or later they're going to summon something they can't control.

passages.title: Oathbound
passages.text:
I took oaths, damn it. We all did.

When Lord Stormsong sent the first orders... well, you saw what happened. What matters is that our oaths are to our people, not Lord "Sells His Soul".

You won't find him here - he's deep in the Shrine by now, and no outsider will make it across the channel alive...

Not without a Tideguard to open the way.

<Victoria locks eyes with you.>

The Rod of Tides is the key to the front door, and it's kept here. Retrieve it and I can get you to him.

passages.title: Oathbound
passages.text: You do have the rod, right?

passages.title: Oathbound
passages.text: I see it deemed you worthy. Good.

passages.title: A Bridge Too Far
passages.text:
The bridge that once crossed this span is the only land route to the Shrine. 

It appears Lord Stormsong has sealed it to buy himself more time. We have been attempting to reopen the way to no avail.

However, the Rod of Tides you recovered may prove our solace. Veteran tideguards use it as a key of sorts to maintain the Path of Storms across these dangerous waters.

We will begin the ritual once more... if you will wield the rod.

passages.title: A Bridge Too Far
passages.text: Now that Lord Stormsong is aware of our intentions every moment is precious.

passages.title: A Bridge Too Far
passages.text: The way is opened at last.

passages.title: The Abyssal Council
passages.text:
The tidesages have a leading council beneath Lord Stormsong. They each oversee a different aspect of the order's work.

Wavespeaker Reid trains initiates here in the oldest form of tidesage magic: communing with the sea.

These deaths are on his hands. It's up to us to take him down.

passages.title: The Abyssal Council
passages.text: Well, Lord Stormsong's definitely aware of us now.

passages.title: Eye of the Storm
passages.text:
If Lord Stormsong wasn't aware of you yet, he is now. Your best shot is to reach him at the Shrine of the Storm before more of his followers fall back to his defense.

I can get you in, but you'll have to protect me. I'm in no shape to take down any more of these fiends.

And try to keep a low profile. The closer we get to the Shrine, the more power Lord Stormsong has at his disposal.

passages.title: Eye of the Storm
passages.text: This is the only way into the Shrine of the Storm.

passages.title: Make Our Case
passages.text:
Katherine has trusted Priscilla Ashvane as an advisor and a close friend for many years, even before they both lost their husbands at Theramore.

She's heard the rumors about Ashvane, just like anyone. Whether by fear or loyalty, she's chosen to ignore them.

It's time to finally open her eyes.

passages.title: Make Our Case
passages.text: Damnit! Where'd she go?!

passages.title: Enemies Within
passages.text:
We need to get Katherine to safety.

Help us take out some of these traitors!

passages.title: Clear the Air
passages.text:
Looks like Priscilla had a backup plan. Her goons set off some kind of smokescreen to cover her escape.

Clear out that smoke so the civilians can evacuate and we can secure the area!

passages.title: Skree...
passages.text:
<Kua'fon rests with his head under his wing.>

Skree...

<Perhaps the little guy could use a display of affection to raise his spirits.>

passages.title: Skree...
passages.text:
<Kua'fon rubs his face against your hand.>

Skree.

passages.title: Cave Commotion
passages.text:
Killing that worm stirred up a commotion in the caves below. The Irontide seem pretty excited. We better check it out.

Nedly's on his way, meet us near the caves.

passages.title: Cave Commotion
passages.text: It's the Irontide! They've found treasure in the caves below us!

passages.title: Seeking Shelter
passages.text:
I must head back to de arena. Razgaji will want to know what happened here. 

If you seek shelter, you will find it at de outpost not too far from here.
 
I will let our leader know you're coming.

Be safe, <name>.

passages.title: Seeking Shelter
passages.text: Yes, Julwaba told me to expect you.

passages.title: Prepare for Trouble
passages.text:
With the evidence you've gathered, we can prove that the Ashvane Company was behind the attack.

I would have preferred to do this in private, but I don't think we'll have the luxury. Look around - company men everywhere. 

Priscilla's got something up her sleeve...

Let's get some backup before we go in there and cause a scene.

passages.title: Prepare for Trouble
passages.text: Alright. It's time.

passages.title: SKREEEEE!
passages.text:
<Kua'fon opens his maw and issues a continuous screech.>

SKREEEEEEEEEEEEE!!!

<You know what to do.>

passages.title: SKREEEEE!
passages.text: SKREEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE!!

passages.title: SKREEEEE!
passages.text:
<Kua'fon licks his chops and sighs contentedly.>

Skree.

passages.title: A Turtle's Invitation
passages.text:
You have been most helpful <race>. Please visit me and the other Tortollans along the Jeweled Coast. 

We'll discuss soup and other pressing matters.

passages.title: A Turtle's Invitation
passages.text: You're arrival is most timely. We could use your help!

passages.title: Out on a Limb
passages.text:
Ah, there you are.

Kua'fon ran off into de jungle. I saw him head down de western path out of the Kraal but beyond that I could not say where he may have gone.

This kind of thing happens with the young. Our winged companions have a keen sense of adventure!

It would be helpful if yours could fly, but it is not yet time. I would check any reasonably high place that he could climb to, as a start.

passages.title: Out on a Limb
passages.text:
<Kua'fon seems mighty pleased with himself.>

Skree.

passages.title: Into the Woods
passages.text:
Careful, <name> -- the forest is still brimming with Stormrage's forces...

Look out behind you!

passages.title: Into the Woods
passages.text: Malfurion will soon return with an army.

passages.title: A Nose for Ptrouble
passages.text:
Ah, yes, I was wondering when you would come to check on your little one.

As you have likely noticed, he is not here. Little ones are very curious and often seek to leave the nest before they are ready. It is often the brooding mother's job to keep them from wandering.

What, did you think I was going to stop him?

<Wingminder Goja laughs.>

I heard some screeching to de west. Best hurry, or you may not have a hatchling to look after!

passages.title: A Nose for Ptrouble
passages.text: <Kua'fon makes a soft sound deep in his throat. He seems very pleased with himself.>

passages.title: Iron Low Tide
passages.text:
A few years ago I tried to join the Irontide. They said I wasn't "Irontide material", not cruel or heartless enough! 

So I teamed up with Nedly and Moxie here in Deadwash, and we started looking for treasure on our own. 

Let's show these Irontide they're not "Deadwash material".

passages.title: Iron Low Tide
passages.text: No one's gonna cry about a few less pirates.  I may even dance about it!

passages.title: I Want It All Now
passages.text:
These Irontide Raiders think they can just come in and take the treasure we've been hunting for months!

By rights, that treasure is ours! Get in there and get our share of it, before it's gone. 

By share, I mean all of it!

passages.title: I Want It All Now
passages.text: I want every piece of that treasure in there.

passages.title: I Want It All Now
passages.text: I'm going to be a rich man! You're not holding out on me are ya?

passages.title: Halting the Empire's Fall
passages.text:
Nazmir be havin' problem after problem, <name>. I not be knowin' how it can get much worse dan an Old God tryin' ta take over.

I be makin' me way back ta Zul'jan ta lead our efforts ta keep Nazmir safe.

Ya should return ta Zuldazar and let Baine know what be goin' on here. Maybe he be likin' dis here underrot, who knows?

I can get ya outta here and back ta Zul'jan, if ya be needin' it.

passages.title: Halting the Empire's Fall
passages.text:
So, an Old God lurks beneath the swamp and it's barely being contained?

Unbelievable. Princess Talanji was right in calling her father a fool. How could he let such a thing stay so close to his empire?

I will ensure that the warchief knows of your victory... and of our new problem.

passages.title: Break 'Em Out
passages.text:
An Irontide captain "Calico McGee" has been trying to scare us off for days now, but it's not working.

He's ordered his men to lock everyone up and sell us as slaves! They've brought enough chains for everyone!

Break the chains and set our workers free.

passages.title: Break 'Em Out
passages.text: With everyone free, we can get back to finding the treasure!

passages.title: Awakened Elements
passages.text:
It seems that all of this infernal blasting and hammering has stirred up... something.

I heard some screaming from over in that direction.

<He gestures vaguely to the north.>

If you could go take care of the situation, that would be most appreciated.

passages.title: Awakened Elements
passages.text: Did you remove the impediment?

passages.title: Awakened Elements
passages.text: That's better. Not sure how we were going to turn a profit if we had to keep replacing workers.

passages.title: A Horrible Place
passages.text:
This town is a horrible place full of bad people. All they care about is money! No one cares about the turtles!

The turtles are out there, thirsty, drying up, and getting stepped on by monsters!

You have to save the turtles for me!

passages.title: A Horrible Place
passages.text: They're still moving! Emma's going to be so happy they are still fresh!

passages.title: A Charming Tail
passages.text:
I think they would make great guardians, when they get older... with the proper training.

However, it seems some of my trainees have wandered off. There are so many things nearby that could harm them!

Between the walking sandstorms and angry plants... it's been safer to hide out here and look at night.

I'm so exhausted! 

Could you take this flute with you and play them a little tune? It will remind them to come back to me.

passages.title: A Charming Tail
passages.text: Yes! Thanks, <name>! They are so much happier now!

passages.title: A Lost Flute
passages.text:
<This little flute, while dusty, appears to be well cared for.

Its owner can't be too far away.>

passages.title: A Lost Flute
passages.text:
My flute! I've been looking everywhere!

Well, sort of...

passages.title: Ripe for the Picking
passages.text:
The kaldorei have finally halted our progress. In a perfect world, we could have marched all the way to Auberdine and taken Teldrassil before they could even slow us down - but it matters little.

Malfurion will try to hold us back until his fleet returns from Silithus. Until then, his army is too small - if only we could find a path through these damned wisps.

I have an idea. Let's have a chat with Saurfang.

passages.title: Ripe for the Picking
passages.text: The kaldorei have begun to reinforce Darkshore. Our path to Teldrassil will be more difficult than we had anticipated.

passages.title: Storm's End
passages.text:
I've no doubt he can feel our presence, but so long as Lord Stormsong maintains his spell the first move is ours. 

We have him surrounded, cornered like the rat he is. We must end this together.

passages.title: Storm's End
passages.text: Samuel was a good man, with a true heart. A fool... but our fool.

passages.title: Shrine of the Storm: Whispers Below
passages.text:
We must not let Lord Stormsong finish his work.

If he delivers the fleet to Azshara, all of Kul Tiras will be vulnerable. Countless innocents will perish -- or worse.

There is no time to wait for more of the Storm's Wake to arrive. We finish this now, for the good of all who call this valley home.

We finish this for Samuel.

passages.title: Shrine of the Storm: Whispers Below
passages.text: I pray we are not too late. The fleet must return home.

passages.title: Keep It Down!
passages.text:
There is a lot of noise and light coming from those filthy mechs down by the shore. No wonder my little hatchlings get so cranky!

They are shaking up a coast that is already unstable. You never know what one might wake up that way! 

Let them know they should be careful.

passages.title: Keep It Down!
passages.text:
Dangerous? Violence incoming? Tell us somethin' we don't know!

We ain't goin' nowhere until we get what we came for!

passages.title: The Port of Zandalar
passages.text:
King Rastakhan has given me orders to investigate de Harbor of Zandalar. De claim Princess Talanji has levied against General Jakra'zet for failing to maintain de safety of our kingdom is a serious accusation.

For dis task, I would have you join me so dat I might have an outside perspective. When you are ready, meet me in de Grand Bazaar.

passages.title: The Port of Zandalar
passages.text: Let us get to work.

passages.title: A Quick Flyover
passages.text:
Malfurion knows that his wisp wall is a temporary measure. He is buying time for reinforcements to arrive in Teldrassil.

It is imperative that we find a way through that wall, and quickly.

I want you to take our explosive reserves and apply pressure. You will not be able to bring it down, but you may be able to find us an opening. I will have a squadron ready to strike once you break ground.

Zarvik Blastwix should have a few bombardiers for the job.

passages.title: A Quick Flyover
passages.text: Done?

passages.title: A Quick Flyover
passages.text: How did it go?

passages.title: A Nose for Ptrouble
passages.text:
Ah, so you noticed he is missing again.

I would check de east this time. I heard some screeching from that direction.

I am sure he will be fine- after all, what sort of trouble could he get in with you looking after him?

<Wingminder Goja smiles just a touch sarcastically.>

Best find out.

passages.title: A Nose for Ptrouble
passages.text: <Kua'fon casually inspects his wings for damage. He seems very smug.>

passages.title: SKREEEEE!
passages.text:
<Kua'fon opens his maw and issues a continuous screech.>

SKREEEEEEEEE!!

<You know what to do.>

passages.title: SKREEEEE!
passages.text:
<Kua'fon inspects your hands for food and shrieks demandingly at you.>

Skree!

passages.title: SKREEEEE!
passages.text: <Kua'fon gurgles in satisfaction.>

passages.title: SKREEEEE!
passages.text:
<Kua'fon opens his maw and issues a continuous screech.>

SKREEEEEEEEE!!

<You know what to do.>

passages.title: SKREEEEE!
passages.text:
<Kua'fon licks his chops. His head bobs in satisfaction.>

Skree.

passages.title: Mast Effect
passages.text:
Kua'fon was peering over de edge and managed to fall off de cliff again.

Normally he gets back up here on his own, but it be taking too long this time.

Best go down to de beach and find him. He is probably stuck up one of de ship masts out there.

If he will not come down, you can try bribing him with more fish.

passages.title: Mast Effect
passages.text: <Kua'fon picks at his teeth with a wing-claw, carefully avoiding eye contact with you.>

passages.title: A Nose for Ptrouble
passages.text:
Kua'fon is getting very large. Perhaps he thinks himself equal to de beasts of this jungle.

He may well learn that he is not. You should find him before that lesson costs him his life.

I heard a commotion to de north. Start there.

passages.title: A Nose for Ptrouble
passages.text:
<Kua'fon spreads his wings and utters a piercing shriek. He had it the whole time.>

Skree!

passages.title: Blurred Vision
passages.text:
Look up.

See them, scattered among the trees? Those brightly glowing owls are not living, breathing denizens of the forest... they are Kaldorei magic. Sentries. A ruse -- reporting everything they see back to Malfurion.

We can't have that, now can we?

Deal with them, <name>. But take care -- they aren't the only enemies in the forest.

We cannot allow anything or anyone to stand in our way.

passages.title: Blurred Vision
passages.text: Nicely done.

passages.title: The Trees Have Ears
passages.text:
With the eyes of the forest shut, one thing remains: the ears. Ancients. 

They feel the vibrations of our footsteps and report our every move to Malfurion.

Got that torch handy?

passages.title: The Trees Have Ears
passages.text: These Ancients must be taken care of.

passages.title: The Trees Have Ears
passages.text: Come, Champion. Let us take this ancient grove.

passages.title: An Unstoppable Force
passages.text:
Now is the time to strike, <name>. 

Passing through the wall will not be easy, but I think it's something you can handle. Do what you must to prevail, and meet me on the other side. I will lead a squad of sturdy soldiers and as many demolishers as can survive the passing.

We may not make it to Darnassus today, but the outcome of this war does not rest on one victory alone -- it will come as the result of a thousand small victories.

So let's get started, shall we?

passages.title: An Unstoppable Force
passages.text: Malfurion will return with his forces, but until then let's press on.

passages.title: Royal Report
passages.text:
Blood magics practiced in de city, guards missing, and our chief spy, Yazma, is acting suspicious. We must present dis to Rastakhan, but without Yazma interfering.

Luckily, Rastakhan is a clever king, which is something his opponents often forget.

I have prepared a report in a code made by King Rastakhan and known only to myself and my brother, Habutu. Bring it to Habutu and he will see dat it gets to de king's ear.

passages.title: Royal Report
passages.text: Hmm. Zolani speaks highly of your deeds. Perhaps we may not need to kill you yet.

passages.title: All to Ash
passages.text:
All throughout our campaign here, I understood the warchief's objective. I saw her strategy... believed in its necessity.

With Darnassus in Horde hands, the Alliance would be paralyzed. Anger and fear would fester in their hearts until they cracked and splintered like deadwood.

But this... this will unite them. They will come for us. All of them.

Return to the Undercity, <name>. Speak to the warchief. We must make ready for what is to come.

passages.title: Surrogate Wings
passages.text:
It is not my way to coddle the young of my brood. But I think I will make an exception for your little one.

After all, I have seen you tend to him. It would be cruel to let your... efforts... go to waste.

Venture into Zuldazar city proper and find something that can act as a surrogate wing for your young one.

Wingminder Goja will know what to do next. Speak to him once you have it.

passages.title: Surrogate Wings
passages.text: Did Pa'ku offer any useful advice?

passages.title: Surrogate Wings
passages.text:
What is this?

<Wingminder Goja looks between you and the pterrordax and grins.>

Oh, I get it!

passages.title: Turn the Heat Around
passages.text:
<In standard goblin fashion, the Horde forces seem to be using flamethrowers to clear out the snow.>

<This one is still usable despite being beaten on, you could use it to destroy some of the goblin mining machinery.>

passages.title: Turn the Heat Around
passages.text: <Oh, the sweet sound of goblin-made explosions.>

passages.title: Maybe When You're Older
passages.text:
<Pa'ku squints down at the young pterrordax.>

Well, I am out of ideas. My son will take you back to the nest. Do not worry, this one can fly.

YOUR little one will need to get back on his own. It builds character.

Maybe he will grow out of this absurd deficiency in time.

passages.title: Maybe When You're Older
passages.text: How did it go?

passages.title: Maybe When You're Older
passages.text:
Pa'ku is Lord of Wind. Naturally she expects young of her brood to take the same joy in flight.

Your little one will come around. Some just take longer than others.

passages.title: A Missing Master
passages.text:
Master Ashton had me grab some healing supplies and run to Mayor Royston when those things attacked town. He didn't make it behind the barricade.

But if he's alive--and he's just crazy enough he might be--he's probably holed up in his cottage. With caustic compounds. And explosives.

Look, why don't you go check out his basement and I'll stay out of the blast radi- I mean I'll go see if the garden can be salvaged.

Try not to look flammable.

passages.title: A Missing Master
passages.text: Oh! You're not one of those monsters at all. Did you trounce those brutes?

passages.title: A Missing Master
passages.text: I appreciate your help in liberating the town! I was becoming quite concerned by these strange monsters.

passages.title: The Abandoned Passage
passages.text:
My people have known about this ancient passageway for generations, but none have dared enter before now.

The tunnel leads to the tomb of Mythrax the Unraveler and it is said that his power still radiates within the cavern. Who knows what horrors await us inside...

It appears that your friends have already gone inside to face Jakra'zet and stop him from raising Mythrax from the dead.

We don't have time to waste. We must find Kaja and Rakera before they confront Jakra'zet on their own!

passages.title: The Abandoned Passage
passages.text: Jakra'zet has already begun the ritual. We must stop him before it's too late!

passages.title: Smells Like Trouble
passages.text:
The Horde spilled a lot of blood in Brennadam. Now it's time to spill some more.

The scent of blood makes predators in these hills go crazy. We use it to lure animals when hunting. 

The Horde forces are occupying caves up in the hills. Toss these scent vials into the caves where the Force Commanders organize the attack. The smell should bring all the hills down upon them!

passages.title: Smells Like Trouble
passages.text: Those scent vials should help you eliminate both Force Commanders.

passages.title: Smells Like Trouble
passages.text: With you around, they won't try this again.

passages.title: Never Outgunned
passages.text:
This is our new home now, and we will fight to keep it!

We may be outnumbered here, but we aren't going to be outgunned.

Find us every axe, sword, spear, crossbow, and gun for our rebellion!

passages.title: Never Outgunned
passages.text: We'll need more than that. Find us some weapons!

passages.title: Never Outgunned
passages.text: This is a good start.

passages.title: Dangerous Game
passages.text:
Most of these Horde don't scare us, but we lost two people today to a group of forsaken keenblades. We've had trouble tracking them down, we could really use your help.

They're stealthy and dangerous fighters, so show no mercy.

passages.title: Dangerous Game
passages.text: Your skills are impressive.  I don't think any of us could have taken out those keenblades so easily.

passages.title: One Man Against the Horde
passages.text:
Me an' a few friends were trying to help some of the folks from Corlain flee safely to Arom's Stand after things started gettin' weird. I noticed some movement up the hill so I decided to come back and check it out. If the town goin' mad wasn't bad enough, now we have another problem to deal with.

The Horde.

<McKellis spits.>

Those fools have no place on our lands. Wash the snow with their blood.

passages.title: One Man Against the Horde
passages.text: The only good orc is a dead orc.

passages.title: Remix to Ignition
passages.text:
<A goblin mining machine is halfway sticking out of the snow.

Despite being buried, it seems to be in working condition. If only you had a key.>

passages.title: Remix to Ignition
passages.text: <The machine lays lifeless on the snow.>

passages.title: Remix to Ignition
passages.text: <With a bit of effort, you free the machine from the snow. It whirs to life upon using the key.>

passages.title: Akunda's Blessing
passages.text:
You have proven worthy of my blessing, <name>.

This means should you choose me as your loa, you can call upon my power when needed.

Commune at my shrine to receive my gift.

Know that whatever you choose, you will always be welcome within these walls.

passages.title: Akunda's Blessing
passages.text: I bestow my blessing upon my followers.

passages.title: Akunda's Blessing
passages.text: If at any time you require my gift, commune at a shrine built in my honor to receive my boon.

passages.title: Powder to the People
passages.text:
The Horde filth up on that hill seem to be mining some kind of ore I've not seen before.

If they've come all the way out here to find it, it must be valuable. Take what you can find!

passages.title: Powder to the People
passages.text: Did you figure out what they were doing up there?

passages.title: Powder to the People
passages.text: This just looks like a pile of junk!

passages.title: Falling With Style
passages.text:
<Kua'fon looks to the kite, then back at you. He looks to the kite again, poking his head forward deliberately. He slowly pans his gaze back to you.>

Skree.

<Time for another flight!>

passages.title: Falling With Style
passages.text: There is a method to Pa'ku's madness.

passages.title: Falling With Style
passages.text:
Another successful flight! I only hope it helps Kua'fon learn that de sky is his home, in time.

Do not worry, he will get back up to de nest on his own.

passages.title: An Unfortunate Event
passages.text:
<You have no means of identifying the corpse, but the clothing appears to be that of an imperial guard from Zuldazar.

A quick search of the area reveals a trail of blood that heads off to the west. Perhaps if you follow it you can discover the cause of death.>

passages.title: An Unfortunate Event
passages.text: You do not look like one of de prisoners. I... I could use your help.

passages.title: A Chance Sighting
passages.text:
One of the lookouts said he saw a bunch of blood trolls chasing after a Zandalari on the other side of the river.

He seemed to be dressed like your group. Why do you people keep running into trouble in this place?

I'll mark on your map where he was last seen. Just don't bring a horde of blood trolls over here, alright?

passages.title: A Chance Sighting
passages.text: <The Zandalari next to this antidote is barely alive.>

passages.title: Wisdom of the Wingless
passages.text:
<Kua'fon wheezes and quivers, exhausted.>

It's not going anywhere. Maybe it's time to seek someone without wings for advice.

passages.title: Wisdom of the Wingless
passages.text: I heard de screeching. Glad to see you still be in one piece.

passages.title: Dress for the Slide, Not the Ride
passages.text:
If Kua'fon is serious about flying, we're going to need to protect him.

Go get a berserker skull and some armor for it. Meet me down in Talanji's Rebuke and we'll get him dressed for success.

passages.title: Dress for the Slide, Not the Ride
passages.text: You got the things I asked for?

passages.title: Dress for the Slide, Not the Ride
passages.text: Now, perhaps, your companion will not be afraid of his next fall. Haha!

passages.title: The Joy of Flight
passages.text:
You be ready, <name>?

Kua'fon is ready to fly. Whether or not he can is another question, but all the same I will see you two back to the roost.

Climb aboard and guide him. I can't imagine he can see very well through that skull.

Ata and I will lead the way.

passages.title: The Joy of Flight
passages.text:
<Kua'fon pants from exertion, but he seems content with his efforts.>

Skree.

passages.title: Down, But Not Out
passages.text:
<Kua'fon wiggles happily in his new armor. He starts to pace restlessly back and forth. A taste for adventure has surely awakened in this flightless creature.>

Skree! Skree!!

passages.title: Down, But Not Out
passages.text: <Kua'fon lowers its head and gently nuzzles you. He is ready to follow you wherever you may go.>

passages.title: Greenstalker
passages.text:
The mighty wolf Greenstalker was once a protector of these forests. He has fallen under the sway of dark forces. My brother and I attempted to calm his spirit, but he is too far gone.

Use the charm I have constructed to weaken him. I ask you <class>, please, end his suffering.

My brother is still weak and I must stay to protect him. Go now before the wolf consumes us all!

passages.title: Greenstalker
passages.text: Did you free Greenstalker's spirit?

passages.title: Greenstalker
passages.text:
A grim but necessary task. I hope Greenstalker's spirit will find peace now.

Be careful, <name>. These woods are being twisted by ancient power.

passages.title: Zandalar Forever!
passages.text:
Bwonsamdi has whispered a warning to me: the enemy is on the move.

I have gathered what defenses I could in the time allowed but we are dangerously under powered. 

I can only hope that, thanks to your efforts, the loa will be with us this day.

Are you ready to defend Zandalar?

passages.title: Zandalar Forever!
passages.text: We have won the battle, not the war.

passages.title: We're Not Friends
passages.text:
I did some time in Tol Dagor with the captain of this crew, Calico McGee. He likes to hang back and direct his men from afar.

I just happened to have spotted him across the flats. You and I should go pay him a visit!

passages.title: We're Not Friends
passages.text: I never liked his cat.

passages.title: Walking-Around Money
passages.text:
This is a lot of gold! It's gonna take me a while to split this up. I can give you some walking-around money to hold you over until I am done.

Come back tomorrow, maybe I will have it figured out.

passages.title: Walking-Around Money
passages.text: <A small advance from Leo, against my share of the loot.>

passages.title: Sweete's Orders
passages.text:
<Tucked into the pages of the captain's logbook is a letter bearing the seal of Harlon Sweete.

It looks like these pirates have been ordered by Sweete to cause further disruption to House Waycrest. 

Lucille should be notified of this immediately!>

passages.title: Sweete's Orders
passages.text: What have you brought, mainlander?

passages.title: Sweete's Orders
passages.text:
<Lucille reads the orders.>

So This pirate seeks to destabilize House Waycrest? As if we don't have enough problems already!

Thank you for bringing this to my attention, <class>. It seems that the coven might just be the beginning of Kul Tiras' troubles...

passages.title: Of Dark Deeds and Dark Days
passages.text:
I should have known better, and now Rezan is dead, and my own power is barely holding on. Soon Bwonsamdi himself will be coming to collect me.

Talanji... she must know what has happened here. Go to her, tell her. Aid her where you can.

I followed a god of strength and yet I have not de strength to face her with dis shame.

For now, I must gather our forces and pursue Zul.

passages.title: Of Dark Deeds and Dark Days
passages.text: Rezan is... dead?

passages.title: Those Who Remain
passages.text:
<The runes on the wooden plaque glow faintly with an ancient magic. It looks like it is a small piece of a larger record.>

<One of the Thornspeakers at the Teller Farm would probably recognize what this is.>

passages.title: Those Who Remain
passages.text: Is there something more you need?

passages.title: Those Who Remain
passages.text: These are a few of the remaining relics of my kin. I thought them lost. You have my utmost gratitude.

passages.title: Lost in the Woods
passages.text:
My student, Amalie, and I have taken it upon ourselves to act as the keepers of these woods. We were away from Drustvar briefly, and upon our return, found the grove infested and the surrounding land corrupted.

Amalie decided that she could deal with the grove infestation alone.

It's been some time since she ran off, could you look for her while you're in the Ashenwood?

passages.title: Lost in the Woods
passages.text: She said she would head back on her own? At least she is safe.

passages.title: A Farmer's Fate
passages.text:
Old Jakob here was one of the few folks who were never wary of us. I have, on occasion, even helped him around his farm in return for supplies. It is an injustice just to ignore his plight even amidst our own problems.

The corruption which holds him seems to be early in form. I believe I can cleanse it.

Take this branch, and bring it to the three shrines around the Ashenwood. That should allow it to gather enough energy for the ritual.

passages.title: A Farmer's Fate
passages.text: The wood remembers, and guides us. This should be enough power to help this farmer.

passages.title: Proudmoore's Parley
