passages.text:
So, we meet again.

I... apologize for how you were treated last time. I trusted Priscilla like a sister and-- 

<Katherine chokes up for a moment before regaining her composure.>

Let us keep this brief, for I will make no promises nor any formal accords in this state.

Return to your leaders. Tell them I wish to parley.

That is all for now. My people have suffered a great deal today and I have much to reflect upon.

passages.title: Proudmoore's Parley
passages.text:
So, Katherine is willing to speak with us at last?

Well done.

passages.title: Just a Nip
passages.text:
My tough-guys-in-training are quick learners! 

They do seem to get a bit... bitey... when they're grouchy, though. Too many, and I start to get a little light-headed.

The nearby atrivax plants have a medicinal gel. It is great to treat fresh wounds and nullify venom.

They don't like sharing it. Could you harvest a bit for me?

passages.title: Just a Nip
passages.text: How goes the juicing?

passages.title: Just a Nip
passages.text:
Thanks, <name>! That should do the trick!

At least it will tide me over until they realize we're on the same side.

passages.title: My Hungry Neighbor
passages.text:
There is an angry hydra that has decided to make a nearby ridge his home.

He keeps getting bigger, and meaner, and hungrier!

My cobras are terrified. 

Please, <name>, take care of him before he comes after us!

passages.title: My Hungry Neighbor
passages.text:
It seems he found you indigestible. Excellent work!

We all thank you!

passages.title: An Economic Opportunity
passages.text:
You look savvy enough to jump on an opportunity when one comes by and, pal, do I have one for you.

See that cove down there? It's run by entrepreneurs with an eye towards meeting the logistical shortfalls that might come up in your typical city or town situation. Well, it's normally run by them.

We have a bit of an infestation by folks who are more mercenary minded if you catch my meaning.

You help me win back control of the cove and I'll see you're treated well. Sound good?

passages.title: An Economic Opportunity
passages.text:
Right! So. Cards on the table. We're smugglers. We're not pirates. Everyone wants those red-coated jerks gone.

You help me become boss of Anyport and I'll help you.

Talk to some of the key folks around here. Do some favors for 'em then come back to me, got it?

passages.title: Cutting Edge Poultry Science
passages.text:
<Before you is a delicious chicken... And yet, despite everything, there is something a little bit... lively about this creature.

With a judicious application of science, there might be something that can still be done for this poor bird.

You resolve to bring the chicken to Dr. Oglethorpe in Booty Bay with all haste.>

passages.title: Cutting Edge Poultry Science
passages.text:
Hmm, a difficult case but I believe I can help!

These days so many people concerned if science should do something rather than if science can do it! Now let's see... Some wire, a few gears, a bit of feath-growth potion and some good old rocket fuel for some kick... And presto! One robotic chicken back from the brink!

Er, if it goes insane and tries to kill everyone, you were never here and we never had this conversation.

passages.title: Every Day I'm Smugglin'
passages.text:
Hey! Wanna make some quick gold?

See, I had a mishap a few weeks ago with a shipment. Too much grog, dark seas, sudden rocks. You know, that old story.

Anyway, my cargo's been floating out there and no one will get it back for me. Can you believe it? You bring my cargo back and I'll pay you a generous recovery fee.

We got a deal? Great!

Oh, uh, watch out for the sharks. Did I forget to mention the sharks?

passages.title: Every Day I'm Smugglin'
passages.text: You get the goods?

passages.title: Every Day I'm Smugglin'
passages.text: Hey thanks! Bit damp but still good.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Monelite Ore
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed this monelite ore badly.

passages.title: Asking for a Friend
passages.text:
Hey! Since you helped Cesi I thought maybe you might do a favor for me.

Well, uh, y'see Miss Sweetflower over there? Sweet as honey, sharp as a tack, and cooks like a goddess.

I'm not much to look at, but the lady might think kindly on me if I could surprise her with a gift. A really great gift! But I can't leave m'post or these red-coated jerks might run off with the merchandise. 

This is where you come in. Find out what Miss Sweetflower wants, get it and bring it back to me.

passages.title: Asking for a Friend
passages.text: Did you find something?

passages.title: Asking for a Friend
passages.text:
She wanted this?

<Kane cracks open the jar slightly. His eyes begin to water immediately.>

T-thanks.

<Coughing, Kane hastily re-seals the jar.>

That must have cost a lot. Let me pay you back with a tip.

passages.title: She's Got it Where it Counts
passages.text:
Word is you're looking to drum up support for Loosecannon. Well I'll buy in if you help me. They took my poor Miranda! 

Boss Tornsail says I had too much to drink and bet her in cards. I don't really remember what happened last night, but I can hold my liquor and I'd never bet my bird! I suspect funny business. She might not look like much, but Miranda's the fastest damn falcon you'll ever see.

They're watching me, so you go free her. She'll fly someplace safe and I'll get her later. We got a deal?

passages.title: She's Got it Where it Counts
passages.text:
Ha! Did you see her fly out of there? Like the wind!

Thank you, <name>. You and Cesi can count on my support.

passages.title: Cutthroat Business Practices
passages.text:
I used to run the inn here. Was a nice gig. I got first crack a lot of good stuff and all the best gossip and information came through my place.

And then that jerk, Gary Cofferdam, came in and kicked me out! The new Boss laughed! 

I'm lookin' at my last few silvers here. Business is not good!

Tell ya what, you remove my problem and I'll side up with Cesi. She'd never kick me out.

passages.title: Cutthroat Business Practices
passages.text:
Looks like this port needs a new innkeeper.

A pleasure doin' business with ya, <name>

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Storm Silver Ore
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed this storm silver ore badly.

passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed this riverbud badly.

passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed this akunda's bite badly.

passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed this tidespray linen badly.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Deep Sea Satin
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed this deep sea satin badly.

passages.title: The Day the Port Fell
passages.text:
Dis be a cursed land, adventurerr. Feel it in your bones: de cold chill of death... and undeath.

De Pirate-King Zem'lan rules dis port, with his crew of de eternal damned.

If you be lookin' for honor or noble adventure, you won't find it here. But if you can settle for vengeance and treasure, I got an offer for you.

But you should know who you be allying with. My hands are not clean in dis.

Take de medallion from my cloak and use it to reveal a vision of my past at de end of de dock.

passages.title: The Day the Port Fell
passages.text: I've witnessed countless horrors through countless generations.

passages.title: The Day the Port Fell
passages.text:
Dat was where it all began. I could've stopped Zem'lan right dere... I could've prevented dis fate for de crew.

Instead, I led dem straight into it.

passages.title: Overdue Mutiny
passages.text:
I used to be a Zandalari, adventurer.

Long ago, before dis curse. We were all Zandalari pirates, proudly sailing under de black flag of our captain, Zem'lan.

Now look at us... undead monsters, forced to serve our eternal captain like slaves.

Well, I be done with dis. De curse can't be broken, but we can still mutiny!

What say you? It gonna be tough, but I promise treasure and a chance to kill de notorious Pirate-King Zem'lan who murdered your vulpera friend.

Help me down, and we be gettin' started.

passages.title: Overdue Mutiny
passages.text: Dis won't be easy, <name>. But it be worth it.

passages.title: The Yard Arm of the Law
passages.text:
I'm not de only pirate Zem'lan has had strung up around de port. Hangin' on de yard arm is his favorite form of punishment for de crew.

We can't feel pain and don't stay dead, so his options are limited.

Look for more crewmates hangin' around town. Tell dem to meet me here after you free dem.

After weeks of hanging helplessly while being mocked and abused by de rest of de crew, I bet dey be willin' to discuss mutiny.

passages.title: The Yard Arm of the Law
passages.text: It looks like we all be of one accord. It be mutiny!

passages.title: My Last Day Alive
passages.text:
De curse came one fateful day, in ages past, when de sethrak attacked. Dere was no end to dem.

In our desperation, I helped Pirate-King Zem'lan do de unthinkable.

We became monsters. Even worse, we became eternal slaves to Zem'lan.

De curse weighs heavy on me, but my guilt is heavier. I led me crew into dis.

Before we confront de Pirate-King himself, you need to understand what we be up against.

You need to see what happened de day dat de Port of Zem'lan fell.

passages.title: My Last Day Alive
passages.text:
Now you know how desperate we were on dat day, <name>.

I don't be making excuses, but you should understand why we did what we did.

passages.title: Maroon 'em with Fire
passages.text:
We gonna have to sail out to de Golden Isle to face Pirate-King Zem'lan.

Let's make sure de rest of de crew can't follow us once we go. Burn their boats in de harbor.

passages.title: Maroon 'em with Fire
passages.text: Don't burn my boat, <name>. We be needin' dat one.

passages.title: Maroon 'em with Fire
passages.text: Good. We be ready to sail.

passages.title: The Golden Isle
passages.text:
Pirate-King Zem'lan don't stay in de port with de rest of us. Too good to crack a jug with his crew no more.

We gotta sail out to de Golden Isle to find him. That be de forbidden island where Zem'lan hoards all of de treasure we've pillaged and plundered, so only he can enjoy dem.

Hop in my boat and we'll row out dere together.

passages.title: The Golden Isle
passages.text:
Here we are. De Golden Isle. It's beautiful, ain't it?

A pirate's paradise.

passages.title: Our Share of the Plunder
passages.text:
Dis treasure belongs to de crew! We've fought every battle for Zem'lan, but he hoards all de booty for himself.

And if ya try to take some for yourself, he turns ya into one of his goldslaves. Those be de mindless drones ya see tendin' to de treasure out here.

We ain't leavin' here empty-handed after de mutiny. Collect all de treasure ya can!

Beware de cursed bits. It don't hurt us, but I'm guessin' it'll hurt you.

passages.title: Our Share of the Plunder
passages.text: More treasure!

passages.title: Our Share of the Plunder
passages.text: I suppose dis little amount of gold won't be cursin' ya for too long. I'll carry de rest.

passages.title: The First Time I Died
passages.text:
Dis be it. Where Zem'lan cursed us all.

It began with me death. De first of countless deaths I've had since. Each of dem spent fighting and dying for Pirate-King Zem'lan and his selfish treasure hoard.

I don't know if de idols he used to curse us can even be destroyed, but we gotta try. Let's take dem to de altar where de ritual occurred and try to smash one.

passages.title: The First Time I Died
passages.text:
I guess de idols can't be destroyed... even by a mortal. Curses be fickle things.

I was de first Zem'lan cursed, and I did nothin' to stop him from cursin' de rest of de crew.

I regret it every day...

But enough livin' in de past. It's time to be free.

passages.title: Escaping Zem'lan
passages.text:
Pirate-King Zem'lan was right about one thing: he won't stay dead for long.

We gotta take our treasure and get out of here while we got de chance.

We can take de boat, but we'll need a place to hide out for awhile. Are your vulpera friends open to housin' a few stowaways?

<First Mate Jamboya motions to the piles of treasure in his boat.>

Clearly, we can pay dem for their trouble.

passages.title: Escaping Zem'lan
passages.text: What have you gotten us into, <name>? We asked you to find our friend, not bring monsters into our camp.

passages.title: WANTED: Darkspeaker Jo'la
passages.text:
Wanted for atrocious crimes against the Zandalari: Darkspeaker Jo'la

 Defeat this powerful adherent of Zul, and a great reward shall be yours.

passages.title: WANTED: Darkspeaker Jo'la
passages.text: Dat troll was nothing but bad news for everyone. You have done well.

passages.title: Raiding the Boulderfist
passages.text:
The Boulderfist have recently raided Drywhisker Mine, and are sitting on a large amount of iron ore.

We want it back.

passages.title: Raiding the Boulderfist
passages.text: We can't let the Alliance take Arathi. We'll use whatever iron we can get.

passages.title: Raiding the Boulderfist
passages.text: This will do. Throm-ka, <name>.

passages.title: WANTED: Sabertusk Empress
passages.text:
To any and all brave enough to seek the challenge: 

Find and defeat a ferocious Sabertusk Empress, the strongest and most vicious of all sabertusks in Zuldazar. 

They can be found up and down the road from the Village in the Vines. 

A reward for any that succeed!

passages.title: WANTED: Sabertusk Empress
passages.text: The wanted poster stands with tasks etched on it.

passages.title: WANTED: Sabertusk Empress
passages.text: Thank you, champion. Dat is one less threat to de area.

passages.title: WANTED: Prime Thumpknuckle
passages.text:
To any and all brave enough to seek the challenge: 

Find and defeat a Prime Thumpknuckle, the largest and most dangerous of all the wild gorillas.

They can be found up and down the road from the Village in the Vines. 

A reward for any that succeed!

passages.title: WANTED: Prime Thumpknuckle
passages.text: You faced down those Thumpknuckles? Dat is worth a lot to us. Thank you.

passages.title: Azerite Madness
passages.text:
There be a group of earth elementals nearby that be goin' crazy due te havin' Azerite infused onto 'em.

We cannot allow this Azerite to spread to any more elementals. We need te put 'em down.

Go and fight these Azerite infused elementals nearby. When they be down, use yer amulet to absorb their lingerin' Azerite.

It be a shame te do this, but we're fightin' these things in order te save the planet.

passages.title: Iron Stores
passages.text:
While the mine is under Horde banners our peons ensure the iron supply never runs dry.

This key provides access to the chest. Make sure it still works.

passages.title: Iron Stores
passages.text: Chest giving you trouble?

passages.title: Iron Stores
passages.text: Heh, glad to see it still works.

passages.title: WANTED: Dark Chronicler
passages.text:
Champion wanted for an expedition into the depths of Xibala. 

Strange noises and wails come from the bones at night and our workers are terrified. 

Seek out the source of the strange noises and destroy it, and a reward will be yours.

passages.title: WANTED: Dark Chronicler
passages.text: The ruins will now be silent at night.

passages.title: Break's Over
passages.text:
It's come to my attention a few of our peons have been caught sleeping instead of hauling iron from the mine. We can't let our supplies get low.

Take this club and get those lazy peons back on track.

passages.title: Break's Over
passages.text: With our peons back on track the iron stores should be full in no time.

passages.title: WANTED: Dark Chronicler
passages.text:
Champion wanted for an expedition into the depths of Xibala. 

Strange noises and wails come from the bones at night and our workers are terrified. 

Seek out the source of the strange noises and destroy it, and a reward will be yours.

passages.title: WANTED: Dark Chronicler
passages.text: Something stirs in the ruins. I hope you can discover its source!

passages.title: WANTED: Dark Chronicler
passages.text: A spirit? How terrible!

passages.title: Heart of Darkness
passages.text:
We sent troops with Captain Conrad ahead to Nazmir to gain a foothold in that hellish jungle.

The reports we've been receiving of the local troll population are... disconcerting.

They're in over their heads, <name>. I have Brann Bronzebeard prepped and ready to head out.

Accompany Brann to Nazmir so we can secure our position. The Wind's Redemption is at your disposal.

passages.title: Heart of Darkness
passages.text: I've wrestled with death, <race>. It's the most unexcitin' contest ye can imagine.

passages.title: WANTED: Tojek
passages.text:
<This appears to be a list of threats in the immediate vicinity, a angry scribble grabs your attention.>

A reward of gold be promised to de one dat slays da creature Tojek. You know what dey say, an eye for an eye! 

-Rovash

passages.title: WANTED: Tojek
passages.text:
Hah! He be dead? Really? Dat be wonderful!

Here be your reward, you earned it!

passages.title: The Wounded King
passages.text:
I have things under control here... for now, at any rate.

If we want to salvage this situation, Rastakhan must survive. Habutu is gone, but his other guardian, Zolani, has sent word.

She is protecting the King at a small fishing village called Zeb'ahari. Find Zolani and do what you can to ensure Rastakhan lives.

Be careful, <name>.

passages.title: The Wounded King
passages.text: It is good dat you have come. De king is dying, and we do not have much time to change dat.

passages.title: King or Prey
passages.text:
My loa has seen fit to question my resolve.

For my people, my pride, and my faith, we will correct dis. Return to your Horde. Ready your forces, and I will ready mine.

When de time comes, we will strike back against de traitorous snake, Zul.

passages.title: King or Prey
passages.text:
You have gone beyond our wildest expectations!

Thank you, <name>, for upholding the honor of the Horde. We must remember who we were, to realize what we may become.

passages.title: Dubious Offering
passages.text:
Cannae be sure o' the wisdom o' this Captain Conrad.

Sendin' our own on these blood troll bats with offerin's?

Somethin' about this stinks more'n an armpit after a bar fight.

passages.title: Dubious Offering
passages.text: I wasn't built for fallin' that far! The only part o' me that doesn't hurt is me hat!

passages.title: If Bones Could Talk
passages.text:
<These skeletons appear to be rising out of the ancient ruins that dot the land here. Their bones are covered with what looks like runes, but time has worn away all but fragments of the markings.

If you could find some of these runes intact, Lucille might be able to decipher them to find out where these skeletons come from...

...and why they are no longer at rest.>

passages.title: If Bones Could Talk
passages.text: What's this?

passages.title: If Bones Could Talk
passages.text:
These markings... this is the language of the Drust!

The magic of the coven must be disturbing their spirits, drawing them back into our world to fight us once more!

This is unsettling... but it is another reason we must bring an end to the Heartsbane!

passages.title: WANTED: Tojek
passages.text:
<The tattered paper appears to include a list of known threats in the area.

The top of the list reads: "Tojek - Direhorn - Responsible for damages to 3 vehicles, 6 supply crates, and the tragic loss of Garrick Blacksteel's mole machine, avoid at all costs."

Perhaps you can hunt down this creature to prevent further attacks.>

passages.title: WANTED: Tojek
passages.text:
Ye got rid o' that blasted direhorn? Fantastic! Maybe some day I can get tae work on rebuilding me machine now!

Thank ye!

passages.title: Share the Wealth
passages.text:
<Though old and mud covered, this is still gold, lots of it! It's not enough to be Nedly's legendary lost treasure, but it's still several thousand in gold coins.

It's a significant find, and should be returned to Shealds to be split among all the workers.>

passages.title: Share the Wealth
passages.text: Some people would have just run off with this, but you didn't! We'll split this up into two hundred and fourteen shares. Here's your cut.

passages.title: Pests
passages.text:
Confound it all! These rat-faced thieves keep getting into all of our supplies! I swear, anything that's not tied down, and even some things that are, they nip off with'.

You want to make a difference for the war effort in Zandalar? Pop off as many of those buggers as you can find. 

Otherwise, get on with it!

passages.title: Pests
passages.text: A thief has come to steal from thieves?

passages.title: A Bundle of Furs
passages.text:
You there! Would you happen to be passing by Hatherford?

I have a delivery to make there, but my normal delivery person fell ill after a trip to Anglepoint. 

Would you mind taking this bundle of furs to Dandy Jones in Hatherford for me? I would go myself, but I must hold down my stall.

passages.title: A Bundle of Furs
passages.text: Welcome to my inn, friend! How can  I help ya?

passages.title: A Bundle of Furs
passages.text:
Ah, my furs! Thanks for the delivery. It's getting a bit cold out here - these will be perfect for the beds!

If you need food or a place to lay your head, I can offer you the best!

passages.title: Curse of Jani
passages.text:
Thief and killer, know dat ya be standin' before da Patron of Scavengers, da Lord of Thieves, da God of Garbage, Master of Minions, and da Keeper of Secrets.

Ya be standin' before me in raiment worth entire kingdoms of gold, bearin' weapons dat cost more than even me most devout and renowned followers will ever earn.

I tink now be a good time ta teach ya a lesson. Maybe show ya high and mighty greatness what it means ta be snappin' in da gutters.

passages.title: Curse of Jani
passages.text: You be bitin' that ratmon yet?

passages.title: Curse of Jani
passages.text: Haha! Well done, wealthy stranger. When ya out and about in dese lands, keep ya eyes open. Ya never know when one of de children might be pointin' ya ta a useful place.

passages.title: Kua'fon's Day Off
passages.text:
You know, I think Kua'fon might be lonely when you are not here.

What makes me say that? Well, I got a very angry scroll from a Tortollan indicating he was stealing shiny things from their stalls, but that could mean anything.

You should probably stop him before he damages your reputation, hm?

<Wingminder Goja cackles.>

passages.title: Kua'fon's Day Off
passages.text:
<Kua'fon apologetically headbutts you.>

Skree.

passages.title: Kua'fon's Day Off
passages.text:
A messenger came from de Terrace of de Chosen. Your companion is at it again.

<Wingminder Goja chuckles.>

Not even de priests of Pa'ku seem to be able to convince him to leave. You should go and send him back home, where he belongs.

passages.title: Kua'fon's Day Off
passages.text:
<Kua'fon scrapes his rough tongue over your cheek.>

Skree.

passages.title: Left at the Port
passages.text:
There was a mishap when we were loading the most recent shipment for the Southwind Station. Apparently some paperwork meant for the dockmaster was left behind.

He can't hand over deliveries to the couriers without it, but the next cargo ferry won't be departing any time soon. Do you think you could deliver it by foot? The ferry dock is just a short ride down the road.

passages.title: Left at the Port
passages.text: I was wondering where this was. Thank you kindly.

passages.title: Honoring the Fallen
passages.text:
This is a shameful situation. Unforgivable! The soldiers weren't carryin' offerrin's to the blood trolls, they WERE the offerin'!

It'd be right difficult to bury 'em proper in this hole. Best we can do is get their dog tags.

Poor lads an' lassies.

passages.title: Honoring the Fallen
passages.text: I'll keep these tags an' get 'em to their families. Let's keep mum on the manner o' their deaths, aye? No need to cause 'em even more sadness.

passages.title: A Letter to the League
passages.text:
A researcher at the Resort up the hill was hoping to get a letter out to a group called the "Explorers' League". He claims that they have a camp set up near some old Drust ruins on the other side of the sound.

There's no official station so it will have to be delivered by hand. If you happen to head in that direction, can you take it with you?

passages.title: A Letter to the League
passages.text: We might have a wee problem on our hands.

passages.title: Bring out the Big Gun
passages.text:
<The cannon here is still in good condition. It's a lot of firepower to slow down the Horde.

Taking this to Lea Martinel at Eckhart Lodge would really help their defenses.>

passages.title: Bring out the Big Gun
passages.text: This is an unexpected surprise!

passages.title: WANTED: Za'roco
passages.text:
To any with honor and a sharp blade: 

Find and kill the thief, Za'roco. 

Those that betray their fellow exile don't deserve to live. 

Any who can cross his name off this list will earn a fitting reward.

passages.title: WANTED: Za'roco
passages.text: Za'roco got what he deserved, and now, so will you.

passages.title: WANTED: Taz'raka the Traitor
passages.text:
To all caravans and travelers:

Beware Taz'raka the Traitor, a skeleton ambushing travelers on the road near Port of Zem'lan. If you must travel on that road, move quickly, and avoid entering any of the ruins.

Several caravans have combined resources to offer a reward for Taz'raka's death.

To collect, speak with Norah in Camp Lastwind.

passages.title: WANTED: Taz'raka the Traitor
passages.text: Be careful out there, <name>.

passages.title: WANTED: Taz'raka the Traitor
passages.text: A bounty worth paying. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: WANTED: Cobra Excursion Participants
passages.text:
Attention guests of the Goldtusk Inn:

We're proud to announce a surprise new addition to our lineup of excursion activities!

The new Giant Deadly Unstoppable Killer Cobra Experience is now available!

There's no need to sign up, you've all been automatically volunteered for this activity.

To participate, simply travel into the dunes north of the inn and try not to be killed by the massive cobra now patrolling the area.

We are not currently offering guided tours for this activity. Have fun!

passages.title: WANTED: Cobra Excursion Participants
passages.text: All of our excursion survivors receive a reward!

passages.title: WANTED: Cobra Excursion Participants
passages.text:
You killed de giant snake? Congratulations!

Guess I'd better update the brochure excursion list.

passages.title: WANTED: Sandscout Vesarik
passages.text:
To any and all who wish to see the Faithless empire fall: 

Sandscout Vesarik was spotted patrolling the dunes to the east. Gather a formidable force and strike him down!

Those who succeed will be granted a fitting reward.

passages.title: WANTED: Sandscout Vesarik
passages.text: Sandscout Vesarik was last seen patrolling the dunes to the east.

passages.title: WANTED: Sandscout Vesarik
passages.text: Vesarik's death will be a devastating blow to the Faithless forces.

passages.title: Blood of Hir'eek
passages.text:
Spooky chantin' in the next room can only mean one thing: someone's askin' for the ol' what-fer!

I'd give ya a hand but I gotta drink a couple-a potions before I'm back on me feet.

Take out that blood witch and I bet the magic'll dissipate.

passages.title: Blood of Hir'eek
passages.text: Two things I can't abide in this world: witches an' tall chairs.

passages.title: Blood of Hir'eek
passages.text: Always thought witches dinnae wear clothes when ritualisin'. And where was 'er broomstick?

passages.title: Zealots of Zalamar
passages.text:
We're surrounded by the enemy, <name>, and it's got me blood ragin'!

I'm fit as a fi... instrument... and ready to help get us outta this forsaken cavern.

Let's show 'em the end o' their miserable lives, eh?

passages.title: Zealots of Zalamar
passages.text: Smells like... Victory.

passages.title: Zealots of Zalamar
passages.text: Worst places in the world are all dark holes with no artifacts about!

passages.title: Flight from the Fall
passages.text:
Let's get outta this hole! Hairs on the back o' me neck won't settle down. Was hopin' I'd find some artifacts, or treasures, or haggis, or at least a few worthwhile trinkets down here.

Those bats look like the ones that we came on... hopefully they'll take us back to Fort Victory and not some rotten grotto with no valuables inside.

passages.title: Flight from the Fall
passages.text: Fort Victory's got the wrong name. Somethin' like Fort Folly seems more appropriate ta me.

passages.title: Ooh Rah!
passages.text:
We're going to need a harbor for our base of operations. Those ruins across the way should be perfect for our needs.

Unfortunately, it looks to be occupied by a hostile force so I'm sending the marines to secure the shore. As the most experienced soldier here I want you to go with them. 

I don't want to see a single hostile remain when our engineers arrive.

Now, go take that harbor in the name of the Alliance!

passages.title: Ooh Rah!
passages.text:
Thank the Light you came with us! Private Leonard didn't make it and Private James got captured by those damn snake-men! 

The important thing is I think the rest of 'em got scared off once you started raining death down on 'em.

Small victories, right?

passages.title: Lessons of the Damned
passages.text:
When I arrived here in disguise, the blood trolls thought me some sort of messenger of their Blood God.

I seized the advantage and played into their primitive beliefs.

I came here intending to open trade and learn how we can work with them against the Horde.

What I discovered was altogether more compelling. I will show you.

passages.title: Lessons of the Damned
passages.text:
Dreadful business, <name>. I was set on a rescue or corpse recovery. To see one o' our own that far gone was... unsettlin'.

What's done is done. I'll send a report back to Halford. Don't bother yerself with the busy work this time.

passages.title: Granting a Reprieve
passages.text:
Now, on to more pressing matters.

The Forsaken have shown up and are preventing us from saving our people. All my soldiers are either injured, exhausted, or in no shape for fighting.

It seems these trollish natives have joined them as well. I am spread too thin.

Kill the Horde. Kill the Zandalari. Kill them all.

passages.title: Granting a Reprieve
passages.text: A few less cretins to worry about.

passages.title: Save Them All
passages.text:
Reinforcements? Ah thank tha Light!

We done the best we can triaging the injured, but we need help. We need more hands that can heal wounds or at the verra least apply bandages.

How are yer hands? Here, take these bandages and do what ye can tae treat tha injured.

passages.title: Save Them All
passages.text: We've done what we can. Now all we can do is rest.

passages.title: Save Them All
passages.text: Ye'd make an excellent medic. Or at tha verra least a good nurse.

passages.title: A Lack of Surplus
passages.text:
Food, wood, cloth... we're short on everything. Of course, I'm always short, but that donna stop me.

Heh.

See what ya can salvage from tha shipwrecks.

passages.title: A Lack of Surplus
passages.text: Did ya find anything useful?

passages.title: A Lack of Surplus
passages.text: It's amazin' what we can do when we have tha supplies tae do it!

passages.title: That One's Mine
passages.text:
Yer here to help? I donna have anything... Well, maybe I do.

I know it's just a simple hammer. I know it's not special. But it's mine.

That disgustin undead, Alan Hawkins, is taunting me wi'it. I promised Feorea I wouldna run off tae fight him, but ye made no such promises.

Kill him and retrieve me hammer.

passages.title: That One's Mine
passages.text: Donna judge me. This is me best hammer.

passages.title: That One's Mine
passages.text: I know it doesna seem like a special hammer. But to me, it's verra important.

passages.title: The Glory of the Hunt
passages.text:
You here for the festival, friend?

We're still settin' up here, but the hunt should've started by now!

If ya want to take part, go meet Abbey in Foxhollow Woods. She'll get you all set up.

Happy huntin'!

passages.title: The Glory of the Hunt
passages.text: Ah, Gora sent you! Care to join in the hunt?

passages.title: The Black Sheep
passages.text:
I'll admit, Millie has never really been one to follow the herd. Usually, it's no problem. She'll wander off for a bit, do her own thing and eventually make her way back to the flock.

The hills have grown increasingly more dangerous lately, especially with the wolves and giants about. She's been gone awhile and I'm starting to worry.

Could you please help me look for her?

passages.title: The Black Sheep
passages.text: Oh, my sweet Millie! Thank you, <name>. I'm in your debt.

passages.title: The Troll's Tale
passages.text:
You've arrived at an... interesting time, <class>. All of my ships have been destroyed. Half of my men are feeding the fishes, and the rest aren't doing much better. We're as good as doomed.

And still, the Alliance prevails.

These Zandalari trolls are to blame for this carnage. I need to know how they did it before we kill them all and escape from this Light-forsaken island.

passages.title: The Troll's Tale
passages.text:
<Thom sneers at the Zandalari troll kneeling before him.>

Talk, you filthy brute!

passages.title: The Troll's Tale
passages.text:
Princess... Talanji, you say? I see.

King Wrynn will be told about this. This Zandalari princess will learn what it means to make an enemy of the Alliance.

passages.title: Cry Wolf
passages.text:
Lately, the wolves have been terrorizing my flock. They weren't an issue until the giants moved in and pushed them out of their normal hunting grounds.

I feel bad asking you to do this, but could you thin their ranks a bit? If there are fewer wolves competing for food, maybe they'll leave us alone.

passages.title: Cry Wolf
passages.text: My flock should be able to rest easier now.

passages.title: WANTED: Razorclaw Alpha
passages.text:
Adventurers Needed!

The wolves have been attacking my flock! I don't have the means to fight them back.

I've seen one, much larger than the rest, leading a few of the attacks.

Please, if anyone can help, I'll gladly offer whatever reward I can muster.

- Shepherd Mary Ann Milbrooke

passages.title: WANTED: Razorclaw Alpha
passages.text: Wow, I wasn't sure if anyone would ever answer my posting. Thank you!

passages.title: Aww, Rats!
passages.text:
I didn't sign up for this! I just want to get back to the simple things, like grinding wheat and drinking mead.

As if things couldn't get any worse around here, there's an army of rats ransacking the shed and I don't have the stomach to exterminate them.

Here, I got this off some crazy gnome that stopped into port recently. I thought maybe it'd help with the bees. Maybe you can try it on the rats?

passages.title: Aww, Rats!
passages.text: Thank you so much. I'll get rid of these little guys.

passages.title: Ettin It Done
passages.text:
Okay, now here's a little something I whipped up for you with those extra ingredients.

We don't have much around here in the way of weapons, but we've got gunpowder and plenty of flour. A surprisingly explosive combination!

Toss one of these goodies at those nasty ettins, should disorient them long enough to give 'em a good whack upside the head!

You thought I was just a sweet old lady, baking delicious cookies for any ol' passerby? Hah, I'll have you know I was quite the firecracker in my day.

passages.title: Ettin It Done
passages.text: <name>, my grandson could learn a thing or two from you. Come back to visit anytime!

passages.title: Wheat A Minute
passages.text:
With the storage shed ransacked by rats and the giants pillaging our shipments, we've been running low on food.

When I was making my way out here, I saw a bunch of grain sacks littered about, near the wrecked wagons.

I'd appreciate it if you could retrieve whatever you find while you're out here.

passages.title: Wheat A Minute
passages.text: Wow! I can't believe you were able to carry all of that.

passages.title: Mighty Grokkfist
passages.text:
Grandma is always telling me I need to toughen up a little... how easy we've got it these days.

I read a story about giants that are terrified of rats, so I thought, "Hey Charles, here's a great idea, let's take all those rats adventurer gathered and let 'em loose on the ettins."

I tried to be tough for once, but look how it turned out. Now, I'm stuck out here, just hoping I don't get squashed.

Their leader is just up the hill there. Here, take the rats with you and let's hope I was right!

passages.title: Mighty Grokkfist
passages.text: I can't believe it actually worked. I thought for sure we'd all be squished!

passages.title: The Heart of Azeroth
passages.text:
Our world's dyin', <name>. Sargeras's sword has cut deep. Her pain is drivin' the elements into a frenzy!

I can hear Azeroth's voice, but she needs more than her speaker.

She needs her champion.

Far below us lies an ancient titan vault called the Chamber of Heart. I sense she wishes tae speak tae ye there.

Come with me into the chamber. It may be our only chance tae save her!

passages.title: The Heart of Azeroth
passages.text: Ye need tae hear from Azeroth herself, <name>.

passages.title: The Heart of Azeroth
passages.text: The Heart of Azeroth... that's the key tae healin' her wounds!

passages.title: Milking Goats
passages.text:
Unfortunately, Milbrooke's flock hasn't been producing lately. What with all the wolves about, the poor things must be terrified.

Wild goats wander the hills, and they are quite fearless compared to the sheep. 

If you can find a few with young ones about, you may be able to persuade them to offer some fresh, delicious goat milk!

passages.title: Milking Goats
passages.text: Were you able to collect enough milk?

passages.title: Milking Goats
passages.text: It smells wonderful. This is perfect, thank you <name>!

passages.title: WANTED: Yarsel'ghun
passages.text:
By the decree of the Storm's Wake.

Find and kill the foreign spy, Yarsel'ghun. 

A foreigner agent hiding on our soil, she is responsible for acts of terrorism against the citizens of Stormsong.

The individual that ends her existence will earn a fitting reward.

passages.title: WANTED: Yarsel'ghun
passages.text: The wanted poster is nailed to the wall, with tasks etched on it.

passages.title: WANTED: Yarsel'ghun
passages.text: One less Horde in Stormsong.

passages.title: Undelivered Package
passages.text: < The ransacked cart has obviously seen better days. A single package remains, obscured by the spilled grain. It's addressed to Marie Davenport of Millstone Hamlet. >

passages.title: Undelivered Package
passages.text: Ohhhh, goodness! You found my lost tea. Thank you dear!

passages.title: What's Yours is Mined
passages.text:
During a visit to Pandaria, I witnessed the citizens of Halfhill defeat attacking hozen by flinging the hozen's excrement back at them. 

The hozen were unprepared to face the wrath of their own weaponry used against them. A similar strategy can be applied here. We will gather Venture Co. Sea Mines and use them against the invaders. 

You hook ropes to each mine, and Ai'twen and I will haul them up.

passages.title: What's Yours is Mined
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>. Our plan is coming together nicely.

passages.title: Death from Two Sides
passages.text:
The overgrown lizards from down on the beach decided to swarm the camp suddenly. 

We're used to dealing with one or two each week, but it seems like the whole brood came up the cliff. Wonder if the smell of blood drew them in.

They're putting our remaining men at risk, wipe them out!

passages.title: Death from Two Sides
passages.text: Have you thinned out those saurolisks yet?

passages.title: Death from Two Sides
passages.text: There's one problem dealt with.

passages.title: Establish a Beachhead
passages.text:
I won't allow Private Leonard's sacrifice to be in vain. Let's get our men out here and fortify this place up before those... "sethrak" decide to come back.

Here, plant this banner somewhere visible so the ship knows its safe. That platform over next to the dock should do the trick.

passages.title: Establish a Beachhead
passages.text:
The crew's setting up our camp in record time! Good work securing the beachhead.

Now, about Sergeant Ermey...

passages.title: Emergency Transplants
passages.text:
Riverbud is a precious resource for us. Not only does it have potent magical properties, but it also feeds many of de beasts we train or eat ourselves.

However, de Blood Trolls have been dumping a lot of cursed blood in de rivers. It may not be their goal, but if we do not act soon, de pollution may wipe out all de riverbud.

I need you to take dis handful of seeds, and plant dem in de rivermud. In exchange, I will teach you how to harvest it more effectively.

passages.title: Emergency Transplants
passages.text:
I cannot thank you enough. Riverbud is absolutely critical to both de Zandalari and to de wildlife. Regardless, I said I would teach you, and I am true to my word.

De riverbud you have harvested looks blown out.  When you go to pick the bulbs, do not just rip dem off of the plant.  Instead, twist dem first so they pinch de stem closed. It will keep de fluid from draining out.

passages.title: Wiccaphobia
passages.text:
Do you see that... that shape up in the brambles up ahead? Is that... <Eitrigg shudders.>

Is that goblin... wrapped up in that tree?

passages.title: Wiccaphobia
passages.text: Huh?

passages.title: Wiccaphobia
passages.text: I TOLD you I've got a bad feeling about this place...

passages.title: I Hope There's No Witches in the Mountains
passages.text:
<Gallywix looks flustered after his ordeal with the crone.>

You know, ah... I think maybe we better set up our foothold somewhere else. Maybe, up in the mountains? You know, like... not here, where the witches are?

passages.title: I Hope There's No Witches in the Mountains
passages.text: Yes, <name>?

passages.title: I Hope There's No Witches in the Mountains
passages.text: This... this I can work with.

passages.title: Krazzlefrazz Outpost
passages.text:
I already did a bunch of the leg-work for settin' up our foothold. All we gotta do is finish deploying all the instant-base technology, and we'll be good to go here in Drustvar.

Why don't you go finish the base building. I'm gonna see if I can salvage any wolfercycle parts.

passages.title: Krazzlefrazz Outpost
passages.text: What?

passages.title: Krazzlefrazz Outpost
passages.text:
There we go. That's real nice.

And hey, look! Here come some fresh rocket troops!

passages.title: Breaking The Food Chain
passages.text:
De extra riverbud you planted has helped, but it has not been enough. Some of de local beasts are consuming de riverbud before dey can mature. We need dese plants to germinate, or we could risk losing it entirely.

The largest group of young riverbud consumers are de jacunda. If we are going to give de riverbud a chance to survive dis, you will need to thin their numbers.

Do dat and I will teach you everything I know about riverbud.

passages.title: Breaking The Food Chain
passages.text:
Thank you for putting de fish down. I do not regret dis action, as dey would have starved if de riverbud ran out, so at least dey had a quicker death.

The secret to riverbud is dat dere are additional bulbs in de root system. Just pull de plant by de vine firmly with steady pressure.

passages.title: What Rots Beneath
passages.text:
Good job killin' Ateena and sendin' whatever dat construct was down ta da bottom of... whatever dis ting be.

Me scouts be seein' Titan Keeper Hezrel marchin' down to sometin' called da Altar of Rot.

Now dat we got rid of dat construct, we can be flyin' down dere ta see what Hezrel be up to. 

Dis be best handled by you and me. Da princess be havin' business back in da city.

passages.title: What Rots Beneath
passages.text:
No time to waste. Area ahead exhibits immense corruption triggered by G'huun.

Scanners indicate corruption caused by leak within G'huun containment structure.

Must push forward to contain leak. Cannot perform function alone.

passages.title: The Wreckoning
passages.text:
I can't believe any of them survived the wreck. We were told to prevent any survivors from gaining a foothold.

There are far more of them than expected. We need to weaken their forces.

Well? What are you waiting for? An engraved invitation?

passages.title: The Wreckoning
passages.text: We have an infestation of Alliance. We've done what we can. I will need to message for reinforcements.

passages.title: The Things They Carried
passages.text:
We need to know more about these sailors before we report back.

Ideally, we would invade their camp but there are too many for our small group to take on. Lucky for us, they are focused on their salvage operation over safety. See if you can find any intelligence on their leaders who are scavenging the derelicts.

passages.title: The Things They Carried
passages.text: What have you found?

passages.title: The Things They Carried
passages.text: Intelligence isn't always gathered from the most obvious things.

passages.title: Productive Pests
passages.text:
This jungle is a whole new habitat for creatures and critters. A shame we're here to deal with Alliance driftwood.

I've got an idea and I think it's genius. Two words: Poison bugs.

First, I need some bugs. Crawling and flying ones, just to be thorough for our test.

passages.title: Productive Pests
passages.text: These are going to be great!

passages.title: Crabulous Feast
passages.text:
The Forsaken didn't bring any food with them. I think they might be cannibals. At the very least, they don't need to eat!

Teekay and I are going to starve out here! <name>, if you're not too busy, could you bring us something to eat?

Maybe some fresh crab?

passages.title: Crabulous Feast
passages.text: My stomach is rumbling already.

passages.title: Crabulous Feast
passages.text: This will do nicely. Now all we need is some butter. And maybe some lemon.

passages.title: Basement Dwellers
passages.text:
Ever since the untimely passing of dear, sweet Lizzie, rest her soul, the pests have multiplied like crazy!

In recent days, giant spiders have begun crawling out of the cellar underneath the southern mill. 

No one has been able to go down there, for fear of being wrapped in web and eaten alive!

Would you mind squashing a few arachnids and collecting any silk you find?

passages.title: Basement Dwellers
passages.text: If only Lizzie were still here...

passages.title: Basement Dwellers
passages.text: We can all rest easier now that those spiders have been squashed.

passages.title: Lost and Forgotten
passages.text:
We have seen firsthand the depravity that has taken hold of my former brethren. The time has come to put an end to it.

The path ahead is no doubt packed with Lord Stormsong's cultists and their soulwrought elementals. I will absorb their souls as they fall with the Dead Ringer, as you once did.

However, there will be no release for these fiends... not this time. We will need them to pry open the final door to the Shrine.

passages.title: Lost and Forgotten
passages.text: This burden is ours to bear, but I am glad we do not bear it alone.

passages.title: Lost and Forgotten
passages.text: Mourn not for the fallen. We do what we must to save our people.

passages.title: Nazmani Cultists
passages.text:
The rumors o' the blood trolls from back in Boralus don't line up with the letters from Captain Conrad.

Open to trade? Willin' to work with us against the Horde? Ready to teach us their magic?

Hogwash.

Only time worth spendin' with these evil trolls is time killin' 'em.

passages.title: Nazmani Cultists
passages.text: That chantin' noise won't leave my head, draenei.

passages.title: Nazmani Cultists
passages.text: Know that feelin' when somethin's amiss and ya can't quite figure it? It's exhilaratin'!

passages.title: Offerings to G'huun
passages.text:
Been watchin' these cultists with both good eyes.

Those big glowin' jars o' theirs look important.

Opened one up and it sent a shiver down me spine, but nothin' seemed worth the takin'.

If it ain't worth stealin', I guess it's worth smashin'.

passages.title: Offerings to G'huun
passages.text: Doesn't seem ta be much o' value out here in this cursed jungle. Why'd Captain Conrad think they were worth tradin' with?

passages.title: Zul'Nazman
passages.text:
Not sure if I like this Harry fella. He's growin' on me, though. Got some wild ideas about the blood elves, but he's not all bad.

What were we talkin' about? Ah, right.

Captain Conrad. He said the Captain went to Zul'Nazman ta commune with the blood trolls there. Seems... less than well planned.

Let's go see what there is to see, shall we?

passages.title: Zul'Nazman
passages.text: I'm startin' to believe we're on a corpse run here. Can't imagine we'll find the famous Captain Conrad alive at this point.

passages.title: Captain Conrad
passages.text:
Looks like there's couple o' guards posted by this hut. If I had ta guess, Captain Conrad'll be in there.

Somethin' still feels off about this place, though. Why don't ya go on ahead and I'll hang here in case things go south fast?

I got yer back, <name>.

passages.title: Captain Conrad
passages.text: I was wondering when you would come for me. I must admit that I am not as captive as you might believe. Quite to the contrary, in fact.

passages.title: Voyage to the West
passages.text:
Reconnaissance reports that the Horde has made inroads into the desert of Vol'dun.

We can't allow the Horde to continue to work there unchecked, so we're preparing an expedition to establish a beachhead.

<name>, as one of our most accomplished soldiers I'd appreciate if you joined us. Your help will be essential for the success of our mission.

Wrap up your affairs here in the harbor and report to Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth. We will set sail when you're ready.

passages.title: Voyage to the West
passages.text: I hope the trip didn't make you seasick, <name>. Our mission is only just getting started.

passages.title: Stop the Evacuation
passages.text:
This is a complete disaster. The intelligence you gathered seems to indicate that they already have footholds on this island and this is just another one.

They have a boat and we need to stall them. Here's some seaforium. Plant it on their boat and sabotage their hopes of escape. If possible, take out their Captain leading the evacuation.

passages.title: Stop the Evacuation
passages.text: I hope you have good news for me. For once.

passages.title: Stop the Evacuation
passages.text: Finally something goes our way. We've stopped them escaping, for now.

passages.title: The Underrot: Sealing G'huun's Corruption
passages.text:
Massive leak of G'huun corruption located nearby. Substance surrounding us indicator of G'huun corruption, named underrot.

Initial scans suggest a massive abomination composed of underrot is ahead, releasing more corruption into Nazmir.

Must destroy Unbound Abomination, contain G'huun's corruption.

Function clear. Proceed inside.

passages.title: The Underrot: Sealing G'huun's Corruption
passages.text:
Hezrel be dead? Dat be a shame, dat thing was useful ta have around. 

It be good dat we stopped dis abomination in dere... but I be worried dat dis ain't gonna be da end.

We still gotta take down da construct dat we shot down... and hopefully find a way ta keep G'huun sealed.

passages.title: Rocks of Ragnaros
passages.text:
With me shaman still in their conveyances, a vital component o' our upcomin' ritual remains scattered among the supplies.

I can only hope the Horde haven't taken 'em. They're rare an' precious...

If you see any glowin' objects out there, recover 'em. They're o' tremendous value.

passages.title: Rocks of Ragnaros
passages.text: I wasn't worried about 'em bein' broken. A little fire'd never hurt those rocks.

passages.title: Rocks of Ragnaros
passages.text: Couple o' scorch marks here an' there, but nothin' out o' the ordinary. These'll do nicely.

passages.title: Raiders of the Lost Crop
passages.text:
I could use a hand here!

So there I was, mindin' my own business and collectin' my harvest when these big galoots show up on their wolves and start torching the town! Luckily I was delivering a sack o' grain, or they'd have caught me and run me down!

I won't stand for having these orcs or their dogs chewing up my fields or my crop.

What do you say, friend? Help a farmer run some looters off his land?

passages.title: Raiders of the Lost Crop
passages.text: Hah, that'll teach them to come here with their pooches and steal our grain!

passages.title: Aromatic Pollenator
passages.text:
While gathering the pollen, you found a dead bug absolutely covered in pollen. You know that this little creature is the secret to harvesting pollen easier, but the answer seems just out grasp.

Maybe if you ask Declan about it, he might have an idea.

passages.title: Aromatic Pollenator
passages.text: Oh, wow.  Yeah, that little fella is certainly covered in pollen.  Actually, this gives me an idea... but you may not like it.

passages.title: Grain Drain
passages.text:
We've got to salvage what we can.

This valley is the breadbasket of Kul Tiras. We feed the citizens, the militia, the army, you name it! Perhaps you've heard of our famous Kul Tiran sourdough bread? Goes great with sausages.

More importantly, those blasted Horde are getting in the way of our harvest! Lucky for us, the golems work 'round the clock to package the grain.

I just need you to go out to the fields and grab as many bags as you can carry. I'll pay you for your trouble, of course.

passages.title: Grain Drain
passages.text: We need that grain!

passages.title: Grain Drain
passages.text: Good harvest this year. Our people will eat well.

passages.title: The Final Ascent
passages.text:
Beyond this gate lies Lord Stormsong... and our retribution. It seems he has sealed it tight, likely to buy himself time to finish whatever foul ritual awaits us.

Release the souls within the Dead Ringer when you are ready. I will direct them into the binding holding the gate shut.

From there, we find Stormsong and end this once and for all.

passages.title: The Final Ascent
passages.text: No matter what lies beyond that gate, we face it together.

passages.title: The Final Ascent
passages.text: I thought this moment would never come.

passages.title: Mole Machinations
passages.text:
Seems the enemy's anticipated our moves. While we developed our refinin' techniques for Azerite, the goblins 'ave done the same.

It wasn't five minutes after we established ourselves here that the Horde arrived to disrupt our progress.

We've got several shaman of great import waitin' impatiently in the mole machines on that beach.

You can take the key and clear the way so they arrive safely.

passages.title: Mole Machinations
passages.text: Ain't my fault those lads seem to hate small spaces.

passages.title: Mole Machinations
passages.text: If they didn't wanna cook in a mole machine, they shoulda chose a different profession!

passages.title: A Trip Across the Ocean
passages.text:
I understand you are to be establishing our foothold in Drustvar. You will be assisted on this mission by Trade Prince Gallywix.

I know, a strange choice, but I am told that there is Azerite in Drustvar, and the Trade Prince was insistent.

passages.title: A Trip Across the Ocean
passages.text:
Hey <name>. You ever been to Drustvar?

We're goin' to Drustvar.

passages.title: Cookies and Cream
passages.text:
Thank you for helping me collect everything. 

I couldn't let you go out there and battle those mean ettins on an empty stomach. Now, I would be no better than those terrible monsters if I did that, would I?

adventurer, you just feel free to take a load off while I make you a fresh batch of cookies and some warm milk!

passages.title: Cookies and Cream
passages.text: Just a moment...

passages.title: Cookies and Cream
passages.text: What did you think <name>, hit the spot, don't they?

passages.title: Drustvar Ho!
passages.text:
Azerite's in the air, <name>. Can ya smell it?

Drustvar--way over in Kul Tiras--apparently has a real big seam o' Azerite beneath it. Azerite means profit, and profit means winning this war against the Alliance... which means even more profit.

We gotta get that Azerite!

Check in with Eitrigg an' Tattersail so we can get going soon. Time is money!

passages.title: Drustvar Ho!
passages.text: Here we are. Time to see what the Alliance is up to.

passages.title: To Matters at Hand
passages.text:
Ye need te get back te Zuldazar, Princess Talanji's people are in desperate need of help.

Now that ye got the heart, ye can absorb Azerite from all kinds of sources.

Use the teleporter pad behind ye te return te Zuldazar. I be disablin' it when yer done... no need te have the likes of Nathanos walkin' in here.

Just remember. Ye got the Heart of Azeroth around yer neck. Whatever happens... we must save the planet.

passages.title: To Matters at Hand
passages.text: Good, you have returned. Dere is no time to waste.

passages.title: Honor Bound
passages.text:
Sergeant Ermey is a man of honor, he would never leave one of his men behind. But one of these days that sentiment is going to get himself killed. 

We don't even know what threats we face in this land. We certainly don't have the resources to spend searching for a missing private.

I want you to go after him. Do whatever it takes to give up this fool's errand and return to the camp. He was last seen headed to the south-east, I'd start your search there.

passages.title: Honor Bound
passages.text:
Wyrmbane sent you after me, huh? Well, he's going to have to wait.

This thing knows where Private James was taken!

passages.title: Unexpected Aid
passages.text:
I was shadowing those sethrak when I saw this one left for dead beside the trail. I don't think he's like the others. Looks like they roughed him up pretty bad.

I made contact and before he passed out he said he knew where our man was being taken!

We need to find out what this thing knows!

I'll need to make a salve for these wounds. There's some cactus I saw growing around here that should make a good base for it.

passages.title: Unexpected Aid
passages.text: Got the cactus for the salve?

passages.title: Unexpected Aid
passages.text: Those will do the trick!

passages.title: Poisoned Barbs
passages.text:
I'm surprised this snake-man is alive, let alone able to speak. Look at this! 

<Ermey holds up a needle-like barb.>

It looks like it came from one of those giant insects wandering about in the bottom of the gulch. I'll bet my stripes it's poisoned.

You know what they say, that which kills can also cure.

Go get a few more of these barbs. I bet if I mix it in with that cactus he's wanting we will get a good antivenom to treat his wounds.

passages.title: Poisoned Barbs
passages.text: Got those barbs for me?

passages.title: Poisoned Barbs
passages.text: That's the stuff! Hope you didn't get stung too.

passages.title: Cave of Ai'twen
passages.text:
Toki has researched a strategy that is historically sound. However to defeat the Venture Company, we will have to awaken Ai'twen from the bubble of tranquil waters.

Seek out Loroja in the Cave of Ai'twen and we shall begin the process.

passages.title: Cave of Ai'twen
passages.text: Your presence here can only mean one thing.  Ai'twen's help is needed.

passages.title: Anger in a Bottle
passages.text:
These quilboar are tougher than normal and I think I found out why.

They carry vials of some sort, filled with this nasty orange liquid. They'll quaff it and gain tremendous strength and stamina.

I'll bet if we get some of it Hobbs could whip up a counter-agent, or whatever it is that alchemists do. Either way, deprive them of their strength potions and it'll make getting around here easier!

passages.title: Anger in a Bottle
passages.text: Do you have the samples yet?

passages.title: Anger in a Bottle
passages.text: This stuff smells awful. Maybe Hobbs will know what to do with it. Once we get out of here I'll make sure these samples get to him.

passages.title: Armed and Ready
passages.text:
You must be special if the sethrak didn't kill you right away.
 
Either that, or you'd fetch a good price at the slave market.

Don't worry though. We're getting out of here.

I have a wagon at the entrance, but no weapon to fight with.
 
Luckily, it seems the sethrak have plenty.

passages.title: Armed and Ready
passages.text: I'm good with whatever you pick, but let's hurry.

passages.title: Armed and Ready
passages.text: Using their own weapons against them. I like it.

passages.title: WANTED: Gryphon 'Nappers
passages.text:
A warning to all gryphon owners!

Do not let your feathered companions out of your sight. We have received numerous reports about gryphons in the area being stolen in the night.

If anybody can track down and stop these thieves, a reward awaits!

passages.title: WANTED: Gryphon 'Nappers
passages.text:
I heard the lost gryphon came back!

I guess we've got you to thank, <name>.

passages.title: Fragment of the Firelands
passages.text:
The rumors o' yer capabilities seemed overblown, but it appears yer indeed a competent one, aren't ye?

I underestimated ye, <name>. For that, I apologize. Don't tell Thaelin.

The components for the ritual are now prepared. All ye need to do is add the Firelands Slag to the Unstable Magma an' a great bein' from the Firelands will heed our call.

You'll gain control o' it and can eliminate the nearby goblin threat with nigh invincibility.

passages.title: Fragment of the Firelands
passages.text: Me shaman are gettin' better at this, aye? First couple o' summons and we had a hot fight on our hands.

passages.title: Fragment of the Firelands
passages.text: Ah haha haaaaaaaaaaaa! Wow! I gotta admit, I'm a bit jealous I let ye take 'er out for a spin before I could. Those goblins never saw ye comin'!

passages.title: Enormous Anchor Pod
passages.text:
In all the gathering you've done, you have never come across an anchor pod of this size. Whatever the reason that it has gotten so large, there is much that can be learned from it.

Your mind wanders back to Declan, and if there is anything about it in the book you picked up earlier.

passages.title: Enormous Anchor Pod
passages.text: Oh dear... This certainly appears larger than usual. Even the book does not have anything on a giant seed pod. This could be bad...

passages.title: More Anchor Pods
passages.text:
Everyone in Kul Tiras knows that anchor weed is a blight that was brought here by merchants.

It thrives in this weather and it leechs nutrients from other plants, so we work to keep it from spreading, but it also has a strong magical essence, keeping us from just eradicating it.

However, if it has mutated so it can disperse more seeds, we may need to finally purge it.

Bring me the biggest seed pods you can find, we need to see if this is a unique case. I'll dissect this one and learn what I can.

passages.title: More Anchor Pods
passages.text: If the anchor weed is mutating, we may need to purge it from this land.  Do you have the other seed pods for comparison?

passages.title: More Anchor Pods
passages.text:
These all look reasonably sized, which helps to confirm my suspicions.

While I was dissecting the enormous pod, I found glass splinters and noticed that the interior had an alchemical smell. It sounds crazy, but I think an adventurer dropped an elixir of giant growth, shattering the vial and this plant soaked it up.

The enlarged anatomy of the giant pod let me notice that these thick walls of the seed pod are actually thin and lined with additional seeds!  You can peel the pod for more seeds!

passages.title: An Explosive Exit
passages.text:
Alright, adventurer. I think it's time we make a run for it. 

Hopefully my wagon's still nearby.

I'll steer us to our hideaway. I just need you to lob explosives onto any sethrak who are brave enough to follow us.

passages.title: An Explosive Exit
passages.text: This is the troll you flew in with, is it not? She lives, for now.

passages.title: Cultural Significance
passages.text:
I've noticed your skill with harvesting plants has improved, but I also noticed that you just treat each flower and leaf as a commodity. The flora of these islands have a rich history, with a deep cultural significance to us.

Take this sea stalk, go around town, and ask some of the men and women what it means to them. Humor me, and I'll make it worth your while.

passages.title: Cultural Significance
passages.text:
Sea stalk has a unique magical property that allows the stalk to provide the flower water, even if the flower is cut off. 

Sailors will give their loved ones a flower and keep the stalk on themselves, so if they fall over board, the salt water kills the flower. What you hold is more than a stick, it's a family member's life.

As for your lesson, unlike most other magic plants, the best material to harvest for magical essence is the stem, not the leaves or flower.

passages.title: Antidote Application
passages.text:
The antidote's ready. 

It smells like death and tastes worse, but it should be potent enough. Let's hope that we're not too late for it to do any good.

Here, administer the salve to his wounds. It should work nearly instantly.

passages.title: Antidote Application
passages.text:
I can feel life returning to my limbs. Thank you, stranger!

I'm afraid we don't have the time for more of an introduction. Your friend is held captive by the Faithless.

Don't worry, my people will be happy to aid you in return for your kindness to me.

passages.title: WANTED: The Hornet
passages.text:
That's it, I'm putting a bounty on that blasted hornet.

Every time I try to do some good old fashioned bare-handed fishing, that son of a bear comes after me.

Somebody take that bug down!

passages.title: WANTED: The Hornet
passages.text:
The hornet's dead! Good on ya, house cat.

I'd like to not die to a bug.

passages.title: Friends in Strange Places
passages.text:
I saw a creature like your friend here. We both were being held captive by my ruthless kin, the Faithless.

Before I was cast aside I gave him something to protect, something most precious. Naturally, I would also like to see your friend's safe return.

My people will lend you their aid. Come, I will call for my pterrordax to take us. Together we shall find where your soldier friend was taken.

passages.title: Friends in Strange Places
passages.text: Oh no! The Faithless are attacking the temple!

passages.title: Flavorable Offering
passages.text:
Ai'twen saved many Tortollans during the great purge of the Inky Grotto. He rests here in this tranquil bubble as a reward for his service. To entice him back to our world we'll need a flavorful offering.

The seaweed that grows outside is Ai'twen's favorite meal. Its salty flavor will surely coax Ai'twen to leave the bubble for our world. Gather it from the creatures outside this cave, and where it grows wild on the reef.

passages.title: Flavorable Offering
passages.text: Search for the Seaweed outside and on Makrura Brineshells

passages.title: Flavorable Offering
passages.text: An excellent offering.  Let us watch now, and see if this will suffice.

passages.title: Back to Franklin
passages.text:
Oh, good! You are still here!

I heard you had built a rapport with Franklin. I'd be lying if I said talking about him didn't make me reminisce when we worked together.

If you're not busy, could you go talk to him? Ask him if he can show you anything else. I'm sure he remembers more, if you're still looking for more information.

And tell him that if he were to get his life sorted out, I'd like to talk to him about working together again.

passages.title: Back to Franklin
passages.text:
Myra sent you?

Wait... my old business partner?

passages.title: WANTED: Quartermaster Ssylis
passages.text:
Don't venture too far into the bay if you're not looking for a fight!

A couple of Bilge Rats have taken up residence in a nearby cave, and they won't stand down from any challenge.

They ain't harming anybody, 'long as you stay away. But if somebody wants to go take care of their leader, they will be rewarded.

passages.title: WANTED: Quartermaster Ssylis
passages.text: <Alby nods at you.>

passages.title: WANTED: Quartermaster Ssylis
passages.text:
Aye, you got the saurok.

Bilge Rats should be out of here soon enough.

passages.title: Breaking Free
passages.text:
Look, these guys are in a tough spot but let's not lose track of the mission. We've got to rescue Private James!

I saw a bunch of cages down in the camp of those snakes that are besieging the temple. If James is going to be anywhere, then it'll be there!

passages.title: Breaking Free
passages.text: I can't believe you and the sarge went to such effort to rescue me! I'm... I'm speechless... thank you!

passages.title: WANTED: The Crimson Cutthroats
passages.text:
For numerous and sinister crimes against the Lord Admiral: smuggling, forgery, sailing under false colors, looting, poaching, brigandage, sacking, pillaging, vandalism, impersonating Kul Tiran Naval officers, arson, kidnapping, torture, piracy, perjury, theft and ransacking multiple mead shipments.

A reward is placed on the heads of The Crimson Cutthroats to be paid in full upon proof of their demise.

passages.title: WANTED: The Crimson Cutthroats
passages.text: The Crimson Cutthroats are a nasty bunch. I wouldn't be sad to see them go.

passages.title: WANTED: The Crimson Cutthroats
passages.text:
You finally got those damnable outlaws? Well done! My people have enough trouble here without having to deal with brigands. 

Take your reward with my thanks.

passages.title: Defang the Faithless
passages.text:
Did you see them as we flew in? The Faithless are sieging the temple! 

Friend, I know we just met but I must ask for your aid once more. Please, help us break their ranks!

passages.title: Defang the Faithless
passages.text:
I've already heard how you sent the Faithless running! 

On behalf of my people, thank you.

passages.title: Break the Siege
passages.text:
This isn't the first time the Faithless have attacked us, nor will it be the last, but the temple must be protected!

Please, do whatever you can to destroy their siege equipment and push them back.

passages.title: Break the Siege
passages.text: We will not let them win!

passages.title: Break the Siege
passages.text: The Faithless will never stop their siege, but your efforts have bought us time.

passages.title: The Keepers' Keys
passages.text:
It's good to see that your companion is back unharmed.

But more importantly, let's see if he still has my stone hidden in his pockets.

passages.title: The Keepers' Keys
passages.text: The Faithless will never stop their siege, but your efforts have bought us time.

passages.title: An Unusual Mentor
passages.text:
Hey <name>, you look like you're ready to handle hostile territory.

Far away in the desert of Vol'dun, on the continent of Zandalar, there grows a plant called akunda's bite. You couldn't pay me enough to go there myself, and there's almost no mention of them in any of the books I've read, but all is not lost.

I know of an herbalist who lives there in the desert and studies that plant. Find him, and I'm sure he'll be able to teach you a thing or two. Oh, and do be warned...

He is a bit... eccentric.

passages.title: An Unusual Mentor
passages.text:
You seek knowledge on akunda's bite? Marvelous plant, but surprisingly delicate given the harsh environment. Only the strongest will survive...

Hmmm... Yes, you'll do nicely.  If you assist me in my work, I would be willing to provide you with some insights.

passages.title: Foul Harvest
passages.text:
You have traveled far to find knowledge, but you have found me instead. I am curious though, how much further you would travel for it. I will teach you, if you do something for me first.

Iron sharpens iron, as they say, so too does adversity strengthen the seed.

Go out and find seeds, ones that have been consumed by the wild beasts and have returned to the earth unscathed.

Only those seeds will be strong enough to survive the desert sands of Vol'dun.

passages.title: Foul Harvest
passages.text: Were you able to get the seeds?

passages.title: Foul Harvest
passages.text:
Hmmm... This seems like a good harvest. There is a quiet dignity in their resilience.

But dignity is not enough. They must be more than quiet, they must quake with thunder.

passages.title: Carry On
passages.text:
Let's get to Brennadam right away. We need to find Brother Pike and get to the bottom of all of this before things get any worse.

This road should take us right into town. Brennadam's the busiest market this side of Boralus, so there should be plenty of people there who can help us find Pike.

Ready when you are!

passages.title: Carry On
passages.text: Looks like more trouble.

passages.title: Reporting In
passages.text:
I can't believe what we got ourselves in the middle of here. Keystones, C'Thraxxi, there's even a snake-man civil war going on!

All I know is Wyrmbane is going to want a full report and if there's anything I hate more than inept privates getting themselves captured it's paperwork.

Let's get going.

passages.title: Reporting In
passages.text:
<Wyrmbane listens to your report.>

The news of this C'Thraxxi is troubling, but you did well in befriending the local population. This likely won't be the last time we'll have to depend upon them.

Well done, <name>.

passages.title: The Speaker's Imperative
passages.text:
The world's soul is secure... fer now. I can hear Azeroth again, although her voice is still weak.

The elementals on the surface above have calmed down. Even using just a fraction of its power, the Heart of Azeroth brought stability tae this place.

Ye need tae return tae Stormwind and inform your allies of what transpired here. Remind them that no matter what happens with the Horde, our world must be saved.

We'll speak again soon, <name>. The battle fer Azeroth has only just begun.

passages.title: The Speaker's Imperative
passages.text:
<Wyrmbane listens to your tale.>

The Heart of Azeroth... a powerful artifact indeed.  Thank the Light you were there to aid Magni.

But I fear I bear dire news, <name>. While you were away, the Horde launched a brazen attack on Stormwind.

I have a message for you from King Anduin. You must meet him at the keep at once.

passages.title: What Happens Next
passages.text:
After feeling the bite of Akunda so many times, static electricity causes your hair to stand on end as you hold in your hands an intact lightning pod. You noticed that by wrapping the lightning pod in it's own leaves, you were able to remove it without discharging it.

If you manage to develop this technique, harvesting this plant would become significantly less hazardous and provide additional material in pristine condition.

passages.title: Find Their Words
passages.text:
This portal will get you quickly back to the outpost.

When there, present the orders to Akru. 

Her knowledge is vast, she will be able to discern the truth within.

passages.title: Find Their Words
passages.text: Ah. Deyon is correct. I know many things. What do you have there?

passages.title: Find Their Words
passages.text: Yes... yes... I see here. Dire words indeed, young one.

passages.title: Xibala
passages.text:
<name>! How's things going over here?

Oh. Wow. There's Horde soldiers everywhere. And Zandalari trolls. And hardly any machines at all.

We should DEFINITELY head back to Xibala, with the dark iron dwarves. It's perfect for our foothold!

passages.title: Xibala
passages.text: You're <name>, the <race> <class> that Kelsey's been talkin' up? We've heard much about ye, lad.

passages.title: Shiver Me Timbers
passages.text:
It seems our resident shadow hunter has managed to seize a small pirate sloop.

We have sent him to Tiragarde Sound in a search for a foothold, and it seems that he has concocted a plan.

Ty'jin has requested your help, personally. Do not keep him waiting.

passages.title: Shiver Me Timbers
passages.text: Welcome ta Tiragarde, boss-mon. Ya ready to be parleyin'?

passages.title: There's No Place Like Home
passages.text:
So, the Arathi Highlands. Quite a sprawl, isn't it?

At some point, you may wish to return to this fair Stromgarde with haste.

Might I offer a suggestion as to how...?

passages.title: There's No Place Like Home
passages.text: Should you desire to return with haste, simply use this, yes?

passages.title: Inspection Gadget
passages.text:
Some time ago, a good friend of mine who had a tinker shop in Boralus just stopped all correspondence. With the state of foreign affairs, I wasn't able to look for him myself until recently.

It's not just him. It seems that all of the gnomes that were living in the city just up and vanished.

I've decided to start my search with these ruins, but the machines here have gone haywire. Could you go get a good magnetic reading on the place?

passages.title: Inspection Gadget
passages.text: This data is astounding! It will take quite a while to go through all of it.

passages.title: Reverse Tinkering
passages.text:
The sentry bots here are definitely of gnomish make. If the creator had any sort of proper education, each machine should have some sort of serial code on it.

And if they've been properly documented, I might be able to use those codes to track that gnome down.

Do you think you could bring a few of them back to me?

passages.title: Reverse Tinkering
passages.text: Did you find anything interesting?

passages.title: Reverse Tinkering
passages.text: I'll have to send these back to Ironforge and we'll see if they can find anything.

passages.title: An Unusual Mentor
passages.text:
You have done well so far, <name>, but dere is still much more for you to learn. I think it is time for you to meet an old 'friend'.

Dere is no better person I know of to teach you about akunda's bite, as his knowledge and respect for de plant is unrivaled.

Head North beyond the desert of Vol'dun. Dere you will find a tortollan who will teach you more about de desert flower.

passages.title: An Unusual Mentor
passages.text:
You seek knowledge on akunda's bite? Marvelous plant, but surprisingly delicate given the harsh environment. Only the strongest will survive...

Hmmm... Yes, you'll do nicely.  If you assist me in my work, I would be willing to provide you with some insights.

passages.title: Swashbuckling in Style
passages.text:
First ting's first, boss-mon. Ya can't parley with pirates unless ya got da appropriate clothes.

I ain't big on fashion, mon, but what ya be wearin' won't work.

Luckily I collected dis box of pirate clothes. No need ta ask how. Just need ta get piratey.

passages.title: Swashbuckling in Style
passages.text: Pick whateva ya want, boss-mon. Dere be so many clothes in dat chest.

passages.title: Swashbuckling in Style
passages.text: Now we be talkin', boss-mon! Ya look ready ta do some privateerin'!

passages.title: Parleyin' Wit Pirates
passages.text:
Some a dese pirates be unhappy wit' da leadership.

I been hearin' dey're da last truly free pirates. Da rest be sellin' out ta some lady named Ashvane.
