I don' really care 'bout dat, but da captain of dese Fogsail Freebootas is tinkin' 'bout sellin' out too.

We gonna help stop it, and in return build a foothold here.

passages.title: Parleyin' Wit Pirates
passages.text: <name>, nicht wahr? Ich habe vernommen, dass Ty'jin einen Champion seiner Horde schicken würde.

passages.title: Parleyin' Wit Pirates
passages.text: I don't care about your faction wars, <name>. If you are the folks that will help save my crew, you are the folks that will get my help.

passages.title: Spike the Punch
passages.text:
Step one in causing a mutiny? Make it seem like leadership is incompetent.

If the captain wants to sell our souls to the Ashvanes, we're going to need to get dirty.

I hate to say it... but we've got to muck up the booze.

That'll make the crew angry at the captain before you can even blink.

passages.title: Spike the Punch
passages.text: It's a dirty deed, but it's necessary.

passages.title: Spike the Punch
passages.text:
That is not what I...

You know what? Sure. That works.

passages.title: Marking Our Territory
passages.text:
Dis could turn out ta be quite da foothold, boss-mon!

I will help wit' da settlin', turnin' da place into a good base.

I tink we need some spikes.

Let's be makin' tings official.

passages.title: Marking Our Territory
passages.text: Dis place be feelin' like home in no time.

passages.title: Marking Our Territory
passages.text: Dis place be feelin' like home in no time.

passages.title: Cannonball Collection
passages.text:
Walkin' through da harbor gave me some ideas, boss-mon.

Ya see dem big guys wit' da cannonballs?

Collect some a dat ammo and bring it ta me. I tink I be havin' a use for it.

passages.title: Cannonball Collection
passages.text: Did ya get da cannonballs?

passages.title: Cannonball Collection
passages.text: Oh da goblins gonna be lovin' dese, mon.

passages.title: A Change in Direction
passages.text:
Whispers of dissent have been spreading through the harbor, <name>.

You can hear the grumblings of pirates who do not want to give up their freedom!

Rumor holds that some of the other authority figures have goals that align with mine.

I forged some letters in the captain's hand. Deliver them... see who bites.

Or who gets in our way.

passages.title: A Change in Direction
passages.text: Mutiny is about subversion. We must fly under the radar as long as we can!

passages.title: A Change in Direction
passages.text: I hoped that Taryn would see the truth. Ah, well. So it goes.

passages.title: Thar She Blows!
passages.text:
Our goblin engineers been workin' on modifyin' some cannons for our uses.

Da cannonballs you been collectin' be perfect ammo for dem.

Dere are rowboats in da harbor dat be readyin' ta bring loot to Owings's enemies. Take dis cannon and sink 'em before dey can get away!

passages.title: Thar She Blows!
passages.text: Sometimes ya gotta use da ammo of ya enemies against dem, mon.

passages.title: Thar She Blows!
passages.text: Now we be havin' ourselves a mutiny!

passages.title: I'm the Captain Now
passages.text:
Alright <name>... It's time to take the mutiny to the captain.

Rhenik sits in his cave, readying himself to sell our souls to the Ashvanes!

Defeat him, and I will allow you to use my port as though it were your own.

passages.title: I'm the Captain Now
passages.text: I cannot stand by and watch Rhenik sell our freedom.

passages.title: I'm the Captain Now
passages.text:
Captain Owings...

It has a certain ring to it, don't you think?

passages.title: Battle for Azeroth: Mission Statement
passages.text:
<name>! The Warchief has summoned you to undertake a mission of the utmost secrecy.

The very future of the Horde is at stake.

passages.title: Battle for Azeroth: Mission Statement
passages.text: The Dark Lady has placed her trust in us. We will not fail her, <name>.

passages.title: Thros, the Blighted Lands
passages.text:
The Blighted Lands... 

If the legends are true then inside we will witness suffering and torment the likes of which we have never known. ..

...but if that is what I must endure to right what I have wronged, then I will cross that threshold gladly.

Will you join me, <class>?

passages.title: Thros, the Blighted Lands
passages.text: I'm with you, champion.

passages.title: Thros, the Blighted Lands
passages.text:
Words cannot express the debt I owe you for helping return my daughter to me, but unfortunately the traitor Ashvane has left us no time for celebration.

We must act.

passages.title: Meet Sweetflower
passages.text:
You have seen and learned much from these islands, but Zandalar is not de only place where you can learn. I have heard of a flower dat cannot grow on dese islands.

If you want to know more about it, you will need to find someone more knowledgeable dan myself. Fortunately for you, I know of someone who may be able to help you.

Her name's Xun Xun Sweetflower, and last I heard she set up shop on the outskirts of Anyport over on de human island of Drustvar.

passages.title: Meet Sweetflower
passages.text: Oh, you'd like to learn about harvesting winter's kiss?  Well that's very fortunate, for both of us...

passages.title: Aromatic Pollenator
passages.text:
While gathering the pollen, you found a dead wasp absolutely covered in pollen. You know that this little creature is the secret to harvesting pollen easier, but the answer seems just out grasp.

Maybe if you ask Jahden about it, he might have an idea.

passages.title: Aromatic Pollenator
passages.text: Yes, I am familiar with dese wasps. Dey are notorious for how... Actually, this gives me an idea... but you may not like it.

passages.title: Disgustingly Damp Flower
passages.text:
Rummaging for pollen as usual, you use the harvesting technique you learned from the wasps. However, when you pull your hand away from the flower, you find that there is no pollen to be seen.

Looking inside the swirl of petals, despite it being a mature flower, you see that there is no pollen at all. Upon closer inspection you see that the flower is filled with a viscous liquid. Could the flower have done this?

While unpleasant to touch, you carefully pluck the flower to show Jahden.

passages.title: Disgustingly Damp Flower
passages.text: Hmm... Dis flower does not seem to have any pollen left. I cannot say that I have heard of a plant doing that before. Dis must be the work of some other creature.

passages.title: Pollen Punching
passages.text:
It looks like some beast managed to lap up all de pollen with it's tongue. It is curious as to what creature could have done dis, I doubt it matters.

You should be able to do dis yourself without needing any sort of rare or dangerous reagents.

Next time you find a siren's sting, wet your glove so the pollen will stick to it. Water, wine, blood... It should not matter.

passages.title: Here In Spirit
passages.text:
If you are up to de challenge, I have a task dat I believe is up your alley.

De spirits of dis land are screaming out in anguish. However, dey are either unwilling or unable to talk to me in their current state.

I need you to get some fresh star moss, which will help anchor and calm their spirits. Once dey are calm, we will be able to give dem de help dey need.

Do dis, and I will teach you how to harvest star moss more effectively.

passages.title: Here In Spirit
passages.text: De spirits are restless. Have you managed to get de fresh star moss yet?

passages.title: Here In Spirit
passages.text:
You have done well. I will begin the ritual as soon as I can.

In de mean time, you are owed a lesson on how to harvest star moss.

The magic of star moss is sensitive to emotions, which is why it helps ground those dat have passed on.

When you go to harvest, clear your mind and think of those you've lost. Dat feeling of loss, reverence, and de joy dey once brought will keep de bloom from wilting.

passages.title: A Load of Scrap
passages.text:
Hey there stranger, you want the scoop on the latest invention of the century?

It's called the Shred-Master Mk1 and this baby can triple, no QUADRUPLE your production capacity as a crafter of armor, weapons or other doohickeys you adventurers wander around with.

Here, take these pants and use the Shred-Master on 'em. You'll get the gist of it.

passages.title: A Load of Scrap
passages.text: This machine is gonna change everything.

passages.title: A Load of Scrap
passages.text:
And just like that, you're back in business. All the materials you put into makin' the item come back to you with the Shred-Master Mk1.

Okay, fine! Maybe not ALL the materials, but hey, something's better than nothin', right?

Oh, and keep an eye out for explusom. It's what we've discovered as a magical byproduct of the scrappin' process.

It's quite potent and only shows up when we scrap really fancy stuff.

passages.title: Life Preserver
passages.text:
The Thornspeakers were assisting me but they have troubles of their own.

I came in search of a powerful dragon who fell in battle many centuries ago. Melting snows have revealed Vadekius's final resting place.

My Queen has tasked me with ensuring his body cannot be reanimated and enslaved. The ritual will require my full attention and my druid friends aren't fit for combat.

Watch my back while I ensure my cousin's soul flies amid the branches of G'Hanir, safe from undeath.

passages.title: Life Preserver
passages.text: Will you watch my back as I complete the ritual?

passages.title: Life Preserver
passages.text: Thank you for your help.

passages.title: Forged in Fire an' Flame
passages.text:
Ye've done more than I had any right tae ask, <name>. Recovered Ironfoe from our enemy, retrieved a fragment o' the Molten Core, an' exposed the enemy within our ranks at the Firelands.

If ye'd do me the honor, would ye come with us tae Blackrock Depths one last time while we repair our most sacred anvil?

passages.title: Forged in Fire an' Flame
passages.text: Ye've been a lifesaver, <name>.

passages.title: Forged in Fire an' Flame
passages.text: We're grateful to ye, <name>.

passages.title: Ghost Busting
passages.text:
I have spoken with de spirits. Most of dem were willing to bare their souls, calling for help from de living as dey are under attack from de blood trolls evil magic.

Dere was one, however, who seemed more angry dan most. It was furious dat we had not acted yet, dat we allowed things to get dis bad.

Go to de Spirits Be With You inn at de port north of here and put dis spirit down, and in return I will teach you everything else I know about gathering star moss.

passages.title: Ghost Busting
passages.text:
I owe you my thanks, <name>. Now that the spirit has been been put to rest, I can get back to work.

You have shown, once again, dat I can rely on you. In exchange, I will tell you the best kept secret of star moss.

Dis is going to sound crazy, but engage with it. Before you pick de flowers, talk to it, sing, hum, anything. I'm not sure why, but since I started, I have noticed one or two extra flowers will bloom before my eyes!

passages.title: The Uncorrupted
passages.text:
This world is... not what I expected.

It is time for us to meet your warchief, <name>.

There is no need to delay any further.

We can lick our wounds once we have a roof over our heads.

passages.title: The Uncorrupted
passages.text: I see you brought a new face along with you, <name>

passages.title: Enormous Anchor Pod
passages.text:
In all the gathering you've done, you have never come across an anchor pod of this size. Whatever the reason that it has gotten so large, there is much that can be learned from it.

Your mind wanders back to Jahden, and if there is anything about it in the book you picked up earlier.

passages.title: Enormous Anchor Pod
passages.text: Hmm... Dis certainly appears larger than usual, even de book does not have anything on a giant seed pod. I have a thought...

passages.title: More Anchor Pods
passages.text:
I need you to bring me a handful of mature anchor pods.

You see, dis seed pod is massive, but it is still just a seed pod. If we dissect it and take careful notes, we can learn about de normal, smaller seed pods and easily see how de anatomy works.

I need you to bring me more of dese mature anchor pods. If my theory is correct, den we could actually have a factual record for de future.

passages.title: More Anchor Pods
passages.text: I just finished with my notes from dissecting de massive seed pod. Do you have de other seed pods for comparison?

passages.title: More Anchor Pods
passages.text:
I am still unsure as to how dis thing got so big, but I am willing to believe dat it is a gift from de Loa.

Dat said, when I was dissecting de big pod, I noticed dat what I thought were just thick walls along de exterior of de pod were actually a separate chamber full of seeds! See? If you carefully trim and peel back de skin on de normal pod, you can harvest some extra seeds.

passages.title: Heritage o' the Dark Iron
passages.text:
Ye've done us proud, <name>. I've heard tales o' yer bravery during yer journeys across the surface o' Azeroth.

Return tae the mountain. We've got somethin' special fer ye.

passages.title: Heritage o' the Dark Iron
passages.text:
The Dark Irons never had it easy in this world. But with champions like ye tae fight for 'em, our allies know the courage that burns in our hearts.

Enough fancy banter! Take this armor, then let's toast yer courage with a mug o' cold brew!

passages.title: Heritage of the Mag'har
passages.text:
You have fought countless battles across the face of Azeroth. You have shown both our allies and enemies what it means to be Mag'har!

Return to Orgrimmar that I may recognize your dedication to our people.

passages.title: Heritage of the Mag'har
passages.text:
Though Draenor is lost to us, we will never forget our ancestral home... or those who were lost in the fight for our freedom.

Your victories in Azeroth prove that our people have earned a place in the Horde. It pleases me to honor you with this symbol of our proud lineage.

passages.title: Time to Leave
passages.text:
I knew it! I knew the fleet wasn't just lost!

We may be a little in over our heads here. Let's leave before things get out of hand.

Galeheart can take us to Stormsong Valley from here. No point in following tradition at this point, right?

passages.title: Time to Leave
passages.text: What's going on here?!

passages.title: Border Issues
passages.text:
They've closed off the entire valley! No wonder so many people have been complaining about trading with the Brennadam market.

We have to do something about this. These people need to make a living!

You're going to have to be an honorary cadet for me here, <name>. Tell these ruffians to clear the road!

passages.title: Border Issues
passages.text: We have to stop this!

passages.title: Border Issues
passages.text: Good work! Now these fine people can go about their lives.

passages.title: Gunpowder Plot
passages.text:
Granny has everyone out running errands trying to put our hamlet back in order.

I don't know what to do. The rats have gotten into our stores, they're eating everything in sight.

I tried prodding one of them to get it to move along, it started foaming at the mouth, then it exploded! 

Think I know where all the gunpowder went...

If you recover any, can you please take it back to Marie?

passages.title: Gunpowder Plot
passages.text: Were you able to find any powder, dear?

passages.title: Gunpowder Plot
passages.text: Thank you so much. I wish Charles was half as studious as you.

passages.title: Cookie Delivery
passages.text:
Before you head out, dear, I have one more favor to ask of you.

Please take these cookies with you to Charles.

What sort of grandmother would I be if I didn't bake some for him too!?

A terrible one, that's what, and I've no wish to be accused of that!

passages.title: Cookie Delivery
passages.text: Are those cookies I smell!?

passages.title: Cookie Delivery
passages.text: Cookies, for me!? Thank you!

passages.title: Vengeance for Vol'jin
passages.text:
If we mean to destroy Zalazane then we gonna need something that can damage that spirit.

Da Glaive of Vol'jin might be what we need to do this.

Zalazane be hovering near where he fell so many years ago. Rokhan and Talanji have already gone to face him.

Go, slay Zalazane, and then plunge da glaive into the spirit before it can escape. Let us hope de bargain Vol'jin made be powerful enough to destroy this enemy.

passages.title: Vengeance for Vol'jin
passages.text: Zalazane has plagued the Darkspear longer than any enemy we ever faced. His destruction must happen swiftly.

passages.title: Vengeance for Vol'jin
passages.text: Da blade... it be glowin'. It never did dat before.

passages.title: Spirit Call
passages.text:
We gonna be reachin' far into de Shadowlands for this. If Vol'jin has gone beyond Bwonsamdi's vision than either he be lost somewhere or hiding.

Either way, I am hoping the bond he shares with de gathered Darkspear here can help bring him to us.

Stay close and don't interrupt de ritual once it has begun.

passages.title: Spirit Call
passages.text: 'Ello mon.

passages.title: The Warlord's Call
passages.text:
Warfang Hold is our best position on Kul Tiras. We can not allow it to fall!

The Warchief has placed High Warlord Cromush in charge of our reinforcement efforts, you are ordered to report to him as soon as possible.

passages.title: The Warlord's Call
passages.text: Hurry up and get yourself squared away, <name>. We've got a battle to get to.

passages.title: Storming In
passages.text:
Front and center, <name>!

As of last night, we received word that Rexxar's force at Warfang Hold in Stormsong was surrounded by a Kul Tiran army and an attack is imminent.

As soon as you have your things packed, go speak with Dread-Admiral Tattersail and we'll get underway. There's no time to waste!

passages.title: Storming In
passages.text:
I don't know what foul sorcery those Kul Tirans used upon our ships, but right now our men are being pushed to the shore with nowhere to evacuate!

No time to puzzle things over, we have to act now!

passages.title: The Glaive of Vol'jin
passages.text:
When fighting someone who has escaped the grasp of Bwonsamdi, as Zalazane has, it is best to bring weapons that can hurt him.

In Darkspear Hold you will find the Glaive of Vol'jin.

It should have enough bond with Vol'jin's spirit to aid us in this fight.

passages.title: The Glaive of Vol'jin
passages.text: Did you find the glaive?

passages.title: The Glaive of Vol'jin
passages.text:
The bond between Vol'jin and Zalazane was one of magic and bargains with loa.

The bond between Vol'jin and dis weapon was also great. Dis may be what we need to finally destroy that spirit.

passages.title: A Veteran's Summons
passages.text:
<name>, we received word from Orgrimmar. Eitrigg has requested a meeting. Says it's important. He left a letter for you.

I wouldn't keep him waiting or he might expire of old age before you find out what he wants.

passages.title: On the Hunt
passages.text:
Looks like the magic the Kul Tirans used on our ships is beginning to dissipate, but I'm sure what happened to our ships here is only just the beginning.

Get to the shore. We need to contact the survivors and find out just what we're up against.

passages.title: On the Hunt
passages.text:
Thank you, friend.

These humans have made a grave error today.

passages.title: Word from the Deep
passages.text:
A dark soul has infiltrated the Zanchuli Council, seeking an accord with Queen Azshara.

Some followed, through greed or fear. Others were too trusting and believed his lies.

We fall, one by one. They will soon clear the path of resistance.

Azshara's motives are hidden behind a vast darkness. She reaches into a place from where she cannot return.

I would pity her, but she killed my followers...

When the time comes, I will rip her apart.

passages.title: Word from the Deep
passages.text: It seems the naga have moved up in threat level from "mere nuisance". These are dark days indeed.

passages.title: Inform the Horde!
passages.text:
This was all perpetrated by someone on the Zanchuli Council. 

They sacrificed their own people, Gral's followers, for Azshara. That is unconscionable!

They weaken the foundation, so the kingdom will fall.

One of your people must have direct access to the king. Anyone else could be the traitor.

passages.title: Inform the Horde!
passages.text: It was wise of you to bring this to me, <name>.

passages.title: Saplings in the Snow
passages.text:
Be wary mainlander, dangers lurk nearby. 

One such creature, Greenstalker, used to be an ally. In his corrupted, mindless rage he nearly killed my brother and I while we were trying to help someone in the wilds. There is something which might help but I must tend to my brother's wounds and cannot obtain the remaining item on my own.

Please go onto the mountainside and pull some saplings out of the earth for me. The plants here are healthy and their roots run deep so they won't come easily.

passages.title: Saplings in the Snow
passages.text: Did you find the mountain saplings I need?

passages.title: Saplings in the Snow
passages.text:
Thank you for returning quickly. These are new growth, full of potent life-giving energy and a necessary sacrifice to cleanse corruption.

Give me a moment as I create the charm.

passages.title: Disarming the Cannons
passages.text:
With your arrival, our salvation may have arrived. Your rowboats will serve as a way for us to evacuate the most critically injured.

Unfortunately, the Horde have brought in a ship, and there's no way we can get our boats past their blockade.

While the rest of us load our injured on the boats, we need you to infiltrate their ship and disable those cannons.

passages.title: Disarming the Cannons
passages.text: What's the status of those cannons?

passages.title: Disarming the Cannons
passages.text: Now we can get our wounded to safety.

passages.title: WANTED: Rindlewoe
passages.text:
A monstrous beast of wood and flesh has been terrorizing the nearby river territories.

If any adventurers are brave enough to vanquish this beast, the town of Fallhaven would gratefully proffer a reward.

Please report to Mayor White if you wish to help.

passages.title: WANTED: Rindlewoe
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: WANTED: Rindlewoe
passages.text:
The beast has been slain? You have my thanks, <class>.

Here is your reward, as promised.

passages.title: The Days Are Just Packed
passages.text:
Hello there! Would you mind checking on someone for me?

Sergeant Calvin was supposed to meet me here. We were going to go out looking for new alchemical reagents, but he hasn't shown up yet.

I know the militia has been really busy lately so I guess he's busy, but he should still be in Brennadam Square. Would you mind checking in on him?

passages.title: The Days Are Just Packed
passages.text: This can't be happening...

passages.title: Reloading
passages.text:
Daryl's making every shot count, but there's just too many Horde. We're going to need more ammo soon!

I need you to take this note to my uncle Leo at Deadwash, he'll be able to help.

passages.title: Reloading
passages.text: Lea Martin?  She's a tough one!  I'll try to help her, but we gotta save our people first.

passages.title: Keep Them On Task
passages.text:
Princess Talanji's actions have thrown off our pursuers. Her loa is powerful indeed.

We need to be certain if there were survivors, they do not gain a foothold on Zandalar. I am concerned that our Forsaken compatriots might get... overzealous. Please keep an eye on them, and remind them of what is honorable.

passages.title: Keep Them On Task
passages.text: You've been sent to check up on me?

passages.title: Myself Again
passages.text:
I joined the tidesages because I wanted to show my brother I wasn't a weakling. 

I loved the magic and power, but I started to do unspeakable things. I even tried to hurt my own family.

Please get word to my brother at Dire Hills Lodge. Tell him I have come to my senses. I am myself again.

passages.title: Myself Again
passages.text: It's just like Julian to realize his mistakes long after he's done harm to others.  I hope he finds his way, but right now I have people here to worry about.

passages.title: Irontide Warning
passages.text:
Horde's taking this town! I'm not gonna stick around to watch!

You could help me out though. Go see Leo Shealds in Deadwash. 

Tell him, Irontide is still coming and we're taking the gold!

passages.title: The Zandalar Campaign
passages.text:
It is time that we begin to think of our enemy, <name>. The Horde spreads its influence throughout Zandalar unchecked.

King Anduin has charged us with establishing footholds in the areas of Zuldazar, Nazmir, and Vol'dun.

I have taken the liberty of deploying some of our forces in key locations, but each will need a firm hand--your hand--to direct our efforts.

Which location shall we secure first?

passages.title: The Zandalar Campaign
passages.text: A fine choice, <name>.

passages.title: Foothold: Zuldazar
passages.text:
Zuldazar is the seat o' power fer the Zandalar empire.

I've deployed some o' me mole machines in a place called Xibala. There's a nearby Azerite deposit that'll be o' great interest to the King. My lads say they're under attack.

 - Moira Thaurissan

passages.title: Foothold: Zuldazar
passages.text: You have chosen to sail to Zuldazar.

passages.title: Foothold: Nazmir
passages.text:
The swamp of Nazmir is home to the notorious blood trolls.

Captain Conrad has been dispatched to determine how we can use their hatred toward the Zandalari to our advantage. Reports from the jungle have proven disconcerting at best.

 - Mathias Shaw

passages.title: Foothold: Nazmir
passages.text: You have chosen to sail to Nazmir.

passages.title: Foothold: Vol'dun
I've Got Your Back
passages.text:
It's good to see a new face around here. I've got a problem and you look like you can handle a fight.

Dat group of murderous thugs over dere are looking for trouble and I need someone to back me up.

De truth is dat I used to be one of dem myself, but I left for a second chance at an honest life.

I need to convince Mojambo and his henchmons to leave before dey start causing trouble for de rest of de outcasts here.

passages.title: I've Got Your Back
passages.text: Mojambo isn't going to back down easily.

passages.title: I've Got Your Back
passages.text: Mojambo will come back with all his minions. And when he does... dere will be blood.

passages.title: Freshly Squeezed
passages.text:
Is this troll a friend of yours? I'm so glad Kiro let me keep her. 

He's a bit wary of outsiders, but he's a great healer. 

She'll wake up, I promise. And when she does, she'll be thirsty.

The sands are short on water, but you're in luck. The grove that surrounds this camp is filled with pricklevines. 

You wouldn't want to eat the flesh, but the liquid inside can quench any thirst.

Just give them a good squeeze to collect their juice.

passages.title: Freshly Squeezed
passages.text: Do you have the juice? Your friend will be thirsty when she wakes.

passages.title: Freshly Squeezed
passages.text: That's a lot of juice!

passages.title: Make it Mildenhall
passages.text:
You've no doubt enjoyed a mug or three of world-famous Mildenhall Mead in your local tavern. Today is your day to become a part of the official meadery of Stormsong Valley!

Ideal applicants have a hunger for craft mead, honey, and boundless innovation. Military experience recommended, but not required.

Must not be allergic to bees.

Mildenhall Mead - Make it Mildenhall.

passages.title: Make it Mildenhall
passages.text: <Ancel is nearly hysterical.>

passages.title: Onward!
passages.text:
I'm glad you came, <name>. With your help, we will show these Kul Tiran dogs what happens when you face a cornered beast!

Warfang Hold is just up the path from here. Come, I'll fill you in on the details.

passages.title: Onward!
passages.text: I thought I was going to meet the Earthmother along with the rest of my men.

passages.title: Breaking Kul Tiran Will
passages.text:
Our partnership with the Zandalari will soon be secured. Took a little longer than I expected... but such is the way of things.

Unfortunately, the Alliance seems intent on securing a naval force of their own. That can't be allowed to happen.

We set sail for Tiragarde Sound when you're ready.

passages.title: Breaking Kul Tiran Will
passages.text:
We're here. Now, to cause a bit of trouble for the locals.

<Nathanos looks at you, then at the rest of the group.>

We don't look too conspicuous, do we?

passages.title: Into the Heart of Tiragarde
passages.text:
Step one is to establish a more suitable base of operations. A pirate's den will do in a pinch, but I believe the warchief expects better of us.

Let's split up and push farther inland, to the west. Be on the lookout for something defensible and inconspicuous.

passages.title: Into the Heart of Tiragarde
passages.text:
<Nathanos peers around the corner at the Kul Tiran roughneck camp.>

This will do. Not only is it well-hidden in the forest, but the locals seem to be rather dull and easily outwitted.

passages.title: Our Mountain Now
passages.text:
<name>, go take care of those "roughnecks." They might fashion themselves as tough, but a bit of your unique brand of Horde savagery should have them running in no time.

Lilian, scout the area. We need to know about any nearby threats.

Rangers, secure the perimeter. We'll reconvene in the roughneck camp once <name>'s work is done.

passages.title: Our Mountain Now
passages.text: Me? I'll go where I'm needed.

passages.title: Our Mountain Now
passages.text:
<Nathanos looks around the camp and nods to himself.>

This will do.

passages.title: Bridgeport Investigation
passages.text:
While you're in Bridgeport, you might keep an ear out for any information that will be of aid to us.

You'd be surprised what you can learn by staying quiet and listening to people who think they're alone...

passages.title: Bridgeport Investigation
passages.text:
Explosives in the Ashvane Foundry? Clearly we can put that information to use. Well done.

It sounds like that Captain Stone is somewhat of a big-shot as well. It would be a shame if something were to happen to her...

passages.title: Explosives in the Foundry
passages.text:
I'm most interested in those explosives, though.

Meet me in the foundry, east of here. You probably passed through it on your way from Plunder Harbor.

passages.title: Explosives in the Foundry
passages.text:
<Lilian gestures toward a pile of crates nearby.>

Think those are filled with the explosives?

passages.title: Explosivity
passages.text:
I don't want to waste your time. Let's make absolutely sure that these are what we're looking for.

Here, take this torch and toss it over onto those crates. If they explode, then we'll know what to do next.

passages.title: Explosivity
passages.text: Well?

passages.title: Explosivity
passages.text: I... ah... I guess we've found our gunpowder then.

passages.title: Ammunition Acquisition
passages.text:
First: we get as much of that gunpowder as we possibly can. Imagine the terror in the Kul Tirans' eyes when they realize the Horde has turned their own weapons against them.

Imagine it, <name>.

<Lilian's eyes briefly glaze over, and the corner of her lips turns upward in a half-smile.>

passages.title: Ammunition Acquisition
passages.text: I've managed to round up a few crates myself. How did you do?

passages.title: Ammunition Acquisition
passages.text: Excellent.

passages.title: A Bit of Chaos
passages.text:
This place seems fairly well-defended for a manufacturing facility, doesn't it?

<Lilian shrugs.>

I suppose we'll have to kill them, then.

passages.title: A Bit of Chaos
passages.text: <Lilian bounces her blade in her hands, looks up, and nods approvingly at you.>

passages.title: Death Trap
passages.text:
We started this mission with a goal, but not much of a plan. I think I can see the pieces coming together, though.

<Lilian surveys the horizon, thinking.>

Place these explosives over on the southwest edge of town. Somewhere inconspicuous.

We'll meet again over there. In the meantime... I need to find a horse.

passages.title: Death Trap
passages.text:
Lucky for us, horses are in no short supply around here.

You placed the gunpowder?

passages.title: Bandit Blades
passages.text:
We only have enough weapons to arm half of de tribe against Mojambo's gang.

We're going to need more weapons if we are going to survive de approaching battle.

Tongo's crew is sure to have a ready supply of weapons at their hideout.

Search de hideout for any weapons you can find and bring dem back to de arena.

passages.title: Bandit Blades
passages.text: Do you have de weapons?

passages.title: Bandit Blades
passages.text: Dese ancient blades may not be in de best condition, but dey are finely forged. I am sure dey will hold up in battle just fine.

passages.title: A Wall of Iron
passages.text:
The enemy has pushed our men to the shore and sunk their ships. They have nowhere to run and nowhere to hide; it's up to us to save them!

Get below deck, man a cannon, and start laying down some covering fire. They're depending on us!

passages.title: A Wall of Iron
passages.text: Good job, that'll buy our troops some breathing room.

passages.title: Preparing for the Fall
passages.text:
<A large quantity of supplies are scattered throughout the temple grounds, much of it under heavy guard. The Jambani appear to be preparing for a siege or another significant event.

Zul would likely think it wise to stymie their efforts.>

passages.title: Preparing for the Fall
passages.text:
Good. I did not need to tell you to do dis thing.

De Jambani prepare for de fall of Zuldazar as foretold by Vol'jamba. Dis will not happen, but destroying their stockpiles will make dem easier to eradicate once Rastakhan decides to deal with dis situation.

passages.title: Douse the Flames
passages.text:
Do you smell it, <name>? Smoke! They're burning down Warfang Hold!

There is little point to our battle if our base burns to the ground!

Their tidesages use wands to control their constructs of water. In our hands they may give us a chance to save the Hold! 

Get those wands and put out the fires before the camp burns to ash!

passages.title: Douse the Flames
passages.text: We're fortunate that the Kul Tirans have a greater affinity for water than they do for fire.

passages.title: Douse the Flames
passages.text: Fire, blood, war. Nothing will stop us.

passages.title: Hunt Them Down
passages.text:
These Kul Tirans, they don't seem normal. Humans can be a cruel bunch from what I've heard, but these ones seem to take pleasure in slaying the fallen. 

The worst of them was a woman wearing a peculiar mask. She seemed to be shouting orders to the others, so I guess she's their leader.

Honor the fallen and ensure they and their leader don't survive.

passages.title: Hunt Them Down
passages.text: You've done us a great service, <name>.

passages.title: Mending Body and Soul
passages.text:
Good. You have brought me the last ingredients I will need to concoct a solution to close the king's wounds.

You are not a moment too soon. He is fading.

I am not comfortable working at an elevated pace, but the situation requires it. You must be my hands, for I am very slow.

Bring me what I need, and let Jamil and I worry about the rest.

Speak to me when you are ready to begin.

passages.title: Mending Body and Soul
passages.text: Stay on your toes. You have more of them than I do.

passages.title: Mending Body and Soul
passages.text:
<Jol wheezes.>

That did not... work how I imagined it would.

passages.title: A Strange Port of Call
passages.text:
I know Rastakhan is furious dat dey claimed his ship, of all de vessels in our navy.

But dere is a better question to ask. Why did dey bring it here?

Zeb'ahari is a small fishing village. Dere are no warriors here, no powerful supporters of de king. Dere must be another reason.

Board de ship and have a good look around. See if you can find out why dey brought dat beast of a boat way out here.

passages.title: A Strange Port of Call
passages.text: Did you learn anything, <name>?

passages.title: A Strange Port of Call
passages.text: I think I know what dis means, <name>, and it does not bode well for my loa.

passages.title: In Bwonsamdi's Shadow
passages.text:
Something is wrong, <name>.

My king is blessed by de loa in ways your kind cannot imagine. He has been given long life, swift healing, and strength beyond most trolls. But still, he lingers on death's door. I can practically hear Bwonsamdi laughing.

Two of his most trusted menders are with him. Go and find out what is taking so long.

I will make sure dey are not interrupted.

passages.title: In Bwonsamdi's Shadow
passages.text: Now you understand the precariousness of this situation. We will need your hands if we are to succeed in this complex bit of mending ahead of us.

passages.title: Almost Worth Saving
passages.text:
We tried to evacuate as many of our people from the hold as we could, but some of the peons weren't so lucky. 

They're worthless as fighters, but we'll need their labor in the times ahead.

Please, save them if you can.

passages.title: Almost Worth Saving
passages.text: Good work, <name>. We'll have need of their labor when we rebuild.

passages.title: Reclaiming What's Ours
passages.text:
I'm impressed. You not only saved our people, but you also managed to kill the leader of the attacking forces.

At the top of this tower is our warhorn. At the signal, our troops will come running and we'll get this hold back under our control.

<name>, I think you've earned the honors.

passages.title: Reclaiming What's Ours
passages.text:
Good work, <name>

Most of the buildings were easily repaired but we'll have to send to the Warchief for more troops.

We're going to have to fight for our place in this land... of this I'm certain.

passages.title: Mission from the King
passages.text:
Och, good ta see ya! Feels great ta stretch me gryphon's wings above the seas.

I'm here ta assist with the war effort. Happy to help!

Let's go meet with Master Shaw, matey.

Ha! Always wanted to say somethin' piratey. Did ya know they named a ship after me once? It was wild!

passages.title: Mission from the King
passages.text: Good, we're all here. I asked for you by name, <name>. Falstad as well.

passages.title: War of Shadows
passages.text:
Every war is fought on multiple fronts, <class>.

King Wrynn has tasked Halford Wyrmbane and his 7th Legion with securing our position in Kul Tiras as well as Zandalar.

But they cannot succeed without us. We are the unseen hand. The shadows in the darkness.

I have been charged with establishing an elite strike force, and I need you to act as liaison between Wyrmbane's efforts and my own.

You will help direct our missions going forward. Let us begin.

passages.title: War of Shadows
passages.text: Without us, this war would be lost easily.

passages.title: War of Shadows
passages.text: I am sure Falstad will handle this mission with his usual grace.

passages.title: The Best Honey In Vol'dun
passages.text:
If you can handle rescuin' de others by yourself, Zulsan and I will head back to de inn and start cleanin' up de place.

Don't worry, I still be cookin' up a special batch of my famous scorpid blood drinks for you.

In fact, you gonna be runnin' right past my friend Rikati. He sells de best honey in all of Vol'dun!

Bring back a few bottles of it for me and let's add some sweetness to de drinks!

passages.title: The Best Honey In Vol'dun
passages.text: Rhan'ka sent you? He still owes me for the last batch of honey I sold him!

passages.title: Harvesting "Honey"
passages.text:
I don't know what Rhan'ka's doing down in that oasis with all of the honey he's bought from me. Frankly, I suspect I don't even want to know.

But whatever his reasons, Rhan'ka is my best customer.

So even though my supply's getting low, because Rhan'ka sent you, I'll give you a special deal.

The wasps here keep all their honey stored in their stingers. Bring some to me, so I can drain them for honey and I'll give you a big batch of the sticky stuff to take back to Rhan'ka.

passages.title: Harvesting "Honey"
passages.text: Don't fret if some sand gets mixed in. It'll taste the same either way.

passages.title: Harvesting "Honey"
passages.text: It'll just take me a moment to get the honey out of these.

passages.title: Saw Dusted
passages.text:
If we want to keep them from expanding into Stormsong, we need to cripple their lumber production!

They've only got so many lumberjacks running around. If we can cut some of them down, they'll be forced to reconsider their plans.

passages.title: Saw Dusted
passages.text: How many d'ya get?

passages.title: Saw Dusted
passages.text: Good work. That'll definitely put a damper on things.

passages.title: Get Out of Here
passages.text:
I can't believe you're here. Please, we need help!

They've been forcing us to mine nonstop. The weakest among us have been steadily dropping. At this rate, we'll all be dead soon.

The chains are weak. You may be able to pry the lock apart.

I'll keep a lookout until the others are free. Don't worry about me!

passages.title: Get Out of Here
passages.text: Did you free everyone?

passages.title: Get Out of Here
passages.text: Thank you for rescuing us, we'd have been trapped in here until we all slowly perished.

passages.title: Burn It All Down
passages.text:
Alright, the flamethrower is all patched up. Now we're going to get a little payback for Brennadam!

If it's flammable, it's a target. If not, well, it probably still needs to die anyway. And let's bring down those siege towers while we're at it.

Burn it all to the ground!

passages.title: Burn It All Down
passages.text: Well at least the flamethrower hasn't blown up on ya yet.

passages.title: Burn It All Down
passages.text: Nothing quite like the smell of freshly roasted Orc!

passages.title: Operation Royalty
passages.text:
I think we've got a real shot at crippling their invasion force, here and now!

While you were out there terrorizing those poor peons, I managed to sneak around and get a peek inside their camp.

I spotted an armor clad undead in the great hall, he was poring over detailed battle plans.

I'm willing to bet the very shirt off my back that he's their general. Think you're up for the challenge adventurer!?

passages.title: Operation Royalty
passages.text: I can't believe you actually pulled it off. We may actually stand a fighting chance now!

passages.title: Grizzled
passages.text:
I saw a particularly ugly and quite agitated goblin barking orders at the rest of the miners.

I'm willing to bet he's crucial to their entire operation. If you can get into the mine and eliminate him, hopefully it will throw things into disarray.

passages.title: Grizzled
passages.text: Hopefully his death throws a wrench into their operation.

passages.title: Mission from the Warchief
passages.text:
Lady Sylvanas issued orders for Garona Halforcen to take on a task of great import.

She will orchestrate missions from the Banshee's Wail, and is to assemble a strong force to execute on our plans.

This effort will be vital to our war against the Alliance, and your assistance will certainly be necessary.

passages.title: Mission from the Warchief
passages.text: Our task is not to be taken lightly, <name>.

passages.title: War of Shadows
passages.text:
I have begun to assemble heroes for our cause. Perhaps you already know Arcanist Valtrois? We will need to recruit more in the future, but this is a promising beginning.

Our missions will be those of subterfuge, reconnaissance, assassination, and other focused strikes against our enemies.

Let us test the mettle of this nightborne, shall we?

passages.title: War of Shadows
passages.text: I will not deviate from my mission.

passages.title: War of Shadows
passages.text: Yes, this will do. The shadows will be stained blue with Alliance blood.

passages.title: The Tortaka Tribe
passages.text:
Have you ever met a tortollan before? Dey have all kinds of useful scrolls and artifacts for sale.

We used to trade often with de Tortaka tribe, but we haven't seen or heard from dem in weeks.

De tribe has a village in Darkwood Shoal. We need someone to make contact with dem and reestablish our trading partnership.

passages.title: The Tortaka Tribe
passages.text: You're from the troll tribe at the arena? I'm afraid we don't have much to trade right now...

passages.title: The Ashvane Threat
passages.text:
De Ashvane Trading Company has a mining operation in Redrock Harbor.

Don't let de fancy name fool you, dey are as dangerous a band of pirates as I've ever seen.

Recently, one of their crew members has been trying to make contact with us. I need someone to meet with him and see what he wants.

It might be a trap, but whatever information he has on de Ashvane Trading Company could prove useful to our survival.

passages.title: The Ashvane Threat
passages.text: You look like the kind of <race> that likes to make some coin. Am I wrong or am I right?

passages.title: Camp Lastwind
passages.text:
A vulpera caravan recently set up camp not far from here.

Dis could be a good opportunity to establish new trade partners with de tribe.

De desert is a dangerous place, <name>. Go see if dey need any assistance. I'm sure dey could use experienced hands like yours.

In exchange, perhaps dey'd be willing to offer de tribe a discount on goods and services.

passages.title: Camp Lastwind
passages.text: So you've come from the trolls at the arena and you're looking for work? I'd be happy to do business with you in exchange for a little help...

passages.title: Examining the Epitaphs
passages.text:
Without Stone's knowledge, this mission shall require some extra legwork.

Read the plaques in the cemetery. Find the corpse of the most import.

The rest should be quite simple.

passages.title: Examining the Epitaphs
passages.text:
Marshal M. Valentine... yes, that name rings a bell. In a locked crypt, you say?

There are ways around that.

passages.title: State of Unrest
passages.text:
There is one thing you should know about ghosts, <name>.

They are a mockery of the dead. Spirits, holding on although they have no hope. In that form, they shall never truly live again. Not as long as they keep haunting our world.

But if they return to their bodies, perhaps they will become of specific use to us someday down the line.

Put those spirits down.

passages.title: State of Unrest
passages.text:
Perhaps we shall have use for these people one day.

Surely they will be thankful.

passages.title: Our Lot in Life
passages.text:
It seems that Amalia isn't taking to undeath well.

I know an herb that may help.

This cemetery is crawling with gravebloom. For the living, it grants the ability to see spirits.

As for the undead...

This may tie her back to reality just enough to be... sane.

passages.title: Our Lot in Life
passages.text:
What Amalia is going through... is familiar to me. She will learn how to embrace her new status as Forsaken.

I will help.

passages.title: Our Lot in Life
passages.text:
Ah yes... in perfect condition.

This should do the trick.

passages.title: The Crypt Keeper
passages.text:
I've been keeping my sights on the cemetery.

There is one ghost that walks with a purpose, unlike the others.

He is the crypt keeper, the keeper of the keys.

If we want to get to Valentine's body, we will need to go through the ghost first.

passages.title: The Crypt Keeper
passages.text: Nothing can stand in our way. Not today.

passages.title: The Crypt Keeper
passages.text: Only one thing left to do.

passages.title: What Remains of Marshal M. Valentine
passages.text:
We have the key. We found the crypt.

Next, Valentine's body shall be ours.

No need to wait for Lilian and Stone. Let's finish this now.

passages.title: What Remains of Marshal M. Valentine
passages.text: No time to dally. We have plans to enact.

passages.title: What Remains of Marshal M. Valentine
passages.text: Another inconvenience. At least Stone finally proved herself useful.

passages.title: Tracking Tidesages
passages.text:
Rexxar has been tracking a powerful tidesage to help us find the body of Marshal Valentine. He has sent word of a breakthrough.

Travel to Stormsong. Help the half-ogre and Lilian find this tidesage, and bend him to the will of the Horde.

Do not come back without a way to find Marshal Valentine.

passages.title: Tracking Tidesages
passages.text: <name>. I'm aware of what the Horde needs. Let's get started.

passages.title: No Price Too High
passages.text:
I have tracked a tidesage to a camp nearby. He has been staying there with his family.

Be warned, tidesages are powerful foes. They have mastery over all the elements, and some even manipulate the Void.

If this man is with his family, it means he may not give up so easily. 

Let us hope he's smart enough to keep them out of this.

Come.

passages.title: No Price Too High
passages.text: Let's hope this tidesage is telling the truth or else it's about to get very bloody.

passages.title: Foothold: Tiragarde Sound
Foothold: Drustvar
passages.text:
It seems Drustvar has a big seam of Azerite underground.

Do you like profit? I LOVE profit. This seems like a golden opportunity, if ya catch my meanin'. Time is money!

 - Trade Prince Gallywix

passages.title: Foothold: Drustvar
passages.text: You have chosen to sail to Drustvar.

passages.title: Foothold: Stormsong Valley
The Kul Tiras Campaign
passages.text:
Our enemy spreads its influence throughout Kul Tiras, recruiting new allies to fight against the Horde.

We must establish footholds in these enemy lands if we are to win this war.

The Warchief requires your assistance in securing outposts in Stormsong Valley, Drustvar, and Tiragarde Sound.

Which location shall we secure first?

passages.title: The Kul Tiras Campaign
passages.text: You have the Queen's trust. For now.

passages.title: They Will Know Fear
passages.text:
Finally, a chance to strike at the Alliance AND Kul Tirans!

Sagehold is crawling with initiate tidesages studying magic and Kul Tirans trying to fortify the place against the Horde.

Let's strike some fear into them. Make them rethink trying to help the Alliance fight the Horde.

Take this horn. In my hands, it calls a val'kyr. In yours, it will sow terror amongst our enemies.

I trust you above all others with this horn. Do not let me down.

passages.title: They Will Know Fear
passages.text: I could hear their screams from here! Maybe now the Kul Tirans will rethink helping the Alliance.

passages.title: Captain Hartford
passages.text:
I'm almost ready to leave Vol'dun once and for all. There's just one thing left to be done...

We need to murder the captain of the ship.

If Captain Hartford finds out I've deserted, I won't be safe in Boralus or anywhere else. He'll hunt me to the Eastern Kingdoms and back if he has to!

This will be dangerous. So you'll want to disguise yourself before boarding The Siren's Call.

This will be our last job together. Do it and I'll give you the code to the captain's lockbox. A pirate's bounty!

passages.title: Captain Hartford
passages.text: A toast to the former captain of The Siren's Call. He was a good man, but good men don't live long around here!

passages.title: Blackrock Depths
passages.text:
Have you heard how the Dark Iron dwarves joined the Alliance? It was a most unusual turn of events.

Brave heroes of the Alliance had been fighting the Dark Iron dwarves for years until a schism happened in their ranks.

Moira Thaurissian, estranged daughter of the former dwarven king Magni Bronzebeard, was leading a faction of the Dark Iron dwarves.

Moira wished to aid the Alliance. This began with an offer to help research Azerite and its potential uses within Blackrock Depths...

passages.title: Blackrock Depths
passages.text: The mind o' a <race> is a glorious thing.

passages.title: Blackrock Depths
passages.text:
Meddlin' goblin bastards!

<Moira takes a deep breath.>

Sorry, I just canna abide those green miscreants any longer.

passages.title: Scattering Our Enemies
passages.text:
We've been scouting the area of Sagehold for some time now. It was recently retaken by a large force of Alliance and Kul Tirans.

We have been waiting for an opportunity to strike when their defenses were weakened. Now is that time.

Go down to Sagehold and show the forces that remain what happens to those who take up arms against the Horde.

passages.title: Scattering Our Enemies
passages.text: Good. The area of Sagehold should be overrun again by the rebel tidesages once we are done.

passages.title: Ranah's Wrench
passages.text:
<The wrench is worn from repeated use, but otherwise appears to be in good shape. 

Engraved on the handle is the name: Ranah.>

passages.title: Ranah's Wrench
passages.text: Do you have something for me?

passages.title: Ranah's Wrench
passages.text: I've been looking everywhere for this!

passages.title: Whatever Will Be
passages.text:
Well, here we are. Zelling seems like he'll be a powerful asset, as long as we ensure his family is taken care of.

He doesn't have much time left. Let's see if he can locate Marshal Valentine for us before he passes.

passages.title: Whatever Will Be
passages.text: Well?

passages.title: Whatever Will Be
passages.text: We had best get moving. As much as I want this to turn out differently... odds are it won't.

passages.title: Storm's End
passages.text:
I've no doubt he can feel our presence, but so long as Lord Stormsong maintains his spell the first move is ours. 

We have him surrounded, cornered like the rat he is. We must end this together.

passages.title: Storm's End
passages.text: Samuel was a good man, with a true heart. A fool... but our fool.

passages.title: Island Expedition
passages.text:
Our spies have intercepted an Alliance message describing an outcropping of Azerite out in the Great Sea.

The Banshee's Wail isn't quick enough to get us there before they do. Lucky for us, I've arranged to have a Zandalari ship rigged and ready to go for opportunities like this.

Go speak with Captain Rez'okun on the western side of the docks. He's been briefed, and should be waiting for you.

passages.title: Island Expedition
passages.text: You da Horde champion I'm waitin' for? Let's get to work.

passages.title: Island Expedition
passages.text:
Our spies have intercepted a Horde message describing an outcropping of Azerite out in the Great Sea.

The Wind's Redemption isn't quick enough to get us there before they do. Lucky for us, I've arranged to have a Kul Tiran ship rigged and ready to go for opportunities like this.

Go speak with Captain Flynn Fairwind. He's been briefed, and should be waiting for you.

passages.title: Island Expedition
passages.text: Oh... you're the <class> I'm supposed to be waiting for? Let's get to work.

passages.title: Pristine Akun'Jar Vase
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in your new ally's capital city.

passages.title: Pristine Urn of Passage
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in your new ally's capital city.

passages.title: Pristine Rezan Idol
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in your new ally's capital city.

passages.title: Pristine High Apothecary's Hood
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in your new ally's capital city.

passages.title: Pristine Bwonsamdi Voodoo Mask
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in your new ally's capital city.

passages.title: Pristine Blowgun of the Sethrak
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in your new ally's capital city.

passages.title: Pristine Ceremonial Bonesaw
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in your new ally's capital city.

passages.title: Pristine Ancient Runebound Tome
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in your new ally's capital city.

passages.title: Pristine Disembowling Sickle
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in your new ally's capital city.

passages.title: Pristine Jagged Blade of the Drust
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in your new ally's capital city.

passages.title: Pristine Ritual Fetish
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in your new ally's capital city.

passages.title: Pristine Soul Coffer
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in your new ally's capital city.

passages.title: The Ongoing Campaign
passages.text:
We have made excellent progress on Zandalar, <name>, but we must continue to expand our influence.

It is time for us to cross the sea once again to exert pressure on enemy lands, lest they fall fully into Horde hands.

Which location shall we secure next?

passages.title: The Ongoing Campaign
passages.text: Excellent choice, <name>.

passages.title: Lumbering Away
passages.text:
The hardwoods in dis jungle are dense enough dat dey rival coal in terms of how much heat a skilled miner can get out of dem.

The biggest problem using local timbers, however, is dat de jungle is always wet. If de wood is not stored properly, it takes weeks to dry out entirely.

I bring dis up because my forge is starting to run low on fuel.

Bring me some dry firewood to keep it going, and in exchange I will teach you a trick for mining monelite.

passages.title: Lumbering Away
passages.text: Have you got more wood for me?

passages.title: Lumbering Away
passages.text:
Dis should do nicely.

Listen well for your reward: When you are mining monelite, do not just chip away at de rock. Instead, try using de pick to pierce de metal, and den peel all of it away from de rock.

passages.title: Insufferable Bloodsuckers
passages.text:
<name>! I have some actual work that you could do for me.

Since your mining skills are still not what Zandalari consider "decent", in exchange, I will show you how to mine monelite better.

De blood trolls of Nazmir have dese enormous ticks that they keep as pets and I have heard dat dey have managed to get within de borders of Zuldazar to de north. Dis does not sit well with me.

Thin their numbers for me, so I can happily die by being eaten by a pterrordax or something else respectable instead.

passages.title: Insufferable Bloodsuckers
passages.text:
Commendable effort, and you seem no worse for wear. I need to remember dis next time I need something exterminated.

I doubt you have noticed that monelite is extremely maleable, ya? Otherwise I would not have to teach you dis method. But you can exploit its malleability, even before smelting it.

By using your pick to deform the metal while it is still in the vein, you can cause it to heat up and get a bigger haul using the other technique I taught you.

passages.title: Lending a Hand
passages.text:
If you are looking for some work, I have something you can do.

I went mining recently and a diemetradon managed to bite off my hand before I could get away from it.

I do not care about the hand, I have already regenerated dat, but I did lose a couple rings dat I made.

If you go get them back, I will show you how to harvest more monelite from a seam. Or not. I do not care, but if you were looking for a chance to finally impress me, dis could be it.

passages.title: Lending a Hand
passages.text: For de record, those rings are worth more den your life. Empirically speaking, of course.

passages.title: Lending a Hand
passages.text:
<Secott places the rings on his new hand.>

Good! As a goldsmith without jewelery, I was beginning to feel naked.

Very well, your lesson is that when you are mining monelite from a seam, it behaves very differently than a normal deposit.

<Secott spends as little time as necessary explaining the different techniques of mining monelite seams.>

passages.title: An Exquisite Brooch
passages.text:
You find a bloody brooch that features impeccable craftsmanship.

The design and quality of work reminds you of rings you previously recovered for Secott.

Perhaps this is another item he lost and would like to see returned.

passages.title: An Exquisite Brooch
passages.text:
Wow, dis is a nice brooch. Good craftsmanship in it.

Whoever it used to belong to, it is mine now.

<Seeing the disapproval on your face, Secott sighs heavily while rolling his eyes and gives you a sidelong glance.>

Tell ya what, in exchange for dis, I guess I can tell you the rest there is to know about mining monelite seams.

<Secott explains in depth, several techniques which will allow you to mine monelite from seams more effectively.>

passages.title: The Ongoing Campaign
passages.text:
The Warchief wishes for us to continue spreading our influence throughout Kul Tiras.

With our grip on Zandalar on the rise, now is the time to move forward with this objective in the lands of the enemy.

Which location shall we secure next, <class>?

passages.title: The Ongoing Campaign
passages.text: You have made your choice.

passages.title: WANTED: Jabra'kan
passages.text:
To any hunters worthy of the challenge:

Find and defeat the troll known as Jabra'kan. His poaching ways have robbed Warbeast Kraal of valuable eggs, hides, and beasts for their pens.

Seek out Wingrider Nivek for your reward.

passages.title: WANTED: Jabra'kan
passages.text: If I see dat thieving wretch, I will wear his tusks for a necklace. Is it done?

passages.title: WANTED: Jabra'kan
passages.text: You have my thanks. He was a slippery one, dat poacher.

passages.title: Wings for the Kraal
passages.text:
It seems your little one needs a moment to rest after dat adventure. I will look after it.

If you want to make yourself useful while you wait, I heard de pterrordaxes to de north have been laying lots of eggs recently. Go collect de ones dat are wiggling and making noises. Dey are about to hatch.

Our beasts breed well, but we always need more wings for de kraal.

passages.title: Wings for the Kraal
passages.text: Do you have de eggs I asked for?

passages.title: Wings for the Kraal
passages.text: I will get dese to a handler. We should be de first thing dey see if we want to keep dem.

passages.title: Charging the Batteries
passages.text:
These little fellas are ravenous whirlwinds of devouring destruction. When they get going, they consume anything in their path, without even stopping! When sated, they discharge power from them little 'lectric zingers on their heads! 

Then they nap.

Lucky for us, we found just the right frequency to control their tiny bug brains. Hit that device, and you can take your own little zapper out for a spin... literally!

Make sure ya bring it back full, so we can keep our rigs charged!

passages.title: Charging the Batteries
passages.text: All juiced up?

passages.title: Charging the Batteries
passages.text: Hey! Not bad for your first time! They're so ugly they're cute, aren't they?

passages.title: DGH: Now With Real Direhorn
passages.text:
...Listen, <name>. I need one more thing to finish making this supplement of mine.

Direhorn Growth Hormone can't exactly be made without, you know, actual direhorn. But I floated the idea of harvesting a few of their beasts and all of a sudden I got a bunch of spears pointed at me.

So I came up with another plan.

Those flying beasts eat direhorns, right? The big green flappy ones. I'm sure if you kill a few of them you'll find all the direhorn bits I need.

passages.title: DGH: Now With Real Direhorn
passages.text: We'll keep this between you and me, okay?

passages.title: DGH: Now With Real Direhorn
passages.text: Let's not talk about this ever again. Deal?

passages.title: Mission Report: The Wolf's Den
passages.text:
<Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Wolf's Den.

It details that victory was hard-fought, but all of the bandits previously living in the outpost have been slain.

Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.>

passages.title: Mission Report: The Wolf's Den
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Tiragarde Sound?

passages.title: Mission Report: The Wolf's Den
passages.text:
It seems the mission to create an additional foothold in Tiragarde Sound was a success. Well done, <name>.

I will send you to oversee the fortifications at once.

passages.title: Wolves For The Den
passages.text:
Our scouts have spotted a large pack of dire wolves not far from here. This is a good omen!

We should send a beast master to capture the wolf pack and bring them to the outpost to be tamed.

The dire wolves will make fine hunting companions and sniff out any Alliance spies that come poking around!

passages.title: Wolves For The Den
passages.text: Rexxar brought us a fine pack dire wolves, <name>. Our operation will be much more secure with the dire wolves patrolling the outpost!

passages.title: Brined Justice
passages.text:
<name>, I just got word dat one of our ships was attacked and a large amount of storm silver stolen!

De sacred materials can not be replaced. Once it is blessed by de wavesinger, it is buried underwater for a year. While I do not care for such nonsense, others do, and will not sail on dat ship.

From what I heard, a group of naga followed de ship to see where the metal was buried on de sea floor before killing de crew and taking her cargo.

Kill de naga, and get me dat metal!

passages.title: Brined Justice
passages.text:
Loa damn de naga!

Have you found de bars?

passages.title: Brined Justice
passages.text:
Ah!  Dis is fantastic news! I will have someone run these out to da docks right away.

I was starting to fear dat you might not make it. Not dat I care, I just did not want to have to explain myself twice.

Dat said, you have avenged my people.  In exchange, let me show you the finer points of harvesting storm silver.

<Secott takes the next several minutes to explain what he knows about harvesting storm silver deposits.>

passages.title: Back to Biru
passages.text:
Oh, you are still here?

Well, I wish I could help you but being de only goldsmith in de city of gold, I am unsurprisingly busy.

I heard you had built a rapport with Biru. I'm sure he remembers more, if you're still looking for more information.

Ask him if he can show you anything else. Tell him if he keeps you from bothering me for the rest of de day, I will stop sending fool hardy miners to him.

passages.title: Back to Biru
passages.text:
Secott sent you?

Wait... my old master? Dat Secott?

passages.title: Informing the Horde
passages.text:
General Jakra'zet has been defeated, but his plan to summon Mythrax succeeded despite our best efforts.

Were it not for the mercy of Sethraliss, I doubt we would have made it out of Atul'Aman alive.

We must inform our allies of what has transpired in Vol'dun.

I'll speak with princess Talanji myself. You should go and speak with the Horde. We need all the help we can get now.

I'm sure our paths will cross again, <name>. It was an honor fighting with you.

passages.title: Informing the Horde
passages.text: I shall inform the Dark Lady of your activities in Vol'dun at once. She will know how to best proceed against this  new threat.

passages.title: Informing the Horde
passages.text:
General Jakra'zet has been defeated, but his plan to summon Mythrax succeeded despite our best efforts.

Were it not for the mercy of Sethraliss, I doubt we would have made it out of Atul'Aman alive.

We must inform our allies of what has transpired in Vol'dun.

I'll speak with princess Talanji myself. You should go and speak with the Horde. We need all the help we can get now.

I'm sure our paths will cross again, <name>. It was an honor fighting with you.

passages.title: Overseas Assassination
passages.text:
Ready to go to war, <name>?

Mathias Shaw has assembled a list of priority Horde targets, and the first is an influential blood elf by the name of Arlethal Sunwatcher. Intelligence shows that he's the highest ranking member of the Reliquary, an elite blood elf excavation force.

He's just standing out in the middle of the desert in Vol'dun, practically begging to be assassinated. Shall we?

passages.title: Overseas Assassination
passages.text: Here we are. Let's begin.

passages.title: The Vol'dun Plan
passages.text:
Our target: Arlethal Sunwatcher, High Examiner of the Reliquary.

Before we charge off blindly into the dunes, however, I'd like to hold a quick strategy meeting with you and the others.

passages.title: The Vol'dun Plan
passages.text: Let's talk strategy, <name>.

passages.title: The Vol'dun Plan
passages.text:
I admire Shandris's... directness.

We will proceed with both plans. Let's move.

passages.title: Comb the Desert
passages.text:
It's time to mobilize, then.

I'll stick with you, <name>. Keep an eye out for Horde activity.

passages.title: Comb the Desert
passages.text: I don't think she's spotted us yet.

passages.title: Dirty Work
passages.text:
That surveyor is wearing a Reliquary tabard. Sunwatcher must be hiring goblins to do his dirty work while he lounges somewhere in the shade.

<Shandris nocks an arrow in her bow.>

Let's find out what she knows.

passages.title: Dirty Work
passages.text: What is that goblin up to?

passages.title: Dirty Work
passages.text: <Halford looks over the Reliquary document you've obtained.>

passages.title: Keep Combing
passages.text: Guzbert will be busy planting explosives for a while. We should continue south, looking for more signs of the Horde.

passages.title: Keep Combing
passages.text: Up there, by the ruins. You see them?

passages.title: Never Stop Combing
passages.text:
<Halford eyes the map one last time before folding it up.>

Onward to the south, then.

passages.title: Never Stop Combing
passages.text: We have an opportunity here, <name>. It would be a shame to pass it up.

passages.title: WANTED: The Rime Huntress
passages.text:
The Waycrest Guard is offering a reward for any hunter who can track down and eliminate the Rime Huntress from the vicinity of Highroad Pass.

Track her with caution. She is a ferocious beast, and has been known to ambush even seasoned hunters.

passages.title: WANTED: The Rime Huntress
passages.text:
So someone has finally managed to track down the Rime Huntress?  Now our traders can continue their routes to Tiragarde without fear of the beast.

Take your reward, and my thanks.

passages.title: A Message to the Zandalari
passages.text:
I know we're here to hunt the Horde, but this is an opportunity.

Exiles or not, these are Zandalari trolls, and the Zandalari have all but put in their lot with the Horde.

Let's show them what we do to friends of the Horde.

passages.title: A Message to the Zandalari
passages.text:
I hope you left a few alive.

They need to learn to fear us.

passages.title: Improvised Survival
passages.text:
The entirety of our copter's hold was reserved for bombs. There's actually still a lot of bombs left inside. Unfortunately, that meant that we weren't able to pack sufficient water and rations for our survival.

Desert natives hoard supplies efficiently. I'm certain the Zandalari trolls up ahead wouldn't miss a few lost supplies.

passages.title: Improvised Survival
passages.text: <Halford nods sternly at you.>

passages.title: Improvised Survival
passages.text:
Excellent reconnaissance. Well-done.

<Halford begins distributing water and rations to the others in your group.>

passages.title: Splitting Up
passages.text:
<Halford looks over the map again.>

The final Reliquary digsite is southwest of here.

<name>, you and Shandris are responsible for laying the explosives at the digsite. I'll work with Zoidfuse to establish a safe position to detonate from.

passages.title: Splitting Up
passages.text: <Shandris licks her lips in anticipation.>

passages.title: Delayed Deathification
passages.text:
While we can handle the assassination portion on our own, I suppose there's no harm in distributing these gnomish bombs around the enemy's digsite.

They're designed to be detonated remotely, so try to bury them in the sand where they won't be noticed.

passages.title: Delayed Deathification
passages.text: I hope you left them somewhere inconspicuous.

passages.title: Delayed Deathification
passages.text: It's done? Good. Let's get a move on.

passages.title: Full of Arrows
passages.text:
There's no need for Halford's overly-complicated desert explosion operation. We can take care of Arlethal Sunwatcher right here and now.

He's right over there. We can just... kill him.

You engage him. I'll join in when he least expects it. You ready?

passages.title: Full of Arrows
passages.text: Whenever you're ready, <name>.

passages.title: Full of Arrows
passages.text: Won't Halford be happy to find out that we've done his work for him?

passages.title: Report to Wyrmbane
passages.text:
Our work here is done. Halford and Zoidfuse should be further down the coast, to the east.

If you don't mind, I'll meet you there.

passages.title: Report to Wyrmbane
passages.text:
Arlethal is already dead?

That's good, I suppose... though it does take some of the fun out of my plan.

passages.title: The Big Boom
passages.text:
Still, we've placed all those explosives, and there's nothing stopping us from detonating them and laying waste to the Horde's excavations.

Speak with Zoidfuse when you're ready, and we'll get this explosive gnome tech going!

passages.title: The Big Boom
passages.text: Whenever you're ready.

passages.title: The Big Boom
passages.text: Ha ha! That should set the Reliquary back a few months.

passages.title: An Exceptional Platinum Shard
passages.text:
Out of dumb luck, you've managed to extract an exceptionally large shard of platinum, instead of several smaller chunks.

You wonder to yourself if Myra could teach you to harvest this much every time.

passages.title: An Exceptional Platinum Shard
passages.text:
Oh, wow! This is really impressive. You managed to get a decently sized shard of platinum in a single piece.

It looks like you managed to hit the ore in line with it's strata... Think of it like chopping wood with the grain, instead of against it.

You know, I bet if you sacrificed some of the power of your swing to keep the pick in line with the strata, you could probably get chunks this size all the time!

passages.title: X Marks the Plat!
passages.text:
You find a folded piece of aged paper next to the deposit

Opening it up, you find a map of Drustvar with an X along the western coast.

Several crude poems adorn the paper, with one in particular drawing your attention.

"Once I were a pirate,
livin' for rum and pleasure.
Since the mutiny, I've retired,
an' now I mine for treasure."

Whoever left this appears to have spent a significant time mining in these lands. They may have some insights you could benefit from.

passages.title: X Marks the Plat!
passages.text:
<Seeing the map, Cinderfuse puts down her weapon.>

I see ye found me map. Guess that means ye be a miner, too?

Well then, if yer lookin' fer booty, best bet would be ta check yer breeches. However, if ye lookin' fer work, then I got just the task fer ya.

passages.title: A More Challenging Career
passages.text:
As ye can imagine, piratin' be in me blood. Spent many of the best years of me life lootin' and plunderin'.

Me favorite part was when takin' a chest filled ta the brim with gold and jewels, and buryin' it where only ye know.

Alas, that life be too chaotic for me nowadays. Swashbucklin' makes me tired, and grog makes me sick. But... I can still bury me treasure.

Bring me some booty worth buryin', and I'll teach ya everythin' I've learned about minin' over the years.

So, wanna be me scallywag?

passages.title: A More Challenging Career
passages.text: The winds be fine for adventure!

passages.title: A More Challenging Career
passages.text:
A fine haul! Pull up a crate, and grab a tankard of rum! This story be a long one!

<Over many drinks, Cinderfuse regales you with many a humorous and informative tale, including several about mining platinum.>

passages.title: The Platinum Map
passages.text:
Nestled within the fissures of the deposit, you find a small disc of pure platinum.

Dusting it off, you see etchings in its surface and recognize it as a map of Vol'dun. You also notice what appears to be a small cave in the south west that has been circled.

Whoever left this apparently has a wealth of knowledge of the metal and wants to be found.

passages.title: The Platinum Map
passages.text:
It is good to meet you. My name is Ta'mil. Please, take a seat, we have much to discuss.

A long time ago, I used to be a miner and a shaman.

I would tell de spirits what metals I needed and why I needed it, and ask them for what dey could spare. Dey would bring what dey could to de surface for me.

<The warmth from his voice leaves as his face turns somber.>

Now de spirits tell me I am not long for dis world. Even in dis desert, I feel de cold creeping into my bones.

passages.title: An Ore for an Eye
passages.text:
I have one last request before I can go.

I wish to see de sunset one last time. I have an enchantment in mind, and I have all the materials I need except de metal.

I need you to bring me twenty platinum nuggets.

I have asked de spirits to bring me de ore, but dey do not listen to me anymore. Dat is why I hid de map where only someone who could be of help would find it.

If you help me out, I will teach you what I can about mining platinum.

passages.title: An Ore for an Eye
passages.text: De elements beckon me. Do you have de platinum nuggets?

passages.title: An Ore for an Eye
passages.text:
Excellent!

<Ta'mil mutters an incantation under his breath as he cradles the platinum nuggets in his hands. A bright light bursts out from between his fingers, fading away as he finishes. Turning to you, he smiles as he holds out what looks like a pair of platinum eyeballs.>

I see you. I thank you for dis. I suppose dis means de next sunset will be my last.

As for your training...

<Ta'mil picks up a large chunk of rock with platinum veins, and shows you his secrets to harvesting the metal.>

passages.title: A Short-Lived Peace
passages.text:
<name>,

As the Legion's presence wanes from our world, a new threat has risen. It is with a heavy heart that I must ask you to put your life on the line for the Alliance once more. 

I have received a disturbing message from our operatives stationed in Orgrimmar.

I await your arrival at Stormwind Keep to discuss matters further.

passages.title: A Short-Lived Peace
passages.text:
You have fought bravely in the name of the Alliance time and time again. For that, I owe you a great debt of gratitude.

But even more must be asked, I fear.

passages.title: The Horde Uprising
passages.text:
Given the potential of Azerite to change the face of warfare, it comes as no surprise that the Warchief seeks to lay claim to it. Reports indicate that she is mobilizing an army to march on Silithus--the site of the great wound.
