Heroes of the Horde and the Alliance fought side-by-side during the Argus campaign. To think that Sylvanas is ready to cast that unity aside...

Speak with Mathias Shaw. I want you to oversee our presence in Silithus.

passages.title: The Horde Uprising
passages.text: Wait! Our reports were wrong!

passages.title: A Disturbance in Ashenvale
passages.text:
The damned Horde! Clever bastards, I'll give them that. They diverted at the north fork of the Barrens and are now marching on Ashenvale.

The kaldorei forces already set sail for Silithus--must be halfway there by now. The only defenders still in the area are the Darnassian City Guard. They are en route to Astranaar, but they won't last long against an army. Their commander goes by the name of Delaryn Summermoon.

Find her, <name>, and buy us time. We will get our fleet there as soon as we can.

passages.title: A Disturbance in Ashenvale
passages.text: Are you the one Malfurion sent?

passages.title: Worse Than It Looks
passages.text:
As bad as things are here we're managing to hold on.

Things are actually a lot worse at Beacon Hill. They're closer to the main attack, and will need all the help they can get.

Head there and see if you can help.

passages.title: Worse Than It Looks
passages.text: Patrick's a good person.  If he trusts you, your help is welcome.

passages.title: Survivors
passages.text:
Patrick and Daryl Eckhart have a place north of town. If I know them, they'll be taking in survivors from Brennadam.

Check in with Patrick and see if they need any help.

passages.title: Survivors
passages.text: Calvin sent you? We can use all the help you can provide!

passages.title: Helping Out, Somewhere Else
passages.text:
You've been a big help and now we've got a lot of gold to divvy up! 

You should go west to Seabreeze Village. Treat it like a vacation, keep your mind off the gold. We'll be fine here. When you come back later, we'll have your share all ready for you.

You'd just be getting in the way here.

passages.title: Helping Out, Somewhere Else
passages.text: Did he owe you any money? He always sends me people he owes money to!

passages.title: More Fodder
passages.text:
Leo Shealds at Deadwash is a crook, but he recognizes the threat the naga pose. He'll send men to help us if we ask, even if most are just fodder.

Travel to Deadwash and ask for help.

passages.title: More Fodder
passages.text: The way the Irontide's hitting us, there should be plenty of volunteers to go help.

passages.title: Bauer Backup
passages.text: We've not heard anything from the coast since the Horde attack started. I need you to check in on Lieutenant Bauer at Seabreeze Village and see that they're safe.

passages.title: Bauer Backup
passages.text: Glad to hear Felecia is safe.  We could use your help here though.

passages.title: The Light of Elune
passages.text:
My sisters lie slain on the soft earth of Ashenvale.

We are trained to expect losses. Soldiers die in battle. But this... this was a despicable attack, even for the Horde.

We have little time to grieve, but we are not savages like our enemy.

Please, <name>. Help me say a prayer to Elune in honor of the fallen. Their wisps deserve the light of her blessing.

passages.title: The Light of Elune
passages.text: Elune bless you, <name>.

passages.title: Petitioning Krag'wa
passages.text:
Nothing! I cannot believe de weapon had no effect!

Damn Ateena and her dark magic! We must get up there somehow, kill her for good, and remove dat barrier!

But how can we get to de top of dat building... ah, of course! Krag'wa! 

De loa of frogs hates de blood trolls. I am sure he will lend us his aid. Then, finally, we will be able to put an end to Ateena's madness.

passages.title: Petitioning Krag'wa
passages.text:
This is it, no more running around! 

Now, we will end this threat to my homeland once and for all!

passages.title: Deliverance
passages.text:
Mainlander! Stop a moment, I could really use a hand!

My team and I were hunting in the ruins of Gol Koval when the stones began to attack us! I've never seen anything like that before. Ranger Wons sent Duke and I to get some medical supplies for our injured.

Duke didn't get hit by those possessed stone monsters but he wasn't as fortunate with the spiders nearby. He'll be okay if he rests here for awhile, but my team needs these medical supplies!

Please take these to Ranger Wons!

passages.title: Deliverance
passages.text: Rebecca sent you? Bless that girl! You've come just in time.

passages.title: Boned
passages.text:
If the living rocks weren't bad enough, it seems the undead are hauling themselves out of the ground, too!

This used to be a Drust settlement, so those are probably Drust bones. They hated us and the feeling is definitely mutual right now.

I don't know what has them stirred up, but they're a danger to us and everyone else. Take them out and I'll reward you for the work.

passages.title: Boned
passages.text: Hopefully those monsters will stay down. You have my thanks.

passages.title: A Soft Glow
passages.text:
The wisps... they sing with sorrow, but also with purpose. The forest stirs, aglow with their light.

That sound... in the distance. Could it be our Shan'do?

Quickly, <name>! Malfurion beckons!

passages.title: A Soft Glow
passages.text: I am glad you have come, <name>.

passages.title: To Be Forsaken
passages.text:
Let's move. Zelling is probably with his family now.

Either they're happily reunited and he helps us find Valentine... or he just helps us find Valentine.

Let's go.

passages.title: To Be Forsaken
passages.text:
Excellent work. I was wondering why Kyra was summoned away. Lucky for Lilian it was for a worthy cause.

Our new ally is getting acclimated to his new life. We'll soon be ready to find Marshal Valentine.

passages.title: The Wolf's Den
passages.text:
The raid you planned on Wolf's Den in Tiragarde Sound was successful. Well done.

The outpost is ready to be claimed.

Make your way to Wolf's Den in Tiragarde Sound and establish fortifications there.

Wolf's Den will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Alliance.

Go with honor!

passages.title: The Wolf's Den
passages.text: Throm-Ka, <name>. This is a fine location for an outpost! Thanks to your leadership the Horde has yet another foothold in Tiragarde Sound!

passages.title: Ferry Pass
passages.text:
<Cyrus takes an official looking document from his jacket, signs it, then offers it to you.>

Here, this will give you access to the ferry system.

passages.title: Ferry Pass
passages.text: There are ferry stations all along the interior coastline of the sound. Don't forget about them during your travels!

passages.title: Power Problems
passages.text:
Rozzy, part of the extraction crew, headed out with some gear to work on a plan to keep these reconfigulators all charged up.

Go see see if she could use some help!

passages.title: Power Problems
passages.text: If Merd wants you to help, I've got just the thing!

passages.title: Deadliest Cache: Carpe Diem
passages.text:
Bah, don't listen to these landlubbers. They haven't fished an honest day in their lives!

Before they met me they were as dry as the sands o' the shoreline at low tide.

I'll spin ye the tale o' the day we met. 'Twas also the day I saved the wharf from the biggest, meanest, largest monster o' the briny deep ye could imagine!

passages.title: Deadliest Cache: Carpe Diem
passages.text: These landlubbers owe me their lives, if ye ask me!

passages.title: Deadliest Cache: Carpe Diem
passages.text: Quite the story, eh lad?! Make sure ye tell yer friends!

passages.title: We Need Each Other
passages.text:
My father believes he is indulging me. He has ruled for two hundred years, many lifetimes of trolls. In his mind, de threats dat face our kingdom are minor.

I have seen too much to believe dat.

So since my father and his advisors would not help, I turned to someone who would.

Your warchief needs our fleet, and I need her champions. So here is what we need to do.

passages.title: We Need Each Other
passages.text: Make your choice when you are ready.

passages.title: The Proof of Piracy
passages.text:
One thing pirates love more than gold is rum. So we're going to find their rum stashes and blow them up. With the rum all gone, a lot of the pirates should move on.

Use my special barrel busting bombs to destroy the pirates' hidden rum stashes.

passages.title: The Proof of Piracy
passages.text: Let's blow up some rum!

passages.title: The Proof of Piracy
passages.text: That was hard, but it had to be done.

passages.title: To Matters at Hand
passages.text:
Princess Talanji should be ready to speak with you regarding how to save our empire.

I would go speak with her now. She has a planning area set up nearby.

passages.title: To Matters at Hand
passages.text: Good, you have returned. Dere is no time to waste.

passages.title: Blood on the Sand
passages.text:
And with that, our mission is done.

Let's verify that Guzbert and Kelsey return safely from their demo sites, and then we can head back to friendlier shores.

passages.title: Blood on the Sand
passages.text: Shouldn't be long now!

passages.title: Blood on the Sand
passages.text: Guzbert's... what? No!

passages.title: Crippling the Horde
passages.text:
Our scouts report that one of Sylvanas's dark ranger captains is in Nazmir. 

The dark rangers are Sylvanas's deadliest fighters and scouts. Killing one of their leaders will cripple Horde operations.

Shandris Feathermoon will be leading the operation in Nazmir. Head there now and strike before we lose this chance.

passages.title: Crippling the Horde
passages.text: Nazmir. Let's be done with this place.

passages.title: Freehold: A Pirate's End
passages.text:
Hey, uh, I don't usually ask for help with personal business, but I know when I'm outmatched.

Someone's gotta take down Harlan.

He's a maniac. The things I saw him do back in the day... that's why I left Freehold in the first place.

H-hey don't think of it as a favor for me--even though it would be a HUGE favor--think of it as making the seas safer for everyone, or something noble like that.

<Flynn leans in and whispers.>

Plus there's a big fat bounty on his head!

passages.title: Freehold: A Pirate's End
passages.text:
What's say sixty-forty split on the bounty? Eh? 

Seventy-thirty?

How about a finder's fee?

passages.title: Freehold: A Pirate's End
passages.text:
Gotta admit, when I first saw you in that prison cell I wasn't sure what all the fuss was about.

But you really came through for me. You came through for everyone.

Thanks, mate.

passages.title: Everburning
passages.text:
My people have suffered loss and pain, struggling in the darkness that covered Drustvar. But now we have some light back. We have the means and the will to reclaim our lands from the lingering evils. Your help has brought much of that about.

I will miss my parents. Though their end was dark, they were family. But my duty as the head of House Waycrest is clear. The dead can handle themselves. I must attend to the living and lead.

There is a short ceremony I need to conduct. Would you assist me?

passages.title: Everburning
passages.text: Thank you.

passages.title: Everburning
passages.text:
I must continue to set my House in order, but our relations with the rest of Kul Tiras have suffered neglect for too long. I have some additional things to handle here first, but I will go to Boralus soon to set the rest right.

My deepest thanks for all you have done, <name>.

passages.title: How to Kill a Dark Ranger
passages.text: Let's go over the plan. We don't get many chances to kill a captain of Sylvanas's dark rangers.

passages.title: How to Kill a Dark Ranger
passages.text: Well? Let's go over the plan.

passages.title: How to Kill a Dark Ranger
passages.text: We have our plan. Let's get underway.

passages.title: A Nation United
passages.text:
You've done a fine job here, adventurer.

With the city secure and Jaina in command of the fleet, the time has come for Kul Tiras to formally join the Alliance.

King Anduin has already departed for Unity Square to meet with Jaina, Katherine and the heads of the major Kul Tiran houses.

They are waiting for you.

passages.title: A Nation United
passages.text:
Hero, you have brought my family and my country back together again.

My heart is whole for the first time in many years.

I cannot thank you enough.

passages.title: Siege of Boralus: Lady Ashvane's Return
passages.text:
If Ashvane thinks we will sit idly by as she attempts a coup, she is sorely mistaken. The citizens of Boralus will fight her to a man.

I'll need you on the front lines to aid them, <class>. Go with Taelia to the docks and engage the enemy. 

With a little luck, we may just make it out of this alive.

passages.title: Siege of Boralus: Lady Ashvane's Return
passages.text: That was incredible! I had no idea Lady Jaina was so powerful.

passages.title: Our Next Target
passages.text:
Welcome back, adventurer.

We're ready to set sail on our next mission.... Now we just need to reach an agreement on where we're headed.

General Feathermoon and I disagree on which Horde target we should prioritize next. But if you'll give me just a moment, I'm confident I can convince her the value of my strategy and we'll be swiftly on our way.

I've considered every reasonable alternative. This is the best course of action.

passages.title: Our Next Target
passages.text:
I'm grateful for Alleria's wisdom and our new allies' willingness to take the lead. This new two-pronged strategy opens up additional tactical options for us to consider.

I must ask Alleria to stay behind with me to coordinate our efforts on both ends. I'll need you to join Umbric on this mission and ensure its success. Good luck.

passages.title: Tortollans in Distress
passages.text:
Our first task is to rescue the tortollans captured by the blood trolls. 

Keeshan's report indicates the tortollans are familiar with all things Nazmir. They should know about the Horde's operations here.

The tortollans tend to stay neutral in most matters. They'll give us details on the Horde's plans if we make a fair trade.

We'll meet afterwards at our other outpost, Redfield's Watch, north of Torga's Rest.

passages.title: Tortollans in Distress
passages.text: What else do you need to know?

passages.title: Tortollans in Distress
passages.text: We've the information we need from the tortollans. We have to push on, time is of the essence.

passages.title: The Savage Hunt
passages.text:
The blood trolls in Nazmir are monsters, pure and simple. No culture, no empathy, they only exist to destroy.

Let's kill 'em and let whatever dark god they worship sort them out.

passages.title: The Savage Hunt
passages.text: The only good blood troll is a dead blood troll. And even that's stretching it.

passages.title: The Savage Hunt
passages.text: We've been fending off blood troll attacks on Fort Victory for too long. Good to know they got what's coming to them.

passages.title: Ending Areiel
passages.text:
The tortollans have given us Captain Areiel's location, as well as new information. She carries a missive from the Horde.

Any missive the Horde would send to Areiel must be extremely important. We must recover it and deliver the information to Halford.

Areiel and I once fought side by side. She's incredibly powerful, Keeshan and I will be there to help you bring her down.

Good luck, <name>.

passages.title: Ending Areiel
passages.text: Did you retrieve the missive?

passages.title: Ending Areiel
passages.text:
I know I shouldn't take pleasure in Areiel's death... but there is a part of me that is glad her reign of terror is over.

What of the missive?

passages.title: One Option: Fire
passages.text:
Here I thought things couldn't get worse, but now we have the Horde making camp around the home of some death god.

I've got a good idea of what they've brought, thanks to my time in the first three wars. Medicine, armor, food...

And probably offerings for this Bwonsamdi fella. Destroy all of these supplies to let the Horde know we won't let them stay here.

passages.title: One Option: Fire
passages.text: The Horde will be forced to retreat from the Necropolis without their supplies. A good win for us.

passages.title: They Can't Stay Here
passages.text:
Can't believe the Horde already have a foothold in the Necropolis. We have to stop them.

This one's simple. Kill as many Horde as you find in that cursed place, but keep your eye out for a fella named Bwonsamdi.

Seems like he's some sort of death god. He's way beyond anything we can handle, but why not send a few of his followers his way?

Better they rot in his necropolis than bother the living.

passages.title: They Can't Stay Here
passages.text: Good, less Horde for us to deal with in this cursed place.

passages.title: When a Plan Comes Together
passages.text:
Having Derek Proudmoore's body in our possession is a greater boon than we had planned for.

Valentine is risen, but I think it best to allow Derek to lay dead for a bit longer.

It's time to use our new allies to our advantage.

passages.title: When a Plan Comes Together
passages.text: And now, we wait.

passages.title: A Well Placed Portal
passages.text:
We have the front here under control. I am sending you and Zelling into Boralus to acquire the Abyssal Scepter.

Oculeth has managed to pinpoint a safe location for a portal. Get moving.

passages.title: A Well Placed Portal
passages.text:
I once studied here. And now...

<Zelling clears his throat.>

We have a job to do.

passages.title: Tidesage Teachings
passages.text:
These people are not tidesages anymore. They do not deserve to bear our title, our prestige, or our knowledge.

So many of our teachings lay scattered around this monastery, potentially lost to those of us that remain.

We must reclaim these writings. Better in my hands than theirs.

passages.title: Tidesage Teachings
passages.text: I will not stand for my people's research to be used for evil.

passages.title: Tidesage Teachings
passages.text: It's a relief to know that this research is free from those who would abuse it.

passages.title: Forfeit Souls
passages.text:
The tidesages here have given in to dark magics. They have submitted themselves to powers they do not understand, and my people have suffered for it.

I knew them once, my brothers and sisters in the tides. But now they are lost.

I guess I am too.

Redeem the name of the tidesages! Kill these betrayers!

passages.title: Forfeit Souls
passages.text: It didn't feel good to ask that of you, <name>. But it was right.

passages.title: Gaining the Upper Hand
passages.text:
We need to retrieve the Abyssal Scepter and get out of here before the Kul Tirans break our line in Plunder Harbor.

I did some research while you were gone. I believe I uncovered the location where the ritual must take place.

When you are ready to go, we can make our way over.

passages.title: Gaining the Upper Hand
passages.text: Nathanos and I believe scepter will help us gain the upper hand on the Kul Tiran fleet. If you wish to win this war, the Abyssal Scepter is key.

passages.title: Gaining the Upper Hand
passages.text: We've got the scepter... for better or for worse.

passages.title: Life Held Hostage
passages.text:
As Lilian has pointed out, it seems we have a final visitor.

Shall we go pay him a visit?

passages.title: Life Held Hostage
passages.text: There is nothing left for us here. Let us return.

passages.title: Life Held Hostage
passages.text:
We have the scepter, we maintain our possession of Derek's corpse...

Let us return to somewhere a little more... homey.

passages.title: The Aid of the Tides
passages.text:
With Derek's body and the Abyssal Scepter in stow, our undertaking here today is complete. Let us escape under their noses.

When you are ready, let us return to Zuldazar. Sylvanas will want to hear of our victories.

passages.title: The Aid of the Tides
passages.text: A couple more Kul Tiran ships on the bottom of the ocean wraps up our mission quite well.

passages.title: What You May Regret
passages.text:
<name>, Genn Greymane left this letter for you. He indicated it was urgent. I was just about to send for you.

<Upon opening it, the letter reads as follows.>
"<name>,

You have helped to unite the Kul Tirans and gained their support for the Alliance. Perhaps now you might be able to help reunite a mother with her daughter.

Meet me at the family memorial by Proudmoore Keep. With luck we can convince Lord Admiral Proudmoore to grant her daughter a stay of execution.

- Genn Greymane "

passages.title: What You May Regret
passages.text: My daughter... My Jaina...

passages.title: What You May Regret
passages.text:
<Katherine looks away for a moment.>

Priscilla- Lady Ashvane convinced me to exile my daughter. I now see she acted in her own self interest, and I do not know if my daughter still lives.

passages.title: Long Away
passages.text:
For every foe we slay, two more take their place.

We are too few in number to stand toe to toe. We must fall back, <name>. Strategy can yet overcome numbers. 

We will regroup at Darnassus. I will send for Delaryn.

passages.title: Long Away
passages.text: These are troubling times, <name>. We must gather our strength.

passages.title: Bilgewater Bonanza Go Boom
passages.text:
I have met very few goblins that I respect, but I must give them universal credit for one thing: they are persistent.

The Bilgewater Cartel, Trade Prince Gallywix's gang, has already sent a full set of replacement miners to extract Azerite from the beach site nearby.

I am certain the Alliance will be pleased if you interrupt their mining operations again.

My regiment is available to aid you, but our combat tactics are unconventional. When you wish our help, call into the Void and we will answer.

passages.title: Bilgewater Bonanza Go Boom
passages.text:
I do not doubt that those goblins will be replaced, like the ones you previously dealt with.

But we have at least set back their progress and given our allies here additional breathing room.

passages.title: Meeting of the Minds
passages.text:
We're in luck. The missive details a meeting in Zo'bal Ruins between Talanji, Rokhan, Areiel, and Blood Prince Dreven.

This is our chance to gain more intel on Dreven and his next move. He killed our soldiers in Vol'dun, it's time for him to pay.

Meet me outside of Zo'bal Ruins. We're going to sneak into the ruins, listen to their plans, and decide what to do next.

passages.title: Meeting of the Minds
passages.text: Let's move.

passages.title: Meeting of the Minds
passages.text: Dreven will be inside of an enclosed tunnel? This is too perfect. Let's move.

passages.title: Sending Out An SOS
passages.text:
I noticed an exodus from the fleet, far out in the harbor.

Flyers were sent out, they seek something, or someone.

Those ships made a great journey, and they have much work ahead.

Please check in with Captain Grez'ko. I am sure he could use a hand!

passages.title: Sending Out An SOS
passages.text: You're just de mon I was looking for! I have heard tales.

passages.title: Ancient Skinning Knife
passages.text:
Within the scarred flesh of the beast, you find a notched golden blade embedded under its skin.

Carefully extracting the blade, you can't help but feel like this is an old Zandalari skinning knife.

You should show this to Rana the Cutta.

passages.title: Ancient Skinning Knife
passages.text:
Ha ha! If I did not know better, I  would say dis was de skinning knife of my old master.

He went out to collect some pelts a couple years ago, and never came back. I figured de idiot got crushed by a log.

If dis was in it's skin, he must have thought he killed it, only to have it wake up and finish him off.

I needed dat laugh. Thank you for dat. Lemme make it up to you.

<Continuing to chuckle to herself, she uses her master's knife to show you a trick to harvesting leather from a kill.>

passages.title: Ceremonial Vestments
passages.text:
Xanjo asked dat I gather de materials for him to make some ceremonial armor.

He requested several pieces of crocolisk hide, but all de hides I have are flawed or scarred.

I need you to bring me a handful of fresh crocolisk hides dat are pristine.

De best source dat I know of are de primal snapjaws in Nazmir, as their hide is usually thick enough to avoid getting scarred when dey fight.

If you do dat for me, I will show you how to better harvest scales from, well... scaly creatures.

passages.title: Ceremonial Vestments
passages.text: Have you got de skins?

passages.title: Ceremonial Vestments
passages.text:
Excellent!

Dese are good! Well, usable... for de most part.

I will need to clean dem up before I can pass dem along. Regardless, look here and I will show you how to get more out of skinning things with scales.

<Rana uses the skins you brought to exemplify small tweaks to be made to your technique to yield better results.>

passages.title: Hexoskeleton
passages.text:
I have a bet going with Xanjo over what leather is de best for armor in regards to resisting piercing and slashing attacks.

He says scales are the best, but I have something better in mind.

I feel de makrura's exoskeleton could be treated to act as a natural plate armor.

Bring me de carapace of a bittertide makrura, and I will teach you how to harvest bones more effectively from creatures you're skinning.

passages.title: Hexoskeleton
passages.text: Do you have de carapace?

passages.title: Hexoskeleton
passages.text:
Nice.

These plates are very thick, and TECHNICALLY leather. My victory is almost guaranteed.

As for your lesson... makrura don't have bones.

<Rana smiles.>

Fine, fine! I will teach you something useful, too.

<Putting the carapace on the ground, Rana shows you how to feel if a bone is broken before removing it.>

passages.title: Loa Fit For A King
passages.text:
Hey, <name>! Come here. Shh. Closer.

<Rana's voice drops to a whisper.>

I have something I want you to do for me. It may be just a touch sacreligous, but... well...

Rezan was once de loa of kings, but he has been taken to Atal'Dazar, and it grieves me what has happened to him.

I want you to go dere, and bring me back a bone of his. Not even a whole bone. A splinter. I don't care how small.

Please do dis for me, and I will teach you everything I know about gathering bones while skinning.

passages.title: Loa Fit For A King
passages.text: Did you get it?

passages.title: Loa Fit For A King
passages.text:
<Rana begins speaking in a whisper and places the bone fragment in a small pouch of a necklace she is wearing.>

Dis means a lot to me. 

While I will never be a king, I will have de Loa of Kings watching over me for de rest of my days.

<Rana dusts off her hands as she returns to her normal volume.>

If I recall correctly, I promised to teach you everything  I know about gathering bones, yes?

<Rana begins explaining which bones can be easily removed from the socket without breaking the bones.>

passages.title: Target: Blood Prince Dreven
passages.text:
We must kill Blood Prince Dreven and his followers. I know of the place where they intend to go. Here is the plan.

You and Keeshan will make your way to the tunnels and act as bait, lure Dreven into a false sense of security.

Myself and the sentinels will seal the entrance to trap him and his allies shortly thereafter.

Then we kill them all. I'll send word to the others to get moving.

Let's go.

passages.title: Target: Blood Prince Dreven
passages.text:
Keeshan has recovered, and I've sent scouts to retrieve the bodies of my sentinels.

They died fighting a monster. Keeshan and I will give them the highest honors.

I'll send a report to Halford regarding what happened here. We must make the destruction of Draven our highest priority.

Thank you for all your help, <name>. We could not have done this without you.

passages.title: Mission Report: Stonefist Watch
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Stonefist Watch.

It details that victory was hard-fought, but all of the bandits previously living in the outpost have been slain.

Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

passages.title: Mission Report: Stonefist Watch
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Tiragarde Sound?

passages.title: Mission Report: Stonefist Watch
passages.text:
It seems the mission to create an additional foothold in Tiragarde Sound was a success. Well done, <name>.

I will send you to oversee the fortifications at once.

passages.title: Stonefist Watch
passages.text:
The raid you planned for Stonefist Watch in Tiragarde Sound was successful. Well done.

The outpost is ready to be claimed.

Make your way to Stonefist Watch in Tiragarde Sound and establish fortifications there.

Stonefist Watch will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Alliance.

Go with honor!

passages.title: Stonefist Watch
passages.text: Throm-Ka, <name>. This is a fine location for an outpost! Thanks to your leadership the Horde has yet another foothold in Tiragarde Sound!

passages.title: Ivory Handled Dagger
passages.text:
While skinning the beast, you feel a lump within the beast's stomach.

Investigating further, you find what appears to be a dagger with a beautifully etched ivory handle.

Carefully extracting it, you wonder if Camilla Darksky might know something about this.

passages.title: Ivory Handled Dagger
passages.text:
I wondered what happened to him...

Yes, I recognize the blade. It was my mentor's.

We sailed here together, but later he went missing. He talked about building a home in Drustvar overlooking the ocean, so I figured that's what happened.

But I guess he was eaten by the creature... in which case, I'm thankful you avenged him by slaying it.

As a thank you for this closure, let me show you his secret to skinning.

<Camilla takes out a fresh pelt and begins showcasing her lost mentor's technique.>

passages.title: Turtle Soup
passages.text:
I cannot believe that I'm constantly stuck in this city!

You'd help me out, right?

You see, I've heard about these turtles that have been living in hot springs.

What makes it interesting is that some of the sulphur from the water has soaked into their scales to give them interesting patterns.

I'm too busy to go check myself, but if you could go get me some of their skins, I'd be more than willing to teach you everything else I know about skinning anything with scales in exchange.

passages.title: Turtle Soup
passages.text: Please tell me you've got the skins.

passages.title: Turtle Soup
passages.text:
Wow, these are... underwhelming.

From they way they were described, I figured they would be irridescent or something.

Instead, they're just yellow and smell of farts.

Regardless, you've kept me from losing my sanity for one more day.

<Camilla deftly draws her skinning knife and begins weaving it along and between scales.

While her finesse may be without equal, you feel the demonstration is more than enough to ensure you can harvest more scales.>

passages.title: Bone Needle
passages.text:
<You see Camilla sucking blood from a wound on her hand.>

Hey, can you do me a favor? I was sewing shut a battle wound in this skin, when my last bone needle broke, and now I need to get a new one.

I've seen quilrats on the coast of Drustvar, one of their spines should do the trick.

Bring me one in perfect condition, and I'll teach you how to harvest more bones when skinning.

<Camilla looks at her hand.>

Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to go see a healer before this gets infected.

passages.title: Bone Needle
passages.text:
I've got a lot of work backed up, waiting on a new needle.

Have you got it yet?

passages.title: Bone Needle
passages.text:
Let's see... smooth, strong, sharp... Ow!  Very sharp!

Yeah, I think this'll do nicely.  Good job!

<Camilla picks up a skin and starts mending another hole in the skin that looks like it's from combat. 

Happy with the result, she turns to you and starts explaining how to extract additional bones when skinning.>

passages.title: Hidden Amongst the Leaves
passages.text:
When the Horde invaded, I did my best to thwart them but it is unknown how many forces have made passage already. This wall will slow them down, but it will not halt their attack entirely. 

<Malfurion's ears perk.>

Do you hear that, hero? The Ancients call to us!

We must protect them at all costs, <name>! They see what our eyes cannot see, and hear what our ears cannot perceive.

I have druids in the Twilight Vale. Find them. Send them to the Grove of the Ancients. I will reinforce the wall.

passages.title: Hidden Amongst the Leaves
passages.text: Elune be praised!

passages.title: Garden Grove
passages.text:
Curse those goblins and their infernal machines!

They are using a shredder to desecrate our sacred grove. 

We need that monstrosity taken down!

passages.title: Garden Grove
passages.text: Well done. These trees have so many stories to tell.

passages.title: A Greedy Goblin's Paradise
passages.text:
The Zandalari have many powerful and ancient artifacts tucked away on this island, hidden from view.

But some of their treasures are more... conspicuous.

It is no surprise that Trade Prince Gallywix was unable to resist the allure of Atal'Dazar, a massive city made entirely of gold.

Come with me and we will hunt him down together.

passages.title: A Greedy Goblin's Paradise
passages.text: Gallywix has no respect for culture or history. Only money.

passages.title: The Wake of Something New
passages.text:
<Onu bellows in pain.>

The disturbance has become more severe. I am sensing a powerful force in our midst. It is unlike anything I have felt before. It comes from the earth itself.

You and Delaryn Summermoon must seek it out, <name>. Go to the water's edge, to the place you call Nazj'vel.

passages.title: The Wake of Something New
passages.text: Keep your head down!

passages.title: The Wake of Something New
passages.text:
The Horde have taken the Master's Glaive! 

We thought the glow from this place was Elune's light... but it appears to be the Azerite the Horde so desperately desire.

passages.title: Enraged Furbolgs
passages.text:
The ancients of the forest are all connected to one another. We can sense a disturbance from deep within our roots. 

I can feel it now, <name>... the rumble of their footsteps in the distance, the thundering clamor of war. With every branch they break, they awaken the ancients.

Soon my brethren will answer in kind, for nothing shall disrupt the balance of nature. 

A disturbance is near. Our kindred spirits cry for help. Seek it out and restore balance.

passages.title: Enraged Furbolgs
passages.text: Have the furbolgs been returned to the wild?

passages.title: Lost Shipment
passages.text:
I let grief cloud my judgment and Jaina may have already paid the ultimate price for my mistake. Yet, I hold out hope she lives.

I do not know where Jaina was taken after Ashvane's people took her from the Keep. The records in their offices here in Boralus will surely tell you where they took her.

<name>, you helped my people when I thought I did not need it. I ask for your help again now. Save my daughter's life!

passages.title: Lost Shipment
passages.text: Did you find what happened to Jaina?

passages.title: Lost Shipment
passages.text:
<Katherine looks up, resolved.>

We have little to go on, but I must believe she still lives.

passages.title: Chasing Gallywix
passages.text:
Look at this... The goblins are looting ancient ornamentation like they're hoarding food at a buffet. What a disgrace.

But we do not have time to get bogged down in everything happening here. Gallywix will soon know that we have arrived.

We should not hesitate in ascending these stairs and locating Gallywix. I am certain that he will be wherever the thieves are carrying their treasure.

Oh, and please do take care. The Zandalari do not typically leave places like this unguarded.

passages.title: Chasing Gallywix
passages.text: Gallywix's greed will be his undoing.

passages.title: Chasing Gallywix
passages.text: A "pleasure palace?" What sort of selfish leader fritters away his people's lives and fortunes in this way?

passages.title: An Explosive Entrance
passages.text:
A hat and some smooth talking won't get us in to Freehold this time, so I'm thinking explosives. And I'm thinking we steal them from Ashvane. Fair's fair, right? She takes something from Lady Katherine, we take some Azerite empowered grenades from Ashvane.

Okay, so it's not really the same, but you get where I'm going with this.

Head over to Ashvane's Foundry. Grab the biggest Azerite Grenades you can get your hands on.

While you do that I'm going to get us some air support.

passages.title: An Explosive Entrance
passages.text: Nicely done! These are going to make quite an impact, if you'll forgive the pun.

passages.title: An Explosive Entrance
passages.text:
You got our ammo and I got our air support.

<Flynn gestures to Taelia and Galeheart with a grin.>

You see where I'm going with this.

passages.title: The Keys to Success in Freehold
passages.text:
I've been known to be a betting man, and I'd place good odds on the information we need being in Harlan Sweete's Strongbox. This would be far too valuable to put anywhere else. I bet they haven't even moved the chest. The problem is the security features.

See, the chest is locked by three keys and he gave each one to a different lieutenant. We'll need to get those.

But between your skills, my finesse and Taelia's air support this will be easy.

passages.title: The Keys to Success in Freehold
passages.text: Nicely done! See? I knew those Irontide wouldn't be a problem for you.

passages.title: The Keys to Success in Freehold
passages.text: Okay, we have the keys. Now we just need to make a run for the chest.

passages.title: Malfurion Returns
passages.text:
Do you hear his voice?

Malfurion seeks our aid! Keep your head high, <name>. The ancients stand with you this day.

passages.title: Malfurion Returns
passages.text: We must push them back!

passages.title: "Rock" The World
passages.text:
We do not fight alone, <name>.

This day, the ancients will bear you in their branches. Hold back nothing in your defense of our forests!

passages.title: "Rock" The World
passages.text: We must hold them back!

passages.title: "Rock" The World
passages.text: We must hold them back!

passages.title: She Sells Seashells
passages.text:
Papa wanted to go fishing, and mum is working, so he brought me along.

But I'm bored! I'm trying to sell some of the shells I found washed up on the beach, but nobody seems to be stopping. I don't think my shells are pretty enough...

You don't seem like you're afraid of those big snakes on the beach. Can you bring me back some prettier shells? Only the shiniest please!

passages.title: She Sells Seashells
passages.text: Come, let us parley... How was that? I'm trying to sound like a proper shell seller.

passages.title: She Sells Seashells
passages.text: Oooh! These are so pretty! I bet they'll sell really well.

passages.title: I Take No Pleasure In This
passages.text:
I knew that Gallywix was selfish and wasteful, but this... this is too much.

His bloated pride has blacked out the sun of good leadership. He hoards the wealth of his people to satiate his gluttony, greed, and lust while his people toil under his calloused heel.

And, maybe worse, opportunistic socialites from all across the Horde revel in the depravity.

All people of Azeroth deserve better than this. We must teach these spoiled cowards a lesson.

passages.title: I Take No Pleasure In This
passages.text: How can they live like this while their people suffer?

passages.title: I Take No Pleasure In This
passages.text: I won't pretend that this will solve all of the goblins' problems, but it does feel good to bring a little justice to these pompous parasites.

passages.title: We Have Him Cornered
passages.text:
Did you hear Gallywix barking orders to his servants and thugs? Still concerned with frivolities as we edge ever closer.

He feels safe in his petulant palace of profits. He should not.

Even here, we will strike down Trade Prince Gallywix. For the Alliance!

passages.title: We Have Him Cornered
passages.text: Gallywix will not be missed.

passages.title: We Have Him Cornered
passages.text:
The Gallywix that we fought was a decoy? A body double?

Infuriating. We were so close... I'm sorry, <name>.

passages.title: Gallywix Got Away
passages.text:
I must confess my disappointment that we were not able to bring an end to Gallywix's greedy reign today.

But I blame no one but myself, and will report the same to the High Commander. Your performance was exemplary, just as I expected.

I hope the Alliance will not lose faith in the void elves because of this. We have much to offer.

When you're ready, I will open a final Void portal to take us back to Boralus.

passages.title: Gallywix Got Away
passages.text:
Thank you, <name>. Not every failed mission is a failure.

We've put Gallywix on the run and uncovered his decoy operations. And I, personally, also learned a thing or two from the surprising tactics of Umbric's void elf regiment.

I have no doubt that the denizens of the Void will prove valuable to the Alliance in the trying days ahead.

passages.title: Mission Report: Swiftwind Post
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Swiftwind Post.

It details that victory was hard-fought, but all of the wicker beasts previously infesting the outpost have been slain.

Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

passages.title: Mission Report: Swiftwind Post
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Drustvar?

passages.title: Mission Report: Swiftwind Post
passages.text:
It seems the mission to create an additional foothold in Drustvar was a success. Well done, <name>.

I will send you to oversee the fortifications at once.

passages.title: Swiftwind Post
passages.text:
The raid you planned for Swiftwind Post in Drustvar was successful. Well done.

The outpost is ready to be claimed.

Make your way to Swiftwind Post in Drustvar and establish fortifications there.

Swiftwind Post will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Alliance.

Go with honor!

passages.title: Swiftwind Post
passages.text: Welcome, <name>. This is a fine location for an outpost! Thanks to your leadership the Horde has yet another foothold in Drustvar!

passages.title: A Looming Threat
passages.text:
If we hope to push the Horde out of our lands, we must call upon all the strength our people have to offer.

Go, seek out the druids, the priestesses, our sentinels! Make the call to arms, and watch as the kaldorei rise to action. Only together can we hope to end the stalemate at the Wildbend River.

When you are finished, report to Malfurion Stormrage. He awaits our fleet in Rut'theran Village.

passages.title: A Looming Threat
passages.text: No matter the odds, we must stay strong.

passages.title: Under the Cover of Swiftwing
passages.text:
Aye! So we be the first in this crazy operation. We'll be hitchin' a ride on Swiftwing to tha Isle of Fangs.

The Zandalari got one of their main ships there, called the Breath of Pa'ku, whatever that is.

Hop on ta Swiftwing when yer ready te go. It's gonna get real cozy on there with all of ye comin' aboard.

passages.title: Under the Cover of Swiftwing
passages.text: Hop on!

passages.title: Under the Cover of Swiftwing
passages.text:
All we need to do is plant some bombs and cause some chaos without the mainland Zandalari knowing. 

Easy, right?

passages.title: How to Sink a Zandalari Battleship
passages.text:
Let's go over our plan of attack, but remember above all things, the Zandalari cannot know our full forces are here.

If they were to discover an Alliance base within the shadow of their empire... we would be wiped out in an instant.

passages.title: How to Sink a Zandalari Battleship
passages.text: Let's go over the plan.

passages.title: How to Sink a Zandalari Battleship
passages.text: You know the plan, <name>. Stay hidden and weaken the Zandalari fleet. If we accomplish those two goals, we'll walk out of here alive.

passages.title: Sabotaging the Pa'ku
passages.text:
Our first job is to plant some bombs along these ships. I'll take care of the smaller ships, you deal with the Breath of Pa'ku.

Whatever that means.

Kelsey says these bombs are the latest in gnome technology. We plant 'em and she can detonate them at any time.

Let's get moving, and remember, this whole plan works as long as they don't see us plantin' these bombs.

passages.title: Sabotaging the Pa'ku
passages.text:
All the bombs are planted on my end. Still wish we could blow 'em up now. 

Guess we'll have to just wait until the time is right to blow these things sky high.

passages.title: Ship Logs
passages.text:
We've got mogu and Zandalari working together on the Breath of Pa'ku. They've got records on the Zandalari fleet's ships.

We've been making educated guesses regarding the Zandalari fleet. It's time to upgrade our intel.

Go in there and get the naval records from anyone on board that ship.

Oh, and take these jet boots. You'll need them to reach the boat if you're planting bombs on the hull.

passages.title: Ship Logs
passages.text: Did you get those naval records? We'll need them to better plan against the Zandalari.

passages.title: Ship Logs
passages.text: Perfect! I'll get these documents back to Halford. We'll be able to coordinate future attacks with this.

passages.title: The Enlarged Miniaturized Submarine
passages.text:
Our next target is a ship docked in a place across from here, the Warport Rastari.

Lucky for you, I can get us all there in my enlarged miniaturized submarine.

Shandris Feathermoon and Magister Umbric should be waiting for you on the coast of Warport Rastari.

Let's get going!

passages.title: The Enlarged Miniaturized Submarine
passages.text: Glad you could make it, <name>. We've got a lot to do within Warport Rastari.

passages.title: Intelligence Denial
passages.text:
There are three Horde spymasters stationed within Warport Rastari. They are giving the Zandalari information on the Alliance fleet.

We need these targets killed. We cannot allow the Zandalari to get any advantageous information on our fleet.

Luckily for us, your blood troll disguise means any witnesses will believe this to be a bold attack by the blood trolls.

passages.title: Intelligence Denial
passages.text: You've prevented the zandalari from getting crucial information regarding our naval forces. Well done.

passages.title: Victory is Assured
passages.text:
Our task is finished. You've planted the bombs on two of the Zandalari's major flagships, and Keeshan has helped with the remainder.

Let's return to Halford, the sooner we're done here, the better. It's far too risky for us to be at the Zandalari's doorstep.

passages.title: Victory is Assured
passages.text:
<name>, good timing. We have to move.

We've been discovered.

passages.title: My Enemy's Enemy is My Disguise
passages.text:
We need you to kill several targets within Warport Rastari, but we also cannot reveal that the Alliance is here.

Umbric has uncovered a ritual from Nazmir that will grant you a blood troll disguise. It is grim, but it must be done.

You will go through with the ritual, then use my invisibility flask to sneak into the Warport. 

If discovered, the Zandalari and Horde will think it's a bold attack from the blood trolls... and not from the Alliance.

passages.title: My Enemy's Enemy is My Disguise
passages.text: I know this is unpleasant, but it must be done.

passages.title: My Enemy's Enemy is My Disguise
passages.text: I have to admit, this disguise is uncanny. Let's hope the zandalari believe they are dealing with a bold blood troll and not the Alliance.

passages.title: Victory Was Assured
passages.text:
Kelsey brought back the records you retrieved on the Isle of Fangs, but it was too late.

What you see before you is Gral's Call, the missing Zandalari flagship, and they've spotted us.

If they make it back to port, we will have the full fury of the Zandalari empire brought down upon us.

We must board the ship and eliminate every Zandalari on board.

Falstad will get us there. Let's move.

passages.title: Victory Was Assured
passages.text: We're here, and the fighting has begun. Let's hurry.

passages.title: Nature Versus Nurture
passages.text:
Greetings, <name>. I am Wingminder Goja.

I overheard the ordeal that Pa'ku has laid at your feet. I can help you.

I oversee this roost at my loa's pleasure. I have seen many eggs become glorious beasts of war. It will be a long road ahead, with many trials to overcome, but de companionship of a pterrordax be a worthy reward.

For now, de little one is young. Simply tend to his needs while he stays in de nest. When he is ready to take on de world he will let you know.

Good luck, <name>.

passages.title: Nature Versus Nurture
passages.text:
<Kua'fon opens his wings and screeches gleefully at you!>

Skree!!

passages.title: Intercepted Orders
passages.text:
Good to see you again, adventurer.

Mathias and I are discussing what to do with new intel that his SI:7 agents procured for us.

The intercepted letter contains orders from Warchief Sylvanas for an operation the Horde is undertaking at sea.

This could be a rare opportunity, or a distraction. The letter is purposefully light on details, and it's unclear if we should make this a top priority or focus on our other missions.

Do you have a moment to talk through this with Mathias and me?

passages.title: Intercepted Orders
passages.text: We cannot afford a distraction... or a missed opportunity.

passages.title: Intercepted Orders
passages.text:
It's decided, then. The assassination of Blood Prince Dreven at sea will be unexpected, demoralizing, and beneficial to the long-term success of our larger campaign.

<Halford Wyrmbane smiles.>

Everything I'm looking for in a strategy.

passages.title: Sweete's Strongbox
passages.text:
You've got the keys, and Taelia's still watching our backs. So let's head up to Sweete's, ah, "office" and liberate the documents in that strongbox.

Come on, it's across the bridge with the rest of his treasure.

passages.title: Sweete's Strongbox
passages.text:
I'm certain the information we need is in this chest. But given the added security, my backup plan of having Taelia bust this thing open isn't going to work. Who knows what other security is set up on this chest?

We need to get that final key.

passages.title: Mission Report: Mudfisher Cove
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Mudfisher Cove.

It details that victory was hard-fought, but all of the guards previously defending the outpost have been slain.

Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

passages.title: Mission Report: Mudfisher Cove
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Drustvar?

passages.title: Mission Report: Mudfisher Cove
passages.text:
It seems the mission to create an additional foothold in Drustvar was a success. Well done, <name>.

I will send you to oversee the fortifications at once.

passages.title: Mudfisher Cove
passages.text:
The raid you planned for Mudfisher Cove in Drustvar was successful. Well done.

The outpost is ready to be claimed.

Make your way to Mudfisher Cove in Drustvar and establish fortifications there.

The cove will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Alliance.

Move quickly!

passages.title: Mudfisher Cove
passages.text: Throm-Ka, <name>. This is a fine location for an outpost! Thanks to your leadership the Horde has yet another foothold in Drustvar!

passages.title: No Ptake, Only Throw
passages.text:
<Kua'fon places a troll skull into your palm. It is covered in teeth marks and rather slimy.>

Skree!

<Kua'fon peers at you expectantly.>

passages.title: No Ptake, Only Throw
passages.text:
<Kua'fon's eyes shine brightly. He tucks his troll skull safely under a wing and gargles appreciatively at you.>

Skree.

passages.title: Mission Report: Windfall Cavern
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Windfall Cavern.

It details that victory was hard-fought, but Gravemaul has been slain.

Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

passages.title: Mission Report: Windfall Cavern
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Stormsong Valley?

passages.title: Mission Report: Windfall Cavern
passages.text:
It seems the mission to create an additional foothold in Stormsong Valley was a success. Well done, <name>.

I will send you to oversee the fortifications at once.

passages.title: Windfall Cavern
passages.text:
The raid you planned for Windfall Cavern in Stormsong Valley was successful. Well done.

The outpost is ready to be claimed.

Make your way to Windfall Cavern in Stormsong Valley and establish fortifications there.

Windfall Cavern will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Alliance.

Go with honor!

passages.title: Windfall Cavern
passages.text: Well met, <name>. This is a fine location for an outpost! Thanks to your leadership the Horde has yet another foothold in Stormsong Valley!

passages.title: Work Order: Demitri's Draught of Deception
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, alchemist. We needed these potions badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Demitri's Draught of Deception
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, alchemist. We needed these potions badly.

passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, blacksmith. We needed these stirrups badly.

passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, blacksmith. We needed these hoofplates badly.

passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, chef. We needed this food badly.

passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, chef. We needed this food badly.

passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, chef. We needed this food badly.

passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, chef. We needed this food badly.
