passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, engineer. We needed this ammunition badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Crow's Nest Scope
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, engineer. We needed these scopes badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Incendiary Ammunition
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, engineer. We needed this ammunition badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Crow's Nest Scope
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, engineer. We needed these scopes badly.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Great Sea Catfish
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed these fish badly.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Sand Shifter
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed these fish badly.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Slimy Mackerel
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed these fish badly.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Redtail Loach
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed these fish badly.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Great Sea Catfish
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed these fish badly.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Tiragarde Perch
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed these fish badly.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Frenzied Fangtooth
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed these fish badly.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Lane Snapper
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed these fish badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Ultramarine Pigment
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, scribe. We needed these pigments badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Contract: Tortollan Seekers
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, scribe. We needed these contracts badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Contract: Champions of Azeroth
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, scribe. We needed these contracts badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Ultramarine Pigment
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, scribe. We needed these pigments badly.

passages.title: Infusing the Heart
passages.text:
Azeroth's voice is growin' fainter and fainter. If the seal on this chamber shatters, her soul will be lost!

We've got one chance tae save us all.

Absorb the Azerite around the chamber into the Heart of Azeroth. Then unleash the amulet's power tae seal that crack in the center of the seal.

Azerite can be a destructive force, but if it's channeled through yer amulet, it can heal the world!

passages.title: Infusing the Heart
passages.text: What are ye waitin' fer?

passages.title: Infusing the Heart
passages.text:
That was too close, <name>! Now ye've seen the true power of the Heart of Azeroth. 

But we've got a long way tae go before the world is healed.

passages.title: The Blackwood Den
passages.text:
We have not moved all of our troops into Darkshore yet, but I think we have enough to justify establishing a foothold somewhere. I know just the place.

Just south of here is the Blackwood Den. Its inhabitants, the Furbolgs, have been driven in to a hysteria. With our enemies pouring from the North, the Furbolg threat is a nuisance we cannot afford. 

I will lead another squad past the wall while you... negotiate with the Furbolgs.

passages.title: The Blackwood Den
passages.text:
Just you wait, <name> -- once we have conquered Darnassus the Elders of the Blackwood tribe will be thanking us for restoring peace to the den.

We just need to borrow it for a moment.

passages.title: The Start of Something Good
passages.text:
While the rest of our army sets up camp -- you should follow me. I spotted something... interesting... on my way back from Zoram'gar.

I'll admit, not even I could have predicted such fortuitous happenstance.

Come with me, <name>. And bring a pickaxe.

passages.title: The Start of Something Good
passages.text: You heard the warchief, we got work to do!

passages.title: A Wild Ride
passages.text:
Let me tell ya, kid... this may be some of the best work I've ever done!

Now that the upgrades are in place, there's no time to waste.

The battle is raging over at Wildbend River. Take the modified hellion into battle and give 'em hell!

passages.title: A Wild Ride
passages.text: For every enemy we slay, two replace them on the battlefield...

passages.title: Iron Stores
passages.text:
While the mine is under Alliance banners our workers ensure the iron supply never runs dry.

This key will provide access to the stores. Take what you need.

passages.title: Iron Stores
passages.text: These old chests can be quite the bother.

passages.title: Iron Stores
passages.text: Well now, that was easy.

passages.title: Resource Recruitment
passages.text:
If we're to maintain our iron supply we'll need a bit of help.

See if you can wrangle us up a few fresh recruits for the mine.

passages.title: Resource Recruitment
passages.text: Well done. Those recruits will surely help maintain our iron supply.

passages.title: The Final Foothold
passages.text:
We have established two critical footholds in Zandalar. The time has come to establish the third.

Let's review the battle plan when you're ready.

passages.title: The Final Foothold
passages.text: Ready to go? Let's get a move on, then.

passages.title: The Final Foothold
passages.text:
We have established two critical footholds in Kul Tiras. The time has come to establish the third.

Let's review the battle plan when you're ready.

passages.title: The Final Foothold
passages.text: I trust you are sufficiently prepared, then.

passages.title: Room To Grow
passages.text:
Ah, I would not worry too much about de little one.

Some beasts take longer than others to find their way, and Kua'fon is no exception.

For now, continue to help him grow. Keep him fed, keep him out of danger, and strengthen your bond. He will let you know when he is ready to try again.

passages.title: Room To Grow
passages.text:
<Kua'fon wriggles anxiously, leveling one golden eye upon you.>

Skree?

passages.title: The Mysterious Island
passages.text:
Fate's End is just that. It's where the very worst criminals are sent. No one ever comes back.

I'm sorry Lady Katherine will have to hear this, but I'm glad it isn't my job to tell her.

<Flynn hands you the document solemnly.>

I'm certain she'll want an update, even if the news is as bad as this.

passages.title: The Mysterious Island
passages.text:
Fate's End! Merciful Tides, I'd hoped she wouldn't have been sent there... But of course she would be.

No matter. I must forge ahead.

passages.title: A Forlorn Hope
passages.text:
<Lady Katherine's jaw sets.>

I refuse to believe I am too late.

No one has ever come back from Fate's End, but if anyone could survive I have to believe it would be my Jaina.

Go to Stormsong Valley and secure transit to Fate's End from the tidesages. Brother Pike is a good place to start.

Hurry, <name>.

passages.title: A Forlorn Hope
passages.text:
Jaina Proudmoore was sent to Fate's End and her mother wishes to save her?

Then we must act at once if we are to have any hope of saving her life!

passages.title: A Load of Scrap
passages.text:
Hello, friend. Would you like the scoop on the latest invention of the century?

It's called the Scrap-O-Matic 1000 and this device can triple, no QUADRUPLE your production capacity as a crafter of armor, weapons or other gizmos you adventurers wander around with.

Here, take these pants and use the Scrap-O-Matic on 'em. You'll get the hang of it.

passages.title: A Load of Scrap
passages.text: This machine is gonna change everything!

passages.title: A Load of Scrap
passages.text:
And just like that, you're back in business. All the materials you put into making the item come back to you with the Scrap-O-Matic 1000.

Well, maybe not ALL the materials, but hey, something's better than nothing, right?

Oh, and keep an eye out for explusom. It's what we've discovered as a magical byproduct of the scrapping process.

It's quite potent and only shows up when we scrap really fancy stuff.

passages.title: Make Loh Go
passages.text:
Hello, <name>! We tortollans grow up hearing the stories of Loh, a tortollan who had many adventures. These stories help to challenge a young tortollan's mind as they try to figure out how Loh would make his way through any given adventure.

Care to give it a try?

passages.title: Make Loh Go
passages.text: Well done, <name>!

passages.title: Bringing Down the Fleet
passages.text:
This is it, <name>. We've weakened the Horde enough to make a daring strike on Zuldazar itself.

Our forces in Zuldazar still remain hidden, thanks to the help of the Dark Iron dwarves. That gives us our chance to strike.

Set sail to Zuldazar. We will be gathering our forces there for a coordinated strike to weaken their harbor defenses.

passages.title: Bringing Down the Fleet
passages.text: We're all gathered. Let's begin, we cannot afford to lose any more time.

passages.title: Mission Report: Hillcrest Pasture
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Hillcrest Pasture.

It details that victory was hard-fought, but the Stormsong defenders have been slain.

Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

passages.title: Mission Report: Hillcrest Pasture
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Stormsong Valley?

passages.title: Mission Report: Hillcrest Pasture
passages.text:
It seems the mission to create an additional foothold in Stormsong Valley was a success. Well done, <name>.

I will send you to oversee the fortifications at once.

passages.title: Hillcrest Pasture
passages.text:
The raid you planned for Hillcrest Pasture in Stormsong Valley was successful. Well done.

The outpost is ready to be claimed.

Make your way to Hillcrest Pasture in Stormsong Valley and establish fortifications there.

Hillcrest Pasture will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Alliance.

Go with honor!

passages.title: Hillcrest Pasture
passages.text: Well met, <name>. This is a fine location for an outpost! Thanks to your leadership the Horde has yet another foothold in Stormsong Valley!

passages.title: Of Myth and Fable
passages.text:
If Jaina is truly trapped in the Blighted Lands, that could mean we're not too late! We just need to find a way inside...

We will need to enlist the help of Lucille Waycrest. The legends of that place are deeply rooted in Drustvar's culture. If anyone would know more about it, it would be she.

I will send a raven ahead for her to prepare what knowledge she can gather. Make haste to Arom's Stand!

passages.title: Of Myth and Fable
passages.text:
I can't believe you're thinking of intentionally seeking out the Blighted Lands. The legends say it's a terrible place that exists for torment and pain.

I'm not sure any prize is worth treading those grounds.

passages.title: The Old Bear
passages.text:
I cannot change your mind, can I? Very well, I may know where you can find your answers. 

High in the mountains, there is a hidden alcove of impossibly verdant growth. It is there that the druids of Kul Tiras train in the old ways of the Drust - from before the time of Gorak Tul.

Their leader is a great bear named Ulfar. I know little about him, but few are more qualified to parse the magic of the Drust.

You will find a path to his den along Highroad Pass. Good luck, Inquisitor.

passages.title: The Old Bear
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: The Old Bear
passages.text:
Forgive my hesitation, mainlander. It would appear the minions of Thros are no longer confined to their own realm.

I will help you cross the threshold into the Blighted Lands.

passages.title: Nightmare Catcher
passages.text:
The effigies crafted by the followers of Gorak Tul were made not of wood, but of the bones and sinew of their enemies. This will be your first task.

Travel to Gol Osigr where the ancient Drust have awoken from their slumber. The bones here belong to Gorak Tul's greatest soldiers who stood with him at the final battle against the first Lord Waycrest.

Their bones seethe with hatred and anger. This will serve your needs well.

passages.title: Nightmare Catcher
passages.text: Do you have the materials?

passages.title: Nightmare Catcher
passages.text: I can practically feel the hatred emanating off these bones. They will do nicely.

passages.title: Buried Power
passages.text:
Since time immemorial, the Drust have used runes to shape their magics. This remains true of the spells woven by Gorak Tul and his ilk. You will need some of these runes for your effigy to be effective.

It is likely that some still exist at the site of his final battle, buried under years of soot and snow. 

Take this stone. It is empowered with the magic of the Thornspeakers and will react to Tul's spells. With it, you should be able to locate the runes, no matter how deep the ages have buried them.

passages.title: Buried Power
passages.text: What have you uncovered beneath the snows of Gol Osigr?

passages.title: Buried Power
passages.text: These runestones still throb with the twisted energy of Gorak Tul's magic. They will serve you well.

passages.title: Hatred's Focus
passages.text:
An effigy requires a central focus. The coven are fond of using animal skulls for this purpose, but for your task you will need something much more potent.

Korvash was a trusted lieutenant to Gorak Tul, as well as a powerful sorcerer, until he was defeated at the battle of Arom's Stand. His bones remain at the site of his demise, now buried by the years.

Find them, and take his skull.

passages.title: Hatred's Focus
passages.text: Have you found Korvash's bones?

passages.title: Hatred's Focus
passages.text:
Korvash's skull will make a powerful focus indeed, but the years have drained it of its natural potency.

You will need to take further steps to prepare it for your ritual.

passages.title: Waycrest Manor: Draining the Heartsbane
passages.text:
The skull you have taken from Korvash needs to be steeped in Gorak Tul's magic to grant the power needed to bridge the gap to Thros. You must take it to a font of his power, and let it absorb his magic.

You will find one such font in Waycrest Manor - the epicenter of the coven's power. Here, their leader has tapped so freely into Tul's power that it emanates from the very walls.

Bring Korvash's skull to the heart of the manor and let it feast. Then, the effigy will be complete.

passages.title: Waycrest Manor: Draining the Heartsbane
passages.text:
So, this thing is the key to opening the gateway?

You truly mean to go through with this, then?

passages.title: Runic Resistance
passages.text:
Whatever is going on with this effigy, I don't think it's going to open the gateway without our help.

These runes must be the key. There must be some way we can use them to activate the effigy.

passages.title: Runic Resistance
passages.text: There must be some trick to these runes...

passages.title: Runic Resistance
passages.text:
Remarkable! Yesterday, I believed this place to only exist in tales and legends, and now I stand a footstep away from it...

I just hope that at least some of those tales were exaggerations...

passages.title: Hunting Blood Prince Dreven
passages.text:
Between the information I gathered from my scouting mission and Mathias Shaw's intel, we know exactly where Blood Prince Dreven is going to be.

We will have our revenge, adventurer. For ourselves, for my sisters, for the Alliance.

We won't underestimate the san'layn this time. We will keep the Horde off-balance and distracted with swift, targeted, ruthless attacks.

Thankfully, the Wildhammer are masters of those combat tactics. I'm glad they'll be joining us.

Are you ready to leave?

passages.title: Hunting Blood Prince Dreven
passages.text: Our strikes will be swift and true. The san'layn will fall.

passages.title: Hunting Blood Prince Dreven
passages.text:
The foul weather offers us some cover. Every thick cloud and raindrop is an ally.

<Shandris Feathermoon smirks.>

In that sense, we actually outnumber the Horde. They don't stand a chance.

passages.title: Behind Enemy Boats
passages.text:
This is where our information ends, adventurer.

Blood Prince Dreven is lurking in one of those Forsaken boats, but we don't know which boat or which section of that boat he's in.

We'll split up and hit the boats simultaneously, so the Horde has less time to react.

If Dreven isn't on the boat you scout, abandon it and join me on the other one. If he's not on my boat, I'll do the same. 

We'll take down Dreven together.

Don't get distracted. Our resources are limited. Dreven is our only target today.

passages.title: Behind Enemy Boats
passages.text:
Ha! Nathanos is gonna be cryin' all the way back tae Sylvanas's nursery after that whoppin'!

Did ye find Blood Prince Dreven?

passages.title: Broadside Bedlam
passages.text:
<The ship's cannons are currently pointed at the other Forsaken ship across the water.

However, it appears the crew hasn't loaded them with gunpowder or cannonballs yet... Probably to avoid any accidental firings while they're anchored here.

Yes, it'd be a real shame if "accidental" cannon fire damaged the other ship.>

passages.title: Broadside Bedlam
passages.text: Ye find anything interesting down in the ship?

passages.title: Broadside Bedlam
passages.text:
I wish ye could've seen the crew panicking when ye shot off those cannons. It was hilarious!

That's the Wildhammer style!

passages.title: The Wildhammer Specialty
passages.text:
Well, if ye didn't find Blood Prince Dreven on yer ship, he must be hiding on the other one.

I can take ye down to it, but the Horde knows we're here now. What do ye say we create some distractions to hold their attention while we hunt down Dreven?

Me Wildhammers are itchin' tae let the hammers fly. Ye want to join us for the first round?

passages.title: The Wildhammer Specialty
passages.text: He's here.

passages.title: An Unnatural Crew
passages.text:
Blood Prince Dreven is here, and the situation's even worse than we thought.

That monster's training other san'layn. Every neophyte you see on this ship is another future Blood Prince Dreven.

His vile practices cannot be allowed to spread within the Horde. We're going to tear the san'layn out, right now, root and all.

passages.title: An Unnatural Crew
passages.text: Every san'layn must be felled today, or we'll never be rid of them.

passages.title: An Unnatural Crew
passages.text: That is enough for now. We must focus our efforts on Blood Prince Dreven.

passages.title: Foul Crystals for Foul People
passages.text:
Blood Prince Dreven and his followers are siphoning power from blood-infused crystals to bolster their unholy abilities.

Destroying those crystals will weaken Dreven before we fight him. Take out as many as you can find.

passages.title: Foul Crystals for Foul People
passages.text: Good. That should weaken Blood Prince Dreven long enough for us to kill him.

passages.title: Ending the San'layn Threat
passages.text:
Blood Prince Dreven has barricaded himself in the lowest deck of this ship. He's trapped down there.

Don't think that makes this easy for us. A cornered beast is more dangerous than a free one. But, if we have the will and wisdom, he can be slain.

Follow me. I will break the barrier blocking his lair and we will face him together.

passages.title: Ending the San'layn Threat
passages.text:
<Shandris raises her eyes to the sky and speaks somberly.>

Ande'thoras-ethil, sisters. Shaha lor'ma.

passages.title: A Clean Escape
passages.text:
Our victory here will echo through the Horde like a warning shot.

Grunts will whisper around the campfire that nowhere is safe from adventurer and the Alliance.

Soldiers will doubt, even for a moment, the strength of their commanders.

Sylvanas herself will hear the story of what we did here today, and it will infuriate her. The thought of her outraged roar when she hears the news will keep me warm tonight.

Let's return to Boralus and inform the High Commander of the good news.

passages.title: A Clean Escape
passages.text:
You've done the Alliance, and all of Azeroth, a fine service today, <name>.

We will sleep in a better world than we woke to. That is all that can be asked of us.

For the Alliance!

passages.title: Raiding the Boulderfist
passages.text:
The Boulderfist have been rather active ever since the battle began. One of our scouts reported their recent raid on Galson's Lode proved rather lucrative.

Scout the cave to the northeast, find the iron ore they stole and steal it back.

We can't afford to let anyone else control our resources.

passages.title: The Strength of the Storm
passages.text:
The ritual I must conduct is written on a scroll. To gain access to it, you'll have to break through the dark energies the fallen tidesages have placed around it, with the power of the storm.

This relic can be used to pull purified power from the enslaved elementals. Not only will you be gaining the means to our end, you will ultimately be freeing these spirits from corruption.

Defeat the enslaved elementals and then call their power into the relic.

passages.title: The Strength of the Storm
passages.text: Well done, <name>. The staff is now imbued with the strength of those elementals. You will need it for what lies ahead.

passages.title: Opening the Way
passages.text:
Hmm. This ritual is a bit... tricky. No matter, together we will be able to complete it.

I shall begin to channel. You will need to activate the runes in the proper order. I shall leave the scroll here so you may consult it.

passages.title: Opening the Way
passages.text: There we are. The clouds clear and the sea calms. Our way is open.

passages.title: Opening the Way
passages.text: From here we shall be able to reach Fate's End. Hopefully in time.

passages.title: Fate's End
passages.text:
Fate's End is a place in turmoil. The seas froth, the air cracks with thunder. We tried to settle there once, but each settlement disappeared into the mists, every soul never to be seen again. The island did not want inhabitants.

Now we send our most vile exiles there. They never return and no one knows why.

Should we find and recover Jaina, she will be the first. I hope we are not too late.

passages.title: Fate's End
passages.text: By the Tides, I thought we were done for.

passages.title: Fate's End
passages.text:
You appeared to leave the island for a brief moment, then reappeared with that creature. Perhaps where it came from is where Jaina has gone.

Lady Katherine should be told of this development.

passages.title: Lost in Darkness
passages.text:
If people are being pulled somewhere else, it would explain why no one has ever returned. I also choose to believe it means Lady Jaina might be able to be saved as well.

Go back to Lady Katherine with all speed! She will want to know of this development.

passages.title: Lost in Darkness
passages.text:
The Blighted Lands? Why... I thought that was only a legend used to frighten children.

My daughter... What have I done to you?

passages.title: The War Campaign
passages.text:
<name>, a moment of your time.

Before you leave Boralus, speak with Halford Wyrmbane, High Commander of the 7th Legion. He specifically requested you by name.

You can find him aboard the Wind's Redemption, which should be parked in the first slip right outside.

passages.title: The War Campaign
passages.text:
Ah, <name>. Good to see you again.

We have a job to do.

passages.title: Eyes on the Skies
passages.text:
You have made a great deal of progress with Kua'fon. He may not yet possess de power of flight, but he is healthy and growing.

Take de success you have made and build upon it, <name>. Do not let Pa'ku's lesson dishearten you.

Continue to do as you have been. Nurture Kua'fon, build his confidence in his wings. Show him de way forward and he will reward you with a bond stronger than any you have ever known.

When his wings are large enough to shade you, we will try again.

passages.title: Eyes on the Skies
passages.text:
<Kua'fon spreads his magnificent wings.>

Skree!

passages.title: The War Campaign
passages.text:
<name>, a moment of your time.

Before you leave the city, speak with me out on the Banshee's Wail, on the docks. I have information to discuss with you about the war against the Alliance.

passages.title: The War Campaign
passages.text: You're here.

passages.title: Farmers Who Fight
passages.text:
I was hoping for a squad of Proudmoore Academy's finest, but I guess you'll have to do.

What we lack in manpower we make up for in courage! Even the farmers here won't give up their land without a fight.

Send the bravest of them to me. They will fight better alongside our marines than by themselves out in the fields!

passages.title: Farmers Who Fight
passages.text: We'll get those volunteers paired up with the regulars and give 'em a fighting chance.

passages.title: A Local Guide
passages.text:
I've spent a lot of time as a guest of the Harbormaster and I've come to understand a few things about Flynn Fairwind. If anyone can quickly help you to sort out any clues in Freehold, it will be him.

Flynn's been doing work for Cyrus and can be found in the Harbormaster's office. Show him the contract and recruit him to our cause. Hurry, <name>.

passages.title: A Local Guide
passages.text: You fight monsters, unite kingdoms and now you're going to save a princess? You really do take on a lot of this 'hero' stuff. I just hope it doesn't catch.

passages.title: A Local Guide
passages.text:
I'd hoped maybe Lady Jaina's location was in the fine print but no such luck. I can confirm that Ashvane was doing business with the Irontide. So we're off to Freehold. Again.

Joy.

passages.title: Journey to the Middle of Nowhere
passages.text:
Our tidesage, Thomas Zelling, claims to have found the wreckage of Marshal Valentine's ship.

Took him long enough.

Marshal Valentine's body is the final piece of our plan, and it lies within that shipwreck. When you're ready, let us depart for his resting place.

passages.title: Journey to the Middle of Nowhere
passages.text: This is the spot.

passages.title: Seafloor Shipwreck
passages.text:
<static>

... look for shipwreck ...

<static>

... east ...

<static>

passages.title: Checking Dog Tags
passages.text:
You are no longer able to hear Hobart's voice over the static.

You can make out the outlines of several floating bodies nearby. They have significantly decomposed, but their dog tags should still be intact.

Hopefully the dog tags can help identify Marshal Valentine.

passages.title: The Sunken Graveyard
passages.text:
<static>

...wait ... more shipwrecks ...

<static>

... lots of 'em ... northeast ...

<static>

passages.title: Captain By Captain
passages.text:
Seems like you're on your own.

More shipwrecks lie along the bottom of the sea. This must have been the location of a major battle.

Time to start checking dog tags to find Marshal Valentine.

passages.title: The Undersea Ledge
passages.text:
So, now that we can hear each other again, lemme tell you what's been goin' on up here.

Apparently we were off by like, a league. Somethin' about undersea currents, somethin' about the tides of time, yadda yadda. I think Zelling is getting rusty.

Point is, you're not far off now. We're SURE that Marshal Valentine is right to the east of ya, in a shipwreck up on a ledge. Zelling says there's something else big up there too, but he can't tell what it is.

passages.title: Water-Breathing Dragon
passages.text:
Huh. A dragon, you say? I suppose that makes sense. I mean, the Horde did utilize red dragons as part of their army during the second war, but... well, we don't talk about that very much anymore.

Still, Valentine is on that ship. You're gonna have to get past that dragon one way or another.

passages.title: Mission Report: Stonetusk Watch
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Stonetusk Watch.

It details that victory was hard-fought, but the outpost has been secured.

Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

passages.title: Mission Report: Stonetusk Watch
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Stormsong Valley?

passages.title: Mission Report: Stonetusk Watch
passages.text:
It seems the mission to create an additional foothold in Stormsong Valley was a success. Well done, <name>.

I will send you to oversee the fortifications at once.

passages.title: Stonetusk Watch
passages.text:
The raid you planned for Stonetusk Watch in Stormsong Valley was successful. Well done.

The outpost is ready to be claimed.

Make your way to Stonetusk Watch in Stormsong Valley and establish fortifications there.

The outpost will be essential in our campaign against the Alliance.

Go with honor!

passages.title: Stonetusk Watch
passages.text: Well met, <name>. This is a fine location for an outpost! Thanks to your leadership the Horde has yet another foothold in Stormsong Valley!

passages.title: Call to Arms: Stormsong Valley
passages.text: We've discovered a spike of Horde activity within Stormsong Valley. We cannot allow them to get the upper hand.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Stormsong Valley
passages.text: Great work, <class>.

passages.title: The Horde Slayer
The Alliance Slayer
Numbing the Pain
passages.text:
The medics here are doing their best, but they've suffered heavy casualties and are strapped for healing supplies.

With a few clumps of evermoss I could mix a painkilling tincture to ease the suffering of the injured. Can you forage some from the nearby trees?

I'll help get Flynn stabilized. The last thing these people need is another wounded man howling in pain.

passages.title: Numbing the Pain
passages.text: Did you find any evermoss?

passages.title: Numbing the Pain
passages.text: That should do.

passages.title: Leave None Alive
passages.text:
Our initial assault was a success. The Dark Iron dwarves are holding the line. Now it's our turn.

You and I must cleave a path through these Zandalari and eliminate them. Our forces will handle any that remain.

Our goal is to weaken their forces and find two important targets: the ship's captain and its advisor.

Let's go, <name>. If we fail here, all of our efforts will be thwarted.

passages.title: Leave None Alive
passages.text: We don't have time to talk!

passages.title: Leave None Alive
passages.text: Good work, that should be enough for the others to handle. We have one final target.

passages.title: Silencing the Advisor
passages.text:
The ship's captain is nowhere to be found. Shandris and Falstad will handle locating him.

We must go after the ship's advisor. Kelsey's logs indicate her name is Ko'jan. 

She may have methods to reach out to the mainland. We have to move before she tries to use any of them.

passages.title: Silencing the Advisor
passages.text: Let's get moving.

passages.title: Silencing the Advisor
passages.text:
It sounds like fighting up above has stopped. I trust Falstad and Shandris have the ship's captain.

Let's see if they managed to capture him alive.

passages.title: An End to the Killing
passages.text:
Let's return to the upper decks and see what our current status is. Shandris should be there by now.

I know Shandris and Falstad well enough that they will be there with the captain of this ship, dead or alive.

passages.title: An End to the Killing
passages.text:
<name>! I only just received the message of your success in Zandalar. Well done.

I'm sorry for everything that you've been put through on behalf of this war. We have only one option if we want to stop the Zandalari from aiding the Horde.

When the time is right, we will send our fleets to Zandalar. Your hard work will ensure we have a breach in their defenses to begin our invasion.

Thank you once more, <name>. We owe a great debt to you and your allies.

passages.title: Circle the Wagons
passages.text:
Darion and the girls should have been back by now. 

Maybe they had trouble on the road, that old wagon is always breaking down. I need to be sure they are safe!

Can you check on them for me?

passages.title: Circle the Wagons
passages.text: I'm getting worried, they should have been here hours ago.

passages.title: Circle the Wagons
passages.text: Thank you.  I can rest easy knowing they are safe.

passages.title: A Saur Point
passages.text:
That saurolisk has been a folktale in these hills for years. "Sourtooth, you can smell his breath from miles away". 

Today that folktale attacked my family, almost killed my father and sister. It's time for it to die.

passages.title: A Saur Point
passages.text: I'm not leaving till Sourtooth is dead!

passages.title: A Saur Point
passages.text: No more smelling it's breath in the wind.

passages.title: Sometimes Less Is More
passages.text:
I don't really hate saurolisk, but there seem to be a lot more around lately. 

Stormsong's military used to thin out the population, but they didn't show up this year.

Maybe you could do the job they didn't!

passages.title: Sometimes Less Is More
passages.text: Thank you.  I can rest easy knowing they are safe.

passages.title: Tol Dagor: The Ashvane Overseer
passages.text:
Tol Dagor stands as a well fortified thorn in this nation's side.

As you are no doubt aware, Ashvane has taken every opportunity she could to throw any opposition into those cells. Among those in the jail are members of the Alliance that arrived alongside you and Jaina.

We now have permission and the needed muscle to free them. Meet up with Taelia on the eastern shore of the island, find the overseer, and take his key. With it, we will have access to the weapon vault and cells.

passages.title: Tol Dagor: The Ashvane Overseer
passages.text: Well?

passages.title: Tol Dagor: The Ashvane Overseer
passages.text: Most of those hostages have seen better days, but they will recover quickly. With Tol Dagor out of the way, Ashvane is quickly running out of places to hide.

passages.title: Mission Report: Veiled Grotto
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Veiled Grotto.

It details that victory was hard-fought, but the enemies guarding the outpost have been slain.

Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

passages.title: Mission Report: Veiled Grotto
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Zuldazar?

passages.title: Mission Report: Veiled Grotto
passages.text:
It seems the mission to create an additional foothold in Zuldazar was a success. Well done, <name>.

I will send you to oversee the fortifications at once.

passages.title: Veiled Grotto
passages.text:
The raid you planned for Veiled Grotto in Zuldazar was successful. Well done.

The outpost is ready to be claimed.

Make your way to Veiled Grotto in Zuldazar and establish fortifications there.

Veiled Grotto will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Horde.

For the Alliance!

passages.title: Veiled Grotto
passages.text: Well done, <name>. This is a fine location for an outpost! Thanks to your leadership the Alliance has yet another foothold in Zuldazar!

passages.title: A Looming Threat
passages.text: This stalemate is unwise to pursue. Let's regroup at the Blackwood Den.

passages.title: A Looming Threat
passages.text: Death is an inevitability.

passages.title: A Looming Threat
passages.text: We must wait for Saurfang to return before we proceed.

passages.title: Mission Report: Mugamba Overlook
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Mugamba Overlook.

It details that victory was hard-fought, but the enemies guarding the outpost have been slain.

Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

passages.title: Mission Report: Mugamba Overlook
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Zuldazar?

passages.title: Mission Report: Mugamba Overlook
passages.text:
It seems the mission to create an additional foothold in Zuldazar was a success. Well done, <name>.

I will send you to oversee the fortifications at once.

passages.title: Mugamba Overlook
passages.text:
The raid you planned for Mugamba Overlook in Zuldazar was successful. Well done.

The outpost is ready to be claimed.

Make your way to Mugamba Overlook in Zuldazar and establish fortifications there.

Mugamba Overlook will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Horde.

For the Alliance!

passages.title: Mugamba Overlook
passages.text: This will make a fine outpost. It is well-hidden and nearly impassable by foot. The Horde will never suspect that we've made camp here.

passages.title: Alchemy is an Inexact Science
passages.text:
Hey, look.

It worked, right? Mostly. I mean, it DID get bigger. Don't look at me like that! So there are some... weird side effects going on. When has that ever gotten in the way of science before?

Okay, okay, okay!

I have an idea. Go and get me everything on this list. And be quick about it! I think these Zandalari might do something to me if you-- if WE-- don't fix this.

<Alexxi hastily pens a list of ingredients and hands it to you.>

Do me a solid, eh?

passages.title: Alchemy is an Inexact Science
passages.text: Those claws look really sharp, <name>. Do you have what I need?

passages.title: Alchemy is an Inexact Science
passages.text: Whew! Maybe this will calm them down.

passages.title: Held For Observation
passages.text:
<Trader Alexxi hurriedly combines the ingredients.>

That should do it. Go on and get this down your direhorn's gullet.

Don't worry, nothing could possibly go wrong with a concoction made under any kind of duress. Also, do I seem like the kind of goblin who would give you something dangerous?

On purpose?

... Don't answer that. Hurry, before they stab me.

passages.title: Held For Observation
passages.text: <The direhorn hiccoughs in distress.>

passages.title: Held For Observation
passages.text:
<Beastlord L'kala peers mistrustfully at Alexxi, then back at you.>

None of this was necessary. Go. I need time to determine what is to be done about your direhorn.

passages.title: WANTED: War Gore
passages.text:
By the decree of the Storm's Wake.

Scouts have reported that forsaken scientists have created a monster, sewn together from the bodies of our own fallen soldiers. 

This monstrosity is called, War Gore.

The individual that destroys this abomination will earn a fitting reward.

passages.title: WANTED: War Gore
passages.text: One less threat to safety of Stormsong

passages.title: Mission Report: Verdant Hollow
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Verdant Hollow.

It details that victory was hard-fought, but the enemies guarding the outpost have been slain.

Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

passages.title: Mission Report: Verdant Hollow
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Zuldazar?

passages.title: Mission Report: Verdant Hollow
passages.text:
It seems the mission to create an additional foothold in Zuldazar was a success. Well done, <name>.

I will send you to oversee the fortifications at once.

passages.title: Verdant Hollow
passages.text:
The raid you planned for Verdant Hollow in Zuldazar was successful. Well done.

The outpost is ready to be claimed.

Make your way to Verdant Hollow in Zuldazar and establish fortifications there.

Verdant Hollow will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Horde.

For the Alliance!

passages.title: Verdant Hollow
passages.text: This'll be a fine location for an outpost. There are azerite deposits nearby and plenty o' big game fer huntin' as well!

passages.title: Restoring Old Bonds
passages.text:
We must speak to Grommash Hellscream and remind him of his debt to us. Everything rests on this mission, <name>.

I hope your skills in diplomacy are greater than mine.

Be on your guard; we do not know what to expect on the other side.

passages.title: Restoring Old Bonds
passages.text: We're not dead yet. I suppose that is a good sign.

passages.title: Calling Out the Clans
passages.text:
This Overlord Geya'rah has a fire inside her. I may come to like her... if she doesn't kill us.

We have but one chance. You pay homage to the symbol of each clan, and I will speak of it.

Show respect--or they will show us the executioner's blade.

passages.title: Calling Out the Clans
passages.text: I do not have time for this.

passages.title: Calling Out the Clans
passages.text: So, you know of our clans.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Drustvar
passages.text: We've discovered a spike of Horde activity within Drustvar. We cannot allow them to get the upper hand.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Drustvar
passages.text: Great work, <class>.

passages.title: Bonds Forged Through Battle
passages.text:
Geya'rah has a fiery spirit... like her mother. Perhaps facing a common foe will ease her wariness.

We subdued the ogre clans long ago. But every so often, one of their bravest--and stupidest--stirs the embers of rebellion. Today is such a day.

You and Eitrigg will join Geya'rah in putting down the ogre uprising. Prove yourself in battle and you may earn her respect.

passages.title: Bonds Forged Through Battle
passages.text: Don't slow me down.

passages.title: Bonds Forged Through Battle
passages.text: We have to deal with an ogre uprising every few seasons.

passages.title: A Dying World
passages.text:
Champion, Azeroth be dyin' while the armies of the Horde and Alliance be fightin' over a ruined city.

She needs yer help. Make yer way to me camp in Silithus. Azeroth's got somethin' tae give ye.

passages.title: A Dying World
passages.text: Ye made it. We don't have any time tae lose.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Tiragarde Sound
passages.text: We've discovered a spike of Horde activity within Tiragarde Sound. We cannot allow them to get the upper hand.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Tiragarde Sound
passages.text: Great work, <class>.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Nazmir
passages.text: It's time to press the attack within Horde territory, <class>! Travel to Nazmir and slay as many Horde as you find.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Nazmir
passages.text: Great work, <class>.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Vol'dun
passages.text: It's time to press the attack within Horde territory, <class>! Travel to Vol'dun and slay as many Horde as you find.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Vol'dun
passages.text: Great work, <class>.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Zuldazar
passages.text: It's time to press the attack within Horde territory, <class>! Travel to Zuldazar and slay as many Horde as you find.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Zuldazar
passages.text: Great work, <class>.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Zuldazar
passages.text: We're getting reports of increased Alliance activity within Zuldazar. Head over there and clear them out.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Zuldazar
passages.text: Good work, <class>.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Vol'dun
passages.text: We're getting reports of increased Alliance activity within Vol'dun. Head over there and clear them out.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Vol'dun
passages.text: Good work, <class>.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Nazmir
passages.text: We're getting reports of increased Alliance activity within Nazmir. Head over there and clear them out.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Nazmir
passages.text: Good work, <class>.

passages.title: Tyranny of the Light
passages.text:
If it is not an uprising of ogres or the promise of starvation, it's the constant threat of the Lightbound.

Should the reports prove true, this is the closest they have dared approach our stronghold in quite some time.

Come or stay, but make your decision quickly.

passages.title: Tyranny of the Light
passages.text: To think of those we just lost... it is... No, it is of no use.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Tiragarde Sound
passages.text: Its time to hit the Alliance at the source. Travel to Tiragarde Sound and slay every Alliance you find. It shouldn't be hard to find them in their own territory.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Tiragarde Sound
passages.text: Good work, <class>.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Stormsong Valley
passages.text: Its time to hit the Alliance at the source. Travel to Stormsong Valley and slay every Alliance you find. It shouldn't be hard to find them in their own territory.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Stormsong Valley
passages.text: Good work, <class>.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Drustvar
passages.text: Its time to hit the Alliance at the source. Travel to Drustvar and slay every Alliance you find. It shouldn't be hard to find them in their own territory.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Drustvar
passages.text: Good work, <class>.

passages.title: Mission Report: Mistvine Ledge
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Mistvine Ledge.

It details that victory was hard-fought, but the enemies surrounding the outpost have been slain.

Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

passages.title: Mission Report: Mistvine Ledge
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Zuldazar?

passages.title: Mission Report: Mistvine Ledge
passages.text:
It seems the mission to create an additional foothold in Zuldazar was a success. Well done, <name>.

I will send you to oversee the fortifications at once.

passages.title: Mistvine Ledge
passages.text:
The raid you planned for Mistvine Ledge in Zuldazar was successful. Well done.

The outpost is ready to be claimed.

Make your way to Mistvine Ledge in Zuldazar and establish fortifications there.

Mistvine Ledge will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Horde.

For the Alliance!

passages.title: Mistvine Ledge
passages.text: Greetings, <name>. Mistvine Ledge will surely be one of our most valuable outposts. We have a direct view of the Golden Throne and the jungle canopy provides ample camoflauge.

passages.title: Saurfang Returns
passages.text:
Saurfang! It's about time.

Look around you, hero! What a lovely sight -- the wisps are scattering. One by one, the walls come crashing down. 

Now is the time. The World Tree is ours for the taking! Find Saurfang. We shall finish this once and for all.

passages.title: Saurfang Returns
passages.text: Our journey was treacherous, but we never lost sight of our goal.

passages.title: No Small Mercy
passages.text:
I will not slay innocents. If they do not raise arms against us, we shall spare them.

Enter Lor'danel and capture any civilians you find there. They shall be questioned and then released.

passages.title: No Small Mercy
passages.text: We've shown honor to our enemy today.

passages.title: Seaside Rendezvous
passages.text:
Lor'danel has mustered significant reinforcements on its shore. Enough to drive us back.

One swift strike and we can end this threat!

You will break through their lines and slay the two commanders. Without leadership this force will crumble.

passages.title: Seaside Rendezvous
passages.text: I congratulate you on your success, but I sense something is not right...

passages.title: A Threat from the North
passages.text:
The Horde must have scaled the mountains of Felwood in the North. 

The wisp wall is failing, it is only a matter of time before the Horde breaks through. They will attack us from both sides. 

We must weather this attack together.

passages.title: A Threat from the North
passages.text: No matter the odds, we must stay strong.

passages.title: Rescue Effort
passages.text:
The suddenness of the Horde's attack gave citizens here little time to flee. Many are hiding in Lor'danel, waiting for help. 

Locate these civilians and send them to safety. We're counting on you, <name>.

passages.title: Rescue Effort
passages.text: You've saved many lives today, <name>. You have my thanks.

passages.title: Action This Day
passages.text:
Two of the Horde's strongest warriors have led a charge to try and capture our fleet. We cannot allow this, <name>.

If they take our ships, they will use them to sail to Darnassus!

Slay the two warriors leading the attack, and the rest of them will give up the fight.

passages.title: Action This Day
passages.text: Have you heard from Malfurion recently?

passages.title: The Guidance of Our Shan'do
passages.text:
Lor'danel is overrun. The Horde... they -- they just don't relent.

There is nothing we can do, <name>. We must find our Shan'do and ask for his guidance. 

He is the only one who can save us.

passages.title: The Guidance of Our Shan'do
passages.text: <name>! The tree...

passages.title: With Prince in Tow
passages.text: Let's set sail for Zandalar. In case you hadn't noticed, we've been dealing with a bit of Alliance interference while you were gone.

passages.title: With Prince in Tow
passages.text: Once again, excellent work, <name>.

passages.title: Killer Queen
passages.text:
Lor'danel is now secure, but something is amiss... there has been no sign of Stormrage. 

Malfurion would have never let Lor'danel fall without a fight. He must have gone after her.

My army has approached from the North, and our reinforcements have arrived from the South -- which means that they are not along any of the roads.

Search the forest with me, <name>. We will find them and be done with this once and for all.

passages.title: Killer Queen
passages.text: The Horde endures.

passages.title: Killer Queen
passages.text: <The flames cast Sylvanas' face in shadow.>

passages.title: I Want It All
passages.text:
An elemental born of pure Azerite! I do not know what kind of threat this poses, champion... but please, do take care.

passages.title: I Want It All
passages.text:
An elemental... of pure Azerite. Slay it, champion, but do not destroy it. Gather as much of its resin as you can! 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(52984))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(52984))");

passages.title: Return to the Harbor
passages.text:
With the scepter in hand, let us return to the portal.

I believe Stone would agree with me when I say that it is best for us to get away from Kul Tiras for a while.

passages.title: Return to the Harbor
passages.text: it seems your mission was a success. Good.

passages.title: A Cycle of Hatred
passages.text:
We have raised new champions for the Horde, established footholds on Kul Tiran soil, and stolen one of their precious artifacts.

We hold greater power and sway over our enemies than we have before.

Sylvanas has great plans for our Horde, <name>. I will allow you the pleasure of reporting our victories to her personally.

passages.title: A Cycle of Hatred
passages.text:
<name>. Nathanos has been updating me on your progress throughout your efforts.

The Alliance, and the Kul Tirans, shall tremble before the might of my Horde.

passages.title: Mission Report: Grimwatt's Crash
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the rescue mission to Grimwatt's Crash.

It details that the supplies were recovered and the enemies surrounding the crash site have been slain.

Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

passages.title: Mission Report: Grimwatt's Crash
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Nazmir?

passages.title: Mission Report: Grimwatt's Crash
passages.text:
It seems the mission to Grimwatt's Crash was a success. Well done, <name>.

I think it will make a fine outpost. I'll send you to oversee the fortifications at once.

passages.title: Grimwatt's Crash
passages.text:
The rescue that you planned for Grimwatt's Crash in Nazmir was successful. Well done.

I believe we should fortify the crash site and turn it into an outpost.

Make your way to Grimwatt's Crash and establish fortifications there.

Grimwatt's Crash will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Horde.

For the Alliance!

passages.title: Grimwatt's Crash
passages.text: The crash site was surrounded when we arrived. It's a good thing we made it in time.

passages.title: Hang On In There
passages.text:
An elemental... of pure Azerite. Slay it, champion, but do not destroy it. Gather as much of its resin as you can! 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(53009))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(53009))");

passages.title: No Turning Back
passages.text:
An elemental... of pure Azerite. Slay it, champion, but do not destroy it. Gather as much of its resin as you can! 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(53010))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(53010))");

passages.title: A Dying World
passages.text:
Champion. Magni Bronzebeard needs your help.

Azeroth is dying. Before this war, a massive demon called Sargeras stabbed the planet with a sword.

Our planet cries out in pain while the Horde and Alliance fight amongst each other.

Magni Bronzebeard believes you can help heal the planet's wounds.

Meet him in Silithus. He has set up camp where Sargeras's sword impacted our world.

passages.title: A Dying World
passages.text: Ye made it. We don't have any time tae lose.

passages.title: A Dying World
passages.text:
While the armies of the Horde and Alliance squabble over a ruined city, our world is dying, <name>.

Magni Bronzebeard, the Speaker of Azeroth, needs you at his encampment in Silithus.

You must hurry. The area is being overrun by elementals driven mad by Azerite!

passages.title: A Dying World
passages.text: Ye made it! Good. We don't have any time tae lose.

passages.title: The Speaker's Imperative
passages.text:
The world's soul is secure... fer now. I can hear Azeroth again, though her voice is still weak.

The elementals on the surface above have calmed down. Even using just a fraction of its power, the Heart of Azeroth brought stability tae this place.

Ye need tae return tae Orgrimmar and inform yer allies what transpired here. Remind them that no matter what happens in their war, our world must be saved.

We'll speak again soon, <name>. The battle fer Azeroth has only just begun.

passages.title: The Speaker's Imperative
passages.text:
It would seem you were in the right place at the right time, <name>. This Heart of Azeroth the dwarf gave you may prove useful indeed.

But the war must remain our sole focus. We can spare no forces to aid Magni on his grand crusade.

The Alliance will stop at nothing to destroy the Horde. Fortunately, the Dark Lady has a plan to make us stronger.

passages.title: A Burning Path Through Time
passages.text: The blazing star shines upon the land, searing the earth and parching the landscape. This star is relentless, malevolent almost. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

passages.title: A Burning Path Through Time
passages.text: Ah, <name>, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.

passages.title: A Frozen Path Through Time
passages.text: The chill star shines upon the land with its cold light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, sapping warmth and life. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

passages.title: A Frozen Path Through Time
passages.text: Ah, <name>, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.

passages.title: A Shattered Path Through Time
passages.text: The Destroyer's star shines upon the land with its piercing light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, laying bare the weaknesses of even the boldest heroes. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

passages.title: A Shattered Path Through Time
passages.text: I foresee that you will follow the Destroyer's star, and walk the paths it reveals.

passages.title: A Shattered Path Through Time
passages.text: Ah, <name>, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.

passages.title: A Shrouded Path Through Time
passages.text: The shrouded star flickers upon the land with its intermittent light ushering in an eerie mist upon the land. This star and the mists bring deep shadows to the land hiding its secrets and dangers. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

passages.title: A Shrouded Path Through Time
passages.text: I foresee that you will follow the shrouded star, and walk the paths it reveals.

passages.title: A Shrouded Path Through Time
passages.text: Ah, <name>, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.

passages.title: A Call to Battle
passages.text: The favorite star of warlords and generals dominates the sky, offering good fortune to tacticians everywhere. Some say that the battle star hones the instincts of commanders to the point of near-prophecy. If ever you were going to test yourself on the field of battle, now is the time.

passages.title: A Call to Battle
passages.text: I trust your battles went well. And that's not just a turn of phrase. I know they did. I knew they would.

passages.title: Emissary of War
passages.text: When the sign of the warrior shines in the night sky, fortune favors the daring. Powerful foes may yield even greater rewards. Venture deep into caverns and strongholds to prove your worth.

passages.title: Emissary of War
passages.text: I foresee significant amounts of loot in your future.

passages.title: Emissary of War
passages.text: Well done, <name>. I knew you could do it.

passages.title: The Very Best
passages.text: This alignment of the stars is truly a strange one, causing the tiniest of creatures to gain unnatural aptitude. None of our sages can explain the phenomenon, but cunning tamers have much to gain, especially by testing their skills against those of their peers.

passages.title: The Very Best
passages.text: I foresee that you will travel across the land, searching far and wide. It's your destiny.

passages.title: The Very Best
passages.text: Well done, <name>. With courage, you have faced every challenge along the way, and battled every day to claim your rightful place.

passages.title: The Arena Calls
passages.text: This alignment of the stars is a dire sign, stirring bloodlust and calling warriors to battle to the death in close quarters. Arena masters turn a tidy profit during these days, likely not understanding why their stands are overflowing. Amidst the excitement, great rewards do await those brave, or foolhardy, enough to venture into the arena....

passages.title: The Arena Calls
passages.text: I foresee blood in your future, <name>.

passages.title: The Arena Calls
passages.text: Well done, <name>. I knew you would do it.

passages.title: Sampling the Goods
passages.text:
Bridgeport is a major trade hub for this area. Naturally, Ashvane has offices and workshops here.

Check around town and see if you can learn anything about this new material and how they're using it.

If you can lift a sample for us to send back to Boralus, even better.

I gotta stay here and keep an eye on someone.

passages.title: Sampling the Goods
passages.text:
<Flynn side-eyes you while trying his best to look casual.>

You get what we need?

passages.title: Sampling the Goods
passages.text:
Good, I'll hang onto them for now.

I think I've found our next lead.

passages.title: Mission Report: Vulture's Nest
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission to capture Vulture's Nest in Vol'dun.

It details that the mission was a success and that the troops holding the outpost have requested reinforcements.

Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

passages.title: Mission Report: Vulture's Nest
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Vol'dun?

passages.title: Mission Report: Vulture's Nest
passages.text:
It seems the mission to Vulture's Nest was a success. Well done, <name>.

I'll send you to oversee the fortifications at once.

passages.title: Vulture's Nest
passages.text:
The mission to take Vulture's Nest in Vol'dun was successful. Well done.

The outpost is ready to be claimed.

Make your way to Vulture's Nest and establish fortifications there.

It will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Horde.

For the Alliance!

passages.title: Vulture's Nest
passages.text: This outpost gives us an ideal vantage point for monitorin' the movements o' the sethrak forces below.

passages.title: Surveying the Wharf
passages.text:
Thresher's Wharf is a bustling fishing hub just across the delta from Fort Daelin. 

It was also in the direct war path of the naga -- who knows what remains now.

If you could stop in and check in on its leader, Coxswain Hook, you'd have my gratitude. I must focus on tending to the wounded here and preparing for the naga's next assault.

passages.title: Surveying the Wharf
passages.text: Ah, just what I needed. A fresh set o' ears to hear a tale or two!

passages.title: Deeper Into Kul Tiras
passages.text:
It is time for us to further our hold on Kul Tiras.

Return to the Banshee's Wail. From there we shall plan our next course of action.

passages.title: Deeper Into Kul Tiras
passages.text: It is time to establish another foothold, <name>. Are you prepared?

passages.title: Deeper Into Zandalar
passages.text:
Our advisors have decided that now is the correct time to further our hold on Zandalar.

Return to the Wind's Redemption posthaste. We shall leave for new lands immediately.

passages.title: Deeper Into Zandalar
passages.text: Welcome back, <name>. Let's get to work.

passages.title: To The Mugambala!
passages.text:
The Rastari have proven to be formidable allies in combat, and reports are coming in that help explain how they've honed their battle prowess. 

Je'stry the Untamed has a fighting ring setup at the base of Mount Mugambala that could prove useful for getting ready for war. We've dispatched our troops to take advantage of these training grounds, go and see what High Warlord Volrath has uncovered.

passages.title: To The Mugambala!
passages.text: Welcome to the Dueler's Guild, <name>.

passages.title: Dueler's Guild
passages.text: I figured a war-torn <race> such as your self would find benefit in this Dueler's Guild. Speak with a nearby Rastari Guard to participate in the carnage.

passages.title: Dueler's Guild
passages.text: Good luck in The Mugambala, <race>.

passages.title: Pushing Our Influence
passages.text:
Our scouts have identified a location for a final major foothold in Zandalar.

Return to the Wind's Redemption so we can ship out.

passages.title: Pushing Our Influence
passages.text: It is time to establish our final major foothold in Zandalar, <name>.

passages.title: Pushing Our Influence
passages.text:
We have identified a location for a final major foothold in Kul Tiras.

Return to the Banshee's Wail to discuss our new mission.

passages.title: Pushing Our Influence
passages.text: It is time to establish our final major foothold in Kul Tiras.

passages.title: The Azerite Advantage
passages.text:
<name>, we have received intelligence pointing us toward a reliable source of Azerite.

We must acquire this precious resource before our enemies in the Horde.

Report to the Wind's Redemption as soon as possible to aid in extraction.

passages.title: The Azerite Advantage
passages.text: We appreciate your timeliness, <name>. We must move quickly.

passages.title: The Azerite Advantage
passages.text:
We have received intelligence pointing us toward a reliable source of Azerite.

We must move quickly to acquire these resources for the Horde.

Report to the Banshee's Wail to aid in this urgent mission.

passages.title: The Azerite Advantage
passages.text: We cannot waste any time.

passages.title: A Mission of Unity
passages.text:
You have done much for the Alliance during your time here in Kul Tiras, <name>.

Today we must ask more of you. Return to the Wind's Redemption when you have the chance so that we can discuss.

passages.title: A Mission of Unity
passages.text: The Alliance needs us to bring our new allies into the fold.

passages.title: A Mission of Unity
passages.text: I have another important mission for you, <name>.

passages.title: A Mission of Unity
passages.text:
You have undertaken great journeys during your time here in Zandalar.

It is time for your next mission. Report to the Banshee's Wail.

passages.title: A Mission of Unity
passages.text: We must bring the Zandalari into the Horde.

passages.title: A Mission of Unity
passages.text: Are you prepared for your next mission?

passages.title: Operation: Grave Digger
passages.text:
Sylvanas has issued us a mission in Drustvar, where we will find our next target.

Report to the Banshee's Wail immediately.

passages.title: Operation: Grave Digger
passages.text: Good. You didn't dawdle.

passages.title: Operation: Water Wise
passages.text:
Rexxar has reported back with news of a new... ally.

Report to the Banshee's Wail for your briefing.

passages.title: Operation: Water Wise
passages.text: Get ready to set sail for Stormsong Valley.

passages.title: Operation: Bottom Feeder
passages.text:
It is time for Zelling to prove his worth to the Horde.

Return to the Banshee's Wail. Today, we sail out to open waters.

passages.title: Operation: Bottom Feeder
passages.text: Interested in some deep sea diving?

passages.title: Operation: Hook and Line
passages.text:
Thanks to the help of our new allies, we have devised a plan to extract a powerful tidesage artifact from Boralus.

I have already sent Valentine to get us started.

Report to the Banshee's Wail posthaste.

passages.title: Operation: Hook and Line
passages.text: I hope you are prepared for some light infiltration, <name>.

passages.title: Operation: Blood Arrow
passages.text:
We have uncovered the location of a high priority target in Nazmir.

Return to the Wind's Redemption for your briefing.

passages.title: Operation: Blood Arrow
passages.text: We return to the harsh lands of Nazmir today, <name>. I hope you are prepared.

passages.title: Operation: Cutpurse
passages.text:
It is time to reconvene for our next mission, though Shandris and I disagree on what exactly that should entail.

Meet us on the Wind's Redemption.

passages.title: Operation: Cutpurse
passages.text: I feel we are close to a conclusion, <name>. Perhaps your presence here will help.

passages.title: Operation: Gryphon's Claw
passages.text:
SI:7 has procured some interesting intel.

I request your presence on the Wind's Redemption immediately to help decide our next course of action.

passages.title: Operation: Gryphon's Claw
passages.text: Thank you for arriving with such haste.

passages.title: Operation: Heartstrike
passages.text:
We've taken out quite a number of high priority targets, <name>. All thanks to your help.

It is time to strike directly at the heart of the Zandalari empire.

Report to the Wind's Redemption as soon as you are able. We will get started from there.

passages.title: Operation: Heartstrike
passages.text: We're going to need to pull out all the stops on this one.

passages.title: Hook Point Investigation
passages.text:
I'm sure you've heard the constant sound of battle coming from Hook Point.

We sent scouts over to find out why the fighting never seems to end, and discovered an unexpected training ground.

Daniel Poole at Hook Point is running some sort of fight circuit near the Tradewind Market. Seek out Grand Marshal Tremblade at our War Headquarters and find out what they've learned.

passages.title: Hook Point Investigation
passages.text: So you've found the Dueler's Guild, <name>.

passages.title: Reinforcements
passages.text:
The resources you gather can be used to recruit new troops for the war effort.

Return to me periodically to issue new recruitment orders for your missions.

If you have available resources, you should use them now to issue your first recruitment order.

The war effort rages on even as we speak. We have need of fresh recruits.

passages.title: Reinforcements
passages.text: Have you issued the recruitment order?

passages.title: Reinforcements
passages.text: Excellent. Your new recruits will be available for missions once they have finished their training.

passages.title: Dueler's Guild
passages.text: I figured a war-torn <race> such as your self would benefit from training in the Dueler's Guild. Speak with a nearby bouncer to participate in the carnage.

passages.title: Dueler's Guild
passages.text: Good luck in the Dueler's Guild, <race>.

passages.title: Reinforcements
passages.text:
The resources you gather can be used to recruit new troops for the war effort.

Return to me periodically to issue new recruitment orders for your missions.

If you have available resources, you should use them now to issue your first recruitment order.

The war effort rages on even as we speak. We have need of fresh recruits.

passages.title: Reinforcements
passages.text: Have you issued the recruitment order?

passages.title: Reinforcements
passages.text: Good. Your new recruits will be available for missions once they have finished their training.

passages.title: Mission Report: Spare Parts
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission to collect salvage for Stonefist Watch.

It details that the mission was a success and the necessary materials have been collected.

Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

passages.title: Mission Report: Spare Parts
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission for Stonefist Watch?

passages.title: Mission Report: Spare Parts
passages.text: It seems the mission to gather supplies for Stonefist Watch was a success. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Spare Parts
passages.text:
An engineer has been assigned to Stonefist Watch to build a scrapping machine.

The mission to salvage materials for the machine was a success thanks to your leadership.

Make your way to Stonefist Watch in Tiragarde Sound and meet with Grizvek Gearsnap. He has been overseeing the upgrades for the outpost.

passages.title: Spare Parts
passages.text: This machine here will break anything apart! Go ahead, try it out!

passages.title: A Flicker of Hope
passages.text:
Champion, I need your help!

We must evacuate Darnassus before it burns to ash! Many of the city's structures have already caught fire. Douse the flames and rescue the trapped civilians within!

Please, do all that you can... we must save as many lives as possible.

passages.title: Despondent Ablutions
passages.text:
You return. A surprise. Perhaps there is still hope.

In victory or defeat, you bear the weight of this place. It hangs on you like a mantle. I see your struggle to bear it.

There is, perhaps, a way to shrug off this burden. An altar, to the northwest. Built by the tidesages, seeking to wash away the corruption.

Offer yourself to the idol. It will exact a price, as do all things. But in communion you may claw back from the brink.

passages.title: Despondent Ablutions
passages.text: Find the circle, pierce the veil. Only in oblivion can you find it.

passages.title: Despondent Ablutions
passages.text: Your mind has rejected madness, and replaced it with determination. For now.

passages.title: A Mote of Cosmic Truth
passages.text:
We stand on the brink, you and I. The final act looms over us, casting a terrible shadow.

Deep we plumbed, seeking knowledge of the world. Deeper still we delved, until our fate was inevitable. Minds were shattered, my comrades ran screaming into the night. We are all lost, to that terrible Thing...

Now, the malformed syzygy beckons. Complete the ritual and bring about the end.

passages.title: A Mote of Cosmic Truth
passages.text: Victory... foolish and meaningless.

passages.title: Mission Report: Giant Slaying
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Stonetusk Watch.

It details that the mission was a success and that one of the ettins is being held captive.

Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

passages.title: Mission Report: Giant Slaying
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission for Stonetusk Watch?

passages.title: Mission Report: Giant Slaying
passages.text: It seems the mission at Stonetusk Watch was a success. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Nettin' Ettin
passages.text:
An ettin has been captured by our troops at Stonetusk Watch.

Apparently, the creature is being trained to work for the Horde as a beast of burden.

Make your way to Stonetusk Watch in Stormsong Valley and meet with Wyna Breezehorn. She has been training the ettin to do her bidding.

passages.title: Nettin' Ettin
passages.text: Ettins aren't as hard to train as you might think. Go ahead and take Donk for a ride. It's okay, he's friendly enough!

passages.title: Mission Report: Nature Calls
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Swiftwind Post.

It details that the mission was a success and the druids there have upgraded their druidic knowledge as a result.

Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

passages.title: Mission Report: Nature Calls
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission for Swiftwind Post?

passages.title: Mission Report: Nature Calls
passages.text: It seems the mission at Swiftwind Post was a success. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Wicker Magic
passages.text:
It seems that the druids at Swiftwind Post have learned much from the ancient Drust rituals you recovered.

The druids are now able to offer improved services at the outpost.

Make your way to Swiftwind Post in Drustvar and see what they have to offer.

passages.title: Wicker Magic
passages.text:
We've learned much from the Drust's unique form of nature magic. We now have some special boons to offer you, <name>.

These blessings of nature are yours whenever you visit.

passages.title: Misplaced Faith
passages.text:
The air is foul with corruption. It must be dealt with.

The tidesages were fools, and I a fool to trust them. Belief in their god to perform miracles and deliver us from our folly. Nevertheless, their methods did serve to drive back the foul presence from these cliffs.

A simple censer, loaded with select powders and oils. The vapors produce an effect that expels the miasma, if only for a time.

Perhaps their ineffectual gesticulation will finally serve a purpose.

passages.title: Misplaced Faith
passages.text: The foul odor is dispersed. Perhaps reality can once more take root in this place.

passages.title: House Waycrest
passages.text:
You have done much for my home and the people of Drustvar,

Tell your allies that House Waycrest will return to Boralus shortly.

passages.title: House Waycrest
passages.text:
I cannot believe all that has gone on in Drustvar!

I am thankful that House Waycrest will return.

passages.title: The High Thornspeaker
passages.text:
My teacher, Ulfar, the High Thornspeaker, must be informed of what's been going on here.

I can't leave just yet. There are too many wounded and we'll need to handle the last few remaining constructs.

You have proven trustworthy, friend. Take a few of these runic cores to Ulfar for me. 

Arthur will meet you at the head of the path to Ulfar's den.

passages.title: The High Thornspeaker
passages.text: What do you have there, mainlander?

passages.title: The High Thornspeaker
passages.text:
What do you have here, mainlander? Ah, I see. My students met with much stronger threats than we'd expected.

Thank you for helping them.

passages.title: A Season for Celebration
passages.text:
Well met, <class>.

Hallow's End is a time for celebration and reflection, though some have no idea why. The burning of the Wickerman in particular is a mystery to many outside the Forsaken.

Travel to the Ruins of Lordaeron and speak to Darkcaller Yanka. She can tell you more about the Wickerman ceremony.

passages.title: A Season for Celebration
passages.text: The Wickerman ceremony is a time honored tradition.  It is good to see the Horde joining us in celebration.

passages.title: Mission Report: Into The Wicker
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Mudfisher Cove.

It details that the mission was a success and the druids there have upgraded their druidic knowledge as a result.

Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

passages.title: Mission Report: Into The Wicker
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission at Fairwind Post?

passages.title: Mission Report: Into The Wicker
passages.text: It seems the mission to defend Mudfisher Cove was a success. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: The Wicker Totem
passages.text:
The defense of Mudfisher Cove was successful. Well done, <name>.

A mysterious totem was found in the aftermath of the battle that may prove useful to you during your adventures in Drustvar.

Travel to Mudfisher Cove in Drustvar and see what power this totem contains.

passages.title: The Wicker Totem
passages.text: This totem was recovered in the aftermath of the battle. It seems to resonate with some strange magic. Personally, I don't trust it...

passages.title: The Lord Admiral's Lament
passages.text:
The footlocker contains a number of Lord Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's personal effects. Among them is a rolled letter, sealed with sea-green wax and stamped with the Proudmoore crest. The parchment tears easily and requires careful handling and it appears that the ink has been largely washed away by tide and time.

Perhaps someone can restore the letter and reveal its contents.

passages.title: The Lord Admiral's Lament
passages.text: What's this?

passages.title: The Lord Admiral's Lament
passages.text: There were rumors that Daelin searched for his daughter before his demise. If this letter is what I think it is, this is part of the reason we are at war.

passages.title: The Lord Admiral's Lament
passages.text:
The footlocker contains a number of Lord Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's personal effects. Among them is a rolled letter, sealed with sea-green wax and stamped with the Proudmoore crest. The parchment tears easily and requires careful handling and it appears that the ink has been largely washed away by tide and time.

Perhaps someone can restore the letter and reveal its contents.

passages.title: The Lord Admiral's Lament
passages.text: What's this?

passages.title: The Lord Admiral's Lament
passages.text:
I can feel history in this scroll, <name>. If this letter contains what I think it does, it is a sad tale indeed.

Now, let me see...

passages.title: Bloodied Sentinel's Glaive
passages.text:
The glaive rests inches from the sentinel's outstretched fingertips. Her eyes stare, sightless, at the ashen husk of Teldrassil on the horizon.

Perhaps someone in Orgrimmar can tell you what happened here.

passages.title: Bloodied Sentinel's Glaive
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Bloodied Sentinel's Glaive
passages.text: Ah, yes, I think I know why you have brought this to me, <name>. Sit, allow me to explain.

passages.title: Bloodied Sentinel's Glaive
passages.text:
