The glaive rests inches from the sentinel's outstretched fingertips. Her eyes stare, sightless, at the ashen husk of Teldrassil on the horizon.

Perhaps someone in Stormwind can tell you what happened here.

passages.title: Bloodied Sentinel's Glaive
passages.text: Can I help you?

passages.title: Bloodied Sentinel's Glaive
passages.text: Aye, I recognize that look. You have seen Teldrassil, or what is left of it. Have a seat, <name>.

passages.title: Mission Report: Wolves For The Den
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Wolf's Den.

It details that the mission was a success and that a pack of direwolves now guard the outpost.

Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

passages.title: Mission Report: Wolves For The Den
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Tiragarde Sound?

passages.title: Mission Report: Wolves For The Den
passages.text: It seems the mission at Wolf's Den in Tiragarde Sound was a success. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Wolves for the Den
passages.text:
The mission at Wolf's Den in Tiragarde Sound was a success. Well done, <name>.

A pack of direwolves now patrols the area surrounding the outpost.

Travel to Wolf's Den and see that the training of the wolves is up to our standard.

passages.title: Wolves for the Den
passages.text: Throm-Ka, <name>. Rexxar has tamed a fine pack of wolves. They will serve the outpost well!

passages.title: Notched Coin
passages.text:
<This old, worn coin has clearly changed hands many times. The edges are rusty from years in the salty air of the Great Sea, and it features an unusual design.

You saw a number of these coins scattered around the island, they appear to be quite commonly used.>

passages.title: Notched Coin
passages.text:
Hello, have you come to sample our new brews?

A coin? Oh, yes, I have seen these before, the island tribes use them.

Sometimes they visit us and purchase supplies. They live a very different life than us, always traveling from place to place, never settling down.

When one group packs up to move on to a new island, it is not uncommon for another tribe to take their place. On and on they go like this.

While you are here, we have be fishing up these strange gems. Can you make use of them?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Coarse Leather
passages.text:
It's time we snuff out the competition, don't you agree? With your help we can ensure our allies receive the necessary goods and armor to prepare for the battle to come.

Let's make sure our allies are well prepared.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Coarse Leather
passages.text: Should you find any additional leather in your hunt, you know where to find me.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Coarse Leather
passages.text: Quite an offering. Thank you.

passages.title: Ancient Crypt Key
passages.text:
<A magical device found on the mogu island invaders, it contains no more power.

You are aware of similar devices that were used to activate ancient titan machinery in the mogu vaults of Pandaria.

This particular one teems with a foreboding presence.

The Lorewalkers may know more about this device.>

passages.title: Ancient Crypt Key
passages.text:
Oh, hello my friend. We do not get many visitors here any longer, it is good to see you. 

What is it you have there?

Ah, yes, I see. A rare device of mogu origin. We have seen these before, many years ago.

During the Age of a Hundred Kings, the mogu found necromancy. Powerful mogu necro-lords ruled their tribes from crypts dug deep beneath the surface.

Many such crypts remain, unearthed or awoken by the wound in the world, I cannot say which.

Oh! And I have something for you, as well. Here.

passages.title: Ring of the Reefs
passages.text:
<A light mist twists and curls around this ring as if caressing it.

Holding this object makes you uneasy, deep within your soul. It feels as if invisible, icy hands from the lands of the dead are pulling at you.

There is no mistaking Helya's power.

The Valarjar will want to hear about this.>

passages.title: Ring of the Reefs
passages.text:
Another ring? Hmph. Yes, we have been seeing them more frequently.

<Valdemar grimaces.>

Helya is growing in power.

What, small one, are you surprised? Did you think she was defeated?

<Valdemar laughs heartily.>

You cannot kill death!

I thank you for making me laugh today, little friend.

Odyn has heard about your search for Azerite, we have gathered what we could. 

Here, it is yours.

passages.title: Bloodwake Drinking Horn
passages.text:
<A large drinking horn taken from one of the Bloodwake vrykul.

The sturdy craftsmanship has allowed it to survive many years of hard travel on the Great Sea.

As you hold the horn, you remember how fervently the vrykul you encountered were after the Azerite, but to what end?

Other vrykul tribes may know more about the Bloodwake and their motivations.>

passages.title: Bloodwake Drinking Horn
passages.text:
<Vydhar's leaves shake as you approach.>

I sense a good story approaches, what do you seek? Answers, I know, about the Bloodwake.

There is a fleet, some say thousands of ships large, that floats on the Great Sea, led by the greatest raider to ever live. His name is Jorun, the Bloodwake.

Long ago he left us to seek a life at sea. He lives only to raid, never in one place for long.

Perhaps you, too will see him one day.

This old one thanks you for visiting. Take these minerals from my roots.

passages.title: Sonic Stone
passages.text:
<The stone vibrates to your touch. The frequency resonates throughout your body, and you feel refreshed.

The mantid likely use these stones to allow them to fly great distances across the sea.

To see them on the island was strange, the mantid took a heavy blow when Shek'zeer was destroyed, they should not be swarming now.

The denizens of Pandaria may have more information.>

passages.title: Sonic Stone
passages.text:
Yes? We are quite busy here, as you can see, what is it?

Ah, I see you have also encountered the mantid swarm.

Our fears are realized, the new empress has hatched. Princess Zara, no, now Grand Empress Shek'zara, is here.

She is as hotheaded and impulsive as mantid queens usually are, and has mobilized most of her forces to search for Azerite.

We know not why.

<Qipan squishes a nearby bug between his fingers.>

But we do not like it.

Here, Azerite taken from their corpses, take it.

passages.title: Icetusk Fur Cloak
passages.text:
<The fur on this cloak is worn and tattered, but it is still warm. It has seen many years in the harsh, unforgiving blizzards of the north.

The icetusk tribe has not been seen on Azeroth until now, someone in Northrend might know more about them.>

passages.title: Icetusk Fur Cloak
passages.text:
Hello friend, my you smell like strange fish, where have you been? Is that too personal of a question?  No matter, how can this one help you?

Ah yes, the Icetusk, a most curious tale of a small tribe.

They resisted the Lich King's promises and set out on huge canoes to find salvation.

And yet, all they found was hardship and despair. In dark times, they turned to necromancy, and thus the tribe has lived on, but only barely. A sad tale.

Oh! I fished this up this morning, it is yours if you like.

passages.title: Magical Spyglass
passages.text:
<This spyglass allows you to see far off into the distance, but looking through it for too long gives you a headache.

The lens appears to have been specifically crafted for someone else's eyes.

Given the intricate detail on the spyglass, they'd likely provide a hefty reward for its return.>

passages.title: Magical Spyglass
passages.text:
Now what do you have there? Oh, oh oh OH, what is this!?

My spyglass!

Oh honey, I never thought I'd see you again. Do you know how expensive this thing was? I had to get the lens custom-made because of my right eye and all.

You didn't look through it, did you?

Listen, I don't tear up often, but I just might this time. It really means the world to me.

Here, all the Azerite I got, its yours. It's... worth a lot... oof. That hurts. You take it though, really. Take it. Go ahead. It's fine.

passages.title: Elemental Core
passages.text:
<A burned-out core from the elementals you encountered.

When you concentrate, you can sense that some elemental energy still exists, deep within the core.

They were clearly after the Azerite, but why?

It might be time to call in an old favor.>

passages.title: Elemental Core
passages.text:
Yes? I am no longer in the business of fire prevention.

Oh, you have questions about the elemental planes? They are in quite a state at the moment. Though the elements are always tumultuous, things have gotten quite out of hand.

The presence of this Azerite has ignited the lesser lords, and each seeks to overthrow the current lords and take the plane for themselves.

They see this new element as a sign of elemental rebirth.

I do not see this. Here, I do not want even the gems I have, take them.

passages.title: Unscarred Black Scale
passages.text:
<An utterly pristine black dragon scale taken from the dragons you recently encountered.

The black dragonflight was completely decimated following Deathwing's demise and Wrathion's rise to power.

Yet the size indicates a younger dragon.

There is one person, one dragon, that you know will want to hear of this, but where IS Wrathion?

You surmise he may be some place familiar, fortified, and abandoned.>

passages.title: Unscarred Black Scale
passages.text:
Hello, I was told to expect you. Kindly hand over the scale.

We will, of course, compensate you.

First in information. Have you heard of the Dragon Isles? Few have, and fewer have been there.

We have not found others of the master's kin... forthcoming in information.

Should you uncover anything further in your travels, we will be awaiting a visit, with payment in kind.

And second, in this Azerite you are seeking. Here, a hefty sum for your troubles.

Until we meet again.

passages.title: Battered Twilight Scale
passages.text:
<The worn scale of a twilight dragon, it has seen many years of fighting.

The twilight dragons were thought to have been defeated with the fall of Sinestra, how were there so many on the island?

And who is leading the flight?>

passages.title: Battered Twilight Scale
passages.text:
Shh! Step back! We can't let them see us!

What are you doing here? Who sent you?

<Eryna listens as you explain the twilight attack.>

Yes, we know. It's those damn stone troggs, nothing stops their digging! They dug far deeper and further than we thought possible.

What's more, when I really concentrate, I can feel the heartbeat of thousands of tiny creatures in there. We have no idea how many more eggs remain...

Since you're out here, one of them had these gems on them, take them.

passages.title: Venture Co. Business Plan
passages.text:
<An enormous volume, and printed in very small print. You can't make it through even a few sentences before the words begin to swim before your eyes.

The Venture Company's long-term plan appears to be quite complex and nearly impossible to understand.

One thing is for certain: a competing enterprise would likely pay well to get their hands on this tome.>

passages.title: Venture Co. Business Plan
passages.text:
Yeah? What do ya got there? Oh.

Listen, my name's on the back of that thing because I'm what you call an "investor." I put money into a bet that the company's going to succeed or not.

It's all a little complicated, so don't worry your pretty little head. I didn't do anything wrong, technically! We're just leveraging some existing infrastructure to make a little gold.

It's harmless.

Hey, look, I've got a huge bag of Azerite right here! Why don't you take it with you? Too heavy for me, really.

passages.title: Murloc Eye
passages.text:
<The murloc eye appears to have no magical properties of its own, but is still quite damp to the touch.

You have seen naga sorcerers use similar objects in their casting rituals, but rarely do they dismember their murloc slaves for this purpose.

This is unsettling, even for the naga.>

passages.title: Murloc Eye
passages.text:
Oh, hello, are you here about the terrible things happening to the murlocs?

I've been hearing tales of terrifying magical experiments happening in the depths, entire murloc tribes being wiped out.

There is one area that they won't even go near anymore, the water bubbles ferociously and the heat is unbearable. The fish have all fled, everything has fled, what could be going on there?

Oh! They've been bringing me some of this Azerite, I'm not sure why. Do you want it?

Thanks for visiting!

passages.title: The Warfront Looms
passages.text:
We cannot myopically focus all our efforts on Zandalar. Horde treachery simmers all across the globe.

One particular hot spot lies in the Arathi Highlands, near the storied citadel of Stromgarde. The Horde has set up an encampment nearby, and intends to capture our territory.

Speak with Ralston Karn, the recruitment officer for the division in charge of this particular warfront. He could use a good <class> like you.

passages.title: The Warfront Looms
passages.text:
You're <name>, with the 7th Legion?

Welcome. We've heard about you. Let's get to work.

passages.title: Glittering Scarab
passages.text:
<A magical trinket found on a tol'vir spellcaster, it appears to augment their casting abilities.

It seems to be very old, but is nearly pristine in form. 

The tol'vir of Uldum may know more about the sudden appearance of the Amathet.>

passages.title: Glittering Scarab
passages.text:
<The scarab catches Kamses' eye.>

I see you have met the Amathet.

The wound in the world has unearthed new tombs, and from one they emerged. 

They speak little to us, believing us betrayers of our sacred duties. They believe that they, stewards of the titans, should control the Azerite.

Worse, when they realized that Rajh and the others were slain, they constructed their own, new keepers.

They must have an active forge.

I will give you what Azerite we have, be careful, they are dangerous.

passages.title: Broken Compass
passages.text:
<A compass found on a stranded pirate, it no longer functions. 

The metal and craftsmanship indicate an origin in Stormwind.>

passages.title: Broken Compass
passages.text:
Hello, are you here to buy herbs?

Oh, what's that, a compass? It certainly looks familiar.

That idiot.

He was always seeking his fortune somewhere and never finding it. Completely useless here at home, too. Couldn't keep an herb alive to save his life.

You know what? I'm glad he's lost at sea. Leave him there.

Here, I'll even give you his stash of Azerite, he would hate that.

Finally free to pursue my own interests, now that's a breath of fresh air. I wonder if Kirsty's still available...

passages.title: Razorfin Hunting Spear
passages.text:
<This spear is razor sharp, though it has clearly seen many years of hunting in the open sea.

The shaft has been broken in several places and repaired with what materials were available at the time. From the variety of repair materials, you surmise that the jinyu tribe you recently faced must travel extensively.

The friendly jinyu of Pandaria might know more about this strange tribe.>

passages.title: Razorfin Hunting Spear
passages.text:
Ah, yes, I do recognize this spear. You have encountered the Razorfin, then?

They are unique amongst Jinyu. Long ago the elder of the tribe was granted a vision of a great beast. So terrified was he that he named it "Onoho," or "Deep Shadow."

He dedicated his tribe to slaying the beast. They travel from island to island, never staying for long, in their endless quest. It is fascinating.

I thank you for your visit. Some Azerite has washed ashore here, please take it, we have little use for it.

passages.title: Vorus'arak's Carapace
passages.text:
<The carapace from the nerubian lord Vorus'arak, it looks ancient.

It appears that Vorus'arak did not want to shed his shell, and instead wore the same scarred carapace for a very long time.

All across the carapace, strange markings have been carved. It seems to be a language of some kind.>

passages.title: Vorus'arak's Carapace
passages.text:
What is this? A carapace? Yes, I see, this writing is in my language. 

It speaks of the swarm lord Vorus'arak, he has written of his journeys on his own chitin.

He tells of the War of the Spider, of his escape through the tunnels with his brood.

Vorus was a powerful digger, yet even his great strength flagged, and he was forced to consume much of his own young.

In the end, they found an island, and survived. Until you arrived.

Our history is important to us, here are some gems for your time.

passages.title: Druidic Fur
passages.text:
<This fur teems with natural magic. The beasts you fought on the island were clearly not beasts at all, but druids.

At least they were before.

What could have caused them to become feral?

You did not want to slay them, but they gave you no choice, didn't they?>

passages.title: Druidic Fur
passages.text:
This fur... has not seem a change in form in quite some time. 

You encountered my kin gone feral, I surmise? That... makes sense.

Following the War of the Satyr, there were those among us that thought that the Pack was the only true way. That we were, at our core, wild creatures, and our humanoid forms are merely a guise.

As a flock they took wing and left us, never to be heard from again. Until now.

I thank you for this information, here is some Azerite I have collected for the Speaker.

passages.title: Strangling Root
passages.text:
<The root twists and struggles in your grip, attempting to wrap itself around your arm.

The keepers you encountered must be powerfully attuned to nature to imbue their creations with such longetivity.

Remembering the ferocity with which they fought against you makes you suddenly uneasy.

Why would these guardians of nature behave this way?

Surely, someone must have the answers.>

passages.title: Strangling Root
passages.text:
This root tells me all that I need to know of your voyage: an island, teeming with the life spirit, and you met keepers there. 

I sense you are surprised at their actions.

Not all of us that guard the natural world see your kind as allies. There are many of my kind that seek to preserve the balance above all things. Even if that means your death.

I will not fault you for defending yourself, but I am powerless to subdue them as well.

However, my fawns have gathered some Azerite for you.

passages.title: Wriggling Mass
passages.text:
<The tendril writhes and pulsates in your hand as your mind is assailed by all manner of vicious thoughts.

One vision in particular surfaces in your mind again and again.

In your mind's eye, you picture a many-eyed goat laying in a pool of black water. As you approach, its eyes burst open, and in an instant you find yourself looking upward at the goat from deep within the puddle.

As you sink into the icy darkness, everything goes black.

You pocket the mass and shake the thoughts from your head.

passages.title: Wriggling Mass
passages.text:
Please, lower your weapon, I mean you no harm. The whispers ceased speaking to me on the day that the wound opened. 

I wish to spend my days atoning for what I have done in my life, perhaps I can help you.

You... I can see it in your eyes, you have seen the vision. 

The goat, the pool, drowning in the icy blackness, does this sound familiar?

I can tell you its meaning. It means we are fast closing in on the end of this world, friend.

Take my Azerite, I have no need of it any longer.

passages.title: Weathered Pamphlet
passages.text:
<This pamphlet appears to be a mass-produced flier advertising an Azerite-buying service.

You can make out a few faded but colorful phrases like "Your fortune awaits in the Great Sea!" and "Everyone's getting rich, isn't it your time?" 

There is no mention of any of the dangers involved.

There is some information about who to contact at the bottom, however.>

passages.title: Weathered Pamphlet
passages.text:
Are you here about the pamphlet? 

What's wrong, expecting someone greener? Listen, we've all got to eat. I've got a family at home, and this war's taking all of the food away.

Not my problem if some amateur adventurers with gold in their eyes get in a little trouble? That sounds more like your problem.

Now if you're not going to sell me your Azerite, buzz off. Big G doesn't like it when I talk too much.

Uh, did I say G? Pretend I didn't.

Here, just take some of my Azerite and keep quiet, ok?

passages.title: Mission Report: Ambush at Grimwatt's Crash
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Grimwatt''s Crash.

It details that the mission was a success and the attacking blood trolls were defeated.

Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

passages.title: Mission Report: Ambush at Grimwatt's Crash
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission for Grimwatt's Crash?

passages.title: Mission Report: Ambush at Grimwatt's Crash
passages.text: It seems the mission at Grimwatt's Crash was a success. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: An Unexpected Guest
passages.text:
The mission to defend Grimwatt's Crash was a success. Well done, <name>.

In addition to successfully holding the outpost, the troops at Grimwatt's Crash have captured a blood crawg. Noella Davenport is handling the beast's training.

Make your way to Grimwatt's Crash in Nazmir and check-in with Noella on the crawg training.

passages.title: An Unexpected Guest
passages.text: Blood crawgs aren't as difficult to train as long as you might think. See for yourself and take "Spud" here for a ride!

passages.title: To the Front
passages.text:
I need you to see the Arathi Highlands. The battle has died down for now, but when it flares up again, we'll need you on the front.

Yvera Dawnwing maintains a portal directly to Stromgarde. She can help you.

passages.title: To the Front
passages.text:
Terrible business, war is. Really.

Glad you could make it, soldier. Let's make this quick.

passages.title: Touring the Front
passages.text:
The Horde haven't attacked for a while now. Neither have we, honestly. It should be safe to head on out and do some scouting.

Check in with our foremen at the mine and the lumber mill. It'd be good to know that they haven't off and gotten themselves killed, and the trip should give you a bit of a lay of the land.

Speaking of which, you might also talk to Grayson Bell, the flight master, who can give you a quick look at our enemy's base. "Ar'gorok," or some other such orcish nonsense.

passages.title: Touring the Front
passages.text: Cheers!

passages.title: Touring the Front
passages.text:
Nobody's been slaughtered by the Horde, then? Excellent.

Glad you could make it back safely too, <name>.

passages.title: Back to Boralus
passages.text: That should just about do it for now, then. We'll be in touch if the fighting heats back up again. No doubt it'll be any day now.

passages.title: Back to Boralus
passages.text:
You're all caught up? Excellent.

Holding a firm line in Arathi is critical to the Alliance's continued occupation of Lordaeron. We appreciate your support, both now and in the inevitable upcoming battle.

passages.title: The Warfront Looms
passages.text:
Our focus must expand beyond Kul Tiras. The Alliance still presses against our forces in other parts of the globe.

We are most interested in the Arathi Highlands, near Stromgarde. We've set up an encampment in the area, with the intent of capturing Stromgarde.

Speak with Throk, the recruitment officer for the division in charge of this particular warfront. He could use a good <class> like you.

passages.title: The Warfront Looms
passages.text:
You're <name>, with the Honorbound?

Welcome. We've heard about you. Let's get to work.

passages.title: To the Front
passages.text:
We're at war in the Arathi Highlands. The battle has died down for now, but when it flares up again, we'll need you on the front.

Druza Netherfang maintains a portal directly to Ar'gorok. She can help you.

passages.title: To the Front
passages.text:
War. It would be horrible if it weren't for all the amazing profit opportunities.

You're <name>, right? Let's get started.

passages.title: Touring the Front
passages.text:
The Alliance haven't attacked for a while now. Neither have we, actually. It should be safe to head on out and do some scouting.

Check in with our foremen at the mine and the lumber mill. It'd be good to know that they haven't gone and gotten themselves killed, and the trip should give you a bit of a lay of the land.

Speaking of which, you might also talk to Flightgineer Krazzle. He can give you a quick look at Stromgarde, so you can see what we're up against.

passages.title: Touring the Front
passages.text: Hey hey.

passages.title: Touring the Front
passages.text:
You're back from your tour? And nobody's been slaughtered by the Alliance? Nice.

Glad you could make it back safely too, <name>.

passages.title: Back to Zuldazar
passages.text: That should just about do it for now, then. We'll be in touch if the fighting heats back up again. Should be any day now, honestly.

passages.title: Back to Zuldazar
passages.text:
Welcome back.

We need to hold that line in Arathi, <name>. We'll be calling on you to help us out when the time comes.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Shimmerscale
passages.text:
I'll keep it simple: we need more Shimmerscale!

I apologize for being so forward with you, but there's little time to waste.

If you happen upon this item throughout your travels I'd be more than happy to put it to good use. Outfitting our allies is of the utmost importance in the battle to come, don't you agree?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Shimmerscale
passages.text: Outfitting our allies is of the utmost importance. This provides us the necessary materials to ensure no one is left unprotected on the battlefield.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Shimmerscale
passages.text: With your help, our stockpiles will be well supplied in no time!

passages.title: Mission Report: Missing Supplies
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Vulture's Nest.

It details that the mission was a success and the lost supply shipment has been recovered.

Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

passages.title: Mission Report: Missing Supplies
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission for Vulture's Nest?

passages.title: Mission Report: Missing Supplies
passages.text: It seems the mission to recover the supplies was a success. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Necessary Supplies
passages.text:
The mission to recover the supplies was a success. Well done, <name>.

The supply shipment in question was ordered by Buzz Crankchug at Vulture's Nest. You should check in with the outpost in Vol'dun and ensure that all of the missing supplies have been accounted for.

Make your way to Vulture's Nest in Vol'dun and speak with Buzz Crankchug.

passages.title: Necessary Supplies
passages.text: Good to see you, <name>! Without your help we would have lost the kegs I ordered! Help yourself to all you can drink, let the brew flow forth!

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Tidespray Linen
passages.text: There is no such thing as too much linen. It is better to maintain a strong supply than be left wanting.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Tidespray Linen
passages.text: How thoughtful of you.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Battle Flag: Spirit of Freedom
passages.text:
Did you make this?

The embroidery is second to none.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Deadly Solstone
passages.text: These are a cut above the rest.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Versatile Kyanite
passages.text: Thank you kindly.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Seasoned Loins
passages.text: Very generous of you.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Grilled Catfish
passages.text: This is a wonderful treat.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Great Sea Catfish
passages.text: You are very kind, <name>. Thank you.

passages.title: Mission Report: Dino Research
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Verdant Hollow.

It details that the mission was a success and a variety of dinasaur specimens have been recovered.

Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

passages.title: Mission Report: Dino Research
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission for Verdant Hollow?

passages.title: Mission Report: Dino Research
passages.text: It seems the mission was a success. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Dino Research
passages.text:
The mission to gather research specimens was a success. Well done, <name>.

You should check in with the outpost commander and inspect the specimens yourself.

Make your way to Verdant Hollow in Zuldazar and speak with Argrim Stonedeep.

passages.title: Dino Research
passages.text: Och, yer team did their job alright! Look at these wee dinasaur hatchlings...there's more o' them than us!

passages.title: Mission Report: Spare Parts
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission to collect salvage for Mugamba Overlook.

It details that the mission was a success and the necessary materials have been collected.

Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

passages.title: Mission Report: Spare Parts
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission for Mugamba Overlook?

passages.title: Mission Report: Spare Parts
passages.text: It seems the mission was a success. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Spare Parts
passages.text:
An engineer has been assigned to Mugamba Overlook to build a scrapping machine.

The mission to salvage materials for the machine was a success thanks to your leadership.

Make your way to Mugamba Overlook in Zuldazar and meet with Gilblin Clockspark. He has been overseeing the upgrades for the outpost.

passages.title: Spare Parts
passages.text: This machine here will break anything apart! Go ahead, try it out!

passages.title: Mission Report: Jungle Escort
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the escort mission to Mistvine Ledge.

It details that the mission was a success and the reinforcements arrived safely at their destination.

Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

passages.title: Mission Report: Jungle Escort
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Mistvine Ledge?

passages.title: Mission Report: Jungle Escort
passages.text: It seems the mission was a success. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Jungle Escort
passages.text:
There are now healers stationed at Mistvine Ledge.

The mission to escort the reinforcements through the jungle was a success thanks to your leadership.

Make your way to Mistvine Ledge in Zuldazar and meet with the outpost commander there to ensure she has everything she needs.

passages.title: Jungle Escort
passages.text: Thanks to you, the outpost now offers healing support in addition to our regular provisions and services.

passages.title: Our Sacred Forest
passages.text:
An elemental... of pure Azerite. Slay it, champion, but do not destroy it. Gather as much of its resin as you can! 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(53319))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(53319))");

passages.title: Ours For the Taking
passages.text:
An elemental... of pure Azerite. Slay it, champion, but do not destroy it. Gather as much of its resin as you can! 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(53320))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(53320))");

passages.title: WANTED: Razorclaw Alpha
passages.text:
The Horde requires your contributions!

We are in need of materials to craft and repair our arms and armor.

There are bountiful resources in this land and they are but ours for the taking.

Seek out the largest wolf you can find, slay it, and secure it's pelt so that we may craft a cloak befitting Rexxar!

- Centurion Kaga Warmstone

passages.title: WANTED: Razorclaw Alpha
passages.text: Have you located a suitable pelt?

passages.title: WANTED: Razorclaw Alpha
passages.text: An excellent pelt! Good work <name>.

passages.title: Time for War
passages.text: You should return to Commander Wyrmbane to begin working with the 7th Legion.

passages.title: Time for War
passages.text:
<Halford looks over the gathered resources.>

This should do it.

passages.title: Time for War
passages.text: You should return to Nathanos Blightcaller to begin working with The Honorbound.

passages.title: Time for War
passages.text:
<Nathanos looks over the gathered resources.>

This should do it.

passages.title: WANTED: Sabertusk Empress
passages.text:
To any and all brave enough to seek the challenge: 

Find and defeat a ferocious Sabertusk Empress, the strongest and most vicious of all sabertusks in Zuldazar. 

They can be found up and down the road from the Village in the Vines. 

A reward for any that succeed!

passages.title: WANTED: Sabertusk Empress
passages.text: Thank ya, champion. That be one less threat to the area.

passages.title: WANTED: Prime Thumpknuckle
passages.text:
To any and all brave enough to seek the challenge: 

Find and defeat a Prime Thumpknuckle, the largest and most dangerous of all the wild gorillas.

They can be found up and down the road from the Village in the Vines. 

A reward for any that succeed!

passages.title: WANTED: Prime Thumpknuckle
passages.text: You faced down those Thumpknuckles? That's worth a lot to us. Thank ya.

passages.title: Bumbles the Bee
passages.text:
Hey adventurer, thanks for delivering Mom's letter. I was really starting to worry about her!

Dad and I have been having a few problems running the farm after she left on her trip. If you didn't show up when you did, we'd still be in real trouble!

I was hoping you would be willing to help Bumbles out too. He was hurt when his hive was destoyed.

If we feed him some of Dad's special formula, hopefully he will heal up faster. First we need to find the secret ingredient, try looking around at his other lab.

passages.title: Bumbles the Bee
passages.text: Were you able to find it? I think it's in a purple bottle.

passages.title: Bumbles the Bee
passages.text: Alright! This is exactly what we needed.

passages.title: The MOTHERLODE!!: Ironfoe
passages.text:
Mogul Razdunk has always been a jealous sort, wishin' he was Gallywix or better.

But he's the worst sort o' greedy. He won't stop at anythin' tae achieve his ends, nae matter the cost.

It was a bold move even fer him tae strike at us in Blackrock Depths.

He should've knaewn he was goin' too far. Kill that covetous wretch an' bring the hammer back where it belongs.

You'll find him in Kezan. Somewhere he calls "The Motherlode," likely with too many exclamation points.

passages.title: The MOTHERLODE!!: Ironfoe
passages.text: I wish I could see look on his face as ye rip the hammer away from his cold hands.

passages.title: The MOTHERLODE!!: Ironfoe
passages.text: Serves him right fer stealin' one o' our most sacred artifacts. I hope he squirmed.

passages.title: Echo of Warlord Zaela
passages.text:
Warlord Zaela... another name that stains the tongue just to speak it...

She was instrumental in freeing Garrosh during his trial when she and her Dragonmaw clan attacked the Temple of the White Tiger.

I am ashamed to say that the dragon Kairozdormu was also involved. We will speak of this no more.

The temple in Kun Lai Summit is our next destination.

passages.title: Echo of Warlord Zaela
passages.text: Some of my kin invite shame upon our name.

passages.title: Echo of Warlord Zaela
passages.text: Let us leave this place before it arouses my anger.

passages.title: Echo of Gul'dan
passages.text:
To attune this shard to the place you wish to go, we must follow some of its history.

The first location we will visit is the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.

It was there that Gul'dan used a piece of the Vision of Time to travel between realities.

Join me there when you are ready.

passages.title: Echo of Gul'dan
passages.text: The Vision of Time still holds power, it just needs to be unlocked.

passages.title: Echo of Gul'dan
passages.text: Gul'dan was a pox upon all lands that he set foot upon. His death was well deserved.

passages.title: Test of Hyphen Tech
Arathi Donations: Meaty Haunch
passages.text:
A nice, hearty meat provides the nourishment our allies deserve before shipping off to battle, not to mention it also makes quite a stew, something our troops seem to rather enjoy when the winds are at their best and the chill of night lingers in the air.

If you bring me some freshly seasoned loins I would be more than happy to deliver it to our supply officers.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Meaty Haunch
passages.text: Fresh meat goes a long way. If we're to endure the battle, we've got to be prepared.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Meaty Haunch
passages.text:
This will last for quite some time.

Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Make Loh Go
passages.text:
Hello, <name>! We tortollans grow up hearing the stories of Loh, a tortollan who had many adventures. These stories help to challenge a young tortollan's mind as they try to figure out how Loh would make his way through any given adventure.

Care to give it a try?

passages.title: The Vanishing Lord
passages.text:
Whoa there! What business do you have in Drustvar?

Lookin' for someone from House Waycrest? Best of luck to ye. Even us in their guard haven't heard a word from them of late. Why, if it weren't for Marshal Reade takin' command, I doubt there'd even be a Waycrest Guard anymore.

I think ye'd be better off on yer way, but if yer bent on stayin' I'd head over to Fallhaven. The mayor there is probably the only welcomin' soul left around here.

Watch yer back, mainlander. There's dark workings about.

passages.title: The Vanishing Lord
passages.text:
<The effigy is protected by powerful magic. 

It seems it will take more than brute force to break this curse.>

passages.title: The MOTHERLODE!!: Raw Deal
passages.text:
Nobody, and I mean NOBODY double-crosses me and gets away with it!

The Venture Co. betrayed us in a deal for Azerite refining techniques. We need pay 'em what we owe 'em.

If you're not pickin' up what I'm puttin' down, I mean we need to kill that backstabbin' upstart Mogul Razdunk.

You take care of him; I'll take care of gettin' what we're owed.

I s'pose we oughta tell Blightcaller about this, huh? When he tells us what to do, just smile and nod. We'll handle it our way.

passages.title: The MOTHERLODE!!: Raw Deal
passages.text:
I'm mad as a... as a... I'm just MAD, okay?!

Look, I realize Blightcaller told you to get the refining techniques, but I'll take care of that.

You just kill Razdunk, got it?

passages.title: The MOTHERLODE!!: Raw Deal
passages.text: Ya really did me a solid there, <name>. May that green bastid rot in a squalid grave.

passages.title: WANTED: Wyvern Poachers
passages.text:
Soldiers of the Horde!

A few nights ago some foolish human soundrels snuck off with one of our strongest wyverns.

If anybody can track down and stop these thieves, a reward awaits!

passages.title: WANTED: Wyvern Poachers
passages.text: Is this about the wanted sign? You better hurry, a good number of hunters are after it as well.

passages.title: WANTED: Wyvern Poachers
passages.text: The wyvern came back mostly unharmed. She will be ready to fly into battle when needed.

passages.title: WANTED: The Hornet
passages.text:
That's it, I'm putting a bounty on that blasted hornet.

Somebody take that bug down!

passages.title: WANTED: The Hornet
passages.text:
The hornet's dead! Good on ya.

I'd like to not die to a bug.

passages.title: The Castaways
passages.text:
You don't look like you're from around here. You're lucky the sirens haven't stripped your bones yet.

If you need to trade supplies or just warm yourself by the fire, there's a camp up the hill behind me.

Everyone there washed up in the tides. Figure we've got folks from at least four or five shipwrecks now. All banded together, just tryin' to survive.

Talk to Stabby Jane. Don't worry about her nickname, she's actually real nice.

passages.title: The Castaways
passages.text: You from a shipwreck? Or just looking for work?

passages.title: Glimmering Locket
passages.text:
<A glint of metal catches your eye among the gently bobbing flotsam. Digging into the tangled seaweed, you discover a locket of simple, yet sturdy design.

Opening the locket reveals a hand-drawn picture of a woman with fiery red bangs. 

Her arm is around a woman with short-cropped auburn hair, and the two are proudly displaying warm smiles for the artist.>

passages.title: Glimmering Locket
passages.text: Hm? What's that you've got there?

passages.title: Glimmering Locket
passages.text:
Is that?

<Jane takes the locket and opens it tenderly. Tears begin to well up in her eyes as she closes it and tucks it away in her jacket.>

Thank you.

passages.title: Silencing the Sisters
passages.text:
The sirens in this tideway have drawn countless ships to their doom. Wiping them out would be a boon to all seafaring folk.

But you can't very well kill all of them. Only a fool would try that.

The real dangerous ones are the elders. The "sisters" as they're known. Bigger, smarter, and stronger than the younger ones. Their voices carry far out to sea and bring in all the big "catches."

I managed to track two of them to a den at the northern end of the tideway, but I can't take them alone.

passages.title: Silencing the Sisters
passages.text: By quieting their deadly song, you have saved countless lives.

passages.title: Local Flavor
passages.text:
I'm STARVING.

Not actually starving, like when I first got here, but you know... Emotionally starving.

Haven't had any luck with the oysters lately, and seaweed soup really upsets my guts. If I eat any more of that stuff, I think the other castaways might actually feed me to the sharks.

How about them tidelurkers? They look pretty juicy. Bet you could steam those up real nice.

Can you get me some? I'm not much of a hunter. But I'll share it with you!

passages.title: Local Flavor
passages.text: <Sam's stomach growls audibly.>

passages.title: Local Flavor
passages.text:
Oh, you're a lifesaver!

Hang on just a sec, I'll cook these up in no time!

passages.title: Apes of Wrath
passages.text:
Alliance, just what I need. Down for performing a deed?

Zandalari are afraid, of new gorillas that raid.

These gorillas are mocking, these gorillas are talking.

Gorillas are dookering, I hear they follow bad king. 

It is important to lead, but this guy fails to succeed.

I shall send Flap-Flap ahead. Make ookin' wikket King dead.

passages.title: Apes of Wrath
passages.text: OOK! Just in time!

passages.title: King Da'ka
passages.text:
King Da'ka? More like King Dooker.

My king sent me to talk to this new king. This new king took my things and tried to take my wings.

Negotiations are ooked. Go, sticket to that angry wikket.

passages.title: King Da'ka
passages.text: Good. Gorillas gotta learn: Kings gotta earn. If they not earn, they not learn.

passages.title: Gorilla Warfare
passages.text:
Your timing is most fortuitous, stranger. I thank you for your assistance.

Things are not peaceful in Gorilla Gorge. The kaja'mite has given us great intelligence and wit. With intelligence has come war. 

My brethren are those who do not wish to fight. But for our passivity we have been persecuted.

Please free my comrades. They will be in cages all throughout the gorge and under guard. Make haste!

passages.title: Gorilla Warfare
passages.text: Thank you my friend! I saw the bravery with which you granted freedom to my comrades. We shall speak more anon.

passages.title: To Stomp or Not To Stomp
passages.text:
Like grandpapaook always say: if a wikket gonna huff the swoof from a dookerhole then plug the dookerhole.

These Da'kani wikkets huffing the green smoke from their dookerholes in the ground. Makes 'em smart and mean. Smart not so bad, mean is bad.

Go into Gorilla Gorge and plug those dookerholes!

passages.title: To Stomp or Not To Stomp
passages.text: Haha. Good. Can't have gorillas going all mean-wikket on everyone.

passages.title: WANTED: Quartermaster Ssylis
passages.text:
Some pirates took off with a supply crate that landed further away from this site then intended.

I don't think there was anything valuable in there, but now the pirates know we're here.

The leader was one of those big lizard men. The worker that kills him will get double pay for the week!

passages.title: WANTED: Quartermaster Ssylis
passages.text: Good work! Hopefully that means we'll be losing less supply drops now.

passages.title: WANTED: The Crimson Cutthroats
passages.text:
For numerous and sinister crimes against the Lord Admiral: smuggling, forgery, sailing under false colors, looting, poaching, brigandage, sacking, pillaging, vandalism, impersonating Kul Tiran Naval officers, arson, kidnapping, torture, piracy, perjury, theft and ransacking multiple mead shipments.

A reward is placed on the heads of The Crimson Cutthroats to be paid in full upon proof of their demise.

passages.title: WANTED: The Crimson Cutthroats
passages.text: Ugh. That lot. Glad someone finally took care of them.

passages.title: WANTED: The Crimson Cutthroats
passages.text:
I tell ya I ain't sad to see that group go.

I know you're not on exactly friendly terms with the Kul Tirans so how's about I front you the reward money and then use my connections to get the reward. Sound good?

passages.title: WANTED: The Rime Huntress
passages.text:
Attention Interested Parties! A Moneymaking Opportunity Awaits!!!!!

There's a big wolf hunting people in the pass. She's taken a liking to the taste of goblin. Nobody got time for being eaten by a wolf, so take out the Rime Huntress and I'll pay you for your trouble.

- Suzie Boltwrench

passages.title: WANTED: The Rime Huntress
passages.text:
Hey you got rid of that big wolf? Nice!

It'll be nice to know she's not munchin' on any of our miners.

passages.title: WANTED: Rindlewoe
passages.text:
A monstrous beast of wood and flesh has been terrorizing the nearby river territories. Knowing more about how the creature fights may yield interesting data!

Please report any and all findings to Suzie Boltwrench in Krazzlefrazz.

passages.title: WANTED: Rindlewoe
passages.text:
Hey! You got some great data off that monster.

Here's a little somethin' for being such a great research assistant.

passages.title: WANTED: Sister Lilias
passages.text:
The Krazzlefrazz Peacekeepers are looking for an able-bodied warrior to eliminate a threat in nearby Corlain.

A witch by the name of Sister Lilias is wanted for the torture and killing of many of our people. Her end would prove a boon to the Horde.

Present her head to claim your just reward.

passages.title: WANTED: Sister Lilias
passages.text: Hey, we got some witch problems. Mind taking care of it?

passages.title: WANTED: Sister Lilias
passages.text:
You got rid of that witch? Great! She was really cutting into our operation here.

Here's the bounty, paid out in full. Pleasure doin' business with ya.

passages.title: Precious Metals
passages.text:
Hey you! I got a business proposition for ya.The locals here seem to have a thing for silver, and we hit the jackpot with a mine just west of here. 

Unfortunately, it's got a bit of a spider problem...

Now, the miners we sent down there are probably goners by now, but there's still some silver left down there. If you can go and fetch it for me, we'll mark it up and make a fortune!

What do you say?

passages.title: Precious Metals
passages.text: Did you find the silver?

passages.title: Precious Metals
passages.text:
Way to come through, pal!

Oh, some of the miners were still alive? Now that's just crazy talk.

passages.title: An Eight-Legged Curse
passages.text:
That jerk Grimelock sent us down here to the mines, only to pack up and leave us behind when these spiders showed up! Now I'm stuck here with about a million legs and eyes in all directions.

You look like the tough sort. Can you clear a path for me? I'll make it worth your while.

passages.title: An Eight-Legged Curse
passages.text: Are they all dead?

passages.title: An Eight-Legged Curse
passages.text:
That's a relief!

Now I can head back to Krazzlefrazz and give Grimelock a piece of my mind!

passages.title: The Village of Glenbrook
passages.text:
<The book is a register of the inhabitants of Glenbrook.

All but a few of the names are crossed out.>

passages.title: The Village of Glenbrook
passages.text:
<The body is twisted and mangled nearly beyond recognition.

You can only assume this is the "Annie" mentioned in the register.>

passages.title: Tea Party
passages.text: <You hear footsteps behind you.>

passages.title: Vision of Time
passages.text:
You wish to hear how the Mag'har orcs joined the Horde? It may be one of the strangest ways we gained an ally!

It all began with a plan from Eitrigg. He had a fragment of the Vision of Time that Garrosh Hellscream used to travel to Draenor.

Chief Telemancer Oculeth believed there would be a way to go back to Draenor and get the Mag'har orcs to join the Horde.

This tale begins with a visit to Oculeth in Zuldazar...

passages.title: Vision of Time
passages.text: <name>, it is good to see you. I have been in need of an assistant to attune this fragment for some time now.

passages.title: Caverns of Time
passages.text:
Were the shard of the Vision of Time not depleted, I could use it to send you on your way. But my specialty is teleportation, not chronomancy.

Time magic was the province of our former leader, Grand Magistrix Elisande. Much of her knowledge died with her.

It is said Elisande had mastered incantations known only to the bronze dragons. Perhaps they would be willing to aid your cause.

passages.title: Caverns of Time
passages.text: Is it time for you to visit me already? Yes, I suppose it is then.

passages.title: The Great Sea Scrolls
passages.text:
<Dust falls from the scroll case as you retrieve it, revealing an ornate etching. The artwork, rendered with obvious care and skill, depicts a scene from a tortollan pilgrimage.

The container has spaces for twelve rolled scrolls, only one of which is occupied. A complete set would likely be quite valuable to a tortollan collector.>

passages.title: The Great Sea Scrolls
passages.text:
Oh my! Is that a complete set of the Ruinous Pilgrimage? With a first-generation scroll case to boot?

Why, I haven't seen one of those in decades! Here, here, I have a nice hat I acquired in a trade from a tall fellow some years ago. Said he was from "up north".

Did I ever tell you the stories that my father's mother's father told me about the days of the pilgrimage? It all started with that scoundrel from... hey, where are you going?

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Welcome to Stormwind, <race>. I invite you to explore our fair city. Say, you look like someone who enjoys caves and such! We have many dark corners in Stormwind to explore.

Ah, but that can wait, a bronze dragon has asked to talk to you. She is sitting under the nearby tree, on an hourglass of all things!

After that, an emissary of yours is waiting to welcome you to the city. Sounds like a busy day for you!

Have a pleasant stay, <name>!

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: Greetings.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Welcome tae Stormwind. Too much sun out here if ye ask me.

I'm off tae seek adventure! An' somewhere a bit darker.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Hi. I'm Ambassador Blackguard.

I am honored to welcome you to Orgrimmar, <race>.

<He smiles unconvincingly.>

As a lifetime of adventure unfolds before you, be assured that... uh...

You know what? I've been saying this same greeting all day. Enough's enough.

Talk to Chromie on top of the hourglass, then talk to your emissary. Run along.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: Another world... another time... this is an age of wonder.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Lots of new things to cut around here, if you know what I mean. I mean I like to cut things.

Do you like to cut things? Maybe we can cut things together one day.

passages.title: A Change in Leadership
passages.text:
In my experience people do not like to be driven from their homes.

While normally we would crush them with the might of the Horde, we do not have time to carry out a lengthy campaign against these creatures.

They will look to their leaders for hope, inspiration, and guidance. They will find none.

You are the instrument of my will, <name>. Make them submit to it.

passages.title: Elves in the Machine
passages.text:
The Horde have already set up camp here. But we can still strike back.

Their war machines are terrible to behold, but they are still machines. And machines do not work well when you go in and hack up a bunch of their inner workings.

If we can sabotage but a few of them, that could mean dozens of lives saved.

Let us make the most of this opportunity.

passages.title: Elves in the Machine
passages.text: We need to destroy those demolishers!

passages.title: Elves in the Machine
passages.text: We have done what we can here. Come, we must finish the mission.

passages.title: Adapting Our Tactics
passages.text:
This war will not be won with strength and might alone. Take in your surroundings while you fight and turn it into an advantage against the enemy.

I have a list of modifications for you to choose from. Any one of these might feel small on its own, but together they might just be all the advantage we need.

Let me know what you would like us to pursue.

passages.title: Adapting Our Tactics
passages.text: What is your decision?

passages.title: Adapting Our Tactics
passages.text: Excellent. We will see to it right away.

passages.title: Clearing Them Out
passages.text:
They have amassed an army before us, <name>. But it is no matter. The Horde war machine will not be stopped.

Go into The Master's Glaive and dispatch their warriors. Their sentinels. Any who would raise a blade against my soldiers. 

Clear out the petty rabble that seeks to delay the inevitable.

passages.title: Clearing Them Out
passages.text: We are one step closer to our goals.

passages.title: A Glaive Misunderstanding
passages.text:
The kaldorei have brought their siege weaponry to the field. They are currently using it to oppose mine.

We need these demolishers to reach Teldrassil if we hope to stand any chance of capturing it. Go and destroy their glaive throwers as swiftly as you are able.

They think they will stop my advance here. They are mistaken. Show them the gravity of their error, <name>.

passages.title: A Glaive Misunderstanding
passages.text: This was an easy victory. Do not expect it to be this simple in the future. Malfurion will return with his forces, but until then let's press on.

passages.title: Aggressive Inspiration
passages.text:
Nothing rallies the Horde more than their banner standing in the ruin of an enemy stronghold.

Go to Blackwood Den, take the territory there, raise the Horde banners and let none question our dominance over this land.

passages.title: Aggressive Inspiration
passages.text: This is not a time for subtle gestures.

passages.title: Fueling the Horde War Machine
passages.text:
You heard the warchief! We got Azerite shooting outta those ruins over there and night elves tryin' to snag it.

Get to those ruins and collect some of the stuff. This whole attack is done for if the night elves get their hands on that Azerite!

passages.title: Fueling the Horde War Machine
passages.text: That should do it! The night elves won't know what hit 'em.

passages.title: A Very Clear Message
passages.text:
The Alliance got to the Azerite here before us, the place is crawling with night elves!

Kill as many of them as you can see, we gotta make sure none of them deliver even an ounce of Azerite to the Alliance!

passages.title: A Very Clear Message
passages.text: Whew, that was a close call. Those night elves shoulda just ran away when they had the chance!

passages.title: Driving Them Out
passages.text:
This is it, <name>. 

Lor'danel is all that stands in our way before we capture Darnassus and reclaim Kalimdor. 

Rout the defenders. We cannot risk allowing a single enemy to escape until we have secured control over the World Tree.

I want this place in order by the time the Warchief arrives.

passages.title: Driving Them Out
passages.text: This has almost been too easy.

passages.title: Knives of the Forsaken
passages.text:
Tread carefully. All is not as it seems. The butchers who did this still skulk within Astranaar.

If you find them, give them what they deserve, <name>.

passages.title: Knives of the Forsaken
passages.text: Has justice been served upon Sylvanas's assassins?

passages.title: Knives of the Forsaken
passages.text: It is no less than those filthy creatures deserved.

passages.title: Mercy for the Mad
passages.text:
The ruin wrought by the Horde is driving the children of the forest mad.

Chief among them are Blackwood furbolgs. They have given into the madness and are a threat to everyone. If left to their madness they could strike us from behind while our forces engage the Horde. 

It pains me to ask this, but please, when you are in the Twilight Vale, put these creatures out of their misery before they endanger anyone else.

passages.title: Mercy for the Mad
passages.text: It is a tragedy that so many furbolgs had to perish, but it was necessary. In their madness they could attack our own people leaving us fighting a battle on two fronts.

passages.title: Azerite Denial
passages.text:
This substance, Azerite, is hurting Onu... and the Horde seem eager to collect it for themselves.

We must not let that happen. Collect as much Azerite as you can find. Ensure the Horde do not retrieve it.

passages.title: Azerite Denial
passages.text: Excellent work... this Azerite is a powerful substance indeed. We must not allow the Horde to get their hands on it.

passages.title: No Horde Allowed
passages.text:
The Horde forces in this area are trying to collect as much Azerite as possible. No doubt they intend to weaponize it.

Slay any Horde forces you can find. They must not be allowed to get their hands on this Azerite!

passages.title: No Horde Allowed
passages.text: We will end the Horde's invasion, here and now. Without this Azerite, they cannot win.

passages.title: Defending Lor'danel
passages.text:
The Horde have invaded from the North! You must protect Lor'danel, <name>. 

Help our forces push back this attack!

I will try to intercept the Warchief. This is our final chance to stop her. Report to Commander Summermoon in my absence.

passages.title: Defending Lor'danel
passages.text: Your aid is welcome, but I fear the Horde is relentless. Their forces are not slowing down.

passages.title: A Gift of Azerite
passages.text:
I think we got a handle on things here. You gotta bring all this Azerite back to Zarvik Blastwix at the main camp!

He's gonna know just how to use this stuff to really take down the Alliance.

passages.title: A Gift of Azerite
passages.text:
Azerite! For me? You shouldn't have! 

Just kidding, of course you should have.

passages.title: Ready for Battle
passages.text:
Greetings, <name>.

Our recruits are eager to join you on the battlefield.

passages.title: Ready for Battle
passages.text: Looking for a few recruits?

passages.title: Ready for Battle
passages.text: With our allies fighting by your side the battlefield is ours for the taking.

passages.title: Armor Up!
passages.text:
Ah, <name>. Word spreads quickly around here.

Unfortunately, with all these orders coming in I can't afford to talk right now.

If you're interested in learning more about the armory Fennick can help you with that. He's just outside.

passages.title: Armor Up!
passages.text:
What? Old Drom'kal's too busy for ya? I'm not surprised.

At least now that the armory's up and 'runnin' we can work on gettin' our allies some better gear.

passages.title: Welcome to the Workshop
passages.text:
You must be the new <guy/gal> around here. Name's Margie. And that over there, that's Pixy.

We run a tight crew here at the workshop. So, if you ever need anything, you know where to find us.

Now, I suggest you head on over and check in with Pixy. She can show you what we have to offer.

passages.title: Welcome to the Workshop
passages.text: I'm workin' here.

passages.title: Welcome to the Workshop
passages.text:
Well that was quick!

Like I said before, if ya need anything you know where to find us.

passages.title: The Altar's Power
passages.text:
Looks like construction on the Altar of Storms is complete.

I'm sure Meredith would be more than happy to show you what mysterious powers lie within.

passages.title: The Altar's Power
passages.text: Yea?

passages.title: The Altar's Power
passages.text:
Huh. Would ya look at that.

I can feel the energy comin' off that thing from here!

passages.title: Beasts of Newstead
passages.text:
Nothing penetrates an enemy's front line like a fierce rider and a well-trained beast. Now that we control Newstead, one of our riders in particular has focused his efforts on training us a few kodos.

Go, check in with Tanauk and find out what these beasts are capable of.

passages.title: Beasts of Newstead
passages.text: What are you waiting for?

passages.title: Beasts of Newstead
passages.text: Powerful beasts, aren't they?

passages.title: The Circle's Power
passages.text:
With the Circle of Elements under our control there are opportunities to harness the powers of the elements.

Kraga understands these powers quite well. I suggest speaking with her.

passages.title: The Circle's Power
passages.text: Have you found what you were looking for?

passages.title: The Circle's Power
passages.text: Such power is not to be taken lightly.

passages.title: Ready for Battle
passages.text:
Welcome to the warfront, <name>.

Our recruits are eager to join you on the battlefield.

A good place to start would be Ralston. I'm sure he's got a few who could learn much fighting by your side.

passages.title: Ready for Battle
passages.text: Looking for a few recruits?

passages.title: Ready for Battle
passages.text: With our allies rallying by your side on the battlefield I have no doubt we will remove the Horde threat from Arathi.

passages.title: Armor Up!
passages.text:
What've we got 'ere? A fresh, young <lad/lass> lookin' ta help better prepare our allies fer battle? Well then, Jonathan's always lookin' for a bit o' help ta keep our armory orders in full swing.

I'd offer ta walk ya over, but I've got me hands full here. Ye can find him just over yonder.

passages.title: Armor Up!
passages.text:
Hmm? Ah, yes.

Everything in order? Armory resources looking good, yes?

passages.title: The Altar's Power
passages.text:
With contributions in full swing it's no surprise the Altar of Kings was built with such haste.

I suggest wandering over that way. You might be surprised to see what the Altar has to offer.

passages.title: The Altar's Power
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: The Altar's Power
passages.text: My goodness! What an incredible source of power.

passages.title: Welcome to the Workshop
passages.text:
Welcome to the workshop!

I told Grumble I thought it best for me ta protect him from unnecessary distractions, but I think it may benefit all of us if ye get a peek at what we're doin' 'round here.

Why don't ye head on over and see what we have ta offer.

passages.title: Welcome to the Workshop
passages.text: How can I help ye?

passages.title: Welcome to the Workshop
passages.text: Ah, wonderful. I take it ye got a good look at our work.

passages.title: The Circle's Power
passages.text:
The Circle of Elements presents us with an opportunity to harness great power. One of our allies, Justine, has great knowledge into what this might mean for our efforts.

Seek her out. It's time you discovered the power of the elements.

passages.title: The Circle's Power
passages.text: Discover anything?

passages.title: The Circle's Power
passages.text: The enemy stands little chance.

passages.title: Beasts of Newstead
passages.text:
Control of Newstead has allowed our forces to advance. It's also provided Vindicator Banra ample room to continue training his elekk for battle.

I suggest you speak with him to learn more about what these magnificent beasts are capable of.

passages.title: Beasts of Newstead
passages.text: Remain vigilant.

passages.title: Beasts of Newstead
passages.text: Truly magnificent. Don't you agree?

passages.title: Allegiance of the Zandalari
passages.text:
It is decided, <name>.

De Zandalari will join de Horde.

Our path together has been a long and difficult one. We have lost much together. De Horde has sacrificed for de Zandalari, and vice versa. I can do nothing to honor that commitment except pledge our loyalty.

Collect your Warchief and send them to my throne. I will extend de offer myself.

passages.title: Allegiance of the Zandalari
passages.text: Without you, none of this would have been possible. You have done well, my champion.

passages.title: Heritage of the Zandalari
passages.text:
You have faced many challenges in your time among de Horde. You carried de pride of de Zandalari on your shoulders and triumphed!

Return to me. I wish to recognize de example you have set for us all.

passages.title: Heritage of the Zandalari
passages.text: Wear dis armor with pride, <name>. You now stand among de greatest champions of de Zandalari.

passages.title: Heritage of the Kul Tiran
passages.text:
Gossip in Boralus has oft reached my ears of your exceptional conduct, <name>.

Meet me before the keep. I wish to commend your efforts on behalf of Kul Tiras.

passages.title: Heritage of the Kul Tiran
passages.text:
Wherever the winds take you, know that you take the spirit of Kul Tiras with you.

Wear our colors with pride, <name>.

passages.title: A People Shattered
passages.text:
While the monument here was intended to honor the fallen members of the Shattered Sun, it quickly took on a second meaning for the sin'dorei.

It was not far from here that we lost one of our greatest heroes: Anasterian Sunstrider, the last king of Quel'Thalas. He led our final effort against the Scourge and personally crossed blades with Arthas himself. As we remember the sacrifices it took to reclaim this land, we also remember the sacrifices made in its defense.

passages.title: A People Shattered
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: A People Shattered
passages.text: Never forget the lives that were lost here. Both to the Scourge, and to their own misguided kin.

passages.title: Walk Among Ghosts
passages.text:
Every year, we ask a champion of our people to perform an act of remembrance in honor of those who fell to the Scourge. Lady Liadrin has performed this ritual, as have I, among others. This year, I am honored to give the task to you.

<The Regent Lord hands you an ornate lantern.>

This lantern carries a flame born of the Sunwell. I would ask that you bring it to locations that were significant to the fall of the Sunwell and of Quel'Thalas, and to light the memories we cannot forget.

passages.title: Walk Among Ghosts
passages.text: This land will never recover from the damage that was done here. But we lost so much more than land that day.

passages.title: The First to Fall
passages.text:
Arthas cut through the land itself to get to the Sunwell. The Dead Scar is a constant reminder of that desecration. Where it starts is where our first line of defense attempted to hold the Scourge at bay. It is where the first blood was spilled.

It was a slaughter.

Take the lantern to the base of the Dead Scar, and use its light to reveal the memories of what happened there.

passages.title: The First to Fall
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: The First to Fall
passages.text:
<Lor'themar stands quiet for a moment.>

Elor bindel felallan morin'aminor.

passages.title: Lament of the Highborne
passages.text:
The next memory...

Forgive me. For many of our people, it was when we realized death was coming for us.

A memorial to a particular defender lies to the west, in the place of her home. The light there has no doubt attracted some of the area's lingering souls. Clear them out, and then relight the flame.

passages.title: Lament of the Highborne
passages.text: Sylvanas and the Farstriders sacrificed more than most of us. Sometimes I must remind myself of that fact, given the current state of affairs.

passages.title: The Day Hope Died
passages.text:
The Ranger-General fell just east of Fairbreeze Village, where she was holding the line to protect the civilians as they retreated to Silvermoon. If it wasn't for her, our people would number even less than we do now.

Shine the lantern upon the battlefield, and witness how her forces ultimately broke under Arthas's personal assault.

passages.title: The Day Hope Died
passages.text: <Lor'themar is silent.>

passages.title: The Day Hope Died
passages.text:
In the words of one of the more poetic retellings:

As her defenders fell, with anguish she cried, "Shindu fallah na, Sin'dorei."

She was a true Ranger-General until her last breath. May Silvermoon never forget her bravery in life.

passages.title: Defense of Quel'Danas
passages.text:
With our best defenders defeated and the line broken, Arthas made quick work of Silvermoon's remaining forces and tore through the city.

This is where we part ways. I must return to Silvermoon before Halduron starts sending rangers to search for me.

The dragonhawk master in Fairbreeze Village has orders to fly you to Quel'Danas. Someone much more familiar with the events on the island will meet you there.

passages.title: Defense of Quel'Danas
passages.text: Are you ready, <name>?

passages.title: Unintended Consequences
passages.text:
<Xal'atath speaks once more.>

The servants of N'Zoth prepare for their master's return. They intend to conjure a scouring storm to wash away all unbelievers.

The particular ritual they will invoke requires three ancient artifacts. One of void, one of storm, and one of ocean.

Even now, I hear the void relic calling to me. It is being empowered... or corrupted, I am not sure which. I see it upon a cliff, overlooking a vast sea.

Come, <class>. We can find a much better use for such a prize.

passages.title: Unintended Consequences
passages.text: Yes... this form should do nicely.

passages.title: Unintended Consequences
passages.text: Do not be distracted. We have more to do.

passages.title: The Pirate's Treasure
passages.text:
I sense another relic. A trident thought lost to the depths. It calls to me, <name>. Do you hear it too?

Its song takes form. I see a harbor to the east. An ambitious pirate, greedy and proud. Completely unaware of the power hidden within her hoard of gold.

The would-be-captain's hubris will not permit her to simply hand over her prize. I fear she must be taught a rather harsh lesson.

But that is your specialty, is it not?

passages.title: The Pirate's Treasure
passages.text: Is the trident in your possession?

passages.title: The Pirate's Treasure
passages.text: I never doubted you for a moment.

passages.title: The Tempest Crown
passages.text:
<Xal'atath breathes in deeply and smiles.>

My strength grows. I can see it clearly now... the third relic we seek. The crown known as Tempest Caller.

How fitting that after the fall of Atal'Gral, the gluttonous Toatana would be the one to find the artifact. He was always scuttling about the depths, seeking treasures for his collection.

Toatana's greed has left him trapped within a cave he can never leave. The crown awaits us there.

passages.title: The Tempest Crown
passages.text: The crown is far more useful in our hands than in the claws of an oversized bottom-feeder.

passages.title: The Tempest Crown
passages.text:
Further proof that you and I can achieve great things together, <name>.

So many possibilities...

passages.title: Twist the Knife
passages.text:
The relics are ours... as it was meant to be.

There is but one more step needed for the great truths to be revealed.

The naga sought to summon their storm from a place that echoes with ancient power. Though this site has had countless names over the ages, you mortals know it as the Precipice of Oblivion.

I will go on ahead and begin preparations. Join me there.

passages.title: Twist the Knife
passages.text: We are so close now... to the end.

passages.title: Twist the Knife
passages.text:
<Talanji listens to your tale of Xal'atath and N'Zoth.>

Zandalar is still reeling from de Old God's infestation in Uldir. If another rises...

Dis is troubling news indeed. Only together can we turn back dis tide.

passages.title: His Eye Upon You
passages.text:
Something dark has taken root within you, <name>. The tendrils of N'Zoth are burrowing into your mind and soul, eager to consume everything you are.

I can perform a rite of cleansing, but only in a place that resonates with the very power that grips you. 

Meet me near the Crucible of Storms. The ritual will be perilous and painful, but it is your only chance to be free.

The Old God has eyes everywhere. I do not wish you to become one of them.

passages.title: His Eye Upon You
passages.text: There can be no treating with the darkness, <name>.

passages.title: His Eye Upon You
passages.text:
It is done. The darkness fades and your mind is once more your own.

You are free of N'Zoth's influence. Let us hope he does not seek to take hold of you again.

passages.title: His Eye Upon You
passages.text:
<Talanji seems to regard you with concern.>

Dark mojo has fallen upon you, <name>. I can sense de tendrils of N'Zoth delving deep into your mind.

Dis evil must be purged... before it claims your very soul!

Go to de Altar of Akunda in de Terrace of de Chosen. Seek out Nailok, one of de priests of Akunda. He is your best chance to be cleansed of de wicked curse dat grips you.

passages.title: His Eye Upon You
passages.text: Are you ready to be free?

passages.title: His Eye Upon You
passages.text: Dat was some baaaaaad mojo gripping your mind, hero. But Akunda's power proved even stronger!

passages.title: To the Broken Shore
passages.text:
Da Broken Shore be where I fell in battle. We were overrun, demons everywhere. Sylvanas was doing what she could, but Thrall was down and I had fallen. It was horror.

And now I need ya to take me back dere. Take me glaive to da battlefield, call to me, and I will come. Perhaps if I be in da spot where me blood was spilled, we might shine some light on dis mystery.

passages.title: To the Broken Shore
passages.text: I may be ancient by your standards, but I lack the raw power Talanji wields. You may wish to stand back, as this will be the first time I have attempted to conjure a spirit that was this powerful.

passages.title: Where He Died
passages.text:
Dis time, I need to bring ya to my side.

We gonna walk da shadows between life and death, see if we can't uncover some clues.

Be careful, adventurer, and be armed. Not everything on dis side wants us to find answers.

Prepare yourself, den speak with me when ya be ready.

passages.title: Where He Died
passages.text: I not be scared away so easily. What dey gonna do, kill me again?

passages.title: Where He Died
passages.text: Dis be leavin' me with much to ponder.

passages.title: The Lies of a Loa
passages.text:
Hidden memories, spirits attackin' us for investigating, and a long road of bodies in da wake of me makin' Sylvanas warchief.

I be thinkin' it time ya speak with Ol' Bwonsamdi. Odd as it sounds, dis don't seem like his style. Dat don't mean he not be behind it.

Ya best work with Talanji. From what little I been seein', da death loa got a soft spot for her highness. You can confront Bwonsamdi at his necropolis in Nazmir. Just... be respectful.

passages.title: The Lies of a Loa
passages.text: We must be very careful. Bwonsamdi may be fond of humor, but his wrath toward those who disrespect him is de stuff of legends.

passages.title: Mysteries of Death
passages.text:
Hmph. Well, da Lich King and dat bossy val'kyr not be me only rivals. But dey were da ones most likely ta be behind all dis. Someone be playin' with very ancient mojo.

Tell Vol'jin's spirit dat da answers he be lookin' for not be found in da world of da living. He gonna need to go beyond da veil ta learn what needs knowin'.

Dere be some places on dat side only he can go.

passages.title: Mysteries of Death
passages.text:
So, to da Other Side den. Where I be goin', da livin' not be followin'. If it be in me power, I gonna send word of what I find. 

Mind yaself in da days to come. If I be readin' Baine's words right, I tink da Horde gonna have a mighty need of a hero like you soon enough.

passages.title: In the Dunes
passages.text:
This schematic you found is encrypted. My tools are no good on it, not without risking the integrity of the data.

However, I do know a guy who can definitely crack this cookie: Mr. Dataguru Gryzix.

If I remember correctly, he's been vacationing on a beach in Vol'dun since the war broke out. Something about not getting the recognition he deserves. 

Anyways, I am sure you can convince him to help you.

passages.title: In the Dunes
passages.text: Ugh, what do you want?

passages.title: The Pride of the Sin'dorei
passages.text:
<name>, Lor'themar Theron has requested your presence in Silvermoon.

He's asking for your assistance with a ceremony of great importance.

passages.title: The Pride of the Sin'dorei
passages.text: Ah, <name>, just in time.

passages.title: Sethrak Persuasion
passages.text:
Let me see the schematic...

Yeah, yeah, alright. I can help you.

I am going to need a few things to power my decoder.

I need a way to channel electricity from the air around us. What better than to steal...I mean borrow some lightning rods from the sethrak that have been trying to steal my tech for weeks now!

I'm sure you'll have to do some "convincing", but you seem like a pretty convincing <race>.

passages.title: Sethrak Persuasion
passages.text: I need those rods to do my work, <name>.

passages.title: Sethrak Persuasion
passages.text:
Perfect, this should be enough to power my decoder.

Now we're cooking with lightning!

passages.title: A Friend in Needle
passages.text:
You can see me?

Oh, thank goodness! I thought I was lost in the folds of time...again!

But for one to see through the folds of time's fabric... you must be a very talented tailor, indeed.

Would you bring me some cloth, then, tailor? I believe I'll be able to place just when I am with your help and right myself.

passages.title: A Friend in Needle
passages.text: When in Azeroth am I...?

passages.title: A Friend in Needle
passages.text: You're back! That was fast...or, was it?

passages.title: Heavy is the Head
passages.text:
Okay, I am going to need one more thing from you.

The sethrak leader, Warlord Surgios, has been a real pain for me.

He stole my mind enhancer. I can't do my work without it. It will make me be able to think much more clearly, and make less...deadly mistakes.

passages.title: Heavy is the Head
