passages.text: The Horde will pay the ultimate price for crossing the kaldorei.

passages.title: No Survivors
passages.text: These Forsaken still fight, even beyond death. What drives their wicked hearts?

passages.title: Trouble in Darkshore
passages.text:
We have received some disturbing reports from Darkshore.

What was once a secure stronghold for the Horde is now beset by an unnatural darkness. The moon has turned completely black.

The outposts there have yet to be reinforced with our main force and we are suddenly outnumbered. Nathanos wants you to meet him in Darkshore and find out what happened.

passages.title: Trouble in Darkshore
passages.text: Have you traveled to Darkshore?

passages.title: Trouble in Darkshore
passages.text: Your arrival is timely. We have a problem.

passages.title: Black Moon Rising
passages.text:
Darkshore has never been known for being bright and sunny, but something strange has happened here. A black moon hangs over everything.

None of the scouts I sent into the forest have returned. The night elves are up to something. And I need to know what it is.

Their rank-and-file won't have the information we seek. Hunt down their lieutenants and get them to talk by any means necessary.

passages.title: Black Moon Rising
passages.text: <The wisp appears lost and disoriented. It follows you.>

passages.title: Black Moon Rising
passages.text: <The wisp bobs up and down, as if in a daze.>

passages.title: Quit Vining!
passages.text:
This is terrible, <name>! We got harvesters that ain't harvestin'!

We've been busting our rumps chopping down all these trees, but someone keeps tangling up our machines in the vines! I ain't going out there with those night elves stalkin' around.

See if you can get in there and free up my equipment!

passages.title: Quit Vining!
passages.text: Now that's more like it! As soon as the boss gets rid of those night elves, we won't have ourselves a lumber problem anymore!

passages.title: We're Not Out of the Woods Yet
passages.text:
<The wisp flickers at you in a confused manner. It seems to want to follow you.

Perhaps it has the information Nathanos seeks.>

passages.title: We're Not Out of the Woods Yet
passages.text: Have you found anything useful?

passages.title: We're Not Out of the Woods Yet
passages.text: That is not exactly what I meant when I said to bring back something useful.

passages.title: Where Hope Dies
passages.text:
We must carry out the Dark Lady's orders before we are overrun by these newly-invigorated elves.

There is one night elf in particular that we seek. You may remember her from our last venture into Darkshore. Lucky for you, she is already dead... so she should prove less troublesome than the living ones you've already encountered.

Signal me when you find her corpse.

passages.title: Where Hope Dies
passages.text: Have you found her yet?

passages.title: Where Hope Dies
passages.text: I sent you to find one dead night elf. It would appear you have outdone yourself.

passages.title: To Kill A Warden
passages.text:
<The oppressive feeling of being hunted has reached a peak.

You know there is someone behind you.> 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(54048))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(54048))");
 
 
 
 
 
 const cta = WH.Tools.createWowheadClientCta();
 if (cta) {
 $('.db-page-collection-tracker-cta').append(cta);
 }

passages.title: The Dead of Night
passages.text:
This is the crux of the Dark Lady's plan for Darkshore. We will raise new champions for the Forsaken and the Horde on this very spot.

Guard the val'kyr. We cannot allow anything or anyone to interrupt them.

passages.title: The Dead of Night
passages.text:
You made it out. Good.

So did I.

passages.title: Aftermath
passages.text:
We all have our reasons for accepting the val'kyr's gift. But now is not the time for those discussions.

Sylvanas has been dealt a heavy blow today with the loss of Brynja. We will have no time to rest before the Alliance descends on this place.

Nathanos has summoned you. There is something you must see.

passages.title: Aftermath
passages.text: Have you spoken with Nathanos?

passages.title: Aftermath
passages.text:
What happens now? We prepare for battle.

They will all pay.

passages.title: Questfall
Unintended Consequences
passages.text:
<Xal'atath speaks once more.>

The servants of N'Zoth prepare for their master's return. They intend to conjure a scouring storm to wash away all unbelievers.

The particular ritual they will invoke requires three ancient artifacts. One of void, one of storm, and one of ocean.

Even now, I hear the void relic calling to me. It is being empowered... or corrupted, I am not sure which. I see it upon a cliff, overlooking a vast sea.

Come, priest. We can find a much better use for such a prize.

passages.title: Unintended Consequences
passages.text: A change of pace can be invigorating, eh, High Priest?

passages.title: Unintended Consequences
passages.text: Do not be distracted. We have more to do.

passages.title: The Night Warrior
passages.text:
It appears these night elves won't give up the information easily... but perhaps that wisp you captured will.

See if you can get it to reveal what happened here. I don't care how you do it.

Father Norlath will handle the wisp from there.

passages.title: The Night Warrior
passages.text: Have you made that wisp cooperate?

passages.title: The Night Warrior
passages.text: This is unsettling. We will have to accelerate our plans.

passages.title: Right Bot for the Job
passages.text:
We don't waste anything around here. Every defeated bot gets a second chance! 

If I'm going to fix this mechaspider, I'm going to need a few extra wrenchbots working with me. 

Use my Bot Re-Energizer on three dead Repeating Wrenchbots and bring them to me, and I'll put them to work.

passages.title: Right Bot for the Job
passages.text: Did you find those Repeating Wrenchbots yet?

passages.title: Right Bot for the Job
passages.text: These bots will work round the clock fixing this mount!

passages.title: You Must be This Height
passages.text:
The moment is here <name>. 

For such a historic moment I feel a gnome, such as myself, should be the one to activate the device.

Let me know when you think we should begin.

passages.title: You Must be This Height
passages.text: This is quite an important discovery!

passages.title: You Must be This Height
passages.text: I'm sure the king didn't mean any harm to YOU champion. Please don't let this incident deter you. I need your help!

passages.title: The Legend of Mechagon
passages.text:
I came as soon as I heard! A mysterious vault has been discovered in Tiragarde. 

Centuries ago, the last king of the gnomes, King Mechagon, led his followers in search of a mythical land of technology. He left no clue as to where he was headed, and over time his legend faded into history. This vault could be the first step to discovering King Mechagon's true fate! 

I must examine it firsthand. Meet me there, Champion. I could use your assistance.

passages.title: The Legend of Mechagon
passages.text: It's as promising as I had hoped! Now that you're here we shall begin the investigation.

passages.title: Toys For Destruction
passages.text:
Ricket sent word that she was here in Mechagon, so I came right away to help with the uh... research.

I had the peons scour the island for any technology they could find. With da stuff we got here, we gonna make some amazing weapons to fight King Mechagon. Then afterwards, we get rich selling 'em!

Help me wrangle everyone's ideas into one perfect weapon!

passages.title: Toys For Destruction
passages.text: You build an amazing weapon yet?

passages.title: Toys For Destruction
passages.text: Something as beautiful as that, needs to be put to good use!

passages.title: A Goblin's Definition of Success
passages.text:
I'm all set here, I'm just gonna play around with the mech, I think I got a good idea how it works thanks to ya.

Nathanos "prince of all that's death and destruction" Blightcaller is gonna want you back on that boat, the Banshee's Scream or whatever it is.

He'll be happy to know we took care of business. Then again, I got no idea if he even feels happy anymore.

passages.title: A Goblin's Definition of Success
passages.text:
Good work. We can breath a little easier knowing our major supply of Azerite is safe.

The Dark Lady has further plans that will require your aid. We have a promising lead on someone who can help us destroy Kul Tiras from within.

Keep up the fight against the Alliance in the meantime. We cannot afford to let down our guard.

passages.title: The Fall of the Sunwell
passages.text:
The flame of the lantern dims. Your final task is to rekindle it.

In order to do so, you must walk one remaining path. While we are fortunate to hold the Sunwell once again, we must always remember that it was yet another part of us that Arthas took away... and that our late prince was forced to find us a new way of life.

Enter the Sunwell Plateau, and witness its fall.

passages.title: The Fall of the Sunwell
passages.text:
<The Regent Lord takes the lantern from you.>
 
It is done.

passages.title: The Dark Lady Calls
passages.text:
Champion, the Dark Lady has need of you.

We cannot speak more of this here. Make haste to Orgrimmar at once.

Best not to keep her waiting.

passages.title: The Dark Lady Calls
passages.text:
My guards are stationed at the door to ensure that this meeting stays private.

Now, let us discuss Varok Saurfang.

passages.title: The High Overlord
passages.text:
I have asked you here to discuss a matter of great importance to the Horde.

Varok Saurfang is no longer in Stormwind.

Let us discuss this turn of events.

passages.title: The High Overlord
passages.text: I trust your discretion in this matter.

passages.title: The High Overlord
passages.text:
I hope you understand how grave of a situation this is, champion.

The Alliance will surely kill him on sight. Some members of the Horde consider him a traitor for his willing surrender at the Battle for Lordaeron.

If Varok Saurfang is to make it back to us alive, it will be up to you. Be discreet.

passages.title: A Way Out
passages.text:
My spies report that our High Overlord did not leave the way he entered, nor any other way we know of. No signs of him were seen at any of the known exits from the Stockades or the sewers. He simply was in his cell one moment, and gone the next.

Begin your investigation around the city of Stormwind. There must be another way out that we do not know of.

Dark Ranger Lyana will meet you there. Her tracking skills are second to none.

Do not fail me, my champion.

passages.title: A Way Out
passages.text: There is no time to waste. Let us begin our investigation.

passages.title: On Track
passages.text:
Keep your head down. We do not want to be seen out here.

Our spies keep watch over Stormwind day and night, and saw no signs of Saurfang. 

Nor did we notice any oddly-oversized carts or strange ships in the night, if that was what you were thinking.

How then, did he make his escape?

Let's look around.

passages.title: On Track
passages.text: Let us keep investigating.

passages.title: On Track
passages.text:
SI:7 lurking around Stormwind? Hmm, probably after the same thing we are.

We need to keep moving.

passages.title: Eastern Escape
passages.text:
It's not unusual to see SI:7 spies lurking around the city, but something about this doesn't feel right.

We need to find where Saurfang's trail picks up. The last tracks were heading east, towards Redridge.

The path to Redridge crosses the Three Corners, one of the Alliance's more well-defended towers.

I have an idea. Meet me there.

passages.title: Eastern Escape
passages.text:
There are few paths through Redridge, save this one.

We should start the next stage of our investigation here.

passages.title: Corner Crossing
passages.text:
If Saurfang was headed in this direction, it would have been difficult for him to avoid the Three Corners watchpost. 

We could simply walk in there and demand information, but I have a feeling that they would not part with it willingly.

So we will take another approach.

I have procured this potion from our alchemists. It will turn us into--ugh--humans for a while.

We can then question the guards. Perhaps someone saw something.

passages.title: Corner Crossing
passages.text: Let's find out everything we can.

passages.title: Corner Crossing
passages.text:
So, Shaw was involved? SI:7... again.

Perhaps a coincidence, perhaps not. 

We have little to go off of. Let us assume Saurfang continued his path eastward, off of the main trails.

passages.title: Signs of Saurfang
passages.text:
With the guards drunk at their posts, and others out of position, Saurfang would have had little trouble passing Three Corners undetected.

The path splits just south of town. The back roads of Redridge are poorly patrolled, and are infested with gnolls and spiders. In other words, perfect for an orc trying not to be noticed.

His most likely path is Lakeridge Highway. We should continue our investigation there.

passages.title: Signs of Saurfang
passages.text: Well? What are you waiting for?

passages.title: Signs of Saurfang
passages.text:
Well, that was invigorating. 

Based on the size of that spider and how injured it was, I'd venture a guess that we are on the right track.

And I think I know where to head next.

passages.title: Ever Eastward
passages.text:
All signs point to our quarry heading farther east. 

To what end, I am not sure. But I have my suspicions.

I am going to scout the area from the air. Let's meet up at Redridge Pass.

passages.title: Ever Eastward
passages.text: This is one of the few pathways through the Redridge Mountains. If Saurfang came this direction, it was through this pass.

passages.title: Tracking Tipoff
passages.text:
Look there, down the hill. One of the Alliance hunters that roam the area.

No one knows these pathways like them. If our quarry passed through here, that hunter would certainly have seen the tracks. His dogs may even have caught Saurfang's scent.

Here is another dose of the potion. Let us question this one while he is alone.

passages.title: Tracking Tipoff
passages.text: Let's find out everything we can.

passages.title: Tracking Tipoff
passages.text:
Thank you for your assistance in this investigation, champion. We have all but confirmed Saurfang's current location.

I must report back to the warchief before we make any further moves. We will summon you if we require your assistance again.

passages.title: Grim Tidings
passages.text:
Ey mon, dat dark ranger, she be lyin' to ya!

Saurfang knew dey'd be comin' for him. He sent me to watch da pass, see who his assassins be. Try to warn him if I could.

She not be reportin' back nothin'... she gonna kill him. Most likely got a whole buncha deathguards just waitin' for her signal.

We gotta stop dem! Ya wit' me?

passages.title: Grim Tidings
passages.text: It be too late! Dey beat us here!

passages.title: A Warrior's Death
passages.text:
She gonna try an' take him in, and den no one ever gonna see Varok Saurfang again.

Dis was never a rescue mission. Dis be about power, an' control, an' Sylvanas think she be holdin' all da cards.

But she didn't count on us!

Let's go!

passages.title: A Warrior's Death
passages.text: Will you stand with us?

passages.title: A Warrior's Death
passages.text:
I thank you and young Zekhan for your assistance. I knew she would come for me. It was only a matter of time. 

And I do not think she will give up.

Now I have something I must ask of you.

passages.title: Queen's Favor
passages.text:
I have two things to ask of you, and I do not ask them lightly.

First, I need you to retain the favor of the warchief. She will undoubtedly have questions, and seeds of distrust may begin to grow, but she cannot lose you as an ally. Not now. She would not so willingly part with one of her greatest champions.

In order to do so, it will have to look like you faced me in combat, and lost. I trust you can take a hit.

Second, I ask you not to follow me further. I must make this journey alone.

passages.title: Queen's Favor
passages.text:
I have not heard back from Lyana since I sent her on her last mission.

Are you here to complete her report?

passages.title: Every Little Death Helps
passages.text:
<The whispers are faint, but grow louder as you hold the blade in your hand.>

So weak... need... blood... souls...

<The voice trails off, but you can still sense the dagger urging you on.>

passages.title: Every Little Death Helps
passages.text:
Ah... much better. How cruel of that priest to leave me in such a state!

But enough about me. No doubt you have many questions. I can offer countless answers.

passages.title: Every Little Death Helps
passages.text:
<The whispers are faint, but grow louder as you hold the blade in your hand.>

So weak... need... blood... souls...

<The voice trails off, but you can still sense the dagger urging you on.

It is a familiar sensation.>

passages.title: Every Little Death Helps
passages.text:
Ah... much better. How cruel of you to leave me in such a state!

But we can reminisce later. No doubt you have many questions. As you know, I can offer countless answers.

passages.title: Every Little Death Helps
passages.text:
<The whispers are faint, but grow louder as you hold the blade in your hand.>

So weak... need... blood... souls...

<The voice trails off, but you can still sense the dagger urging you on.>

passages.title: Every Little Death Helps
passages.text:
Ah... much better. How cruel of that priest to leave me in such a state!

But enough about me. No doubt you have many questions. I can offer countless answers.

passages.title: Every Little Death Helps
passages.text:
<The whispers are faint, but grow louder as you hold the blade in your hand.>

So weak... need... blood... souls...

<The voice trails off, but you can still sense the dagger urging you on.

It is a familiar sensation.>

passages.title: Every Little Death Helps
passages.text:
Ah... much better. How cruel of you to leave me in such a state!

But we can reminisce later. No doubt you have many questions. As you know, I can offer countless answers.

passages.title: To Orgrimmar
passages.text:
A darkness in me mind be keeping me from remembering what happened da day I named Sylvanas warchief.

Take me glaive and travel to da pyre where I was cremated in Orgrimmar.

Master Gadrin be packin' enough juju to call me to dat place.

Go, and I be seein' ya dere.

passages.title: To Orgrimmar
passages.text: Vol'jin might be havin' confidence in me skill, but I asked some allies to come aid us. Dis not be an easy task. Talanji be da better choice for such a ritual, but I will do me best.

passages.title: Breaking Out Ashvane
passages.text:
The Dark Lady wishes to gain another potential ally in the fight against the Alliance.

Lady Ashvane, head of the Ashvane Company, was one of the greatest enemies of Kul Tiras until her capture.

We are going to release her.

Meet Valtrois in Tiragarde Sound. She and Rexxar are working out a plan to break Ashvane out.

passages.title: Breaking Out Ashvane
passages.text: Your arrival is timely. We have much to do.

passages.title: It Belongs in My Mech!
passages.text:
Check this out! It's my latest creation that someone else came up with and built, Gallywix's Mech of Death!

I got it fueled with all that Azerite you found, but I still need more of the stuff to give it that extra kick.

I was SUPPOSED to have the stuff from our operations here, but there's some sorta Azerite goop causin' a mess!

My guy Patch made an Azerite vacuum device. I want you to suck the Azerite outta these slimes!

passages.title: It Belongs in My Mech!
passages.text: That's what I'm talkin' about! This bad boy is gonna be fueled up in no time.

passages.title: Avoiding Lawsuits 101
passages.text:
Yo, <name>! I leave the A.M.O.D. for two seconds to deal with old Gallywix and now I'm knee-deep in Azerite goo!

Listen, here's the deal. I need ya to rescue some of these goblins from these monsters.

I'll be honest, I skimped on the money that covers their insurance in the event of Azerite-monster-related injuries.

What? Who knew that these slimes would appear and attack these guys!

Do me a solid and get these goblins outta there!

passages.title: Avoiding Lawsuits 101
passages.text: Ya help those guys?

passages.title: Avoiding Lawsuits 101
passages.text:
You're a real life saver! Well, life for them, gold for me.

If anyone asks, we never talked about this. Ya catching my drift?

passages.title: Twist the Knife
passages.text:
The relics are ours... as it was meant to be.

There is but one more step needed for the great truths to be revealed.

The naga sought to summon their storm from a place that echoes with ancient power. Though this site has had countless names over the ages, you mortals know it as the Precipice of Oblivion.

I will go on ahead and begin preparations. Join me there.

passages.title: Twist the Knife
passages.text:
<Brother Pike listens to your tale of Xal'atath and N'Zoth.>

Dark tidings indeed, <name>.

I could sense something stirring beneath the waves. If the Old God is on the rise, we must make ready.

passages.title: Necessary Precautions
passages.text:
That was freakin' awesome! We decimated Mekkatorque's puny little army.

We got a location on where that little punk and his airship is. That's where he's controllin' all his FORMER mechs.

Here's the plan, we're gonna fly over there, blow up that freak, then destroy his airship!

Now, I ain't no idiot, <name>, I'm the smartest goblin alive. First, we gotta take what they call necessary precautions.

Take this manual, I want you to make sure the G.M.O.D is ready to go!

passages.title: Necessary Precautions
passages.text: Well? This thing ain't gonna double check itself! Although... maybe it should.

passages.title: Necessary Precautions
passages.text: I don't care what the meter says, I say we're good to go!

passages.title: Horde of Heroes
passages.text: The Alliance has begun a coordinated assault against our forces in Stormsong Valley. Attack the enemy forces and drive them back!

passages.title: Horde of Heroes
passages.text: I heard Usha spoke highly of your actions in Stormsong in her report... You must have done well, because she hates everyone!

passages.title: Many Fine Heroes
passages.text: The Alliance has the upper hand in Vol'dun. We strike now! You will lead our forces to victory!

passages.title: Many Fine Heroes
passages.text: Have we pushed the Horde out of Vol'dun?

passages.title: Many Fine Heroes
passages.text: I wish I could've seen that final battle in Vol'dun myself! I heard it was incredible... If we had more soldiers like you, this war would be over tomorrow.

passages.title: March on the Marsh
passages.text: The Alliance has begun a coordinated assault against the Horde in Nazmir. Defeat the enemy forces and drive them out!

passages.title: March on the Marsh
passages.text: What news do you bring from the front lines of Drustvar?

passages.title: March on the Marsh
passages.text:
Nazmir may not look like much, but every territory we control opens up strategic options for the future.

Plus, I hear you made quite a dent in the Horde's fleet out there. Ha! That alone was worth the trip.

passages.title: In Every Dark Corner
passages.text: The Alliance's hold on Drustvar is weak. We will conquer it for the Horde!

passages.title: In Every Dark Corner
passages.text: What news do you bring from the front lines of Drustvar?

passages.title: In Every Dark Corner
passages.text:
Wherever the Alliance hides... we will find them.

I'm glad Rokhan and the Darkspear are on our side.

passages.title: Ritual Rampage
passages.text: The Alliance has launched an assault into the very heart of the Zandalari empire. Defeat the Horde on their own soil to show them our strength!

passages.title: Ritual Rampage
passages.text: I read Magister Umbric's report... It sounded like quite an impressive display over there. The Horde must know now that we can control powers far beyond theirs.

passages.title: War Is Here
passages.text:
We need to move, <name>. We've received word that the Alliance have mounted an attack through Nazmir.

Make for the Great Seal. King Rastakhan and Princess Talanji are there forming a plan of attack.

Make no mistake, we will crush the Alliance. They are fools to attack us through Nazmir.

passages.title: War Is Here
passages.text: Let's get moving.

passages.title: War Is Here
passages.text: Let us move, we do not have time.

passages.title: Ride of the Zandalari
passages.text:
It is time de Alliance see de full fury of de Zandalari. Dey are fools to try an attack in Nazmir.

We must tell de fleet, our warriors, and our flyers dat dey must move out and go to Nazmir at once.

I will go aid our forces at de Blood Gate. Here is a list of dose you must speak with to mobilize our forces.

Move as fast as you can, we must stop de Alliance as quickly as possible.

passages.title: Ride of the Zandalari
passages.text: The Zandalari and Horde are engaging the Alliance. We must move!

passages.title: The Azsharan Medallion
passages.text:
<On the naga's body you find an ornate metal disc. The writing on its surface resembles elven script, but you cannot decipher it. You suspect the words are written in the Nazja tongue.

Perhaps someone with a knowledge of naga artifacts could translate the text.>

passages.title: The Azsharan Medallion
passages.text:
A medallion, you say? Well, let's have a look at it.

I don't have all day, you know.

passages.title: Orders from Azshara
passages.text:
<Kojo studies the medallion and grimaces.>

Ugh... naga.

This medallion is inscribed with orders. Looks like naga have been commanded to invade our shores and seize artifacts of great power.

You know, I recently came upon one such object. See that dagger over there? Nasty thing. Gives me the willies. I swear I hear it whispering to me.

I found it on an island in Stormsong Valley, on a makeshift altar. Maybe if you take it there, you'll get an idea of how the naga intended to use it.

passages.title: Orders from Azshara
passages.text: <As you place the dagger upon the altar, it seems to shudder and blink at you.>

passages.title: Orders from Azshara
passages.text:
<You are filled with a sense of dread and foreboding.

This is probably a very bad idea.>

passages.title: The Loa of Death
passages.text:
Bwonsamdi is a dangerous loa, but even I do not believe he whispered to Vol'jin on his deathbed. To appoint Sylvanas sounds, well... he is not fond of de undead. And from what I have seen of de warchief, she is no fan of death.

We must be respectful when we speak to Bwonsamdi, or dere will be consequences. Come, stay close.

passages.title: The Loa of Death
passages.text:
Now listen here, mon. Usually, ya disrespectul actions would be mighty irritatin' to Ol' Bwonsamdi. But I be lettin' dis one slide. For now.

What ya be talkin' about sounds like some bad mojo. I gonna need ya to find out more from some of me... "old friends."

passages.title: A Path of Blood
passages.text:
De main fleet of de Alliance and Kul Tirans are off de coast in Nazmir. But we cannot ignore de forces here.

Dere seems to be a strange fog coming in from Nazmir. De Kul Tirans must be using some of their voodoo to weaken us.

We must carve a path of blood through dese Alliance fools. Help our forces by weakening de Alliance.

passages.title: A Path of Blood
passages.text: Good, my forces can handle de remnants. You need to keep moving.

passages.title: No One Left Behind
passages.text:
De warriors here tell me Rokhan made a heroic stand, holding off de Alliance and their champions before being defeated.

Rokhan is still here within de Blood Gate, held captive by some strange creature called a Lightforged.

I must stay here and help hold de line. I need you to rescue Rokhan!

passages.title: No One Left Behind
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Rokhan will prove valuable in our fight against de Alliance.

passages.title: What the Drust Knew
passages.text:
Bal'a dash, <name>.

If you have a moment, I could use your assistance. I've recently received a shipment of Drust relics that were smuggled out of Kul Tiras.

Most have our usual enchantments, but there is one that is unique. Just holding it makes my hair stand on end. 

With you being my best pupil, I was thinking that it would be enlightening if we disenchanted it together, to see how it was made.

What do you say?

passages.title: What the Drust Knew
passages.text:
I'm sorry, <name>, I didn't think that the enchantment would be so complex. I thought I could maintain the incantation.

I guess that's it. With the relic destroyed the technique behind its construction is lost.

A shame, really. It's not often that I'm left dumbfounded by another enchanter.

passages.title: As the Dust Settles
passages.text:
We have achieved a great victory, <name>, though at a cost.

King Wrynn is gathering the Alliance leadership in Unity Square to discuss matters. He has requested our presence as well. 

Go to Unity Square. I'll meet you there shortly.

passages.title: As the Dust Settles
passages.text: Thank you for coming, <name>.

passages.title: The King's Death
passages.text:
King Rastakhan is dead, the Zandalari fleet has been decimated, and we have lost valuable soldiers.

The Dark Lady is on her way from Orgrimmar to assess the situation. We must figure out our next move before the Alliance strike again.

I believe protocol now would be to pay respects to the fallen king. We will determine our next move afterwards.

passages.title: The King's Death
passages.text: Good, you're all here. Let's begin our discussions.

passages.title: The Return of Derek Proudmoore
passages.text:
I'll admit, I did not think the Little Lion had it in him to kill King Rastakhan. Blood has been spilled, and vengeance must be had.

Give me a moment to express my condolences, then come with me. We have more to do to win this war.

passages.title: The Return of Derek Proudmoore
passages.text:
Derek Proudmoore will be twisted to become a weapon against Katherine and Jaina Proudmoore.

The Allliance brought an army to kill Rastakhan. All we'll need is one Forsaken to kill their leaders.

I will contact you when your aid is further needed. In the meantime, continue the fight against the Alliance, we must survive until this plan is ready.

passages.title: The Treasury Heist
passages.text:
The Abyssal Scepter is a powerful tidesage artifact and a serious threat to the fleet. The Horde stole it, but it is being held by the Zandalari in their treasury.

The Storm's Wake has crafted a fake Scepter. Your first job is to obtain the real one without alerting suspicion.

Speak to me when you are ready to go over the plan.

passages.title: The Treasury Heist
passages.text: Were you successful?

passages.title: The Treasury Heist
passages.text:
Mission accomplished on all fronts, it seems. I will ensure that the High Tinker gets the data you collected.

I remember hearing stories of the Abyssal Scepter when I was young. Aside from being a tactical victory, it is good to have this relic back in our hands. Thank you.

passages.title: The Abyssal Scepter
passages.text:
The Lord Admiral has proposed our next move. It's something we don't think the Horde will expect, but it's dangerous: We're going to steal back the Abyssal Scepter.

Your name came up as someone who could see it through, if you're willing to take the chance.

Meet Lady Jaina at our base in Xibala. She'll have more information for you there.

passages.title: The Abyssal Scepter
passages.text:
<Jaina looks up from her consultation with Magister Umbric as you approach.>

This mission will be dangerous, but it's necessary to ensure our victory here in Zandalar.

passages.title: The Azsharan Medallion
passages.text:
<On the naga's body you find an ornate metal disc. The writing on its surface resembles elven script, but you cannot decipher it. You suspect the words are written in the Nazja tongue.

Perhaps someone with a knowledge of naga artifacts could translate the text.>

passages.title: The Azsharan Medallion
passages.text:
A medallion, you say? Well, let's have a look at it.

I don't have all day, you know.

passages.title: Orders from Azshara
passages.text:
<Kojo studies the medallion and grimaces.>

Ugh... naga.

This medallion is inscribed with orders. Looks like naga have been commanded to invade our shores and seize artifacts of great power.

You know, I recently came upon one such object. See that dagger over there? Nasty thing. Gives me the willies. I swear I hear it whispering to me.

I found it nearby at Atal'Gral, on a makeshift altar. Maybe if you take it there, you'll get an idea of how the naga intended to use it.

passages.title: Orders from Azshara
passages.text: <As you place the dagger upon the altar, it seems to shudder and blink at you.>

passages.title: Orders from Azshara
passages.text:
<You are filled with a sense of dread and foreboding.

This is probably a very bad idea.>

passages.title: Face Your Enemy
passages.text:
We have decided that our best course of action would be to enter the prison disguised as Proudmoore military. Rexxar will be our prisoner.

We want to keep a low profile until we break Ashvane out.

I find that I work better with reference when undertaking this type of endeavor.

I have chosen some humans that interest me. I would like to examine their faces.

Use the Shard of Vesara on them, and they will be... encouraged to find their way to me.

passages.title: Face Your Enemy
passages.text: Humans can be so malleable.

passages.title: Be More Uniform
passages.text:
Head into the foundry. Proudmoore's guards have taken over there. They will provide excellent accessories for our disguises.

I can recreate their faces, but without the clothing, we won't make it far.

Gather enough gear to cover us. 

We'll need the Captain's jacket as well. 

There will be less of a challenge at the gate if we outrank them.

passages.title: Be More Uniform
passages.text: Was the harvest successful?

passages.title: Be More Uniform
passages.text: Well done, <name>. This is going better than I expected.

passages.title: A Brilliant Distraction
passages.text:
We plan to be cautious on entry to Tol Dagor.

I imagine our exit will not be as... subtle.

That foundry to the west... I hear they made Azerite explosives there.

Stock up, we will need them.

passages.title: A Brilliant Distraction
passages.text: Did you find them all?

passages.title: A Brilliant Distraction
passages.text:
Gently...

Maybe Valtrois should take charge of these. She may be able to stabilize them another way.

passages.title: Catching a Ride
passages.text:
Nathanos should have found a boat by now.

Let us hasten to meet him in the harbor.

It behooves us to take care of this business quickly.

There are better ways for us to support the Horde's effort here.

passages.title: Catching a Ride
passages.text: This should be adequate.

passages.title: Through the Front Door
passages.text:
We would like the least amount of risk during your retrieval of Priscilla Ashvane.

You will arrive on the docks during a shift change. From there, you will prepare and enter the prison. 

Find me in Zuldazar when you are successful.

passages.title: Through the Front Door
passages.text: Your success bodes well for our future endeavors.

passages.title: Dead Reckoning
passages.text:
While I have some concerns, I cannot deny the bravery, heroism and sacrifices we have made. That you have made, <name>. Thank you for all the aid you have given to the Alliance.

The future of our ongoing war campaign is why I have asked everyone here. I wish to look at what we've done, so we can decide on the best way forward.

passages.title: Dead Reckoning
passages.text: This war may have been necessary, but it is my hope it will be over soon. Then we can begin rebuilding.

passages.title: Dead Reckoning
passages.text:
We may be on the cusp of winning but we cannot lose sight of ourselves or we will have lost what is most important and our victories will be for nothing.

I hope it will be as High Commander Wyrmbane and Master Shaw say it is and we will see a conclusion soon. Then... Then we can begin the process of rebuilding and healing - Ourselves as well as Azeroth and the Horde.

passages.title: Trouble in Gnomeregan
passages.text:
Some strange spikes of electric usage have been happening in Gnomeregan recently. We need you to investigate what is going in there as soon as possible.

We've received contact from one of the chief engineers in charge of keeping things in Gnomeregan under control, and he has offered to assist us in getting inside to see what's going on.

passages.title: Trouble in Gnomeregan
passages.text:
I don't know how this is possible! What is going on in there?! I don't have time to answer your questions or send you off on trivial tasks, there's work to be done! 

Oh, you want to go in Gnomeregan and find out what's going on? Why didn't you say so?

passages.title: Pet Battle Challenge: Gnomeregan
passages.text:
Gnomeregan's at Mayhem Level Maximum again. Those machines just don't give up, and keep coming back.

I can teleport us in there again, but all of those crazy robots are back. You sure you want this? I don't. I mean, maybe I want to watch robots smash things for some entertainment. I'm sure you will be fine. Lets go!

passages.title: Pet Battle Challenge: Gnomeregan
passages.text: I can teleport you in. Getting out might be more of a challenge.

passages.title: Pet Battle Challenge: Gnomeregan
passages.text: Someone stole a schematic from one of Thermaplugg's inventions?  This isn't good, we've heard that a mischievous group has been collecting odd parts from the Wailing Caverns and the Deadmines as well. What crazy thing could they be doing? Who is this group? We better start finding some answers, and soon.

passages.title: Changing Course
passages.text:
Champion, the time for action is upon us. 

Developments are underway that will change the course of this war. 

Report to me aboard Wind's Redemption as soon as possible.

passages.title: Changing Course
passages.text: I have news from our allies.

passages.title: Sensitive Intel
passages.text:
I've received a report from Kelsey Steelspark. She claims to have discovered something that will aid our war effort.

She's refused to go into specifics, citing a need for secrecy with such sensitive intel.

It looks like you'll need to speak to her in person. 

She's expecting you in Xibala.

passages.title: Sensitive Intel
passages.text: Take a moment to prepare yourself. I've got huge news!

passages.title: This is Huge!
passages.text:
adventurer, allow me to introduce Megs and Morton, the gnomes who are going to shake things up for the Alliance in a big way!

They've been perfecting a device that can take any ordinary animal and turn it into a humongous, unstoppable beast that we can then unleash on our enemies!

I'll let Megs and Morton fill you in on the specifics, but I promise you, this tech is a game changer!

passages.title: This is Huge!
passages.text: Wait until you hear their big plan. It's perfect!

passages.title: This is Huge!
passages.text: All up to speed, then?

passages.title: Real Big Power
passages.text:
We're still building a harness for the Embiggifier, but we need to test its core first. That's where the real power is!

This technology is years ahead of the Horde's, but it's so easy to use that even an orc could do it!

Just point and click!

passages.title: Real Big Power
passages.text: I love this part! When we get to see all our hard work pay off in a big way!

passages.title: Real Big Power
passages.text:
I thought that might happen. 

That poor clucker's mind wasn't strong enough to withstand the Embiggifier, but otherwise, it's working as intended!

passages.title: A Beast with Brains
passages.text:
For optimal results, the Embiggifier should be used on someone with substantial intellect. 

Good thing our partner is as smart as they come. 

He and his kind have been empowered by kaja'mite, granting them exceptional intelligence! 

Head up to the gorge and let Grong know we're ready to begin the embiggifying!

passages.title: A Beast with Brains
passages.text:
So the time has finally come! 

I have been awaiting this day--the day my ideas would be brought to life!

But first, I must see that the gorge will be safe after my departure.

passages.title: Out of Options
passages.text:
My kind are hunted like animals.

We've tried to reach a resolution through civil discourse, but these poachers recoil from rational thought. They revel in brutality.

I ask you, adventurer: Who are the real animals?

It pains me to descend to their level, but I fear I've exhausted all other options.

passages.title: Out of Options
passages.text: It pains me to descend to their level, but I fear I've exhausted all other options.

passages.title: Out of Options
passages.text: It's a shame we had to resort to violence, but I believe this was the only way.

passages.title: Freedom for the Da'kani
passages.text:
Have you seen the barbaric conditions to which the Da'kani are subjected? Corralled and caged, awaiting slaughter, or worse...

I cannot leave here in good faith without first seeing that my kind are liberated.

passages.title: Freedom for the Da'kani
passages.text: You are a true friend of the Da'kani.

passages.title: Bittersweet Goodbyes
passages.text:
You've helped me prepare my village for my departure, but now I must prepare myself. 

Meet me within the grotto, where I will say my farewells.

passages.title: Bittersweet Goodbyes
passages.text: I am ready.

passages.title: The Needs of the Many
passages.text:
Ever since the kaja'mite began bubbling around the gorge, I have been searching for meaning. Why was I burdened with intelligence? What is my purpose?

I have found my answers in the Embiggifier.

I was meant to help the Alliance defeat the Horde.

If I can save lives by volunteering, then my choice is clear.

The needs of the many outweigh the needs of one.

I am ready, adventurer.

passages.title: The Needs of the Many
passages.text:
You don't disappoint, <name>. Grong is the answer to all our problems.

I'll just need him to sign a few dozen documents before we get started. All standard stuff, I assure you.

passages.title: Bring the Base
passages.text:
We'll need to collect some baseline statistics before we use the Embiggifier.

Grong will be asked to perform basic tasks pertaining to speed, intelligence, and strength. 

This will help us measure the increase once he's been embiggified.

passages.title: Bring the Base
passages.text: Quite impressive, really! Grong's in superb condition.

passages.title: Fit for Grong
passages.text:
Grong is already impressively large. In fact, I don't think our Embiggifier is going to fit around his noggin without some modification. 

I'll require an ample supply of ore to make the necessary adjustments, but we're in luck. The goblins nearby have already done the work of mining it; we just need to take it off their hands!

Secure an ample amount of Azerite-infused ore, and we'll be back in business!

passages.title: Fit for Grong
passages.text: Have you acquired the ore?

passages.title: Fit for Grong
passages.text: This should help ensure the Embiggifier is a perfect fit!

passages.title: Calibrate the Core
passages.text:
The Embiggifier is nearly ready! All that's left to do is calibrate its core. 

The best way to do that without catastrophic results is to use it on things that are already dead.

This should be a simple task!

I have a hunch you excel at making things dead.

passages.title: Calibrate the Core
passages.text: Have you calibrated the core yet?

passages.title: Calibrate the Core
passages.text: The calibration is complete? Splendid!

passages.title: The Embiggining
passages.text:
I'll give you the quick rundown before we get started.

The Embiggifier is remotely controlled. 

See this big red button?

<Megs gestures to the device in her hand.> 

This jolts the wearer with a surge of power, making them bigger.

For safety reasons, you should remain here at camp. 

I think that's it! Are you ready to science?

passages.title: The Embiggining
passages.text: Let's see what Grong can do once he's been embiggified!

passages.title: The Embiggining
passages.text: Grong exceeded all our expectations. I'd say this is a resounding success.

passages.title: Total Temple Destruction
passages.text:
Grong is our greatest achievement, and he's ready to be unleashed!

The Horde is staging its troops at a temple to the north. 

Magister Umbric's portal will get you there fast. Then Grong can get to work!

passages.title: Total Temple Destruction
passages.text:
I'm not sure how I feel, <name>. 

The Embiggifier worked, but Grong won't ever be the same.

I suppose it's what he wanted, and what we need if we hope to win this war.

passages.title: A Nice Nap
passages.text:
I'm not sure how much longer those chains will hold. 

Grong's going to have to take a little nap until he's ready to be deployed.

Use this dart. It's been double-dipped in something potent enough to take down a direhorn, so it should do the trick. 

Grong would want you to be the one to do it.

passages.title: A Nice Nap
passages.text: Go ahead, use the dart on Grong. He won't feel a thing, I promise.

passages.title: A Nice Nap
passages.text: Grong will go down in history as a true hero of the Alliance.

passages.title: The Sleeper Agent
passages.text:
Your work here is done, adventurer. Morton and Megs can take it from here. 

Head back to Boralus and let Halford know we've secured the weapon. 

Don't you worry one wink about Grong. Morton and Megs will make sure he's well looked after.

passages.title: The Sleeper Agent
passages.text:
Are you certain about this? Our secret weapon is a gorilla? 

I suppose I'll just have to trust that the gnomes know what they're doing. 

Thank you for your report, <name>.

passages.title: Retaking the Outpost
passages.text:
We can handle de rest of de Alliance. I received a report that Hexlord Raal's forces are having issues up ahead.

He claims dat dere is an even thicker fog enveloping Nazmir. De Alliance must be using some tricks to slow us down.

Go to Nazmir to see what can be done to help Hexlord Raal. We must reach dat fleet and destroy de Alliance!

passages.title: Retaking the Outpost
passages.text: I wish I had better news to tell you and Princess Talanji.

passages.title: Minesweeper
passages.text:
The Alliance are stalling our efforts here with this irritating fog, as well as layering the entire area with traps.

We will suffer too many casualties if we try marching our army through this trap-infested area.

I've heard you're good at sneaking around. Use your talents to disarm the traps in this area.

I'll deal with getting the goblin's parts back from the Alliance while you disarm those traps.

passages.title: Minesweeper
passages.text: Good, we should be able to march our army now. Rokhan and I recovered enough parts for these goblins to rebuild their machine.

passages.title: Putting the Gob in Gob Squad
passages.text:
Yo! We gotta get the rest of the Gob Squad back if we wanna fix the A.F.M.O.D.!

So, our mech got trashed. It was rough. The rest of the Gob Squad are hidin' out there, waiting for word when it's safe.

Take this tracker. It'll tell ya when you're getting close to one of the squad. When you get real close, you should see 'em.

That'll tell any of the squad nearby that it's safe to come outta hidin' and come back here.

With the right goblins and parts, we'll be killing Alliance in no time!

passages.title: Putting the Gob in Gob Squad
passages.text: You didn't blow up the Gob Squad tracker, did you?

passages.title: Putting the Gob in Gob Squad
passages.text: I gotta tell ya, it feels good to get the gang back.

passages.title: Re-rebuilding the A.F.M.O.D.
passages.text:
Alright, so, we're goin' after the Alliance through this crazy fog. We gotta retake Zo'bal ruins up ahead.

We can do that real easy if we fix up our mech, A.F.M.O.D. - a flying mech of death! 

The Alliance wrecked it in their initial attack and took a bunch of its parts. Get those parts back and we'll have this thing fixed in no time!

passages.title: Re-rebuilding the A.F.M.O.D.
passages.text: You got the parts? We'll figure out what goes where when it's all done.

passages.title: Re-rebuilding the A.F.M.O.D.
passages.text: Great! We'll get this thing fixed in no time.

passages.title: It's Alive!
passages.text:
We got the A.F.M.O.D. repaired and it works perfectly! Eh, except that it's got no power.

Princess Talanji seems like she can help us out with this. Ask her if she can give the mech a jumpstart!

Once we're set, we can use this thing to mow down the Alliance, take back Zul'jan ruins, and push forward to blow up that fleet!

passages.title: It's Alive!
passages.text: Uh, can we get this thing started or what?

passages.title: It's Alive!
passages.text: Hahaha! Now it's time to show these guys how we roll.

passages.title: The Battle of Zul'jan Ruins
passages.text:
General Rakera has pushed forward with de army. Raal and his forces are still grounded until we remove dis fog.

You must pilot de A.F.M.O.D. and help our forces retake Zul'jan ruins. Only den can we move ahead to stop de Alliance and dis fog.

Rokhan, and I will join you. De Alliance must see dat our victory is swift and decisive. 

I would have our enemies cower before us when dey meet dere ends. Such is de price for defiling our lands.

passages.title: The Battle of Zul'jan Ruins
passages.text:
De last time I was in Zul'jan, we had an army cobbled together from our allies in Nazmir.

Now, we have de full force of my empire and de Horde. Let us march forward!

passages.title: Mission Report: The Great Seal
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at The Great Seal.

It details that the mission was a success and that a Mission Command Table has been constructed.

Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

passages.title: Mission Report: The Great Seal
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to The Great Seal?

passages.title: Mission Report: The Great Seal
passages.text: It seems the mission at The Great Seal was a success. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Outpost Upgrade: The Great Seal
passages.text:
The mission at The Great Seal was a success. Well done, <name>.

A Mission Command Table is now ready for use.

Travel to The Great Seal and see that the troops quality of work is up to our standard.

passages.title: Mission Report: Zul'jan Ruins
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Zul'jan Ruins.

It details that the mission was a success and that the power of the Loa has increased, allowing for Boons to persist longer.

Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

passages.title: Mission Report: Zul'jan Ruins
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Zul'jan Ruins?

passages.title: Mission Report: Zul'jan Ruins
passages.text: It seems the mission at Zul'jan Ruins was a success. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Outpost Upgrade: Zul'jan Ruins
We Have Them Cornered
passages.text:
General Rakera has already begun mobilizing our forces to our next target: Zalamar.

Once we destroy de Alliance dere, we can push forward to de coast and destroy de source of dis fog.

De Alliance will have nowhere to hide. We will surround their fleet and end dis war, once for all.

Dey will wish dey never stepped foot in Nazmir.

Come. We shall ride together to Zalamar and ensure our victory!

passages.title: We Have Them Cornered
passages.text: We must move!

passages.title: We Have Them Cornered
passages.text: We have de Alliance forces cornered. We must finish dem off.

passages.title: Zandalari Justice
passages.text:
We must wipe out whatever is left of de Alliance in Zalamar. Den we can find de source of dis fog and dere fleet.

Rokhan will scout ahead to find dis Telaamon. He appears to be de general leading de forces here.

I need you to go in and wipe out de Alliance forces within Zalamar so dat we can crush dem once and for all.

Find Rokhan in Zalamar after dey have been weakened.

passages.title: Zandalari Justice
passages.text: We must keep up de pressure on de Alliance.

passages.title: Zandalari Justice
passages.text: I be dealin' with de Alliance down here. I woulda thought dey be bringin' more soldiers ta de party.

passages.title: Mission Report: Vulpera Hideaway
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at the Vulpera Hideaway.

It details that the mission was a success and that a Caravan is now available for use.

Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

passages.title: Mission Report: Vulpera Hideaway
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Vulpera Hideaway?

passages.title: Mission Report: Vulpera Hideaway
passages.text: It seems the mission at Vulpera Hideaway was a success. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Outpost Upgrade: Vulpera Hideaway
passages.text:
The mission at Vulpera Hideaway was a success. Well done, <name>.

The Caravan Master is very thankful for our assistance and ready to return the favor.

Travel to Vulpera Hideaway and speak with the Caravan Master to see what he can do for you.

passages.title: Outpost Upgrade: Vulpera Hideaway
passages.text:
You better believe I'm glad to be out of the hands of the Faithless! Thank you so much!

If you ever need to ride in a Caravan, you be sure to let me know. 

In fact, here, have one now!

passages.title: Mission Report: Brennadam
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Brennadam.

It details that they were successful in gaining access to a Harvester mount.

Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

passages.title: Mission Report: Brennadam
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Brennadam?

passages.title: Mission Report: Brennadam
passages.text:
It seems the mission to enhance our outpost at Brennadam was a success. Well done, <name>.

I will send you to oversee the upgrade yourself.

passages.title: Outpost Upgrade: Brennadam
passages.text:
The mission at Brennadam was a success. Well done, <name>.

We now have access to what's rumored to be a very fast Harvester that you are able to ride. Sounds strange to me, but what do I know?

Travel to Brennadam and enquire about this upgrade.

passages.title: Outpost Upgrade: Brennadam
passages.text:
Well, sure, it don't look like much but hooo-boy when it goes it really goes!

Want to take it for a spin?

passages.title: None Shall Escape
passages.text:
De Alliance are using de Dark Iron's mole machines to transport troops in and out of Zalamar.

We need dose machines destroyed. We are going to establish Zalamar as our forward base to attack de Alliance's main fleet.

Take out dem machines, den find Rokhan within Zalamar. He be tracking down where de Alliance general be hidin'.

passages.title: None Shall Escape
passages.text: With dem mole machines destroyed, we be able ta make a base in dis place ta fight de Alliance fleet.

passages.title: Breaking Mirrors
passages.text:
We have reports dat Telaamon, de Lightforged in charge of dis attack, can create mirror images of himself to strike us down.

Two Zandalari, Witch Doctor Kejabu and Jo'chunga, have offered to go in and help fight his mirror images. 

I want you to ensure dey survive.

Eliminating dese strange images should make Telaamon weaker, allowing you and Rokhan to slay him.

passages.title: Breaking Mirrors
passages.text: Are de Zandalari safe?

passages.title: Breaking Mirrors
passages.text: It be good ta be seein' Jo'chunga and Kejabu again. We gonna need all de help we can get against dis Telaamon.

passages.title: Telaamon's Purge
passages.text:
Telaamon, de Lightbringer leadin' dis assault, be in Hir'eek's cave. He must be thinkin' he can take us all by himself.

When he is dead, we be sendin' dis assault force into chaos, allowin' us ta be marchin' on de Alliance along de shore.

And hopefully, we can be findin' de source of de fog and destroyin' it.

Da three of us be ambushin' Telaamon once ya start fightin'. He ain't gettin' outta here alive.

passages.title: Telaamon's Purge
passages.text: Telaamon be defeated. We best get movin'.

passages.title: Parting Mists
passages.text:
It be time ta face de main Alliance fleet. Dey be on da beachhead nearby.

I can be feelin' da dark voodoo from dat fog nearby. Princess Talanji be wantin' ta destroy dat mojo as soon as we can.

I can be gettin' us outta dis cave real fast, den we be ridin' with da princess and Rakera ta put an end ta all dis.

passages.title: Parting Mists
passages.text: I do not like dis, <name>. We must investigate further.

passages.title: Trouble in Gnomeregan
passages.text:
Our engineers have reported surges of electric usage in Gnomeregan recently. We need you to investigate what is going in there as soon as possible.

We made contact with one of the chief engineers in charge of keeping the robots in Gnomeregan under control, and he has offered to assist us in getting inside to see what's going on.

passages.title: Trouble in Gnomeregan
passages.text:
I don't know how this is possible! What is going on in there?! I don't have time to answer your questions or send you off on trivial tasks, there's work to be done! 

Oh, you want to go in Gnomeregan and find out what's going on? Why didn't you say so?

passages.title: Fly Out to Meet Them
passages.text:
De Alliance scum will pay for dis! Our army is moving as fast as it can to defend our city.

Ride with Raal to get back to de entrance to our city. We must stop de Alliance!

passages.title: Fly Out to Meet Them
passages.text: We cannot go further, de Alliance are swarming my city!

passages.title: Mission Report: Castaway Point
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Castaway Point.

It details that they were successful in gaining access to an extremely large cannon.

Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

passages.title: Mission Report: Castaway Point
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Castaway Point?

passages.title: Mission Report: Castaway Point
passages.text:
It seems the mission to enhance our outpost at Castaway Point was a success. Well done, <name>.

I will send you to oversee the upgrade yourself.

passages.title: Outpost Upgrade: Castaway Point
passages.text:
The mission at Castaway Point was a success. Well done, <name>.

We now have access to a very large cannon which promises to be a fast way to travel to Tiragarde Sound. Glad that's not how I plan to get around.

Travel to Castaway Point and enquire about this upgrade.

passages.title: Outpost Upgrade: Castaway Point
passages.text:
Ain't she a beauty? I know its unusual, but this baby here can get you quick smart to Tiragarde Sound. 

Want to give her a shot?

passages.title: Breaking the Faith
passages.text:
De faithful are among de most revered in Zandalari society. They are an example for others to aspire to. This is not de example we want others to follow.

We must respond in kind.

Princess Talanji wishes for us to spare them that will see reason. Do so, if you can find any willing to surrender.

For de rest, give them a swift death.

passages.title: Breaking the Faith
passages.text: De faithful among us are meant to be de example others must follow. In turn, we must make an example of them when they fail.

passages.title: Talanji's Mercy
passages.text:
I know my priests, <name>. Such an uproar did not appear out of thin air.

There is much I have to atone for, but I am not yet ruler. I have not had de time to do what is needed for de faithful of Zandalar. That does not mean they deserve to suffer.

Go into de Terrace of de Chosen and find them that refuse to fight. See that they get out safely. I will hold none of them accountable for de actions of others.

passages.title: Talanji's Mercy
passages.text: De people of Zandalar are my first priority, <name>.

passages.title: Talanji's Mercy
passages.text: It is a weight off my mind. Thank you.

passages.title: The Fall of Zuldazar
passages.text:
It's time, <name>. We have the Abyssal Scepter, along with confirmation that the bombs placed amongst the Zandalari fleet are still active.

Unfortunately, even with everything at our disposal, we would still lose a frontal assault against the Zandalari empire.

For that reason, we plan to lure the forces of the Horde and the Zandalari away from the harbor.

Mathias Shaw is holding a meeting nearby, and he has requested your presence.

passages.title: The Fall of Zuldazar
passages.text: I take it you and the Lord Admiral were able to send the Horde packing?

passages.title: The Fall of Zuldazar
passages.text: Now you know the gravity of the situation. We must begin.

passages.title: The March to Nazmir
passages.text:
Greetings, <name>. I am Blademaster Telaamon, and I have volunteered to lead this mission against the Horde.

Our forces will be gathering off the coast of Nazmir. Go now and we shall all meet there.

If all goes according to plan, we will lure the Horde away from Zandalar and bring an end to this war.

passages.title: The March to Nazmir
passages.text: We're all here. Let's begin.

passages.title: Mission Report: Arom's Stand
passages.text:
Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Arom's Stand.

It details that they were successful in gaining access to a blessing from the Order of Embers.

Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

passages.title: Mission Report: Arom's Stand
passages.text: Do you have news regarding the mission to Arom's Stand?

passages.title: Mission Report: Arom's Stand
passages.text:
It seems the mission to enhance our outpost at Arom's Stand was a success. Well done, <name>.

I will send you to oversee this yourself.

passages.title: Outpost Upgrade: Arom's Stand
passages.text:
The mission at Arom's Stand was a success. Well done, <name>.

We now have access to a blessing from the Order of Embers.

Travel to Arom's Stand and enquire about this blessing.

passages.title: Outpost Upgrade: Arom's Stand
passages.text: Yes of course, you have done so much for us, the least we can do is grant you our blessing.

passages.title: Repurposing Their Village
passages.text:
Myself and Shaw will provide support for Telaamon's army until our distraction is set up.

First, we need to clear the blood trolls out of their nearby village, Zalamar, in order to move our army forward.

That's where you come in. We need you to assault the blood trolls there to weaken their forces, then our army will arrive.

Telaamon will be on site to help you, meet with him once you've weakened their forces. 

I will be here with Shaw ensuring our forces aren't seen.

passages.title: Repurposing Their Village
passages.text: We must move, time is of the essence.

passages.title: Repurposing Their Village
passages.text: How many did you kill? Hrm... seems as if we are at the same number. Good work.

passages.title: Fog of War
passages.text:
Do not mind this, I am finishing off this insect. You have bigger matters to handle.

Our army is moving within Zalamar as we speak. But the Horde will know our army's true size without aid.

Speak with Brother Pike and have him perform the ritual with the Abyssal Scepter to cover Nazmir in a thick fog.

He claims the illusion will also mimic an entire fleet off the beach. Let us hope he is right.

I will join you once I finish with this stain upon Azeroth.

passages.title: Fog of War
passages.text: We don't have time to discuss this, <name>. We must begin.

passages.title: Fog of War
passages.text: We have our fog, now we have to move.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Winter's Kiss
passages.text: I'll make sure ta put dese ta good use.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Enchant Ring - Seal of Haste
passages.text: Dese will do nicely.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Enchant Ring - Seal of Mastery
passages.text: Tank you kindly.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Contract: The Honorbound
passages.text: These will ensure that those we hire will be bound by more than just words.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Masterful Kubiline
passages.text: Very generous of you.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Star Moss
passages.text: There is no such thing as too much star moss. It is better to maintain a strong supply than be left wanting.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Star Moss
passages.text: How thoughtful of you.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Unstable Temporal Time Shifter
passages.text:
It's time we snuff out the competition, don't you agree? With your help we can ensure our allies receive the necessary goods and armor to prepare for the battle to come.

Let's make sure our allies are well prepared.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Unstable Temporal Time Shifter
passages.text: Our healers are spread thin and we need alternative methods to handle our fallen troops.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Unstable Temporal Time Shifter
passages.text: Quite an offering. Thank you.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Electroshock Mount Motivator
passages.text:
I'll keep it simple: we need more Shimmerscale!

I apologize for being so forward with you, but there's little time to waste.

If you happen upon this item throughout your travels I'd be more than happy to put it to good use. Outfitting our allies is of the utmost importance in the battle to come, don't you agree?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Electroshock Mount Motivator
passages.text: Outfitting our allies is of the utmost importance. This provides us the necessary materials to ensure no one is left lagging behind on the battlefield.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Electroshock Mount Motivator
passages.text: With your help, our troops will be ready to rush into battle!

passages.title: Shifting Gears
passages.text:
<name>! The Alliance has made a new request for Gnomeregan's might.

Captain Sparknozzle wishes for your expert assistance in the matter.

He'll be waiting for you in New Tinkertown, outside of Gnomeregan.

passages.title: Shifting Gears
passages.text: The rest of the gnomes I requested arrived shortly before you. Allow me to brief you on the situation.

passages.title: Dark Iron Machinations
passages.text:
We have some additional support for our plan to deceive the Horde and assault the Blood Gates, but we need your help.

The Dark Iron dwarves have several mole machines waiting to erupt and supply fresh troops.

I've determined several spots within Zalamar that would be perfect for them to use.

Take this device and plant it in the following areas. It will send a message to the Dark Iron dwarves to erupt from there.

They will stay safely in their machines until our army arrives.

passages.title: Dark Iron Machinations
passages.text: Excellent! We are one more step closer to purging the Horde.

passages.title: Lurking in the Swamp
passages.text:
We have Zalamar, and we've got our fog. Now, we have to take the attack to the Horde.

Our goal is to take as much land in Nazmir as possible to make the Horde think our main fleet is here.

The first target is Zul'jan ruins, one of the Horde's main bases in Nazmir.

We'll have to make our way through the swamps to our attack position. Meet us there.

passages.title: Lurking in the Swamp
passages.text: We've made it and still maintain the element of surprise.

passages.title: Zul'jan Deluge
passages.text:
Through the mists is Zul'jan ruins, a major Horde outpost in Nazmir. We need to take it over to help our forces push forward.

The Horde needs to believe a large Alliance army is here, so we're going to throw everything we've got at taking the ruins.

Our army will charge forward to attack, while you join them using my water elemental.

Meet me outside of the ruins when you're done, we'll need to keep pushing forward.

passages.title: Zul'jan Deluge
passages.text: Good work, our forces have taken over Zu'jan ruins. We're almost to our main destination.

passages.title: Warfront Preparations
passages.text:
We must make our preparations. 

Return to Zandalar immediately and rally our forces. Any contributions to our cause must be made.

Go. We will hold for now.

passages.title: Warfront Preparations
passages.text: Welcome back to Zuldazar. We will rally at your side!

passages.title: Showing Our Might
passages.text:
We are within reach of the Blood Gate in Zandalar. Once we take that, the Horde and Zandalari will believe our full invasion has begun.

Our forces have already engaged the Zandalari within the Fallen Outpost. We'll need your help to push them back.

I'll be focusing on finishing off what remains of the Horde and Zandalari back in Zul'jan ruins.

passages.title: Showing Our Might
passages.text: We've taken Zul'jan ruins, and with your help our army will finish off the remaining Zandalari here.

passages.title: The Mech of Death
passages.text:
We have reports of a goblin machine causing havoc among our troops up ahead. They call it the A.M.O.D.

It is a crude machine compared to what the Lightforged have aboard the Vindicaar.

Together, you and I will bring down this machine. Go, I will await for you near the machine and engage it when you are ready.

passages.title: The Mech of Death
passages.text: You fought well! It is a shame we must part soon, I would have enjoyed fighting side by side with you.

passages.title: Quelling the Masses
passages.text:
One of my own in de Rastari has seen fit to rile de drudges and guards in de Zocalo.

They threaten de stability of our empire with this foolishness. If they are angry, we can address it. But this wanton destruction will not stand.

Go down into de market of de Zocalo and bring about calm however you can. Choose de method that works for you.

I care only for de result: Peace, so Talanji can finally be crowned.

passages.title: Quelling the Masses
passages.text: I hope we are not too late to stop this unrest from growing.

passages.title: Taming their Beasts
passages.text:
Our goal is to assault the Blood Gate, but to be blunt, we don't have the force necessary for this.

That's why we have gnomish technology. The Zandalari have battle beasts, direhorns mounted with powerful weapons.

Several of these beasts are resting within the Fallen Outpost. This device, the Re-Discombobulator, will give us control over these animals. 

Take this device and use it on these battle beasts. We'll assault the Blood Gates once we have them under our control.

passages.title: Taming their Beasts
passages.text: Good work, these beasts will be imperative to take the Blood Gate.

passages.title: A Shady Character
passages.text:
Your followers tell of a smuggler of wit and guile, who was able to charm them with stories of lands far and wide.

Though it cost a fair sum to retrieve, they managed to obtain a token which when displayed to the smuggler, will allow the bearer to purchase his wares.

passages.title: A Shady Character
passages.text: Do you really think you should be talking to me?

passages.title: A Shady Character
passages.text:
Well alright then, looks like you check out.

Yea I got pets, they aren't easy to come by though, so don't expect me to give them away.

passages.title: Orders from Azshara
passages.text:
This medallion is inscribed with orders commanding the naga to invade our shores and seize artifacts of power.

<Kojo studies you thoughtfully.>

I've heard tales of a priest who used a horrifying dagger to fight the Burning Legion. It is said this blade... Xal'atath... whispers secrets of the deep. It might be our best chance of uncovering what the naga seek.

I recently came upon a makeshift naga altar in Atal'Gral. If you take Xal'atath there, the dagger may reveal crucial information.

passages.title: Orders from Azshara
passages.text:
<You feel a familiar sensation as Xal'atath reaches out to your mind.

A beguiling blend of dread... and delight.>

passages.title: Wisp'd Into Shape
passages.text:
We're off to a good start, but we're going to need more wood if we want to win this battle!

The Horde has set up a lumber mill to the north of Bashal'Aran, past Forlorn Crossing. If we take it, we can stop them from destroying the forest while also getting the wisps to help us out.

It's a two-for-one!

passages.title: Wisp'd Into Shape
passages.text: We need that additional wood from Cinderfall!

passages.title: Wisp'd Into Shape
passages.text: The wisps will do their part from here!

passages.title: Crucible of Storms: Relics of Shadow
passages.text:
Your intention to stop the naga attacks was noble, <name>. But that shadowy dagger tricked you into delivering powerful relics into the hands of a great enemy.

No doubt those artifacts will be well defended. Gather your allies, <class>, and return to the Crucible of Storms.

Defeat any opponents that stand in your way. Ensure the relics cannot be used against the Alliance.

The naga cannot be allowed to summon their storm... or to call forth something even worse.

passages.title: Crucible of Storms: Relics of Shadow
passages.text:
I am pleased that you defeated N'Zoth's minions, <name>. But I feel in my bones that this danger is far from over.

Remain on your guard, champion. Once an Old God fixes his gaze upon you, dark times are sure to follow.

passages.title: Crucible of Storms: Relics of Shadow
passages.text:
Your intention to stop de naga attacks was noble, <name>. But de talking dagger tricked you into delivering powerful relics into de hands of our enemies.

No doubt dese artifacts will be well defended. Gather your allies, <class>, and return to de Crucible of Storms.

Defeat any opponents dat stand in your way. Ensure dese relics cannot be used against de Horde.

And if any shadowy weapons ask you to do favors for dem in de future... I suggest you decline.

passages.title: Crucible of Storms: Relics of Shadow
passages.text:
I am pleased dat you defeated N'Zoth's minions, <name>. But something tells me de danger is far from over.

Remain on your guard, champion. I fear de Old God will be keeping his eye on you.

passages.title: A Shady Character
passages.text:
Your followers tell of a smuggler of wit and guile, who was able to charm them with stories of lands far and wide.

Though it cost a fair sum to retrieve, they managed to obtain a token which when displayed to the smuggler, will allow the bearer to purchase his wares.

passages.title: A Shady Character
passages.text: Do you really think you should be talking to me?

passages.title: A Shady Character
passages.text:
Well alright then, looks like you check out.

Yea I got pets, they aren't easy to come by though, so don't expect me to give them away.

passages.title: He Who Walks in the Light
passages.text:
Shaw reports that Zandalari scouts have been dispatched to alert of our "full assault". 

We did it, <name>. The Horde and Zandalari will throw their armies at our forces within Nazmir.

We cannot let their sacrifice be in vain. We must get back to Boralus and let Halford know it's time to strike.

Come, I'll create a portal for us to leave, once we say one final word to Telaamon.

passages.title: He Who Walks in the Light
passages.text: Telaamon's sacrifice will be remembered, but for now, we must move.

passages.title: Expanding our Influence
passages.text:
As we expand the War Effort on the enemy continent we are finding ideal locations to establish new outposts, and even upgrade our current ones.

Once secure, these outposts will allow us to utilize a new flight network to quickly and easily navigate the area.

passages.title: Expanding our Influence
passages.text:
I have many Scouting Reports and Outpost Upgrades available for you to purchase. These will allow you to unlock new outposts, flight paths and upgrades on both continents.

Once you have chosen a Scouting Report or Outpost Upgrade, use your Mission Command Table and instruct your troops to complete the mission.

passages.title: Expanding our Influence
passages.text:
As we expand the War Effort on the enemy continent we are finding ideal locations to establish new outposts, and even upgrade our current ones.

Once secure, these outposts will allow us to utilize a new flight network to quickly and easily navigate the area.

passages.title: Expanding our Influence
passages.text:
I have many Scouting Reports and Outpost Upgrades available for you to purchase. These will allow you to unlock new outposts, flight paths and upgrades on both continents.

Once you have chosen a Scouting Report or Outpost Upgrade, use your Mission Command Table and instruct your troops to complete the mission.

passages.title: Mischief Managed
passages.text:
Thank you for returning this artifact to us, <name>. Now that we have the Abyssal Scepter, the fleet can advance without fear of the seas being turned against us.

Please report our success to High Commander Wyrmbane.

passages.title: Mischief Managed
passages.text: Excellent! The Horde having access to the Abyssal Scepter was a point of concern for us. Now that we've recovered it, not only can we move forward with our final plans, we've once more strengthened our friendship with the Kul Tirans.

passages.title: Zero Zeppelins
passages.text:
The Horde zeppelins proved to be problematic for our forces here. I tried to construct something quickly, but while the weapon had power, it didn't have the range necessary to take them out.

The Lord Admiral has provided us with an expedient solution to the problem!

Use this jury-rigged hand cannon on the zeppelins. A quick application of high energy and heat will cause thermal shock and critical failure!

To simplify, blow them up while they're grounded!

passages.title: Zero Zeppelins
passages.text: If you could take out those Zeppelins before they can thaw and fly out of range, we'd be assured of victory!

passages.title: Zero Zeppelins
passages.text: Ha! The Horde's air forces aren't so superior now, are they?

passages.title: Squad Goals
passages.text:
My patrol squad fought off the Horde so Galeheart and I could fly free. I have to stay with the Lord Admiral, so I can't look for them on my own. With any luck, they're out there fighting and waiting for reinforcements.

Well, we're here to help save them. Would you find the rest of my patrol squad for me?

passages.title: Squad Goals
passages.text:
They fought like Outriggers when the Horde showed up. True Kul Tiran steel, one and all. 

I'll see to it the injured are protected until we can get out and I'll give the able-bodied ones some blades. 

I imagine they'll want to repay the Horde for the loss of their friend.

passages.title: Free Plumeria!
passages.text:
My poor Plumeria has been captured by an exceptionally brutal villain. He has been overseeing the spread of pestilence along the wharf.

Rosaline needs my mechanical expertise in fixing our weapons. Would you free my poor Plumeria and slay the vile knight tormenting her?

passages.title: Free Plumeria!
passages.text: I cannot thank you enough for the timely rescue of my gryphon and for removing the vile monster who was torturing her.

passages.title: Gnomeregan's Finest
passages.text:
