passages.title: Blueprint: Perfectly Timed Differential
passages.text:
<This blueprint details how to build what appears to be an exceptionally intricate gear train.

You should be able to upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database in Rustbolt.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Perfectly Timed Differential
passages.text:
Have you recovered a new blueprint, my fleshy friend?

I will add it to my database posthaste.

passages.title: Blueprint: Anti-Gravity Pack
passages.text:
<This blueprint details how to build what appears to be a kind of high-tech jetpack.

You should be able to upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database in Rustbolt.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Anti-Gravity Pack
passages.text:
Have you recovered a new blueprint, my fleshy friend?

I will add it to my database posthaste.

passages.title: Blueprint: Rustbolt Pocket Turret
passages.text:
<This blueprint details how to build what appears to be a tiny flame turret.

You should be able to upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database in Rustbolt.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Rustbolt Pocket Turret
passages.text:
Have you recovered a new blueprint, my fleshy friend?

I will add it to my database posthaste.

passages.title: Blueprint: Annoy-o-Tron Gang
passages.text:
<This blueprint details how to build what appears to be a barrel... stuffed with tiny robots?

You should be able to upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database in Rustbolt.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Annoy-o-Tron Gang
passages.text:
Have you recovered a new blueprint, my fleshy friend?

I will add it to my database posthaste.

passages.title: Blueprint: Encrypted Black Market Radio
passages.text:
<This blueprint details how to build what appears to be a highly encrypted radio transmitter.

You should be able to upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database in Rustbolt.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Encrypted Black Market Radio
passages.text:
Have you recovered a new blueprint, my fleshy friend?

I will add it to my database posthaste.

passages.title: The Gathering Storm
passages.text:
While I deal with the naga incursions, Lady Proudmoore is going to take on handling the Horde in Stormsong Valley and figuring out what happened to our spies there.

You'll find her near Proudmoore Keep.

passages.title: The Gathering Storm
passages.text: It appears the Horde activity in Stormsong Valley is more serious than we originally thought.

passages.title: Lost in the Field
passages.text:
When Shaw and I got here we discovered most of our operatives were dead. Most, but not all. 

Go into the field and get any of our operatives out of there. They might have more intel on what the Horde are planning here in Warfang Hold.

passages.title: Lost in the Field
passages.text: Our people stumbled onto something really big out here!

passages.title: Shaw's Shank Redemption
passages.text:
Hmm. Shaw said he'd check in when we got communications back but he hasn't. He's probably run into the same trouble the rest of our spies did.

I'll stay here and guard the listening post. You find Shaw. He was headed for the cliff above Warfang Hold near the top of the waterfall. The peons called that area "The Screaming Pit" for some reason. I bet it's a real pleasant place.

Stab whatever he's fighting for me, okay?

passages.title: Shaw's Shank Redemption
passages.text: Just in time, <name>.

passages.title: Shaw's Shank Redemption
passages.text: They've increased security here beyond anything we expected, and with good reason.

passages.title: A Gathering of Foes
passages.text:
Before I was distracted, I was able to find out more about this Horde gathering. Sylvanas has summoned the leaders of the Horde and its allies. For what purpose, I cannot say.

We aren't in a position to strike her down--she is too well-protected. But perhaps we can learn something that will prove useful in the ongoing war.

Keep your head low and take a look. I'll keep an eye out for more guards.

passages.title: A Gathering of Foes
passages.text:
I cannot help but pity Baine. Honor such as his has lost its value in the Horde.

Sylvanas has made a bold move. We'll go after her, but she's cunning. We need to push back the naga and gather our forces for a final strike.

passages.title: Disruption of Power
passages.text:
The naga tap into the power within nearby ley lines and have found a way to harness it.

Destroy their devices before they can put that power to use against us.

passages.title: Disruption of Power
passages.text: Hopefully we will never find out what they were drawing in such power for.

passages.title: Stay Low, Stay Fast!
passages.text:
It's a straight shot home. We just need to be careful.

Neri's rule of survival number six: always be prepared!

Let's go!

passages.title: Stay Low, Stay Fast!
passages.text: Finally, some small relief. But we must not rest easy; Azshara surely has more in store for us than she lets on.

passages.title: Upheaval
passages.text:
So many lives lost... And the attacks from the naga are relentless!

I apologize, adventurer. This attitude is unbecoming of a king.

We have no time to lose musing of our own plight.

Let us meet with Jaina and descend from this perilous place into the unknown.

passages.title: Upheaval
passages.text: Finally, some good news. Our champion awakens from the chaos.

passages.title: TBD NOT USED
passages.text:
The fabled workbench of Rustbolt - MY workbench - has fallen into disrepair!

This tragedy was no doubt caused by the same ruffians and miscreants who kidnapped me and Princess Wiggles.

The VERY same ruffians and miscreants, in fact, who still show their faces in this very town on the regular.

Their presence here is a veritable slap to our collective faces!

Dispatch the snatchers quickly and recover my binder of blueprints. We may then commence crafting what we shall need to repair this.

passages.title: Junkyard Tinkering and You
passages.text:
Behold, the fabled Pascal Workshop of Rustbolt -- MY workshop!

Countless inventions have sprung forth into existence on this very spot, including my very finest invention, Pascal-K1N6!

Pascal-K1N6 can craft anything... as long as you have the blueprints for it.

And since I have you to thank for the K1N6's safe return to Rustbolt, would you like to learn how to access his blueprints database?

passages.title: Junkyard Tinkering and You
passages.text: Remember, you can collect Spare Parts from almost anything on Mechagon.

passages.title: Junkyard Tinkering and You
passages.text:
Pascal-K1N6 is a marvel of junkyard tinkering! A wonder of the modern age!

Did I mention that I invented him myself? Of course I did.

passages.title: Ideas Can Come from Anywhere
passages.text:
I didn't notice the tinkerer's spark in you when we first met.

But look at all of the blueprints you've recovered and uploaded to Pascal-K1N6's database.

I was wrong. And happily so, my budding junkyard tinkering apprentice!

But this is a dangerous moment in your creative development.

You must avoid complacency!

Take time off to find new ideas. Speak with builders that inspire you, reverse-engineer bots on the island, and be open to new ideas - no matter where they come from!

passages.title: Ideas Can Come from Anywhere
passages.text:
I see it! The spark of new ideas in your eyes...

You've returned from your travels fresh and ready to brainstorm some blueprints!

I have too. Let's discuss.

passages.title: Getting a Clue
passages.text:
I'm betting that one page of jibberish is a coded message. We can send it back to Stormwind to be cracked by our codebreakers or we could break some heads and find the cipher here.

I'm thinking we'll just save some time and do that.

The guy in charge here probably has what we're looking for. Why don't you take him out and see if you can't find it. Even if you don't, without a leader the loyalists won't be much trouble. It's a win-win!

Well, for us I guess.

passages.title: Getting a Clue
passages.text: Did you find a cipher? Or some kind of decoding gadget?

passages.title: Getting a Clue
passages.text:
A decoder ring? Can't go wrong with the classics I guess.

<Kelsey uses the ring to decode the message.>

This is from Ashvane alright. The date on here is pretty old though. The "patron" she mentions is something they're gonna want to hear about back in Boralus.

passages.title: Correspondence Conundrum
passages.text:
I think Ashvane has been in contact with her loyalists, but I don't know what their orders are.

Go into their camp and see if you can't read their mail. We might find something that leads back to where Lady Ashvane is hiding or what their next move is going to be.

passages.title: Correspondence Conundrum
passages.text:
A recipe, a personal letter.... a grocery list? Oh! Yeah, this is a coded communication. Hmmm

<Kelsey rubs her chin and idly flips one of her knives as she thinks>

I'm betting whoever is in charge here has the cipher. Why don't you go pay them a visit and get it for us.

passages.title: Loose Ends
passages.text:
Our campaign against the Horde is going strong, but there are some loose threads to take care of.

Lady Ashvane was broken out of Tol Dagor - by the Horde. We don't know where she's gone or what she is planning. I sent Kelsey out to track down some Ashvane Loyalists to get answers. She found them and has requested backup.

She's waiting for you in Freehold.

passages.title: Loose Ends
passages.text:
I found a whole nest of these guys!

You ready to help me take 'em out?

passages.title: Reporting In!
passages.text:
Well it looks like Ashvane's been out of contact for some time but this 'Patron' thing could be a problem.

You did excellent work today, <name>. Those Loyalists aren't going to be thinking about causing trouble for awhile, heh.

I'll make my way back. You take the letter to the High Commander.

passages.title: Reporting In!
passages.text: Did you find anything on Ashvane?

passages.title: Reporting In!
passages.text:
<Wyrmbane gestures to the letter>

If this was Ashvane's last communication, perhaps her meeting with this mysterious "patron" of hers did not go as she planned.

We'll keep an eye on this. In the meantime, perhaps you'd better speak with our... guest.

passages.title: Righting Wrongs
passages.text:
Champion! I come with an urgent request from Baine Bloodhoof. He asks that you meet him at Plunder Harbor to help him with a... sensitive situation.

You must tell no one of this request, <class>. 

Ancestors watch over you.

passages.title: Righting Wrongs
passages.text:
You're here.

Good, now we can proceed.

passages.title: Her Dog Days Are Over
passages.text:
<The Wicker Beast gently nudges the dog's body with its snout.

The creature whines plaintively and moves to your side.

It gives a hopeful twitch of its bony tail.>

passages.title: Her Dog Days Are Over
passages.text: What's this...? I see you found my keys, but...

passages.title: Her Dog Days Are Over
passages.text: Oh... Oh tides below... no...

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Hi. I'm Ambassador Blackguard.

I am honored to welcome you to Orgrimmar, <race>.

<He smiles unconvincingly.>

As a lifetime of adventure unfolds before you, be assured that... uh...

You know what? I've been saying this same greeting all day. Enough's enough.

Talk to Chromie on top of the hourglass, then talk to your emissary. Run along.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: Dis land is much less... fertile than Zandalar.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
So dis is it. We begin our adventures to bring honor to the Zandalari and de Horde!

Loa be with you, <name>.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Welcome to Stormwind, <race>. I invite you to explore our fair city. Since you hail from Kul Tiras, might I suggest visiting our lovely docks? They are home to our majestic fleet. I would be shocked if you were not impressed!

Ah, but that can wait, a bronze dragon has asked to talk to you. She is sitting under the nearby tree, on an hourglass of all things!

After that, an emissary of Kul Tiras is waiting to welcome you to the city. Sounds like a busy day for you!

Have a pleasant stay.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: Enjoying your stay in Stormwind?

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: Wherever you venture, know that Kul Tiras is behind you.

passages.title: Collaborative Construction
passages.text:
Construction projects can be found all over the island. You'll be able to build some of 'em yourself, but you're gonna need help with the bigger projects.

Ask around and see what others are already working on, or just head out on your own and find a project you're interested in.

Construction projects move around and even change day-to-day, so keep an eye out for new ones while you're exploring.

If you're ever curious what construction projects are available on a given day, just ask me!

passages.title: Collaborative Construction
passages.text:
Ah, I remember my first construction project...

<Waren sighs wistfully.>

I wonder where I put that steam-powered pacifier?

passages.title: Spy Versus Spy
passages.text:
Naga attacks are on the rise, but that isn't all we have to deal with. We've received word of increased Horde activity near Warfang Hold in Stormsong Valley.

Send some of our operatives to investigate what they are doing.

passages.title: Spy Versus Spy
passages.text: Hopefully we can gather information on what they're up to in Stormsong Valley.

passages.title: Spy Versus Spy
passages.text: Damn. Most of our spies haven't made their scheduled check-ins. Whatever the Horde is doing I doubt it bodes well for us.

passages.title: Where the Road Leads
passages.text:
My people know many secrets about this place. If you prove yourselves worthy allies, you will be privy to them.

First, we must regroup in Mezzamere. There, we at least have a foothold against the tide.

passages.title: Where the Road Leads
passages.text: So far, these ankoan have proven themselves formidable allies.

passages.title: Tearing at the Seams
passages.text:
I feel odd... weak. As though something is affecting my very existence.

Would you come with me, <name>? I may need your help. At the very least, you could be a witness to whatever happens should something dire occur.

passages.title: Tearing at the Seams
passages.text: Well, this doesn't look good...

passages.title: Retaliation Coordination
passages.text:
Master Shaw deployed a number of Alliance spies near a base the Horde have made in Stormsong Valley. When our spies stopped checking in, he took Kelsey Steelspark and went to investigate. 

Now Master Shaw is the one who hasn't checked in.

I need someone to go in and find our missing people and give them whatever help they clearly need.

passages.title: Retaliation Coordination
passages.text:
We knew someone would come when we missed our check-in. With you as our backup the Horde isn't gonna stand a chance.

Shaw's further in the Valley trying to figure out what is going on in Warfang Hold. I've been trying to control the chaos here. Care to lend a hand?

passages.title: Reassembly Required
passages.text:
Master Shaw wanted me to rebuild the listening posts the Horde destroyed when they started to clear the area in preparation for whatever they are planning.

I managed to salvage most of the parts for one, but I'm missing a few.

Fortunately for us, I've been watching the workers and they've been picking up the pieces of the destroyed machines. Go get our tech back and I can take care of the rest.

passages.title: Reassembly Required
passages.text: I am so excited! I love getting to work with our spy tech! Did you find what we need?

passages.title: Reassembly Required
passages.text: Yes! This is precisely what I needed.

passages.title: Seeking Higher Ground
passages.text:
We've only got one shot at reestablishing our communication network, so we've got to pick the right spot and I found just the right place! 

While you've been busy down here, I set up some camouflage and hauled the bulk of the machinery up there.

What? Did you think I was just sitting here polishing my knives while you were gone?

Well, okay I did that too. Anyway, I'll meet you up the hill!

passages.title: Seeking Higher Ground
passages.text: Once we get the listening post set up again, we won't have the range to reach Boralus, but we'll have plenty of power to get in touch with Master Shaw!

passages.title: Listen Up!
passages.text:
Okay! Once we get this up and running we should be able to send messages! In the valley at least.

It's gonna be a little bit tricky, but I've read the manual for these things cover to cover.

<Kelsey slaps the top of the listening device.>

I'm gonna put this thing back together. You watch out for the Horde.

passages.title: Listen Up!
passages.text: Woohoo! We are up and operational!

passages.title: Listen Up!
passages.text:
Ha! I knew I could get this thing up and running in record time.

Hmm. But Master Shaw isn't responding to my signal. That's no good.

passages.title: Tearing at the Seams
passages.text:
I feel odd... weak. As though something is affecting my very existence.

Would you come with me, <name>? I may need your help. At the very least, you could be a witness to whatever happens should something dire occur.

passages.title: Tearing at the Seams
passages.text: Well, this doesn't look good...

passages.title: Reverberation
passages.text:
Hati's spirit is bound to yours forevermore, hunter. But it also now carries a link to the Temple of Storms--as well as Silithus, I fear.

The Thunderspark shares these same bonds. By physically linking it here, you can call upon the different aspects of Hati's spirit and bind them to yourself as well.

Do not worry. Skoll and I will guard the Thunderspark with our very lives! It will be safe.

passages.title: Reverberation
passages.text: It warms my heart to see Hati by your side once more.

passages.title: Reverberation
passages.text:
You may return here any time you wish to rekindle your bond with Hati.

You shall forever be a welcome guest in my court.

passages.title: Batteries Not Included
passages.text:
You will not be sorry that you rescued my dear sister and me, adventurer.

We are the vanguard of a new technological revolution, creating opportunities for all to enhance their lives with incredible technology!

But, before we can do that, we need our laboratory to be fully powered. Those ruffians from Mechagon really did a number on our equipment.

Fully charged energy cells are exceptionally rare around here, but I can make do with broken ones.

Check around town, in the wreckage from the last attack.

passages.title: Batteries Not Included
passages.text: Everything old can be made new again.

passages.title: Batteries Not Included
passages.text:
These are broken, but not TOO broken... Yes, I'm sure I can get these working again.

You may keep one as your recompense.

passages.title: Recharging Rustbolt
passages.text:
Our personal generator is worthless until we recharge its empty energy cells.

As my dear brother says, energy cells are the lifeblood of innovation. Everything in Mechagon needs power, and energy cells deliver that power in a wonderfully universal format.

But, once they're drained of power, most people toss the empty cells away.

Most people are fools, dear test subject.

We have perfected the technology to recharge small numbers of energy cells back to full power.

Will you help us test it?

passages.title: Recharging Rustbolt
passages.text: We only test the best!

passages.title: Recharging Rustbolt
passages.text:
Wondrous work, my dear test subject!

I detected unconventional electrical discharges from the NRG-100, but I see now that I was wrong to worry.

It's still in one piece. Oh, and so are you!

Cheer up. You've already outsurvived 5% of our test subjects!

passages.title: Seam Stress
passages.text:
I...I need a moment, <name>.

<Delormi seems disoriented and grabs your shoulder for support. She presses her hand against her forehead and stands there for a minute. 

Finally shaking off whatever she was feeling, she stands up straight and faces you.>

There are gaps in my memories. Things important to me, lost now. We must stop her at all costs, <name>.

passages.title: Seam Stress
passages.text: I feel so weak...

passages.title: Seam Stress
passages.text: That rift, don't repair it! That's the one.

passages.title: The Audition
passages.text:
Xanjo has spoken highly of your skills, but I need to be certain of what you can do. I mean no offense, this is as much for your benefit as it is our own, as if you are not ready the task could kill you.

If you are willing, I would like to provide you with a test to see how well you can work leather.

Bring me three Drums of the Maelstrom that you have crafted yourself. This will prove your skill and consistency.

If your work is up to par, I will inform you of my plan.

passages.title: The Audition
passages.text:
<Atikka breathes audibly in anticipation of your return.>

Have you got the drums?

passages.title: The Audition
passages.text:
Tight stitching. Even tension. No tears or holes.

You'll do nicely.

<Atikka leans in as he whispers.>

My plan is to make a set of drums from rare and powerful components. The drum's design will let you harness the raw, primal might of the slain beasts, and allow you to teach those Alliance dogs a lesson they won't soon forget. 

Using the drums will require a special mallet, but fear not. Once our work is done, I will teach you how to craft a mallet for yourself.

passages.title: Repaying the Life Debt
passages.text:
When I heard that the Alliance attacked Dazar'alor, I couldn't help but think of those lost when they attacked Camp Taurajo. No longer can I sit idly while they continue to slaughter us!

I need you to go to Thunder Bluff, find Sheza Wildmane on the Elder Rise, and ask for some of her personal collection.

I won't go into detail, but she owes me a life debt, and seeing her would... bring back too many painful memories... for both of us.

Find her, tell her I sent you, and that this absolves her debt.

passages.title: Repaying the Life Debt
passages.text:
<You explain your mission and relation to Atikka.>

I see. Of course I'm more than willing to help, especially since it's Atikka.

However, doing so is going to take a bit more work on your end, if you don't mind.

passages.title: Sheza's Prized Leather
passages.text:
I have a stash of extremely rare leathers, or... rather, I did.

I don't know how, but the Venture Company must have heard how valuable my collection was because they stole it!

And THEN they had the audacity to leave a note offering to sell it back to me for 1,000 gold! As the "former owner", I'm able to "best appreciate the value of their new acquisition."

The note states they'll be in the bluffs to the East until someone buys them.

However you get the skins, consider them yours.

passages.title: Sheza's Prized Leather
passages.text: How was she?

passages.title: Sheza's Prized Leather
passages.text:
<You explain what happened in Mulgore.>

Bah! Wretched goblins and their lust of coin!

<Attika takes a deep breath to steady himself.>

I... Am sorry you had to see that. I just find it so infuriating when our fight is made harder so one of those green-skinned runts can steal your last copper.

passages.title: Dropping by the Base
passages.text:
When the Legion was attacking, I met with a member of the Highmountain Tauren who had a knack for making and playing drums.

Torv usually keeps to himself, but he is as brilliant as he is insane.

If there is anyone who would know where we could get the raw materials for something of this magnitude, it would be him.

Head to Thunder Totem, and ask Torv Dubstomp if he can think of a suitable source of scales. Preferably something still living, so its power is still fresh.

passages.title: Dropping by the Base
passages.text:
Atikka sent you? Ha! How is the old steer?!

Hmmm... scales you say.

<His eyes flick back and forth as he looks off into the distance. His expression quickly shifts from a grimace to one of delight.>

I got it!

passages.title: Bass Fishing
passages.text:
Have you heard of people taking small golden carp as pets?

Well, if it is kept in a pond free of predators, over time it can grow enormous, only limited by the food present.

Centuries ago, one of these fish lived in the pond atop a mountain. It ate everything and began to starve, so my people dug a river that connected the pond to the ocean so the fish could be free.

Now, fishermen talk of being attacked by an enormous golden fish in the Rockaway Shelf.

Kill it. Take his scales back to Atikka.

passages.title: Bass Fishing
passages.text: Did you meet with Torv yet?

passages.title: Bass Fishing
passages.text:
<After hearing your retelling of Torv's plan, Atikka bursts into laughter.>

A centuries old goldfish?!

I told you he was insane!

Ahhh, good work. Glad to see you weren't eaten by a guppy.

passages.title: Picking Bones
passages.text:
When I was sailing in, I noticed the remains of an unbelievably large beast on the nearby peninsula.

Whatever it was, it must have been strong, making it the perfect source for the bone elements of the drums.

Go to the peninsula, 'Xibala' I've heard it called, and fill a bag with the bones you find.

If you come across any of those damned Alliance, show them no mercy. They did this to themselves.

passages.title: Picking Bones
passages.text:
Did you get the bones?

Did the Alliance give you any trouble?

passages.title: Picking Bones
passages.text:
These look good.

It makes me even happier knowing this was something the Alliance was after, and that you mucked that up for them! Heh!

passages.title: Make Some Noise
passages.text:
We have everything we need to craft the drum, except the Earth Mother's blessing. 

The drum is but a vessel, like a cup. We need her to imbue the drum with power, filling the cup so that we may drink.

It will not be easy to convince her to assist us in creating a weapon of war, but I will implore her to protect her children.

While I'm doing that, you will need to craft the drum itself.

Not too big, though. The larger the vessel, the more power it can hold, but the harder it becomes to carry.

passages.title: Make Some Noise
passages.text: <Clearly exhausted, Atikka is trying to remain composed.>

passages.title: Make Some Noise
passages.text:
<Atikka lets out a beleaguered breath, before turning his head to face yours, smiling weakly.>

We've done it, <name>.

passages.title: Instruments of Destruction
passages.text:
Our work is almost finished.

These drums, while powerful, are practically useless here in port.

If you want to get the most benefit from them, you'll need to spread them out. I'd suggest one for each territory here and in Kul Tiras, to help you when you are on a quest and to keep you at your strongest when you're behind enemy lines.

Look for someplace centralized in each territory to place drums.

Once you return, I'll show you how to make the mallet needed to utilize the drums.

passages.title: Instruments of Destruction
passages.text:
I'm glad to see you back in one piece.

In hindsight, I suppose I could have shown you how to make the mallet before you left, but everything seems to have worked out well.

Now then, let me show you how to make the Mallet of Thunderous Skins...

passages.title: Rank 2 - Poen test
passages.text:
Gather corrupted ink sacs from the Nazothian Brain squids. 

The naga use them to control us, let's see if it works the other way.

passages.title: The Aeonian Artisan
passages.text:
Good day, friend!

A Night Elf woman stopped by and asked who was the best leatherworker I knew who didn't mind getting their hands dirty.

I gave her your name, and she asked me to ask you to find her in Boralus Harbor.

She didn't say what she needed my best student for, but the way she acted makes me think that it is for something big.

Head on down to the docks and look for her. She has white hair, purple tattoos, and a pet turtle named "Gouge". Show her what I've taught you!

passages.title: The Aeonian Artisan
passages.text:
Goddess be praised!

We have much to discuss.

passages.title: The Audition
passages.text:
Cassandra has spoken highly of your skills, but I need to be certain of what you can do. I mean no offense, this is as much for your benefit as it is our own, as if you are not ready the task could kill you.

If you are willing, I would like provide you with a test to see how well you can work leather.

Bring me three Drums of the Maelstrom that you have crafted yourself. This will prove your skill and consistency.

If your work is up to par, I will inform you of my plan.

passages.title: The Audition
passages.text: Do you have the drums?

passages.title: The Audition
passages.text:
Clean lines. Even tension. No tears or holes.

Very well.

My plan is to make a set of drums from rare and powerful components that will let you harness the raw, primal might of the slain beasts.

With this power, you will teach the Horde that home is not a place that can be burned, hope is not something that can be slain, and that we are stronger than flame. 

The drums will require a special mallet to use, but once our work is done, I will teach you how to craft this mallet for yourself.

passages.title: Repaying the Debt
passages.text:
I was in Teldrassil when it was set alight. Through the panic and chaos, I knew I could not rest as long as those who did this were unpunished.

I need you to go to Stormwind, find Telonis near the Lion's Rest, and ask for some of his personal collection.

I managed to save him from the fires, so he owes me a great deal. I would go myself, but the loss of Teldrassil is still a fresh wound. I still need to give it time to heal.

Find him, tell him I sent you, and that this will absolve his debt to me.

passages.title: Repaying the Debt
passages.text:
<You explain your mission and relation to Daniss.>

I see. Of course I'm more than willing to help. She may be a T'lara, but I do owe her my life.

However, there is a slight issue that will need to be dealt with.

passages.title: Telonis' Prized Leather
passages.text:
I have a stash of extremely rare leathers, or... rather, I did.

A group of thieves must have heard how valuable my collection was because they stole it!

And THEN they had the audacity to leave a note offering to sell it back to me! As the "former owner", I'm able to "best appreciate the value of their new acquisition."

The note states they'll be waiting in the foothills behind the castle, to the east, until they find another buyer.

However you get the skins, consider them yours.

passages.title: Telonis' Prized Leather
passages.text: How is he holding up?

passages.title: Telonis' Prized Leather
passages.text:
<You explain what happened in Stormwind.>

Typical humans. Extorting allies because only their suffering matters.

<Daniss takes a deep breath to steady herself.>

I am sorry, <name>. I spoke out of frustration.

I'm no stranger to war, but Sylvanas' tactics have made this one exceptionally taxing. I didn't mean to discourage their... resourcefulness. I simply wish it hadn't come to it.

At this time, we must keep our faith in the Alliance.

passages.title: The Other Ghostdancer
passages.text:
When the Legion was attacking, my partner went to Val'sharah to fight the demons.

Mevris may be cold and headstrong, but he's goal oriented, and willing to sacrifice to achieve them. That's part of why I fell in love with him.

If there is anyone who would know where we could get the raw materials for something of this magnitude, it would be him.

Head to Val'sharah, and look for him in the Temple of Elune. Tell him of our plan, and that we need his help securing scales.

passages.title: The Other Ghostdancer
passages.text:
Daniss sent you? Is everything alright?

<You explain the plan and need for scales.>

Hmmm... scales you say.

passages.title: Mevris' Menace
passages.text:
There is a hydra that has been something of a nuisance for us as of late. It lives out on the Gloaming Reef, almost directly due west of here.

It's been attacking ships that pass by, making it difficult to get supplies to and from Bradensbrook.

I sent a team to handle it, but they haven't returned.

Go out there, kill it, and take its scales to Daniss.

And when you see her, tell her that I said...

<Mevris pauses as he thinks of his words, and the meaning they carry.>

Nothing.

passages.title: Mevris' Menace
passages.text: Have you met with Mevris?

passages.title: Mevris' Menace
passages.text:
<After hearing your retelling of Mevris' plan, Daniss nods thoughtfully.>

I'm glad you were able to assist him. He has been gone for some time now. Hopefully with this creature now deceased, there is one less obstacle before he can come home.

And good work with the scales. These appear to be perfect for the task.

passages.title: Picking Bones
passages.text:
When I was sailing in, I heard some of the sailors talking about the Horde presence here in Tiragarde Sound.

Apparently they're scrounging around the remains of a massive creature that has washed ashore.

Whatever it was, if the Horde wants it, we need to make sure they don't get it.

Find the Horde, keep them from taking anything, and see if there are any bones from the creature we can use for our drums.

Show them no mercy, <name>.

passages.title: Picking Bones
passages.text: Have you dealt with our mutual problem?

passages.title: Picking Bones
passages.text:
These bones look good.

I'm thrilled to hear that the Horde bought nothing with their lives.

passages.title: Make Some Noise
passages.text:
We have everything we need to craft the drum, except Elune's blessing. 

The drum is but a vessel, like a cup. We need her to imbue the drum with power, filling the cup so that we may drink.

With Tyrande donning the mantle of the Night Warrior, much of Elune's power is taxed. Asking for another favor is not insignificant, but I must try.

While I'm doing that, I need you to craft the drum. Try to keep it small. The larger the vessel, the more power it can hold, but the harder it becomes to move.

passages.title: Make Some Noise
passages.text: <Clearly exhausted, Daniss is trying to remain composed.>

passages.title: Make Some Noise
passages.text:
<Daniss lets out a beleaguered breath, before turning to face you, smiling weakly.>

We did it, <name>.

They may have called me "T'lara", a warrior armed only with words, but those words have given us the strength of a goddess.

With these drums, we can break the Horde.

passages.title: Instruments of Destruction
passages.text:
There is one last thing we need to do.

These drums, while powerful, are practically useless here in town.

If you want to get the most benefit from them, you'll need to spread them out. I'd suggest one for each territory here and in Zandalar, to help you when you are on a quest and to keep you at your strongest when you're behind enemy lines.

Look for someplace centralized in each territory to place drums.

Once you return, I'll show you how to make the mallet needed to utilize the drums.

passages.title: Instruments of Destruction
passages.text:
You've returned! I take it all went well?

In retrospect, I could have shown you how to make the mallet before you left, but everything seems to have worked out well.

Now then, let me show you how to make the Mallet of Thunderous Skins...

passages.title: A Daughter of Torcali
passages.text:
It has long been remarked upon that a direhorn is de bravest beast in de jungle. That is why they are chosen as mounts for our warriors.

In this case, that bravery may not be in your favor. De little one has run off and I do not think she is hungry this time.

Best find her before she gets hurt.

passages.title: A Daughter of Torcali
passages.text: <The Child of Torcali holds her head high.>

passages.title: Away From the Herd
passages.text:
<The Child of Torcali stares longingly out of her pen. Her gaze seems to be following the other nearby direhorns.

Perhaps she could use a distraction.>

passages.title: Away From the Herd
passages.text: <The Child of Torcali lovingly headbutts your leg.>

passages.title: Eat Like a Direhorn
passages.text: <The Child of Torcali investigates your hands for traces of food and makes a small sound of distress.>

passages.title: Eat Like a Direhorn
passages.text: <The Child of Torcali wiggles impatiently.>

passages.title: Eat Like a Direhorn
passages.text: <The Child of Torcali blinks trustingly up at you and makes a warm rumbling sound.>

passages.title: Even Greener Pastures
passages.text:
Ever since Torcali gave her boon to de little one, she has been growing like a weed. Dat makes her very hungry.

She got out again to look for more things to eat. Before you ask, it is not my role to stop her from doing what she wants. Only to ensure she is safe.

She is probably fine. Bring her home, and if you have trouble bringing her home, you might try a bribe.

passages.title: Even Greener Pastures
passages.text: <The Child of Torcali seems very pleased with herself.>

passages.title: The Trust You've Earned
passages.text:
I believe my loa will agree with me when I say that you have proven yourself worthy of this one's companionship.

She is large enough now that she can bear you wherever it is that you wish to go.

I had de Beastlord craft a saddle for you. Go and get it and I will help you put it on your new steed's back.

Congratulations, <name>.

passages.title: The Trust You've Earned
passages.text: <Li'zal rubs her head and groans.>

passages.title: The Trust You've Earned
passages.text:
I could not stop her. She rammed de gate...

Like a thing possessed...

passages.title: Greener Pastures
passages.text:
You have done an adequate job keeping de little one fed, but sometimes they just want something else.

I did not see where de hatchling went, but you should start where de grass is real green. You will likely find her eating it.

If you have trouble bringing her home, you might try a bribe.

passages.title: Greener Pastures
passages.text: <The Child of Torcali seems very pleased with herself.>

passages.title: Away From the Herd
passages.text:
<The Child of Torcali stares longingly out of her pen. Her gaze seems to be following the other nearby direhorns.

Perhaps she could use a distraction.>

passages.title: Away From the Herd
passages.text: <The Child of Torcali lovingly headbutts your leg.>

passages.title: A Growing Appetite
passages.text: <The Child of Torcali investigates your hands for traces of food and makes a small sound of distress.>

passages.title: A Growing Appetite
passages.text: <The Child of Torcali wiggles impatiently.>

passages.title: A Growing Appetite
passages.text: <The Child of Torcali blinks trustingly up at you and makes a warm rumbling sound.>

passages.title: A Daughter of Torcali
passages.text:
It has long been remarked upon that a direhorn is de bravest beast in de jungle. That is why they are chosen as mounts for our warriors.

In this case, that bravery may not be in your favor. De little one has run off and I do not think she is hungry this time.

Best find her before she gets hurt.

passages.title: A Daughter of Torcali
passages.text: <The Child of Torcali holds her head high.>

passages.title: A Loa Without a Temple
passages.text:
I have given some thought about your situation, <name>.

It is not your fault dat de goblin deceived us. I followed along with his scheme as well. From today, you have my forgiveness. 

But dat cannot help de little one. I fear we may lose it, if we do not act. We must ask de wanderer's loa, de mountain dat moves, de great bulwark, de greatmother of direhorns, to save her child.

Take dis offering to her shrine and ask for her boon... and her forgiveness.

passages.title: A Loa Without a Temple
passages.text: <The great direhorn looks down upon you.>

passages.title: A Loa Without a Temple
passages.text:
<A warm but thunderous voice enters your mind.>

You have come to redeem yourself. Good. Let us begin.

passages.title: A Show of Faith
passages.text:
<Torcali's voice enters your mind.>

I have watched your efforts from afar, small thing. You have made mistakes, and one of my young has suffered for it.

I do not forget, but I can forgive.

<The enormous direhorn touches the offering bundle with her nose.>

As my people place faith in me, I place my faith in you. Take my blessing to my child and she will wake.

passages.title: A Show of Faith
passages.text: <The Child of Torcali peers sleepily up at you and rumbles contentedly.>

passages.title: An Unending Sleep
passages.text:
<The direhorn hatchling continues to sleep soundly, despite any efforts on your part to wake it.

It's probably been too long. You should speak to Beastlord L'kala.>

passages.title: An Unending Sleep
passages.text:
I see you have noticed de state of your hatchling.

Given it is your responsibility, I will accept dat you did not know what you were doing when we started dis whole affair.

I hope you are ready to change dat.

passages.title: Sleep, Eat, Repeat
passages.text:
<The Child of Torcali pushes the sack of herbs around with her snout.

She then looks to you and stomps eagerly in place.>

passages.title: Sleep, Eat, Repeat
passages.text: <The Child of Torcali pushes her snout into your hand in search of food.>

passages.title: Sleep, Eat, Repeat
passages.text: <The Child of Torcali trumpets in satisfaction.>

passages.title: Bottom Feeding Stinkfish
passages.text: <Danielle Anglers may be interested in this fish.>

passages.title: Bottom Feeding Stinkfish
passages.text: This fish looks to have adapted to survive in the shallow water pools around the trash heaps. It smells awful, the smell probably protects it from any predators. I want to catalogue this and release it before this smell sticks to me!

passages.title: Bolted Steelhead
passages.text: <Danielle Anglers may be interested in this fish.>

passages.title: Bolted Steelhead
passages.text: This fish appears to have been manufactured! The workmanship is quite sophisticated. I want to catalogue this and release it for further observation.

passages.title: Pond Hopping Springfish
passages.text: <Danielle Anglers may be interested in this fish.>

passages.title: Pond Hopping Springfish
passages.text: This fish has adapted itself to allow it to hop between shallow pools of water. I will catalogue it and release it back into a nearby pool.  We'll then see where it hops too!

passages.title: Shadowy Cave Eel
passages.text: <Danielle Anglers may be interested in this fish.>

passages.title: Shadowy Cave Eel
passages.text: This fish looks to have adapted to survive in dark caves of Mechagon. I will catalogue it and return it to a nearby cave.

passages.title: Mechanical Blowfish
passages.text: <Danielle Anglers may be interested in this fish.>

passages.title: Mechanical Blowfish
passages.text: A strange mechanical fish that appears to be modifying itself for survival in these waters. An amazing discovery!

passages.title: Spitting Clownfish
passages.text: <Danielle Anglers may be interested in this fish.>

passages.title: Spitting Clownfish
passages.text: This fish has developed an unusual behavior. It most likely is imitating the actions of surrounding creatures. I will catalogue it and then release it immediately.

passages.title: Sludge-fouled Carp
passages.text: <Danielle Anglers may be interested in this fish.>

passages.title: Sludge-fouled Carp
passages.text: Something horrible has happened to this fish. It maybe worth further investigation of the waters where you found it.

passages.title: Energized Lightning Cod
passages.text: <Danielle Anglers may be interested in this fish.>

passages.title: Energized Lightning Cod
passages.text: This fish radiates electricity. I suspect it has been feeding on underwater power cables. A most interesting find, which I will catalogue immediately!

passages.title: Solarsprocket Barbel
passages.text: <Danielle Anglers may be interested in this fish.>

passages.title: Solarsprocket Barbel
passages.text: This mechanical fish appears to be powered by sunlight. I will catalogue this find and return it to its pond.

passages.title: Tasty Steelfin
passages.text: <Danielle Anglers may be interested in this fish.>

passages.title: Tasty Steelfin
passages.text: This fish appears quite healthy and probably tastes quite delicious. I will catalogue this and then probably cook it for dinner.

passages.title: Tidying Up
passages.text:
Ionized Minnows are a scourge of these waters. They strip the ocean floors of any food, making it difficult for other species to survive.

These fish have little to offer other than being a food source for larger fish. I want to see these larger fish, so I have a plan to clear the waters of these minnows and lure the bigger fish out from its hiding place.

Let's start by using my Minnow Vac to catch Ionized Minnows for me.

passages.title: Tidying Up
passages.text: Did you catch any fish?

passages.title: Tidying Up
passages.text: With these minnows, we can build the trap.

passages.title: Assault: Amathet Advance
passages.text:
The Amathet seek to claim the Forge of Origination for their own. We must not allow it to fall into their hands again!

Our men are defending the entrance, but they will be overwhelmed if the entire might of the Amathet advances upon them. 

Do what you can to route their forces before its too late.

passages.title: Assault: Amathet Advance
passages.text: The Amathet must be stopped!

passages.title: Assault: Amathet Advance
passages.text:
Hah! You showed those dusty zealots what a true warrior looks like.

Well done.

passages.title: The Lost Shaman
passages.text:
Pardon me, <class>. I am in need of your assistance.

Our shaman, Farseer Ori, left the camp some days ago to investigate a nearby disturbance in the elements. He took his apprentice with him, a young initiate named Odari. Neither have returned.

I am leading an expedition to find them and return them here safely. Nazjatar is full of dangers. The skills of an accomplished <class> like yourself could prove most useful.

Will you help me return the lost shaman to safety?

passages.title: The Lost Shaman
passages.text: It is good you are here. We must speak quickly. I fear for the safety of my master...

passages.title: Elemental Fury
passages.text:
The naga have angered the elements and disrupted the natural order. We must restore the balance before it is too late.

A Farseer maintains a deep connection with the elements. When the naga forces imprisoned my master, the natural balance was disturbed.

Take the Stone of Elements and use it to pacify the enraged water elementals throughout Dragon's Teeth Basin.

Ultimately, our only solution is to rescue Farseer Ori and bring him back alive, but the Tidestone could buy us precious time...

passages.title: Elemental Fury
passages.text: We must restore the balance before it is too late!

passages.title: Elemental Fury
passages.text: You have done well. I can sense that the elemental balance is close to being restored to its natural state.

passages.title: Rescue The Farseer
passages.text:
My master, Farseer Ori, has been imprisoned by the forces of Queen Azshara.

Farseer Ori was captured while performing a sacred ritual to call upon the elements for guidance. I managed to escape, but the ritual has been left unfinished.

If we do not rescue my master soon, the elements will grow even more restless.

The elemental balance must be maintained. I fear what may become of my clan and our bond with the elements if Farseer Ori is not returned to us.

passages.title: Rescue The Farseer
passages.text: I fear whatever fate may have awaited me had you not rescued me when you did.

passages.title: A Disturbance Beneath the Earth
passages.text:
Manifestation of dragon essence detected. Location: Highmountain. 

Assuming successful retrieval, calculations indicate 92.7 percent probability of empowering Heart of Azeroth.

Theory: By combining dragon essence with sufficient quantities of Azerite within Heart Forge, previously undiscovered abilities may manifest within Heart.

As Speaker Magni would say: "Get to work, champion."

passages.title: A Disturbance Beneath the Earth
passages.text: What brings you here, <name>?

passages.title: A Disturbance Beneath the Earth
passages.text: We must make haste. I feel the essence of my kin calling to me.

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Shimmerscale
passages.text:
I've received an urgent request from Tinkmaster Overspark.

These supplies are needed!

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Shimmerscale
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Your contribution has been logged in our records for posterity to appreciate!

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Star Moss
passages.text:
I've received an urgent request from Tinkmaster Overspark.

These supplies are needed!

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Star Moss
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Your contribution has been logged in our records for posterity to appreciate!

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Storm Silver Ore
passages.text:
I've received an urgent request from Tinkmaster Overspark.

These supplies are needed!

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Storm Silver Ore
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Your contribution has been logged in our records for posterity to appreciate!

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Storm Silver Ore
passages.text:
Gazlowe's orders are in: He wants these supplies ASAP.

Ya got the goods?

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Storm Silver Ore
passages.text:
Thanks for pitchin' in.

I'll make sure Gazlowe and Prince Erazmin know these came from you.

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Shimmerscale
passages.text:
Gazlowe's orders are in: He wants these supplies ASAP.

Ya got the goods?

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Shimmerscale
passages.text:
Thanks for pitchin' in.

I'll make sure Gazlowe and Prince Erazmin know these came from you.

passages.text:

Ya got the goods?

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Star Moss
passages.text:
Thanks for pitchin' in.

I'll make sure Gazlowe and Prince Erazmin know these came from you.

passages.title: Settling In
passages.text:
Whatever Azshara is up to, this *ahem* great new landscape we have found ourself in is terribly inconvenient. 

Too many getting too close to our home. We have moved most of the refugees deeper into the cave.

Could you ask Telur to move our calling conch inside? 

Grab some of Slen's Elixir and check in with Vim.

Once it is set up, test it out! 

I'm off to do a progress check!

passages.title: Settling In
passages.text: We won't be missing that sound, land friend!

passages.title: In Darkness, I Dream
passages.text:
The green dragonflight calls for aid. The Emerald Dream, which they have watched over for eons, has been invaded by terrible creatures of the Void.

Merithra of the Dream is attempting to combat the threat, but she cannot do so alone. If you seek to empower the Heart of Azeroth with the strength of the green dragonflight, you must first help Merithra save it.

Meet her at the Temple of Elune in Val'sharah, and assist her however you can.

passages.title: In Darkness, I Dream
passages.text:
Thank you for coming, champion. My mother once placed her trust in mortals, and I find that I must call upon them once again. 

I simply do not know how to fight this battle on my own.

passages.title: Enter the Dreamway
passages.text:
We have little time, so I will be brief.

The Emerald Dream is under attack. The shadows of the Void are on the rise, and not even the Dream is beyond their reach. Many of my kin have already been slain, and still more are at risk.

We must enter the Dreamway and save what remains of my dragonflight before it is too late.

passages.title: Enter the Dreamway
passages.text: Now you see how dire our situation is. The Void is consuming us!

passages.title: Null the Void
passages.text:
The green dragonflight cannot stop this tide of Void creatures on our own. Not with our reduced strength.

Please, lend us your might and drive them from the Dreamway before they can enter the waking realm.

passages.title: Null the Void
passages.text: Thank you. With fewer of those Void creatures about, we can attempt to secure the Dreamway.

passages.title: Shards of Emerald
passages.text:
Kalecgos tells me that you seek the power of the dragonflights in its most essential form. There may be something here that can help you.

Fragments of our latent power have coalesced here in the Dream.

They are scattered about the Dreamway, where my kin have fallen. Within the Dream, you should be able to wield those fragments in their raw state.

passages.title: Shards of Emerald
passages.text: Have you collected the shards?

passages.title: Shards of Emerald
passages.text:
This power once belonged to my flight, passed down through my mother when she was empowered by the Titan, Eonar.

<Merithra lowers her head for a moment.>

If you are to use it to help save our world, then we must first bind these fragments together.

passages.title: Don't Close Your Eyes
passages.text:
The Void assaults us as we sleep! Those who it ensnares may never wake again.

They can only be roused by powerful magic native to our dragonflight. The shards that have formed near our fallen kin may be exactly what is needed.

If we succumb to slumber in the Void, we will be lost forever. Please, aid us!

passages.title: Don't Close Your Eyes
passages.text:
Karkarius... and Thessera, too? I never thought...

It saddens me terribly that some would choose to die instead of fight. This life may be fraught with hardship, but it is the only one we have.

I am grateful that you tried to save them, even if they were not willing to be saved.

passages.title: Before I Wake
passages.text:
It is as I feared. We cannot fuse the shards together until the Void has been driven from this place.

Quickly, strike down these aberrations. I suspect the source of the corruption will not sit idle in response.

passages.title: Before I Wake
passages.text: The Void is at its strongest here. I feel at fault for allowing it to spread unhindered.

passages.title: Before I Wake
passages.text: To think something so dark, so terrible, festered here for this long. We are truly lost.

passages.title: The Long Awake
passages.text:
There is nothing more you can do for us here, champion. You have the power you sought, and the Emerald Dream is fighting back against the Void.

Bring this dragonscale back to Magni and the others. I will meet you in the Chamber of Heart to help infuse it into the Heart of Azeroth.

As for my flight, our long vigil must continue... or we will be lost to the Void.

passages.title: The Long Awake
passages.text: This place is incredible, and I am proud to stand with the other dragonflights in defense of Azeroth. Let us hope that this essence will turn the tide in our favor.

passages.title: Take My Hand
passages.text:
Beneath us lies the former home of the dragon Neltharion. You may know him as Deathwing. 

If your titan watcher friend detected an essence of dragon magic coalescing nearby, it may be an echo of the power of the dragonflights. Such power will be coveted by others as well.

This force is likely originating from the most potent area within the lair--the decaying bones of my kin slain in the throes of Deathwing's fury.

We must go before the essence falls into the wrong hands.

passages.title: Take My Hand
passages.text: I hope the trip down was not as...rocky for you as it was for me.

passages.title: Calming the Spine
passages.text:
It is plain that the situation here is dire.

The power of the black dragonflight echoes around us, and the earth is reeling in response. 

I have heard tales of ruptures like these on Kul Tiras and Zandalar. The elementals have been driven into a frenzy, and they bar our way from seeking the essence.

If we are to preserve the tenuous balance of the elements here, the wounds must be mended, <name>.

passages.title: Calming the Spine
passages.text: Are the wounds healed, <name>?

passages.title: Calming the Spine
passages.text: The fissures are healed? Good. We can proceed.

passages.title: Dominating the Indomitable
passages.text:
With the wounds healed, I can clearly sense the dragon essence. Unfortunately, it seems to emanate from the earthen giant before us.

I will address the creature. Let us hope it listens to reason... but be prepared for anything.

When Deathwing shattered the World Pillar in Deepholm, he earned the ire of the Stonemother and her forces. I fear this being may blame me for my father's crimes.

passages.title: Dominating the Indomitable
passages.text: The essence of my flight is powerful indeed.

passages.title: Dominating the Indomitable
passages.text: Now that we have the essence, I pray the earth finds peace once again.

passages.title: Paint Vial: Fireball Red
passages.text: <Marvelous Martini could make use of this item.>

passages.title: Paint Vial: Fireball Red
passages.text: What a bold color for a mechanocat. I could see you riding this!

passages.title: Paint Vial: Fel Mint Green
passages.text: <Marvelous Martini could make use of this item.>

passages.title: Paint Vial: Fel Mint Green
passages.text: A delicious color choice. I can almost taste the fel.

passages.title: Paint Vial: Lemonade Steel
passages.text: <Marvelous Martini could make use of this item.>

passages.title: Paint Vial: Lemonade Steel
passages.text: What a tasty color for a mechanocat!

passages.title: Paint Vial: Mechagon Gold
passages.text: <Marvelous Martini could make use of this item.>

passages.title: Paint Vial: Mechagon Gold
passages.text: Good or bad, it makes a statement!

passages.title: Paint Vial: Copper Trim
passages.text: <Marvelous Martini could make use of this item.>

passages.title: Paint Vial: Copper Trim
passages.text: A unique choice, for those that want to be different.

passages.title: Paint Vial: Overload Orange
passages.text: <Marvelous Martini could make use of this item.>

passages.title: Paint Vial: Overload Orange
passages.text: One of my favorites!

passages.title: The Wanderer's Call
passages.text:
Greetings, small thing.

De Great Wanderer asked this one to collect you. She has a task for you and de little beast to complete.

Jo'nok's loa is patient, but he would not keep her waiting.

passages.title: The Wanderer's Call
passages.text:
<The great direhorn regards you with one enormous eye. A voice enters your mind.>

I am pleased by what I see. I would ask more of you, now.

passages.title: We Must Go Deeper
passages.text:
These shards can only do so much in their current state. They are broken and scattered... not unlike my kin.

We must bring them together.

Let us go deeper into the Emerald Dream. I know of a place where we can reforge the shards into a dragonscale. With it, you can empower the Heart of Azeroth with the essence of my dragonflight. We must go to the ancient heart of the Dream, where my mother once rested.

Speak with me when you are ready to delve deeper.

passages.title: We Must Go Deeper
passages.text: The extent of the corruption is more dire than I thought. My mother used to love this place... and now it withers within the Void's grasp.

passages.title: To Zin-Azshari
passages.text:
We need something to deal with the guardian of the Tidestone, <name>.

Our new allies here say that there is a naga enclave located in the ruins of Zin-Azshari. If there is anything potent enough to counter Azshara's sorcery, it will be in the ruins of her capital city.

The First Arcanist will accompany you, champion. She will be best equipped to assist you in matters both historical and magical while you search.

Good luck.

passages.title: To Zin-Azshari
passages.text: Is that what I think it is?

passages.title: Making the Connection
passages.text:
A communication crystal! Have they survived this long?

We used to use these to communicate. They allowed us to project images of ourselves to other nearby crystals to see and speak with those on the other end.

<Thalyssra examines the crystal for a few moments.>

The magic has long since depleted from the crystal. We will need a power source, preferably something just as old as this.

Check our surroundings, but be careful. It is too quiet out here....

passages.title: Making the Connection
passages.text: Have you found anything to power the crystal?

passages.title: Making the Connection
passages.text: This should work if they have sufficient power....

passages.title: Terrors in the Deep
passages.text:
Azshara knows we are here. Still, we must press on.

Be careful, though. There is a... wrongness coming from the water. It is unlike the magic of old, but more ancient and terrible.

Traverse the canals and find the source of corruption. If we are to search Zin-Azshari, we cannot let any relics fall into the hands of even darker powers.

passages.title: Terrors in the Deep
passages.text: His influence is spreading...

passages.title: Secrets of Telemancy
passages.text:
The nightborne are no strangers to this place. It was once our capital too, long ago.

Before the Sundering and erecting the shield over Suramar we used to travel freely to Zin-Azshari. Oculeth had a workshop in these estates. 

Perhaps it might contain some secrets or magic that went undisturbed by the survivors.

passages.title: Secrets of Telemancy
passages.text: Have you found the workshop yet?

passages.title: Secrets of Telemancy
passages.text: Why am I not surprised. Still, these notes may prove useful.

passages.title: The Handmaiden's Tale
passages.text:
The Javelins of Suramar!

Wielded by Azshara herself, they contain immense magical power. She has always had a fondness for bestowing favors on her favorites, but I never suspected she would give one something so valuable as one of her Javelins. This foe must be formidable indeed.

Nevertheless, <name>, we cannot let this opportunity pass us. Defeat the handmaiden and retrieve the relic!

passages.title: The Handmaiden's Tale
passages.text: We cannot let her get away.

passages.title: The Handmaiden's Tale
passages.text: This just might work.

passages.title: We'll Poke Their Eye Out
passages.text:
The Javelins were some of Suramar's finest creations before the Sundering. Their magic is ancient and potent. Perhaps strong enough to defeat Azshara's wards.

Hurry back to Newhome. We must tell the others of our success here. You have done well.

passages.title: We'll Poke Their Eye Out
passages.text: With this, we can secure the Tidestone.

passages.title: A Friendly Face
passages.text:
An essence of black dragonflight magic is not to be trifled with, <name>.

My flight has been the pawn of dark forces in the past. I owe it to my fallen kin to see that our power is never used for evil again.

I would like to journey with you and meet your allies. Perhaps my knowledge can help you use this essence to defend our world.

passages.title: A Friendly Face
passages.text: Was MOTHER's analysis correct?

passages.title: A Friendly Face
passages.text:
I like this tauren friend o' yers. Here's hopin' he stays free o' corruption!

Okay, time tae see what MOTHER can do with that essence!

passages.title: The Shimmering Crystal
passages.text:
Though the crystal appears familiar at first, upon contact with your finger it reveals itself as so much more. A grand, lost civilization appears in front of you. Fixtures of gold shimmer in every direction, bright feathers of purple occasionally falling from overhead. You hear the distant sounds of battle, culminating in a thunderous explosion that overwhelms all of your senses and turns your vision white.

When your vision returns, you feel something within you pulling you toward Ashran.

passages.title: The Shimmering Crystal
passages.text:
I've always been fascinated with The Age of Order, but never have I found such an interesting crystal. 

I will study this artifact. Perhaps I chose the right time to conduct my research.

passages.title: The Shimmering Crystal
passages.text:
Though the crystal appears familiar at first, upon contact with your finger it reveals itself as so much more. A grand, lost civilization appears in front of you. Fixtures of gold shimmer in every direction, bright feathers of purple occasionally falling from overhead. You hear the distant sounds of battle, culminating in a thunderous explosion that overwhelms all of your senses and turns your vision white.

When your vision returns, you feel something within you pulling you toward Ashran.

passages.title: The Shimmering Crystal
passages.text:
The Age of Order shaped much of Draenor's future in many timelines. With each new artifact we find, we learn more about their development and demise, the commonalities and dissonances between each branch.

This artifact is the most peculiar of all. You did well to bring it to me.

passages.title: Save A Friend
passages.text:
In the cave ahead is where they are holding Mak. 

They torture us. They break us. 

Don't let them take her, too.

passages.title: Save A Friend
passages.text: We are deeply in your debt, land friend.

passages.title: The Direhorn and the Saurid
passages.text:
<A gentle voice enters your mind.>

I am pleased with your efforts. He will not soon forget the kindness you have shown him, and so he will not soon forget me.

Now your journey will take you south. I can no longer sense one of my wayshrines. If you can determine what has happened to it and restore it, I would be grateful.

passages.title: The Direhorn and the Saurid
passages.text: What did you learn?

passages.title: The Direhorn and the Saurid
passages.text:
<An amused voice enters your mind.>

Ah, the trickster Jani thought to amuse himself at my expense. I suppose that is the payment I have earned for stepping on his tail.

Thank you. This shrine will once again serve the Zandalari.

passages.title: Wayshrines of Zuldazar
passages.text:
<A calm but thunderous voice enters your mind.>

My child grows under your care. I am pleased. Now, I would have your aid.

There was a time long ago when the roads of Zandalar were under my protection. Those who walked them gave praise, and in return I gave them my blessing. Fewer wander now.

My shrines remain, their purpose forgotten. You will help me to restore them.

Begin in the north. See to the wayshrine there. If you find any lost travelers, see that they know my blessing through you.

passages.title: Wayshrines of Zuldazar
passages.text: Do you have de herbs?

passages.title: Wayshrines of Zuldazar
passages.text:
Most of my goods have spoiled in de heat and rain, but take dis token of my appreciation.

We can finally go home.

passages.title: Roo'li's Memory
passages.text:
I was going to be a Dinomancer. Roo'li was going to grow with me as I learned.

<Koo'li shakes her head.>

Dat future is gone now. Please, take him. Find a proper place to bury him.

I... can't. De shame is too great.

passages.title: Roo'li's Memory
passages.text:
<The great direhorn loa stares down at you.>

What do you bring me, <name>?

passages.title: Roo'li's Memory
passages.text:
<Torcali's voice rings in your mind.>

His time walking this world is done, but he will not be forgotten. He is returned to the soil, and with it his spirit lives on.

passages.title: One Road Ends
passages.text:
<A warm voice enters your mind.>

There is one more wayshrine in this region that requires your attention.

Follow this road until you near its end at the Port of Zandalar.

It is there, at the start and end of so many journeys, that one of my most trafficked shrines was established. Restore it and see that any weary travelers have my blessing.

We will speak again when you are finished.

passages.title: One Road Ends
passages.text: Roo'li... Oh, Roo'li....

passages.title: One Road Ends
passages.text:
I should have protected him, but he stood his ground. Fierce little thing.

<Koo'li pats Roo'li's head.>

passages.title: Torcali's Blessing
passages.text:
<Torcali's voice enters your mind.>

Your actions speak to your intentions, <name>.

I can see that my child will have the care she needs to grow strong, and grow she will. 

In the coming days she will recover the strength that would have been hers, if nature had been allowed to take its course. Tend to her, earn her loyalty, and I will allow you to keep her at your side.

This is my gift to you.

You may go now. She will bring you to me when it is time.

passages.title: Torcali's Blessing
passages.text: <The Child of Torcali peers trustingly up at you.>

passages.title: Spark of Genius
passages.text:
<name>, I require your assistance.

A recent energy signature tripped several detection relays I installed after that unfortunate incident with Sargeras.

Initial diagnostics suggest that these energies emanate from Hati, a legendary creature of lightning magic. This wolf was linked to the Titanstrike artifact, a weapon that proved instrumental in defeating the Legion!

Hati's spirit is still bound to Titanstrike's core, so I'll need your help. Meet me at my library in the Storm Peaks right away!

passages.title: Spark of Genius
passages.text:
Our scientific team simply would not be complete without Bronzebeard here.

Let's begin!

passages.title: Paint Vial: Big-ol Bronze
passages.text: <Marvelous Martini could make use of this item.>

passages.title: Paint Vial: Big-ol Bronze
passages.text: One of my favorites!

passages.title: A Fresh Trauma
passages.text:
Azeroth is strugglin' tae survive, but new wounds are formin' at a rapid pace.

I can sense her cries o' pain risin' from the north... in a place o' ancient power...

<Magni closes his eyes, as if listening to an unseen voice.>

By the Forge! Somethin's gone wrong in Mount Hyjal. The World Tree, Nordrassil, is in danger!

Meet me there, adventurer. There's no time tae lose!

passages.title: A Fresh Trauma
passages.text: If we don't heal these wounds, the World Tree might not be standin' much longer.

passages.title: Do It the Azerite Way
passages.text:
Incredible! Ye stopped the wound from spreadin' before it could get out o' control!

Nordrassil should be safe again, fer now. This is a good sign that we may just be able tae reverse all the damage done tae Azeroth.

Let's get back tae the Chamber o' Heart, an' see if we can put any o' that azerite ye absorbed tae good use.

passages.title: Do It the Azerite Way
passages.text: Additional azerite available for Heart of Azeroth. Activating now.

passages.title: Return to the Heart
passages.text:
Greetings, Champion of Azeroth.

MOTHER's been monitorin' yer progress with the Heart of Azeroth, and is mighty pleased with the work you've done tae make it stronger.

At least, we think she's pleased. It's difficult tae tell at times.

Regardless, come back tae the Chamber of Heart when ye've got a chance. There's more that needs doin'.

passages.title: Return to the Heart
passages.text: The Heart o' Azeroth feels stronger than ever. I wonder what amazing powers might be locked within!

passages.title: Bring Him Some...
passages.text:
<Mrrl points at your backpack then draws some pictures in the sand. He pulls out a pretty object from behind a rock then furiously points to himself then back at you then your bag.

You believe it might want to make a trade.>

passages.title: Bring Him Some...
passages.text:
<Mrrl points at your backpack then draws some pictures in the sand. He pulls out a pretty object from behind a rock then furiously points to himself then back at you then your bag.

You believe it might want to make a trade.>

passages.text:
<Mrrl points at your backpack then draws some pictures in the sand. He pulls out a pretty object from behind a rock then furiously points to himself then back at you then your bag.

You believe it might want to make a trade.>
