passages.text:
<Mrrl points at your backpack then draws some pictures in the sand. He pulls out a pretty object from behind a rock then furiously points to himself then back at you then your bag.

You believe it might want to make a trade.>

passages.title: Bring Him Some...
passages.text:
<Mrrl points at your backpack then draws some pictures in the sand. He pulls out a pretty object from behind a rock then furiously points to himself then back at you then your bag.

You believe it might want to make a trade.>

passages.title: Playtime's Over
passages.text:
The troggs have been raiding our supplies since we got here, but now that we got some fire power you're going to put a stop to that!

Let's teach them troggs to stay away from our stuff!

passages.title: Playtime's Over
passages.text: Take out some troggs.

passages.title: Playtime's Over
passages.text: You earned your salary, <race>!

passages.title: A Safer Place
passages.text: <The murloc seems to be in rough shape. Perhaps it would be safer with your allies in Newhome.>

passages.title: A Safer Place
passages.text: <Mrrl seems at home in his new spot and his family has also taken up refuge here. It is unlikely you will be able to remove this new murloc infestation.>

passages.title: MOTHER Knows Best
passages.text:
Now that this chamber's not fallin' tae pieces anymore, we can focus on makin' the Heart stronger!

MOTHER says she's finished her fancy calculations. Have a word with her, champion. See if we can further empower the amazin' gift Azeroth gave ye.

passages.title: MOTHER Knows Best
passages.text:
Report: Ready for dissemination.

Champion's response: Critical.

passages.title: MOTHER Knows Best
passages.text:
Analysis complete. In order to prevent planetary annihilation, Heart of Azeroth must be enhanced.

Objective: Seek out compatible essences. Priority: Critical.

passages.title: A Bolt Hole
passages.text:
<name>, we must seek out a powerful weapon to combat the naga who guard the Tidal Conflux. I am certain such an object would be in the hands of one of Azshara's minions.

Thanks to our new allies, we've tracked down the location of one of her handmaidens within the ruins of Zin-Azshari. The journey will be quite dangerous. Thankfully our allies have a location nearby that we can use as a staging ground.

I've marked the location on your map, meet with me there as soon as you can.

passages.title: A Bolt Hole
passages.text: Yes. This place will do nicely. It is easily defended and has safe access to the ruins.

passages.title: Utama's Vengeance
passages.text:
We Ankoan are a small tribe. There are not that many of us remaining.

This place was once overrun with makrura, before Utama. They tried to hide here, from the naga, but found the makrura. They fell, in battle, to the Kil'karrok.

If you wish to show your dedication to the Ankoan, become a force of vengeance in Utama's memory. Destroy the makrura.

passages.title: Utama's Vengeance
passages.text: We remember Utama. And honor their memory here.

passages.title: Utama's Vengeance
passages.text: You do Utama great honor by killing his foes.

passages.title: What Remains of Zin-Azshari
passages.text:
Zin-Azshari, once the capital of night elf civilization, was lost during the Sundering. Queen Azshara betrayed her people and allowed N'Zoth to corrupt them, turning them into naga.

It has now fallen into ruin and chaos.

We must see what it has become. Meet me by the statue of Azshara.

passages.title: What Remains of Zin-Azshari
passages.text: You must venture deeper into the city.

passages.title: Shoring Up Mana Reserves
passages.text:
Holding back the tide walls is not an easy task, even using the Tidestone. The ebb and flow of the magical energies in the area are too inconsistent.

We need to shore up our magical reserves, which requires mana batteries, if you will. The befouled elementals along the canal here are created with exactly the elemental cores we need.

The goal is two fold. Clearing out the befouled elementals, before their corruption spreads, but also retrieving their cores, so we can keep the water at bay.

passages.title: Shoring Up Mana Reserves
passages.text: How goes your hunt?

passages.title: Shoring Up Mana Reserves
passages.text: We will get these back to Admiral Proudmoore.

passages.title: Echoes of Pain
passages.text:
These spirits... they are the Highborne. They were those Azshara held close. Azshara often played favorites, but these people... they were her favorites.

I do not know why their spirits are here. We should investigate further. See if you can communicate with them and find out why their spirits cling to these ruins.

How could she abandon them?

passages.title: Echoes of Pain
passages.text: I feel such sadness for these spirits. Eternally locked to this place, reliving the worst day of their lives.

passages.title: Secrets in the Ruins
passages.text:
This was once a place of great power. The highborne who lived here would host lavish parties, living in splendor.

Zin-Azshari was once on the shores of the Well of Eternity and drew powerful mages from all over the empire to study here. I suspect, despite the many years at the bottom of the sea, there are still treasures and powerful artifacts hidden away here.

Speak with the spirits that remain and see what you can find. There must be something to help us overcome the Guardian of the Tidestone.

passages.title: Secrets in the Ruins
passages.text: What have you discovered, <name>?

passages.title: Secrets in the Ruins
passages.text: The Javelins of Azshara? I've never heard of such an item. Unless they mean the Javelins of Suramar? That would be a wondrous find!

passages.title: Help Them See the Truth
passages.text:
The information you have gleaned concerns me, <name>. These spirits cling to this place because they still, even now, believe in Azshara and her reign. She sold their lives to the void and they still believe in her.

I know we have concerns that outweigh this, but I cannot leave them here like this.

Show them. Confront them and tell them of Azshara's betrayal.

passages.title: Help Them See the Truth
passages.text: Have the spirits been put to rest?

passages.title: Help Them See the Truth
passages.text:
Many of the spirits who haunt Zin-Azshari do not know they are dead. They will not admit it to themselves.

We might be able to help them. If you are willing to help me.

passages.title: Purging the Defilers
passages.text:
Azshara always did need everything to be about her. Everything had to have her name on it. Everything was for her glory. She forgot our people's connection to Elune. Or perhaps she believed it did not matter?

Azshara and her minions have too long defiled this place with their heresy.

Let us show them Elune's vengeance.

passages.title: Purging the Defilers
passages.text: Elune's vengeance is swift and fierce. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: The Javelins of Azshara
passages.text:
These spirits keep speaking of the Javelins of Azshara. At first, I believed it to be referring to the handmaidens, who are currently holed up in Elun'alor.

But -- now I think they are referring to the Javelins of Suramar. They were powerful weapons -- long thought lost. Azshara does like to claim things as her own.

We need to defeat her handmaiden in Elun'alor regardless. Seizing the Javelins would be an amazing stroke of fortune.

passages.title: The Javelins of Azshara
passages.text: Killing her handmaidens will drive the naga back and out of Zin-Azshari.

passages.title: The Javelins of Azshara
passages.text: Killing a handmaiden alone would have been an amazing victory. Retrieving the Javelins of Suramar as well? Today is the turning point. Today, we have created the path to victory.

passages.title: Tol Dagor: Jewel of the Tides
passages.text:
<As you peer at the shrine in front of you, you can't help but revel at the construction of it.

Seamlessly constructed with azure jewels placed just so in a radial pattern, collapsing towards a single point.

A single, empty point. An absence you assume to be a mistake. Quickly surveying the area for something that might fit there, you find nothing.

However, there appears to be a drunk here shouting at the shrine. Perhaps he might know the whereabouts of the shrine's missing piece.>

passages.title: Tol Dagor: Jewel of the Tides
passages.text: <Perhaps finding the missing centerpiece will give you a clue into the shrine's operation?>

passages.title: Tol Dagor: Jewel of the Tides
passages.text:
<As you affix the gem back into the center of the shrine, a strange pulse emanates from it.

The shrine, now whole again, begins to hum with energy.>

passages.title: Cracking the Surface
passages.text:
<Upon your investigation you discover that the shrine has a couple locations where jewels appeared to have been located, but no longer exist.

Additionally, the center jewel appears to have several cracks in it as well.

Checking your notes, the earthen mentions having prospected the jewels from a nearby mountain to the northwest.

Perhaps you can prospect the earth in that area to find more of those jewels.>

passages.title: Cracking the Surface
passages.text: <The placement of the jewels on this shrine appear to be placed in a rather intricate fashion.>

passages.title: Cracking the Surface
passages.text:
Using your tools, you carefully shape the jewels and affix them into the empty slots on the shrine.

Using the remainder, you are able to fill in the cracks of the center jewel, giving it a flush surface.

As you place the final jewel, a similar pulse of energy radiates from the shrine as the light in the area seems to draw into it. A strange glow now emanating from the shrine leads you to believe it is once again active.

passages.title: High Prospects
passages.text:
<Inspecting the shrine, you realize that several of the gems embedded on its surface are cracked and need to be replaced.

Checking your notes, you find that the earthen had extracted the gems from some earth elementals to the south.

Looking at your map, you wonder if he was referring to the now ruins of a once ancient settlement that has become littered with constructs and undead.

Perhaps investigating there will yield some clues as to where to find these jewels.>

passages.title: High Prospects
passages.text: <All of the cracked jewels will definitely need to be replaced.>

passages.title: High Prospects
passages.text:
<You begin to remove all the cracked gems from the shrine and carefully start placing the new ones in.

Placing the final one, a pulse radiates from the shrine, as the light in the area seems to draw into it.

That strange, similar glow now emanating from the shrine leads you to believe it is once again active.>

passages.title: Atal'Dazar: Not All That Glitters...
passages.text:
<As you observe the shrine, it's quite clear that the central jewel is badly broken and in need of replacement.

You reference your notes on the shrine and discover that these jewels came from a "golden sanctuary".

Given your location, that can only mean Atal'Dazar. Perhaps you could find a replacement from that ancient city.>

passages.title: Atal'Dazar: Not All That Glitters...
passages.text: <When you're done replacing the central gem, you think you might still be able to sell the old one.>

passages.title: Atal'Dazar: Not All That Glitters...
passages.text:
<Returning to the shrine, you begin to pluck the old gem from its holding place. As you do, the gem cracks again and shatters in your hands.

Apparently these gems are much more fragile than you originally thought.

Very carefully, you replace the gem you obtained into the slot.

Once affixed, a peaceful glow now emanating from the shrine leads you to believe it is once again active.>

passages.title: Out With the Old
passages.text:
<Upon inspection of the shrine, you notice something... familiar. The cut of the gems looks like a primitive or simple version of the way you've learned to cut rubellites.

It's clear though that time has had its way with these gems, some eroded and chipped in places.

Repairing this shrine may be as simple as replacing the old gems with newer ones of the same type and cut.>

passages.title: Out With the Old
passages.text: <Interesting that the cut should be so similar, you wonder how the design has persisted all these years.>

passages.title: Out With the Old
passages.text:
<Replacing each gem, they fit perfectly into the slots confirming your suspicions of their similarities.

As you place the final gem, the familiar pulse radiates once more from the shrine and the glow emanating from it confirms its restoration.>

passages.title: A Promising Beginning
passages.text:
<The shrine now repaired, you find yourself eager to seek out the next shrine.

Perhaps Samuel has come across more locations.>

passages.title: A Promising Beginning
passages.text:
<You recount your findings of the Shrine of Storms to Samuel.>

And you were able to repair the shrine? That's excellent news. Perhaps the next two will have a similar situation given their age and potential disuse.

passages.title: Polished Up
passages.text:
<Samuel will surely want to hear about your progress on this shrine.

You feel as though you should report back to him as soon as you're able.>

passages.title: Polished Up
passages.text:
<You recount your findings about the shrine in Drustvar to Samuel.>

How fortunate for us that the inhabitants of that area used the same rocks to create their constructs from.

I suppose luck is on our side in the quest for these shrines.

passages.title: Setting Things Right
passages.text:
<Samuel will surely be interested to hear about your investigation into this shrine.

Most assuredly the part where you had to fight your way through a prison.>

passages.title: Setting Things Right
passages.text:
Oh, back already? That seemed quick. How'd it go?

<You recount your finding of the shrine and the replacement of the gems.>

That does sound like quite the adventure! Excellent work, <name>.

passages.title: A Promising Beginning
passages.text:
<The shrine now repaired, you find yourself eager to seek out the next shrine.

Perhaps Seshuli has come across more locations.>

passages.title: A Promising Beginning
passages.text:
So de shrine used de same cut of gems we use? To think dat design has survived all dese years.

You know, dat may be de oldest recorded cut in history. Maybe even de first!

But it's good to hear you were able to repair de shrine. Maybe de other two will need to be fixed too, seeing as how dey are very old.

passages.title: Polished Up
passages.text:
<Seshuli will surely want to hear about your progress on this shrine.

You feel as though you should report back to her as soon as you're able.>

passages.title: Polished Up
passages.text:
<You recount your findings about the Vol'dun shrine to Seshuli>

Dat desert is a fools home if ya ask me. Good thing de shrine still stands dere and you were able to fix it.

I'm still reading de journal trying to gather more information for you.

passages.title: Setting Things Right
passages.text:
<Seshuli will surely be interested to hear about your investigation into this shrine.

Most assuredly the part where you had to fight your way through Atal'Dazar.>

passages.title: Setting Things Right
passages.text:
<You recount your experience at the shrine with Seshuli.>

Traveled ta Atal'Dazar, eh? Dat place is quite amazing from what I remember.

Still though, great job on repairing de shrine.

passages.title: Bound by Honor
passages.text:
It is true that my clan has been battling the naga for generations, but it was only in recent times that we took the fight to Nazjatar. 

Our leader was slain by the vile queen, and now honor binds my clan to this deep ocean. 

We will avenge their death or die here trying. It is our way. 

Your mission aligns with our duty, so we will fight the naga together. 

Slay their forces and bring us one step closer to honoring our promise.

passages.title: Bound by Honor
passages.text: You fight like an Ankoan. You bring my clan honor with your actions today.

passages.title: Scouting Undercover
passages.text:
Entering the stronghold alone would be a death wish. 

The Zanj'ir slaughter outsiders on sight. 

The only way to get in without being killed is to appear to be under the effects of a zoatroid. 

Even then, the mind-shackled are put to work. 

You must obey all commands, or they will know your mind is still your own. 

Once the Zanj'ir believe you are mind-shackled, it should be easier to navigate their domain and uncover their secret.

passages.title: Scouting Undercover
passages.text: What use are you if you're not working?

passages.title: Sating Snapdragons
passages.text:
It's time for the snapdragons to feed, but it's a job best left to someone a little more expendable. 

The beasts will eat anything, including your arm if you don't move it away quickly enough. 

Luckily for you, they've developed a taste for Chitterspine Roe.

passages.title: Sating Snapdragons
passages.text: I'm surprised they didn't make a meal out of you.

passages.title: Coveted Crystals
passages.text:
Locating the weapons cache should not be a problem once we have the proper tools. A little light and a lot of bioluminescent fluid is all that is needed.

It all seems rather simple, does it not? But the key is in the Deepsea Crystal used to refract the light. 

The Bloodfin tribe covets these crystals, so you should have no trouble obtaining one.

passages.title: Coveted Crystals
passages.text: Have you found the crystal?

passages.title: Coveted Crystals
passages.text: I can see why the Bloodfin covet these crystals. The gem is unlike any I've seen before.

passages.title: What Will It Lure?
passages.text: <Putrid and pungent, this lump of bait is the preferred food of skittering eels. Perhaps you can find infested waters nearby?>

passages.title: What Will It Lure?
passages.text: What have you brought me?

passages.title: What Will It Lure?
passages.text:
Ah, what do we have here? A rare find, indeed! 

You've been chumming the waters I see! 

Just be careful. 

Eels aren't the only creatures that you'll attract with that bait.

passages.title: NOT USED
passages.text: TBD Collect Spare Parts from anything on the island.

passages.title: Operation: Mechagon - The Mechoriginator
passages.text:
My father's madness won't be contained to this island.

King Mechagon is creating a massive device capable of reversing the Curse of Flesh across the entirety of Azeroth!

Any races forged by the Titans will return to their original state. For us gnomes, that means fully mechanical. For dwarves and troggs, stone. Vrykul, iron.

The list goes on, but most races aren't even ON the list. Anything not forged by the titans will be completely obliterated.

We must stop King Mechagon before it's too late!

passages.title: Operation: Mechagon - The Mechoriginator
passages.text: King Mechagon's madness threatens all of us. We must stop my father!

passages.title: Operation: Mechagon - The Mechoriginator
passages.text:
That robot... that AI... was not my father.

My father died the day he abandoned his body and soul for full mechanization. The day he betrayed our people.

The burden of leadership has rested on my shoulders for some time... Only now, do I feel I can embrace it.

I will lead my people with wisdom, ingenuity, and humility. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: The Heart Forge
passages.text:
Rise in Heart Forge energy levels indicates presence of black dragon essence.

Recommendation: Initiate Heart Forge activation sequence.

passages.title: The Heart Forge
passages.text: Data calculations complete. Awaiting initiation of forge activation sequence.

passages.title: The Heart Forge
passages.text: Power source accepted. Forge activation complete.

passages.title: Drive It Away Today
passages.text:
The mount's all polished up and looking great. We are almost done!

I gave the Powercore Schematics to PASCAL-K1N6. He's ready to build us a new 500S-Cybergenic Powercore, once you get him the parts.

We install that powercore and you can drive this bot away today!

passages.title: Drive It Away Today
passages.text: Did you get the core?

passages.title: Drive It Away Today
passages.text: They won't be stealing from us anymore!

passages.title: Let's Get It Started
passages.text:
Those gnomes think busting up machinery is gonna stop a goblin like me from figuring out what all the tech in this place does?

I ain't never seen a hunk of junk so busted up that ol' Skaggit and I can't get running smoother than the day it was made.

Tell ya what. You head around with Skaggit and see what you can piece back together.

Meanwhile, I'll have a chat with our gnome friend here and see what she knows about all this tech.

passages.title: Let's Get It Started
passages.text: We'll have this place up and running in no time.

passages.title: Let's Get It Started
passages.text:
<Gazlowe's ears perk up and he listens intently for a few moments.>

Machine sounds good. Few loose bolts and missing wires, but nothin' we'd really miss.

Nice work.

passages.title: You Must be This Height
passages.text:
You and the Greasemonkeys got this machine up and running even faster than I expected.

The gnome we captured is keeping her mouth shut, but that shouldn't be a problem. I can take it from here.

Let me know when you're ready. I'll crank up this machine to max and we'll finally see what it can do.

I hope it prints gold coins...

passages.title: You Must be This Height
passages.text: That's the best use of a gnome I've ever seen!

passages.title: You Must be This Height
passages.text:
Phew. Close call there, but the risk is gonna pay out big.

Did you see the sweet tech King Mechagon was wearing? We gotta get our hands on that!

passages.title: A Voice on the Wind
passages.text:
<A distant, mysterious voice fills your mind.>

My enchantments are not lost...

Find me...

Drustvar...

Fallhaven...

passages.title: A Voice on the Wind
passages.text:
Be at ease, friend. I don't want to hurt you. Instead, I have a proposition for you.

You see, I was a druid once and the only thing I loved more than tending to the forests and creatures within them was enchanting. 

Then I was murdered and cursed to wander this peninsula, unable to cross river nor mountain so long as my body still exists. 

If you destroy my old body and help me make a new one, I will teach you how I made the rod you disenchanted.

passages.title: Vision of Stormwind
Princely Visit
passages.text:
This is it! The fabled Mechagon!

The greatest discovery of our age, and you're here to witness me accomplish it!

<Tinkmaster Overspark puffs out his chest, brushes off his robes, and smiles confidently.>

I am ready to address the Mechagon people. You may accompany me.

passages.title: Princely Visit
passages.text: Mechagon is not like the legends you were told.

passages.title: Princely Visit
passages.text: Welcome to the Rustbolt Resistance.

passages.title: The Legend of Mechagon
passages.text:
Heya, adventurer. I was just tellin' Skaggit that I was hoping I'd run into you up here!

I caught wind of an Alliance operation into some old vault that opened in Tiragarde Sound.

In typical gnomish fashion, Tinkmaster Overspark is overreacting like crazy, claiming it's some lost connection to the gnome fairytale land of Mechagon.

<Gazlowe scoffs.>

I don't buy that for a second, but I am very interested in getting my hands on whatever tech's in that vault. You in?

passages.title: The Legend of Mechagon
passages.text: Keep your head down! The Alliance beat us here!

passages.title: A Quick Ear Hustle
passages.text:
Bad news. We're late.

The Alliance was already crawling all over the vault when we got here.

Lucky for us, some big commotion inside sent some of 'em running for the hills.

Most of 'em are still down in that vault, though, including that crazy braggart Tinkmaster Overspark.

Let's give 'em a few more minutes to clear out, so we don't have to go in guns blazing.

passages.title: A Quick Ear Hustle
passages.text: What'd they find down there?

passages.title: A Quick Ear Hustle
passages.text:
Told you that Overspark was a chump.

A boss has gotta respect his crew, or they won't respect him.

passages.title: This is Our Vault Now
passages.text:
Looks like the coast is clear with Overspark gone. Let's get inside that vault and see what's really going on here.

Mechagon or not, there'd better be some quality hardware in there to make this trip worth our time.

passages.title: This is Our Vault Now
passages.text: Easy peasy. Now we just gotta get all this fancy gnomish machinery workin' again!

passages.title: Machinations for Mechagon
passages.text:
So Mechagon ain't just a fairy tale? Gotta admit I'm surprised.

But, if the tech on that king is any indication of what they've got out there for us to swipe, I am very, very happy to be wrong!

We can't rush into this. A good crew died today. That ain't happening again on my watch.

Meet me and Skaggit back in Zuldazar Harbor, and we'll build this expedition up right.

passages.title: Machinations for Mechagon
passages.text: Feels good to be back on Horde turf.

passages.title: Only the Best Will Do
passages.text:
You heard Gazlowe. The boss wants this expedition to go smoothly. No cutting corners, no slush.

I know you've worked with Gallywix in the past. We don't run our operations like that.

We expect the best from our crews, so we pay 'em what they're worth and treat 'em well. In return, we got the best goblin crews on the planet, and they ain't goin' over to any competition.

Here's a list of who and what we're gonna need to pull this off. Don't worry, Gazlowe'll cover all the costs.

passages.title: Only the Best Will Do
passages.text: Look, <name>, I ain't got time to hold your hand through all this. Figure it out or I'll find someone else who will.

passages.title: Only the Best Will Do
passages.text: This might be the best crew Gazlowe and I have ever assembled!

passages.title: To Mechagon!
passages.text:
Whatever's waiting for us on the shores of Mechagon, we're going to be ready for it with this crew.

I don't hold any misconceptions about how that crazy king is going to welcome us. Guns blazin', I'm sure.

So we're going in quietly on this submarine. Low profile'll keep us all safe.

When you're ready to go, talk to Captain Krooz.

passages.title: To Mechagon!
passages.text:
Don't let the grass fool ya. Look at those bots on the shoreline. That city up ahead. That constant buzz of machinery and smog in the air.

This place is a technological gold mine.

passages.title: Prospectus Bay
passages.text:
Looks like we made it in unnoticed.

Skaggit's crew can set up shop on that beach, but we gotta make sure it's safe for 'em to land first.

Let's do a quick flyover to scout out how we're going to crack this place wide open.

That town up on the hill looks promising...

passages.title: Prospectus Bay
passages.text: We'll own this whole island in no time.

passages.title: Clues Abound
passages.text:
Before King Mechagon claimed this island, someone else lived here. Buried beneath this filth and garbage is the history of a forgotten people. With your help, we shall learn about these previous inhabitants.

Sir Finley has marked a location where he's seen unusual artifacts. Meet him there and see if you can discover any clues.

passages.title: Clues Abound
passages.text: Get to it, history is waiting for you!

passages.title: Clues Abound
passages.text: Good show! We'll get to the bottom of this mystery in no time!

passages.title: Encrypted Radio Receiver TBD
passages.text: NYI - Will add Black Market viewing NPC in town

passages.title: A Historical Mess
passages.text:
The text on this parchment appears to be Tortollan. Is it possible that Tortollans once resided on this island? 

We need to act quickly, before the creatures in this area destroy anymore evidence. Search the area for any signs of Tortollan relics.

passages.title: A Historical Mess
passages.text: Get to it, history is waiting for you!

passages.title: A Historical Mess
passages.text: Jolly good show. We'll be to the bottom of this mystery in no time!

passages.title: We Come in Peace... and Profit
passages.text:
King Mechagon won't be happy we're on his island.

But a cruel king like that is gonna have enemies. You and I know that better than most, yeah?

While Skaggit and the crew get our foothold dug in here, you and I are gonna find some potential allies to shield us from King Mechagon's wrath.

Those two guards ran into that junkheap town up the hill. That place don't smell of royalty to me... Let's check there first.

passages.title: We Come in Peace... and Profit
passages.text: Mechagon is not like the legends you were told.

passages.title: We Come in Peace... and Profit
passages.text: Welcome to the Rustbolt Resistance.

passages.title: A Growing Mystery
passages.text:
This runestone could be of Vrykul origins. Is it possible that Vrykul once visited this island? 

Where there's one runestone, there's usually more. The roots of lashers are drawn to the magic of runestones. If there are more buried here, the Lasher roots maybe wrapped around them!

Clear these lashers and see if any have runestones tangled in their roots.

passages.title: A Growing Mystery
passages.text: Get to it, history is waiting for you!

passages.title: A Growing Mystery
passages.text: Very good, We will examine these and see where it leads us.

passages.title: There's Something in the Water
passages.text:
The Ankoan must contend with threats from not only the naga, but also the horrors of N'Zoth. We learned early that if we allow his infection even the smallest purchase, he will grow and corrupt everything.

There is a great evil who is lingering near the waterway that flows through this place. It must be dealt with.

passages.title: There's Something in the Water
passages.text: Another will take it's place, eventually. Like clearing weeds from a garden, it's a constant battle against invasion.

passages.title: That New Mount Smell
passages.text:
Once every week, Mechagon expels a lot of excess oils through the outflow. That's why the place is a toxic mess!

Today they expelled a batch of Golden Cogpaste. The stuff is amazing! I make air fresheners out of it. Makes any mount smell like it's brand new!

Check all the pipes in the outflow, and see if you can collect some of this paste.

passages.title: That New Mount Smell
passages.text: I still could use that cogpaste.

passages.title: That New Mount Smell
passages.text: I was running low on Air Fresheners, this will let me whip up a new batch right away!

passages.title: A Little Leg Work
passages.text:
The legs and shocks on this mount are shot! We'll need some new ones if we're going to get this mount crawling.
 
A few weeks ago, Bondo and his gang rode into the Scrapbone Den hoping to scare the Troggs off. The Troggs tore their crawlers apart! The parts for those crawlers are still laying all around Scrapbone Den.

See if you can get us some of those parts from the Troggs.

passages.title: A Little Leg Work
passages.text: We need those legs.

passages.title: A Little Leg Work
passages.text: These parts will get us closer to being able to ride this thing!

passages.title: First One's Free
passages.text:
The pocket-sized computational device can accept punch cards to upgrade and modify its performance.

I could give you a punch card, but a particularly crafty trogg, Moch'k Eight-Thumbs, stole my satchel full of cards. 

Kill Moch'k Eight-Thumbs, recover my satchel, and I'll set you up with a punch card for free.

passages.title: First One's Free
passages.text: Get that satchel back!

passages.title: First One's Free
passages.text: You are rather amazing for someone with so little mechanization!

passages.title: Upgraded
passages.text:
Well, look at you, <race>...

<Christy's mechanical eyes quickly scan your body.>

Not as impressive as I had hoped.

King Mechagon's armies are fully mechanized. But, you... you have a severe excess of flesh and matching machinery deficiency.

Yes, we simply must make a few changes... Maybe a neural-cranial upgrade!

Bring me a few microcogs from the motospiders nearby and I'll fix you up!

passages.title: Upgraded
passages.text: You must be able to out-think King Mechagon in battle. Get me those parts.

passages.title: Upgraded
passages.text: Your first upgrade! Try it out some before we attach it permanently.

passages.title: Strange Discovery
passages.text: <A very old ring of Nightelf origin. Seems out of place on this island, perhaps Elise Starseeker will know what to make of it>

passages.title: Strange Discovery
passages.text:
This creates more questions than answers about this islands past.

I'll look into this further when I return to Ironforge.

passages.title: Requisition: A Few Seaweed
passages.text: We have so many wounded and we are dangerously low on seaweed bandages. If you find Sticky Seaweed, please give it to the quartermaster.

passages.title: Requisition: A Few Seaweed
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: Requisition: A Few Kelp Buds
passages.text:
We need rations for our forces. While kelp buds do not have the same delicious taste as other options, it is nutritious and plentiful near any kelp forests. This makes it our first choice for making rations.

If you happen to find any around Nazjatar, please leave your stores with the quartermaster. The ones freshly fallen from kelp are best.

passages.title: Requisition: A Few Kelp Buds
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: Requisition: A Few Deepcoral Buds
passages.text:
Many species feed on the deepcoral buds from the tall columns that grow in the east. Fathom rays feed on these buds especially. We use the buds as lures for fathom rays to use as mounts. But with our stores so low, we will not be able to provide the air support we need across Nazjatar.

If you could gather more deepcoral buds and return them to the quartermaster, you will surely be rewarded.

passages.title: Requisition: A Few Deepcoral Buds
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: Requisition: A Few Flotsam
passages.text:
I have seen piles of flotsam in the sands to the west. If you could go out and scrounge anything useful from the debris, it could prove useful. Beware, that area is a hydra breeding ground and they have been growing more aggressive since the water receded.

Once you've gathered some supplies, return to the quartermaster for your reward.

passages.title: Requisition: A Few Flotsam
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: The Resistance Needs YOU!
passages.text:
Rustbolt isn't usually in this level of malfunction.

King Mechagon attacked our town last night. His mechanical armies captured many members of the Rustbolt Resistance and destroyed as much as they could before we drove them out.

The prisoners are being processed at Junkwatt Depot. After that, they'll be transferred down into King Mechagon's underground city... for full mechanization.

We can't let that happen. Will you help me rescue them?

passages.title: The Resistance Needs YOU!
passages.text: This is where they process all prisoners before sending them into King Mechagon's city for reprogramming.

passages.title: Rescuing the Resistance
passages.text:
King Mechagon is ruthlessly efficient. He only expends resources to kidnap those he deems worthy.

The rest, he... discards.

<Prince Erazmin grimaces.>

We will deal with my father, King Mechagon, another day.

This information is more immediately relevant in that my father's predictability means our top scientists, engineers, and tinkerers should all be trapped, alive, somewhere in this depot.

We will find them, and break them out.

passages.title: Rescuing the Resistance
passages.text: My father is short-sighted. He judges the worthiness of an individual in its current state. He fails to truly see their potential.

passages.title: Rescuing the Resistance
passages.text: My father is short-sighted. He judges the worthiness of an individual in its current state. He fails to truly see their potential.

passages.title: My Father's Armies
passages.text:
My father was once a good leader. He envisioned a brighter future for his people, and did everything in his power to help us acquire it.

But when his vision became misaligned with the dreams of his people, he failed to adapt. Instead, he grew rigid, forcing his will on others.

In secret experiments, he began fully mechanizing the bodies of those who resisted him.

It was horrible to watch... there was nothing left of the original gnomes who followed him willingly.

Only robots remained. Slaves.

passages.title: My Father's Armies
passages.text: If we don't stop my father here, we will all share these poor gnomes' fates.

passages.title: My Father's Armies
passages.text: If we don't stop my father, we will all share these poor gnomes' fates.

passages.title: An Old Scar
passages.text:
We've got a new problem, champion. Another grievous wound has opened up, this time at the Maelstrom!

The shaman there are in deep trouble, an' they need our help!

Speak tae MOTHER. She'll get ye tae the Maelstrom. I'll meet ye there.

passages.title: An Old Scar
passages.text: I expected things tae be bad, but it's even worse than I thought!

passages.title: Welcome to the Resistance
passages.text:
Life in the Rustbolt Resistance is not easy, <name>.

But it is yours. We will not order you around or force you to fight. Mechagon is a land of endless opportunities, and you may chase whichever opportunities you see fit.

Of course, if you'd like suggestions for which improvements you most require, myself or any of the other mechagnomes in town will be happy to advise you of your current weaknesses.

But, for now, I ask simply that you walk with me to my workshop.

passages.title: Welcome to the Resistance
passages.text: I wonder, what will you choose to do next?

passages.title: At the Azerite Time
passages.text:
Ye did it! Ye stopped the damage before it could get any worse!

The Maelstrom will always be a place o' great history an' pain fer Azeroth, but any little bit we do will make things better. Who knows, maybe we can even heal Silithus one day!

I'll meet ye back in the Chamber o' Heart. MOTHER's sure tae be interested in what happened here.

passages.title: At the Azerite Time
passages.text: Heart examination complete. Additional Azerite amplification activated.

passages.title: TBD NOT USED
passages.text: TBD

passages.title: Back to the Chamber
passages.text:
The Heart o' Azeroth is gettin' stronger every day, and it's makin' a difference.

Make yer way tae the Chamber o' Heart, champion. Yer talents are needed.

passages.title: Back to the Chamber
passages.text: The Heart o' Azeroth never ceases tae amaze me. Well done, champion!

passages.title: TBD NOT USED
passages.text: TBD

passages.title: More Recycling
passages.text: <Recycling is fun and profitable. The Recyclerizer DX-82 stands ready to receive more scrap metal.>

passages.title: More Recycling
passages.text: <WARNING 3.6.4 - Y: Keep all appendages clear of doors or risk irreversible limb recyclerization.>

passages.title: More Recycling
passages.text: You deposit the bundle of parts into the Recyclerizer DX-82.  The doors close and the machine surges to life, a slight buzzing sound begins emanating from within. The sound increases in frequency, the slight buzz giving way to a high-pitched whirring. The machine shakes violently, seemingly ready to explode...

passages.title: We Stand United
passages.text:
The work ye've done tae empower the Heart o' Azeroth cannae be understated! With this power, we might just stand a chance o' savin' the world.

It's been a long fight fer certain, an' there is still more tae do. But fer now, we've got a little gift fer ye!

Let me know when yer ready, champion.

passages.title: We Stand United
passages.text: Ain' it incredible, champion? There's no tellin' how powerful the Heart may yet become!

passages.title: We Stand United
passages.text:
Amazin' isn't it? Tae see the dragonflights united in support o' Azeroth. Some o' them may be battered an' bruised, but they're still fightin'.

Bear their gifts well, Champion of Azeroth.

passages.title: Knock His Bot Off
passages.text:
I need to rebuild the main powercore. It's a 500S Mekronic so I'll need the operational schematics to get the work done. Only person I know who has a copy of that is Bondo Bigblock.

We're going to need Bondo's help to finish this. Maybe if you ask him, he'll lend us his schematics.

passages.title: Knock His Bot Off
passages.text: Did you make a deal with Bondo?

passages.title: Knock His Bot Off
passages.text: Great work <name>. All that's left is to rebuild this power core.

passages.title: Bugs, Lots of 'Em!
passages.text:
You got a problem with mechanical bugs, so the Roughriders are here to sort this mess out!

In my experience, this big of an outbreak must have some sort of queen bug behind it all. We gonna go in, kill a lot of bugs till we find the leader of 'em all.

Horde or Alliance don't matter, you're with the Roughriders today. Let's kill some bugs!

passages.title: Bugs, Lots of 'Em!
passages.text: Do your job!

passages.title: Bugs, Lots of 'Em!
passages.text: You took the battle to them. You are a Roughrider!

passages.title: Visions of Danger
passages.text:
<name>, Spiritwalker Ussoh has revealed a disturbing vision to me regarding Baine Bloodhoof.

He has asked that you speak with him as soon as you can.

Return to me after. We will have much to discuss.

passages.title: Visions of Danger
passages.text: Sylvanas will execute Baine Bloodhoof soon... unless we act.

passages.title: Stay of Execution
passages.text: Come. It is time to save a friend.

passages.title: Stay of Execution
passages.text:
Thank the Sunwell you were able to save Baine's life, <name>. Thank you.

And Jaina Proudmoore came to his aid as well. Interesting...

passages.title: Old Allies
passages.text:
Sylvanas was my Ranger-General. I have respected her for millennia. Making this choice is something I have been wrestling with for some time. Baine's death will tear the Horde apart. The Tauren will not stand for it and if they leave, I know they will not be the last.

We must save Baine. Not just for his life, but for the Horde. I can only hope once the time pressure is gone we may be able to reason with her but... 

I have contacted allies who will help. Meet them in the Cleft of Shadows.

passages.title: Old Allies
passages.text: It is good to see you again, <name>. Quickly, Baine does not have much time.

passages.title: Old Allies
passages.text:
Sylvanas Windrunner was once my ranger-general. Now she is my warchief. Through peacetime and war, I followed her orders.

Until now.

Baine is a noble soul. His execution would drive a blade into the very heart of the Horde.

We must save him, <name>. It is the only way to preserve who we are. What we stand for. 

I have reached out to allies who will help you. But in siding with them, you will put your own life in peril.

If you feel as I do, then meet them in the Cleft of Shadows. Good luck.

passages.title: Old Allies
passages.text: Once again, we face dark times, <name>.

passages.title: Old Allies
passages.text:
Your aid is welcome, <class>.

Baine has little time left.

passages.title: Stay of Execution
passages.text: Baine's time is short. We must act now.

passages.title: Stay of Execution
passages.text:
A pity Bloodhoof and all the rest survived.

Our Warchief has anticipated this outcome, however.

passages.title: Stay of Execution
passages.text:
When I was younger, Baine Bloodhoof and I began exchanging letters. Through our unlikely friendship, I learned that there was nobility in the Horde.

He proved that by defying Sylvanas when she planned to strip the free will from Derek Proudmoore. That act of nobility will cost him his life... unless we intervene.

If there is to be peace in Azeroth, our hope depends upon good people doing the right thing. People like Baine. People like you.

Please, go with Jaina. Save my friend and see him home.

passages.title: Stay of Execution
passages.text:
Thank you for helping us rescue Baine.

It was the right thing to do.

passages.title: Payment in Kind
passages.text:
<name>, King Anduin has requested our presence in Stormwind.

We've sent him reports on our situation here in Nazjatar, and he understands the severity of the threat we're facing. For him to pull both of us back from the front lines, it must be a matter of grave importance.

I will meet you in Stormwind Keep.

passages.title: Payment in Kind
passages.text: Thank you for coming, <name>.

passages.title: Payment in Kind
passages.text:
We may be at war with the Horde, but that did not stop Baine from doing the right thing.

We can do no less for him.

passages.title: Requisition: More Seaweed
passages.text: We have so many wounded and we are dangerously low on seaweed bandages. If you find Sticky Seaweed, please give it to the quartermaster.

passages.title: Requisition: More Seaweed
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: Requisition: More Kelp Buds
passages.text:
We need rations for our forces. While kelp buds do not have the same delicious taste as other options, it is nutritious and plentiful near any kelp forests. This makes it our first choice for making rations.

If you happen to find any around Nazjatar, please leave your stores with the quartermaster. The ones freshly fallen from kelp are best.

passages.title: Requisition: More Kelp Buds
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

Many species feed on the deepcoral buds from the tall columns that grow in the east. Fathom rays feed on these buds especially. We use the buds as lures for fathom rays to use as mounts. But with our stores so low, we will not be able to provide the air support we need across Nazjatar.

If you could gather more deepcoral buds and return them to the quartermaster, you will surely be rewarded.

passages.title: Requisition: More Deepcoral Buds
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: Requisition: More Flotsam
passages.text:
I have seen piles of flotsam in the sands to the west. If you could go out and scrounge anything useful from the debris, it could prove useful. Beware, that area is a hydra breeding ground and they have been growing more aggressive since the water receded.

Once you've gathered some supplies, return to the quartermaster for your reward.

passages.title: Requisition: More Flotsam
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: Mountain On the Move
passages.text:
I have seen such fervor only once before.

In times of peril, Torcali may call upon her children to defend her and those she looks after.

It is likely she called your beast away. Go to her and see how you can help.

passages.title: Mountain On the Move
passages.text:
<Torcali's voice enters your mind.>

I have called and you have come once again, <name>. We have little time to waste.

passages.title: Heresy at the Crossroad
passages.text:
<Torcali's voice enters your mind.>

My followers undertook a pilgrimage to a place called the Antul'Mita Plateau. It is regarded as the crossroads of Zandalar among my faithful and is the site of a Greater Wayshrine.

I sense some great peril has fallen upon them.

I have sent my children and my champion, Jo'nok, to their aid. Your charge is among them. Go to her and ensure that my acolytes reach the shrine safely.

Let nothing stand in your way.

passages.title: Heresy at the Crossroad
passages.text: She is ready. You are ready. This one thinks dey have made a mistake in challenging us.

passages.title: The Direhorn Mother's Fury
passages.text:
This one protects de faithful who still seek de shrine.

You will take your companion and show them de fury of a mother direhorn.

Trust in your young friend. She has always known how to fight.

Open de way. Slay de heretics that defile our loa's shrine.

passages.title: The Direhorn Mother's Fury
passages.text: A direhorn is gentle until it is provoked. Their mistake.

passages.title: The Direhorn Mother's Fury
passages.text: It is a joy to behold her strength, <name>. Our faith is rewarded.

passages.title: Wander Not Alone
passages.text:
She is here. I can feel her eyes upon us.

My loa is generous. She will reward you for de service you have given her.

Great Wanderer guide your path, <name>.

passages.title: Wander Not Alone
passages.text:
<Torcali's voice enters your mind.>

Time and time again I have called upon you. Time and time again you have answered.

The little one tells me she will follow you wherever it is that you wish to go. After all that you have done for my faithful and my young, this is my gift to you.

From this day until the end of your days, you will wander not alone.

<Torcali gently touches her great snout to your head.>

Thank you and farewell, <name>.

passages.title: Aim High
passages.text:
This conspiracy of ravens is preying on citizens of Rustbolt, it's unacceptable! 

Prince Erazmin has asked me to reduce their numbers, but I could really use your help. Can you help me kill some of them? 

Use my marker gun if you need it. I'll blast the ones you mark, and help bring them down.

passages.title: Aim High
passages.text: Let's get to it!

passages.title: Aim High
passages.text: We make a superior team.

passages.title: Other Interests
passages.text:
Madam Goya is interested in many unusual items other than just rare metals.

Keep an eye out for these particular items during your travels in Nazjatar.

Deliver them to me and Madam Goya will consider you for special access.

passages.title: Other Interests
passages.text: Have you found these items?

passages.title: Other Interests
passages.text: Excellent work, we shall speak again.

passages.title: The Other Place
passages.text:
In my travels of the many possible futures, I discovered another place much like Rustbolt, but different.

In this other time and place, very little is alive, everything is machines.
 
You must travel to this other place. You will scan the memory banks of the Clockwork Giants you find there. Then we will use that data to ensure that our Rustbolt never becomes the other place.

passages.title: The Other Place
passages.text: You must accomplish this task, for all of our sakes.

passages.title: The Other Place
passages.text: With this perhaps we can alter the timeline that would bring us all to this place.

passages.title: Bounty: A Few Naga
passages.text:
The naga are our true enemy. All other efforts in Nazjatar are second to disrupting the naga's operations. If you want to be an asset to our cause then destroying the enemy is a quick way to earn your way here.

When you have completed your task, report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

passages.title: Bounty: A Few Naga
passages.text: I know it is dirty work, but someone must do it.

passages.title: Bounty: A Few Naga
passages.text: This will ease our efforts in Nazjatar.

passages.title: Bounty: A Few Murlocs
passages.text:
While murlocs are often only a nuisance, certain factions are becoming more of a danger to our people. It is time we work together to preserve our safety while moving about Nazjatar.

Put an end to some of the more aggressive murlocs and the quartermaster will award you.

passages.title: Bounty: A Few Murlocs
passages.text: This will ease our efforts in Nazjatar.

passages.title: Bounty: A Few Hydras
passages.text:
Our forces are desperately outmatched when it comes to the hydras. They are ferocious, tenacious, and deadly. We have retreated almost entirely out of the western region of Nazjatar.

If we are going to hold the line against the naga, we need to make sure the western region is safe for our forces. Destroy as many hydras as you can manage, then report to the quartermaster.

passages.title: Bounty: A Few Hydras
passages.text: This will ease our efforts in Nazjatar.

passages.title: Bounty: A Few Coral Ancients
passages.text:
Coral ancients are beginning to awaken from their long slumber. I warn you, these are very dangerous creatures of immense size and power. If more of them begin to awaken, our forces will be in great danger.

Once you have defeated some of these ancients, report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

passages.title: Bounty: A Few Coral Ancients
passages.text: This will ease our efforts in Nazjatar.

passages.title: Bounty: A Few Makrura
passages.text:
The makrura have been a thorn in our side for too long. They are aggressive towards almost all species in Nazjatar and are very dangerous in groups. Less of them in our waters would certainly benefit our cause.

Once you are done, report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

passages.title: Bounty: A Few Makrura
passages.text: This will ease our efforts in Nazjatar.

passages.title: Bounty: A Few Crabs
passages.text:
The crab population is expanding too quickly within Nazjatar, endangering local plant life. Cull their numbers in our conservation effort.

Report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

passages.title: Bounty: A Few Crabs
passages.text: This will ease our efforts in Nazjatar.

passages.title: Bounty: A Few Snapdragons
passages.text:
Snapdragons are one of the most dangerous species on Nazjatar. The naga breed them for the viciousness and their ability as trackers.

If we hope to keep our positions hidden from the naga, we must take out these groups of snapdragons immediately.

After you are done, report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

passages.title: Bounty: A Few Snapdragons
passages.text: This will ease our efforts in Nazjatar.

passages.title: Bounty: A Few Fathom Rays
passages.text:
The fathom ray population is eating all of the coral buds to the east. If we do not cull their numbers, we may have an environmental catastrophe on our hands.

Once you have finished, report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

passages.title: Bounty: A Few Fathom Rays
passages.text: This will ease our efforts in Nazjatar.
