passages.text: This will ease our efforts in Nazjatar.

passages.title: Bounty: Elite Naga Forces
passages.text:
Strike at the elite naga forces within Nazjatar. Once we remove some of their leadership, our people will be able to move about more freely.

Report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

passages.title: Bounty: Elite Naga Forces
passages.text: I know it is dirty work, but someone must do it.

passages.title: Bounty: Elite Naga Forces
passages.text: This will ease our efforts in Nazjatar.

passages.title: Essential Empowerment
passages.text:
Champion, excitin' news!

I know yer busy dealin' with the naga threat right now, but we need ye to come back tae the Chamber of Heart! MOTHER's finally finished her calculations and she's got an idea of what tae do next!

Hurry back tae Silithus as quick as ye can. Azeroth needs ye!

passages.title: Essential Empowerment
passages.text: There ye are! Chamber's lookin' better, eh?

passages.title: Essential Empowerment
passages.text:
Welcome back, champion! We've got loads tae do now that MOTHER's finished her calculatin'.

Let's get started, eh?

passages.title: Let the Residue Lead You
passages.text:
I have fashioned a device that will emit bioluminescent light when toggled on, allowing you to see any Azerite residue that lingers. 

It should give you a clear trail to the weapons cache. 

Good luck, <name>.

passages.title: Let the Residue Lead You
passages.text: <Although tightly sealed, the radiating energy and weight suggest that the crate contains Azerite weapons.>

passages.title: Insight into Our Enemies
passages.text:
There's no telling what awaits us within this land. We cannot press forward without first knowing exactly what we're up against. 

Although our new allies have suffered greatly at the hands of the naga, their hardships will not be in vain. 

The kelfin should have invaluable knowledge of Azshara's forces. 

With their help, we might be able to learn more about how our enemies operate.

Speak with Neri and see what insight she can provide.

passages.title: Insight into Our Enemies
passages.text:
You want some insight into the naga?

I can tell you what I know, but the kelfin who are still being held captive can give you a firsthand account.

passages.title: The Price is Death
passages.text:
We've long believed that the ocean is big enough for all that wish to call it home. 

Unfortunately, the naga don't see it that way. 

They kill and capture our kind without remorse, and it's about time they paid the price.

passages.title: The Price is Death
passages.text:
If they're dead, they can't hurt me anymore. 

If I keep telling myself that, soon enough I'll believe it, right?

passages.title: Scouting Undercover
passages.text:
Entering the stronghold alone would be a death wish.

The Zanj'ir slaughter outsiders on sight. 

The only way to get in without being killed is to appear to be under the effects of a zoatroid. 

Even then, the mind-shackled are put to work. 

You must obey all commands, or they will know your mind is still your own. 

Once the Zanj'ir believe you are mind-shackled, it should be easier to navigate their domain and uncover their secret.

passages.title: Scouting Undercover
passages.text: What use are you to us if you're not working?

passages.title: Coveted Crystals
passages.text:
Locating the weapons cache shouldn't be a problem once we have the proper tools. A little light and a lot of bioluminescent fluid is all we need!

It all seems rather simple, doesn't it? But the key is in the Deepsea Crystal used to refract the light. 

I am told that the Bloodfin tribe covets these crystals, so it shouldn't be too much trouble to get your hands on one.

passages.title: Coveted Crystals
passages.text: Have you found the crystal?

passages.title: Coveted Crystals
passages.text: The clarity on this gem is rather remarkable, wouldn't you say? I think it'll do nicely.

passages.title: Let the Residue Lead You
passages.text:
I've fashioned a device that will emit bioluminescent light when toggled on, allowing you to see any Azerite residue that lingers. 

It should give you a clear trail to the weapons cache. 

Good luck, <name>.

passages.title: Let the Residue Lead You
passages.text: <Although tightly sealed, the radiating energy and weight suggest that the crate contains Azerite weapons.>

passages.title: Clearing Out the Cache
passages.text: <While inspecting the crate, a commotion can be heard within the cavern. A familiar voice, shouting orders.>

passages.title: Clearing Out the Cache
passages.text:
It seems Azshara's influence reaches even further than we thought. 

Ashvane may have escaped, but at least we have secured the weapons.

passages.title: Redistribution of Power
passages.text:
Welcome back, dear test subject.

Today's experiment is...

<Pristy flips through some papers and smiles.>

...My pet project, the NRG-100!

I am quite pleased with the potential improvements I've made to efficiency, potency, and destructivity.

And the only thing I had to sacrifice was stability!

When you're ready to proceed, strap on the NRG-100.

passages.title: Redistribution of Power
passages.text: Let's experiment!

passages.title: Redistribution of Power
passages.text:
Wondrous experimentation, dear test subject!

I'll make further modifications to the NRG-100 based on these results. It will be ready for our follow-up test in a few days.

passages.title: Rico's Rescue
passages.text:
Some of our Roughriders are missing, I tried to find them, but got pinned down here by the bugs! 

I could really use your help, <name>. See if you can save my missing troopers.

passages.title: Rico's Rescue
passages.text: Rico put in a good word for you. Could mean a promotion sometime.

passages.title: Rustbolt Rebellion
passages.text: Aid the Rustbolt resistance.

passages.title: Clearing Out the Cache
passages.text: <While inspecting the crate, a commotion can be heard within the cavern. A familiar voice, shouting orders.>

passages.title: Clearing Out the Cache
passages.text:
It seems Azshara's influence reaches even further than we thought. 

Ashvane may have escaped, but at least we have secured the weapons.

passages.title: Sating Snapdragons
passages.text:
It's time for the snapdragons to feed, but it's a job best left to someone a little more expendable. 

The beasts will eat anything, including your arm if you don't move it away quickly enough. 

Luckily for you, they've developed a taste for Chitterspine Roe.

passages.title: Sating Snapdragons
passages.text: I'm surprised they didn't make a meal out of you.

passages.title: Iteration is Key
passages.text:
You've been holding out on me!

Here I was, thinking that we're friends now and yet you neglected to tell me about your magnificient wrench!

<Christy inspects it closely.>

Well, not too magnificient... I recognize the Ub3r-Spanner from its blueprints, but whoever built this lacks a certain level of craftsmanship.

I will upgrade it for you. Bring me the Overcharged Mecha-core from a mechanocrawler.

No excuses. I will fix your mistakes.

passages.title: Iteration is Key
passages.text: Imagine crafting an Ub3r-Spanner without an overcharged mecha-core... Ha!

passages.title: Iteration is Key
passages.text: This will only take a minute. Keep a close eye on what I do, and you will learn a thing or ten.

passages.title: A Safer Place
passages.text: <The murloc seems to be in rough shape. Perhaps it would be safer with your allies in Mezzamere.>

passages.title: A Safer Place
passages.text: <Mrrl seems at home in his new spot and his family has also taken up refuge here. It is unlikely you will be able to remove this new murloc infestation.>

passages.title: Do Not Drink
passages.text:
These troggs watch everything we do. 

They see us pouring oil into various machines, so now they're stealing the oil and drinking it. I think they believe it's going to turn them into machines!

We need that oil back, before they drink it all!

passages.title: Do Not Drink
passages.text: Get that oil back quick!

passages.title: Do Not Drink
passages.text: Ya done good work.

passages.title: The Warchief's Order
passages.text:
Champion, the Dark Lady summons you. The time has come to set her plan into motion.

Our warships are ready to embark. The key to victory over the Alliance is within our grasp.

Meet me in Zuldazar, aboard the Banshee's Wail. What we do next... we do for the Horde.

passages.title: The Warchief's Order
passages.text: Ah, the final member of our crew has arrived.

passages.title: The Wolf's Offensive
passages.text:
Champion, Spymaster Shaw reports that the remains of the Horde fleet is preparing to depart.

They will be easy pickings for our superior forces. Let us seize this opportunity to eliminate their threat once and for all!

Preparations are underway to set sail. Come to Boralus Harbor and meet with me upon the Wind's Redemption with all haste!

passages.title: The Wolf's Offensive
passages.text:
You're just in time, <name>. 
Spymaster Shaw was just informing me of some new intelligence we've recently learned about the Horde fleet.

passages.title: Working with Purpose
passages.text:
It seems the Shirakess are never satisfied with the number of pearls we source for them. They're always demanding more. 

Before you came along, it was my job to crawl around the cavern, cracking open clams. 

So you see, you have some purpose, other than being a mindless sack of flesh.

passages.title: Working with Purpose
passages.text: Do you have them all?

passages.title: Working with Purpose
passages.text: Eager to please, aren't you?

passages.title: We Can't Have Dull Weapons
passages.text:
For a squid head, you sure are making my life easier. 

I guess you get to live long enough to complete another task. 

Our new weapons are forged from some foreign material that I don't quite trust. 

You won't catch me sharpening any blades, but the work still needs to get done. 

Get to it!

passages.title: We Can't Have Dull Weapons
passages.text: <The weapons on the rack radiate with a familiar energy.>

passages.title: Send the Fleet
passages.text:
This war has cost us dearly, but victory will soon be in our grasp.

What remains of the Horde fleet has departed Zuldazar and our spies say that the Banshee Queen's hand sails at their helm.

This is our chance, <name>! With one strike we can eliminate what remains of their fleet and rid Azeroth of Blightcaller's filth once and for all!

The fleet is preparing to depart, report to the Harbormaster when you are ready to set sail.

passages.title: Send the Fleet
passages.text: Never could I have expected this...

passages.title: Send the Fleet
passages.text:
The Warchief has entrusted me with a mission of the highest priority, <name>.

The mission will succeed, of this there is no question, but to ensure that any obstacles I encounter are dealt with swiftly I once again have need of your particular skills.

The Zandalari have offered us use of their ships for this endeavor. Clear out whatever affairs you have remaining and report to Captain Rez'okun when you are ready to set sail.

passages.title: Send the Fleet
passages.text:
An unexpected development, but it changes nothing.

We have our orders to carry out, <name>.

passages.title: Working with Purpose
passages.text:
It seems the Shirakess are never satisfied with the number of pearls we source for them. They're always demanding more. 

Before you came along, it was my job to crawl around the cavern, cracking open clams. 

So you see, you have some purpose, other than being a mindless sack of flesh.

passages.title: Working with Purpose
passages.text: Do you have them all?

passages.title: Working with Purpose
passages.text: Eager to please, aren't you?

passages.title: We Can't Have Dull Weapons
passages.text:
For a squid head, you sure are making my life easier. 

I guess you get to live long enough to complete another task. 

Our new weapons are forged from some foreign material that I don't quite trust. 

You won't catch me sharpening any blades, but the work still needs to get done. 

Get to it!

passages.title: We Can't Have Dull Weapons
passages.text: <The weapons on the rack radiate with a familiar energy.>

passages.title: Deck 'Em
passages.text:
That ooze seems really hungry!

He ate my backpack, compass, pickaxe, and my hearthstone cards.

Get my cards back!

passages.title: Deck 'Em
passages.text: I'm not leaving till I get my cards back!

passages.title: Deck 'Em
passages.text: Thank you! I'll grab my cards here, and meet you back in town!

passages.title: The Final Act
passages.text:
Those of us with enough mechanization survived, but it didn't matter. Bondo Bigblock sold us out. In exchange for full mechanization, he built giant bots and attacked Rustbolt. 

He will continue to act against us, till those few of us left are dead. 

We must remove this threat immediately.

passages.title: The Final Act
passages.text: Will you help me deal with this threat?

passages.title: The Final Act
passages.text: We can start to rebuild now.

passages.title: De-Synced Vibro Blade
passages.text: The wildly shaking blade reminds you of the blades the Rustbolt defenders use. No doubt someone will be able to fix it up.

passages.title: Bot Rampage
passages.text:
Those bots have been attacking us from the moment we landed. We've got to hold this beach!

My expedition guards could use your help, <name>. Lend a hand, destroy bots on the beach and in the nearby woodlands.

passages.title: Bot Rampage
passages.text: The expedition guards could use your help!

passages.title: Bot Rampage
passages.text: They're still attacking, but we can handle it from here.

passages.title: Unsafe Work Conditions
passages.text:
Those rampaging bots ain't lettin' up!

We're payin' good money for the best and brightest goblins on the planet, and I ain't gonna let some malfunctionin' machinery take 'em outta the shift schedule.

This is textbook unsafe working conditions, and the Greasemonkey Union reps are givin' me an earful for it. Protect the workers!

passages.title: Unsafe Work Conditions
passages.text: The greasemonkeys could use your help!

passages.title: Unsafe Work Conditions
passages.text: Ya done good work for a <race>.

passages.title: Blueprint: Holographic Digitalization Relay
passages.text:
<This blueprint details how to build what appears to be some form of holographic teleporter.

You should be able to upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database in Rustbolt.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Holographic Digitalization Relay
passages.text:
Have you recovered a new blueprint, my fleshy friend?

I will add it to my database posthaste.

passages.title: Blueprint: Experimental Adventurer Augment
passages.text:
<This blueprint details how to build what appears to be some form of ring... or maybe it's a trinket?

You should be able to upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database in Rustbolt.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Experimental Adventurer Augment
passages.text:
Have you recovered a new blueprint, my fleshy friend?

I will add it to my database posthaste.

passages.title: Grime-Coated Disc
passages.text: <Look for someone that can help recover the data trapped on this grime-coated disc.>

passages.title: Defensive in Death
passages.text: <Having handled zin'anthid for a while now, you pluck one of its tentacles from the main body. As you do, the tentacle retracts, spiraling in on itself preventing you from getting to the blooms that reside along it. Perhaps Instructor Ulooaka will have more insight on how to keep this herb from defending itself.>

passages.title: Defensive in Death
passages.text:
Zin'anthids are no mere plant, <name>. They are living beings and as such, know when a predator is trying to harvest them. And yes, even in death they defend themselves.
If you wish to harvest all they have to offer, you must lure them into a false sense of security. Here, let me show you a technique I know.

passages.title: Ounces of Osmenite
passages.text: <Picking away at the ore, you pick up some shards that have fallen to the ground. There ought to be a way to mine these deposits without wasting any of it. Perhaps Instructor Ulooaka knows of still a better way to mine this ore.>

passages.title: Ounces of Osmenite
passages.text:
Ah yes, that's due to the fragile nature of the ore. You need to adjust your style a bit.

Instead of heavy, powerful swings, try picking away at the edge of where the ore meets the rock.

Like peeling the skin off a fruit. Here, let me show you what I mean...

passages.title: One of the Hive
Leaving the Hive
passages.text:
<The enormous bee twitches its antennae toward you. It swings its abdomen toward the cave exit.>

Barry might know what's going on.

passages.title: Leaving the Hive
passages.text:
<It wriggles eagerly in its new harness.>

Bzzz!

passages.title: Defender of the Hive
A Defender Emerges
The Usurper
A Royal Awakening
Tracking Quest
Recyclable Parts
passages.text: <This bundle of recycling could be valuable. The gnomes in the area appear to be dropping their scrap into some nearby contraptions.>

passages.title: Recyclable Parts
passages.text: <WARNING 3.6.4 - Y: Keep all appendages clear of doors or risk irreversible limb recyclerization.>

passages.title: Recyclable Parts
passages.text: You deposit the bundle of parts into the Recyclerizer DX-82.  The doors close and the machine surges to life, a slight buzzing sound begins emanating from within. The sound increases in frequency, the slight buzz giving way to a high-pitched whirring. The machine shakes violently, seemingly ready to explode...

passages.title: The Waveblade Ankoan
passages.text: Assist the Ankoan in Nazjatar by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: The Waveblade Ankoan
passages.text: Return to me when you have finished aiding the Ankoan, <name>.

passages.title: The Waveblade Ankoan
passages.text: May Neptulon shower you with his blessings, friend.

passages.title: The Unshackled
passages.text: Assist the Unshackled in Nazjatar by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: The Unshackled
passages.text: Return to me when you have finished aiding us, <name>.

passages.title: The Unshackled
passages.text:
You've really made a difference out there! 

Thank you, friend.

passages.title: Seams to be a Problem
passages.text:
<Picking away at the ore, you notice that much of it seems to turn to dust and fall to the floor at your feet. Enough even, that had it held its shape, would be enough to craft something with.

It may be worth talking to Instructor Ulooaka to see if there's a way to prevent this loss from happening.>

passages.title: Seams to be a Problem
passages.text:
The seams that osmenite flows through are structurally different than that of their mere deposits.

If you want to harvest the full amount of osmenite from a seam, you'll have to ignore the ore all together and go for the rock surrounding it.

It's a bit counter to how you normally mine, but trust me, you'll be pleasantly surprised with the results.

passages.title: Drowning the Horde
passages.text: We must strike now before the Horde have a chance to gain a secure foothold. Attack their champions and knock them on their heels.

passages.title: Drowning the Horde
passages.text: If we keep up the pressure there is no way the Horde will succeed.

passages.title: Security First
passages.text:
Many dangerous creatures and allies of my father still seek to destroy us.

Help secure this island, seek out and and eliminate five of our most powerful enemies.

passages.title: Junkyard Treasures
passages.text:
Everyone here needs to work hard to find resources for our cause. 

Locate and open ten mechanized chests on the island.

passages.title: Security First
passages.text:
Many dangerous creatures and allies of my father still seek to destroy us.

Help secure this island, seek out and and eliminate five of our most powerful enemies.

passages.title: Blueprint: Advanced Adventurer Augment
passages.text:
<This blueprint details how to condense even more power into a ring or trinket!

You should be able to upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database in Rustbolt.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Advanced Adventurer Augment
passages.text:
Have you recovered a new blueprint, my fleshy friend?

I will add it to my database posthaste.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Nazjatar
passages.text:
Our objectives in Nazjatar are being interrupted by the influx of Alliance scum.

Clear as many of them out of the area that you find, then report back.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Nazjatar
passages.text: Good work, <class>.

passages.title: A Tempered Blade
passages.text:
These blades that I wield are newly forged. The time has come to temper them in the blood of my enemies.

I have heard that you are skilled in the ways of battle. I too am proficient in the business of death and I would be honored to fight at your side.

Accompany me, <class>, and together we will spill the blood of our enemies.

passages.title: A Tempered Blade
passages.text: A blade is not worthy of a warrior until it is tempered in the blood of the enemy.

passages.title: A Tempered Blade
passages.text: It was an honor to fight by your side, <name>. If you should have need of me in the future, you need only ask.

passages.title: Back Out to Sea
passages.text:
Now that things're under control here, I'm sure they could use your help back in Nazjatar!

Why don't ye head back out tae sea, err, or under the sea, tae lend a hand with the new folk there?

passages.title: Back Out to Sea
passages.text: Welcome back. There's work to do.

passages.title: Back Out to Sea
passages.text:
Now that things're under control here, I'm sure they could use your help back in Nazjatar!

Why don't ye head back out tae sea, err, or under the sea, tae lend a hand with the new folk there?

passages.title: Back Out to Sea
passages.text: Thank you for returning to assist us. There's more to be done.

passages.title: Blueprint: Extraordinary Adventurer Augment
passages.text:
<This blueprint details how to condense an extraordinary amount of power into a ring or trinket!

You should be able to upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database in Rustbolt.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Extraordinary Adventurer Augment
passages.text:
Have you recovered a new blueprint, my fleshy friend?

I will add it to my database posthaste.

passages.title: The Needs of the People
passages.text:
There are others in the camp that may be in need of aid. Ask around and see if there are any duties that you could take up.

Be sure to report what you find to Speaker Utia.

passages.title: Investigating the Highlands
passages.text:
When I first sensed these essences, I did not anticipate the importance of the role they would play. It is only a matter of time before all of the dragonflights are brought into the fold.

Though I have reached out to the other Aspects, I have yet to hear from Alexstrasza. It is odd that she would be silent while these powers manifest.

She was last seen in the Vermillion Redoubt in Twilight Highlands.

I fear she may be in trouble. We must hurry.

passages.title: Investigating the Highlands
passages.text:
It is far worse than expected. We tried to reach the Redoubt, but did not even make it to the ridge.

Something is watching the skies and preventing us from reaching Alexstrasza.

passages.title: Factory Refurbished
passages.text:
I need you to get us a Recycled Crawler Manifold.

You should be able to get one up at Junkwatt Depot if you recycle parts found there.

passages.title: Factory Refurbished
passages.text: Head up to the Junkwatt Depot and get working!

passages.title: Factory Refurbished
passages.text: Nice work, this is just what I needed.

passages.title: Other Interests
passages.text:
Madam Goya is interested in many unusual items other than just rare metals.

Keep your eyes out for these particular items during your travels in Nazjatar.

Deliver them to me and Madam Goya will consider you for special access.

passages.title: Other Interests
passages.text: Have you found these items.

passages.title: Other Interests
passages.text: Excellent work, we shall speak again.

passages.title: Other Interests
passages.text:
Madam Goya is interested in many unusual items other than just rare metals.

Keep your eyes out for these particular items during your travels in Nazjatar. 

Deliver them to me and Madam Goya will consider you for special access.

passages.title: Other Interests
passages.text: Have you found these items.

passages.title: Other Interests
passages.text: Excellent work, we shall speak again.

passages.title: Other Interests
passages.text:
Madam Goya is interested in many unusual items other than just rare metals.

Keep your eyes out for these particular items during your travels in Nazjatar. 

Deliver them to me and Madam Goya will consider you for special access.

passages.title: Other Interests
passages.text: Have you found these items.

passages.title: Other Interests
passages.text: Excellent work, we shall speak again.

passages.title: Emission Free
passages.text:
We're going to need a few Empty Energy Cells to fill out the battery pack on the mount control assembly. 

See if you can find me these.

passages.title: Emission Free
passages.text: We need to fix this battery pack.

passages.title: Emission Free
passages.text: Nice work, this will help a lot.

passages.title: This One's on Me
passages.text:
I'm sure you agree that Pascal-K1N6 is the greatest invention you've ever seen!

If you're not convinced yet, try to push him to his limits. I don't mind!

Bring him more resources and blueprints -- he'll craft anything you need!

passages.title: This One's on Me
passages.text:
You've done good work around town, <name>. A real asset to the resistance.

I've also seen you admiring my blowtorch... Quite the creation, isn't it?

Tell you what, I'll unlock the blueprint for the Scrapmaster Blowtorch on Pascal-K1N6 for you.

No need to thank me. Excellence should be rewarded.

passages.title: Pirates, Sea Monsters, Robots
passages.text:
I finally found it! This is the resting place of my father, after his crew mutinied and left him here to die.

I've scouted the island, and found the locations of three chests that contain mementoes of my father. 

Do this for me and my family. Recover my father's sword, clothing, and bones from the three chests I've marked.

passages.title: Pirates, Sea Monsters, Robots
passages.text: Help my recover the remains of my father.

passages.title: Pirates, Sea Monsters, Robots
passages.text: I can never thank you enough, so I won't.

passages.title: Whispers of N'Zoth
passages.text:
Are you curious how I came to be here, in the Chamber of Heart? 

Of course I arrived of my own volition, but there was quite a search for me, for a time.

Kalecgos remembers how it went. Speak to him, if you wish to relive the details of how I thwarted discovery by both Speaker and Old God.

passages.title: Whispers of N'Zoth
passages.text:
I knew that N'Zoth was powerful, but to reach Ebonhorn within the safety of the Chamber... 

We have to do something about this. None of us are safe.

passages.title: Spies to the Left and Right
passages.text:
Ebonhorn cannot resist the whispers for long. The dark forces that once corrupted the black dragonflight seek to overwhelm the world once again.

We need a way to fight back. While I am loathe to mention him, I do know of someone who has been studying the Old Gods in order to better combat their insidious power: Wrathion.

The Black Prince has associates in Pandaria, in the Tavern of the Mists at the Veiled Stair. I suggest you begin your search there.

Please hurry, adventurer.

passages.title: Spies to the Left and Right
passages.text: The Black Prince isn't here. But we might be able to help you find him.

passages.title: Spies to the Left and Right
passages.text:
Good work getting rid of those spies.

Things have been quiet here for a long time. And now, suddenly, all eyes are on us. So to speak.

The Black Prince is notoriously secretive about his plans. I'm not in the habit of reading other people's journals, but I'm guessing he expected you to feel differently about it.

passages.title: Black Winged Shadow
passages.text:
Obviously, the Black Prince isn't here. Trust me when I say he's not an easy one to find.

If I were you, I'd make my way to Blackrock Mountain. There's a terrace carved into its slopes, where Nefarian once made his lair.

Wrathion has been monitoring that place for a long time. Even if he's not there himself, you might find someone who knows where to look.

And <class>... it's clear you're not the only one searching for him. Watch your back.

passages.title: Black Winged Shadow
passages.text: My head is still spinning... they showed me... such terrible... tempting things...

passages.title: Black Winged Shadow
passages.text:
Thank you. They... forced their way into my mind. I couldn't stop them from finding what they sought.

The Black Prince meant for you to have those pages. He was certain that you would need the knowledge within them.

passages.title: To the Catacombs!
passages.text:
I held out as long as I could, but... the whispers were too strong.

You must hurry to Karazhan. The Black Prince said he intended to study the artifacts stored within its catacombs.

Please, do not allow my failure to bring about his doom!

passages.title: To the Catacombs!
passages.text: <It seems the lookout gave his life in service to the Black Prince.>

passages.title: To the Catacombs!
passages.text:
<The lookout put up a fierce fight before he died.

You have found more pages from Wrathion's journal on his body. Perhaps the Black Prince himself is not far.>

passages.title: On the Trail of the Black Prince
passages.text:
<It looks like a fight took place here. N'Zoth's agents must have already entered the catacombs beneath Karazhan.

The dead lookout still has a set of keys on him. Perhaps they will unlock the door.

With any luck, you can find Wrathion before N'Zoth's agents and gain something that can help Ebonhorn.>

passages.title: On the Trail of the Black Prince
passages.text: <The note appears to have been left behind in a hurry, and deliberately placed where you would find it.>

passages.title: On the Trail of the Black Prince
passages.text:
The note reads:

"<name>. If you are reading this note, then I assume that Ebyssian has fallen prey to the whispers of the Old Gods. Fortunately, I have prepared a method to save him.

You will find a potion with the properties you seek sitting next to this note. Bring it to my brother and it will clear his mind of N'Zoth's influence.

I will thank you for your efforts in person, soon enough."

passages.title: Blueprint: TK32[DNT]
passages.text:
<This blueprint details how to build what appears to be TK.[DNT]

You should be able to upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database in Rustbolt.>

passages.title: Just Ptrust Me On This
passages.text:
Ahhh, it is good to see you, <name>.

How is de defective one? Still pleased to be at your side?

I have given this some thought. Fear may still be what holds your not-so-little one back, but your love is what enables him to thrive without his wings. Perhaps that love will be what restores him to de skies.

I am asking you to trust me. I wish to try something.

If I am correct then de two of you will find yourselves airborne as nature intended!

passages.title: Just Ptrust Me On This
passages.text:
What did I tell you, child?

All he needed was de right motivation. Haha!

passages.title: Scrying Stones
passages.text:
I have a gift for you, <name>. 

It's a stone unlike anything you've seen before. To the uninformed, it may seem to be a simple rock, but it's far more precious than that. 

This is a scrying stone. It reveals objects that have been hidden by magic. When near an anomaly, the runes etched within will begin to glow. 

Use the stone to reveal treasure hidden away by ancient magic.

passages.title: Scrying Stones
passages.text: See, I wasn't lying. The scrying stones are extraordinary!

passages.title: Scrying Stones
passages.text:
I have a gift for you, <name>. 

This stone is unlike anything you may have seen before. To the uninformed, it appears to be a simple rock, but it is far more precious than that.

This is a scrying stone. It reveals objects that have been hidden by magic. When near an anomaly, the runes etched within will begin to glow. 

Use the stone to reveal treasure hidden away by ancient magic.

passages.title: Scrying Stones
passages.text: Have you found any treasure?

passages.title: Scrying Stones
passages.text: As you are now aware, these stones are quite extraordinary.

passages.title: Good Girl
passages.text:
I have learned so much by your side, I can't believe how many naga we've taken down!

When you first arrived, I was skeptical that you'd make a difference. We've been down here, fighting, for so long. I had almost lost hope.

But now, we see a way out of the darkness of the depths, finally!
 
I took in a snapdragon pup when we formed Newhome, been training her ever since. I think... I think I'd like you to have her.

She'll make a great mount... and loyal friend.

passages.title: Good Girl
passages.text:
Take good care of her, ok? She means a lot to me. 

She likes fathom ray eggs best, so remember that.

Goodbye, little one! Neri loves you!

passages.title: Glittering Shell
passages.text:
Hi, friend. I just wanted you to know that traveling with you has been the best ever!

I never thought I could learn so much about fighting, but now I feel like I can actually hold my own.

I will protect all of the wee ones that can't protect themselves!

<Poen produces a crab from somewhere, it has a bright shell.>

Like this little one. I found him a while back, while we were out. He looked so scared.

Hey, why don't you take him?

passages.title: Glittering Shell
passages.text:
I've never seen one with a shell this brightly-colored, must make him a target.

Without you, we could have both been doomed.

Here, take him, it's because of you that we're all a lot safer now.

I have more friends to protect!

passages.title: Last Heirloom
passages.text:
We have encountered many foes together, and emerged victorious every time. I have you to thank for our safety this day, and my prowess in combat.

I will be honest with you, friend. I did not think I would live this long.

My people had families, once. Traditions. We would carve symbols into our talismans and pass them down from generation to generation of deep sea hunters. Charms for luck, or prowess, each family had their own.

This is mine. I have none to pass it on to. I would like you to have it

passages.title: Last Heirloom
passages.text:
This charm is one of luck, it was passed down through many years of my people.

It has brought me little luck, until now, until it brought you to me.

It is only fitting that you take it from here.

passages.title: Wild Tame
passages.text:
In our time together, I have learned much. Both about my own abilities, and about your people. 

You are selfless in the face of challenge, much like our own. I consider us kin.

For some time, I have been training a snapdragon I found as a pup. He is a worthy mount, and I have been waiting for a worthy hunter to ride him. I believe I have found that hunter.

Here, he is yours.

passages.title: Wild Tame
passages.text: Take care when feeding him, the poison is no less lethal to a friend.

passages.title: Beauty in the Deeps
passages.text:
We have slain many enemies, spilled much blood on the sand. My skills have improved tenfold fighting at your side.

Yet let us not forget that once, this was a place of peace. Once, my people walked amongst the caverns and reefs undisturbed.

There is beauty, here, in the depths, all around us. Take a moment, sit, and enjoy your serene surroundings. Look here, a crab with a shell of brilliant colors.

You see? There is beauty here, even now.

passages.title: Beauty in the Deeps
passages.text:
Take this crab, may it be a symbol of the beauty that once reigned in this place.

With your help, it will again.

passages.title: Tome of Tears
passages.text:
We've been fighting side by side for a while now. I didn't think an old salt like me could get any better at killing naga, but here we are.

I have something to show you...

<Vim produces a book from his pack.>

Worst thing we can do is forget.

So many names I've written in this book, each and every one of them an Unshackled. All of them gone, now.

I will never forget their names.

I want you to have it. Tell people. Tell them who they were, and what we have done here.

passages.title: Tome of Tears
passages.text:
This book contains the names of brave creatures of all kinds that helped us, fought for us, and died for us.

Help me remember them.

passages.title: Down Into Nazjatar
passages.text:
We have much to do <name>. However our troops are weary and need rest. Decisions made when tired are often the wrong ones.

These "Unshackled" have offered to aid us with what forces they have. If we hope to survive down here against Azshara's forces, we will need to support our new allies.

Join one of their hunters and aid them in their tasks, we will remain here and discuss our next move.

passages.title: Down Into Nazjatar
passages.text:
Excellent work. Your efforts have helped us rebuild our supplies and gained our friends some much-needed combat experience.

They have entrusted us with this item, which appears to be quite magical. I cannot harness the power, but perhaps your Heart of Azeroth can. Take it, may it do us some good in this strange place.

passages.title: Strange Silver Knife
passages.text:
<This silver knife is small and lightly decorated, you found it inside of a chest. 

It was more likely used for eating or preparing food than combat. What would the naga need with such a thing?

One of the Ankoan may know more...>

passages.title: Strange Silver Knife
passages.text:
What do you have there?

Ah, yes, you found this within one of the chests? We have found similar things inside of them -- finery, decorative platters, and the like. Perhaps they do not belong to the naga? It is a mystery.

passages.title: Strange Silver Knife
passages.text:
<This silver knife is small and lightly decorated, you found it inside of a chest. 

It was more likely used for eating or preparing food than combat. What would the naga need with such a thing?

One of the Unshackled may know more...>

passages.title: Strange Silver Knife
passages.text:
Ay, what's that? 

Ah yeah, lots of nice things to be found in those chests out there. Don't seem to be naga things, mind you, and that's kind of strange. Someone else left those here.

Happy to take that off of your hands, though.

passages.title: Diaries of the Dead
passages.text:
<The enchantments preserving this journal are intact, but fading. It appears to be the diary of a citizen of the city. You turn to a random page...>

Then he had the audacity to enter our summoning circle and demand we evict his study space at once. Who willingly steps into the chaos of a summoning ritual? He is mad. We call him that now -- Mad Mardivas.

Of course, he was bitten on the leg by a lesser summon, and...

<It continues -- not useful, but you surmise there may be more such tomes.>

passages.title: Diaries of the Dead
passages.text: <A preserved tome.>

passages.title: Diaries of the Dead
passages.text:
<You see a glowing lock, and Mardivas' journal is next to it. You glance at the final pages.>

The rune locks have been stabilized, and organized in such a way that only one with my level of logical acumen would be able to decipher.

Oh, to see the faces of the would-be thieves, thwarted! 

Yes, yes, yes that is it! I shall work on a ward that allows me to view the thieves in the act! Genius, genius, I am.

I simply need a bit more time...

passages.title: Diaries of the Dead
passages.text:
<The enchantments preserving this journal are intact, but fading. It appears to be the diary of a citizen of the city. You turn to a random page...>

Then he had the audacity to enter our summoning circle and demand we evict his study space at once. Who willingly steps into the chaos of a summoning ritual? He is mad. We call him that now -- Mad Mardivas.

Of course, he was bitten on the leg by a lesser summon, and...

<It continues -- not useful, but you surmise there may be more such tomes.>

passages.text: <A preserved tome.>

passages.text:
<You see a glowing lock, and Mardivas' journal is next to it. You glance at the final pages.>

The rune locks have been stabilized, and organized in such a way that only one with my level of logical acumen would be able to decipher.

Oh, to see the faces of the would-be thieves, thwarted! 

Yes, yes, yes that is it! I shall work on a ward that allows me to view the thieves in the act! Genius, genius, I am.

I simply need a bit more time...

passages.title: Enchanted Lock
passages.text:
<The lock appears to be secured by a magical mechanism.

It is clearly one of Mardivas', and from what you can surmise from reading the journals, it is likely locked via an arcane puzzle.

You look around the room, and see something odd in the water.>

passages.title: Enchanted Lock
passages.text: <The lock hums.>

passages.title: Enchanted Lock
passages.text:
<With the puzzle complete, the lock springs open with a satisfying click.

It seems that Mardivas' devised a series of similar such puzzles with which to secure his belongings.>

It is clearly one of Mardivas', and from what you can surmise from reading the journals, it is likely locked via an arcane puzzle.

You look around the room, and see something odd in the water.>
