passages.title: Enchanted Lock
passages.text:
<With the puzzle complete, the lock springs open with a satisfying click.

It seems that Mardivas' devised a series of similar such puzzles with which to secure his belongings.>

passages.title: Treasure Tale
passages.text:
<You discovered the history of Mardivas, a sorcerer that once lived in the city and the crafter of the arcane chests scattered around Nazjatar.

From the sounds of it, he was not well-liked, which worked out for him, as he did not much like others.

You also found and unlocked one of his "unsolvable" arcane locks. This knowledge may prove useful on your journey.

Artisan Itanu will surely enjoy hearing the end of this tale.>

passages.title: Treasure Tale
passages.text:
Ah, how nice to see a proper end to the tale, thank you.

I had always wondered why one would lock up one's dinnerware. If one does not much like or trust others, it becomes more obvious.

Despite all of his efforts, they will end up in your hands, in the end. How droll.

passages.title: Treasure Tale
passages.text:
<You discovered the history of Mardivas, a sorcerer that once lived in the city and the crafter of the arcane chests scattered around Nazjatar.

From the sounds of it, he was not well-liked, which worked out for him, as he did not much like others.

You also found and unlocked one of his "unsolvable" arcane locks. This knowledge may prove useful on your journey.

Finder Palta will surely enjoy hearing the end of this tale.>

passages.title: Treasure Tale
passages.text:
Hey, thanks for letting me know. Always wondered what was going on with those chests. 

Not that I mind free treasures, mind you. All for them.

I'm sure it'd just steam his clams to know that you're going to end up with all of his stuff, ha!

passages.title: I Am the Trashmaster
passages.text:
Whatcha got there, richmon? 

Ha! You think you be de Trashmasta? You be talkin' to de God of Garbage! De Ruler of Rubbish! Master of all things Discarded an' Unwanted!

So you not be wantin' that ol' trashy cloak, eh? Jani got somethin' better. 

You just give dat ol' thing to me, an Jani will be takin' care o' you...

passages.title: I Am the Trashmaster
passages.text:
Hek hek hek. Thanks for de trade, richmon.

I not be wantin' this thing. It be too stuffy, too high-an-mighty. Not worthy of Jani! But you can have it.

Now be gone. I got offerins' to sort.

passages.title: I Am the Trashmaster
passages.text:
Whatcha got there, richmon? 

Ha! You think you be de Trashmasta? You be talkin' to de God of Garbage! De Ruler of Rubbish! Master of all things Discarded an' Unwanted!

So you not be wantin' that ol' trashy cloak, eh? Jani got somethin' better. 

You just give dat ol' thing to me, an Jani will be takin' care o' you...

passages.title: I Am the Trashmaster
passages.text:
Hek hek hek. Thanks for de trade, richmon.

I not be wantin' this thing. It be too stuffy, too high-an-mighty. Not worthy of Jani! But you can have it.

Now be gone. I got offerins' to sort.

passages.title: Unlocking the Power
passages.text:
There's somethin' special waitin' fer ye back in the Chamber of Heart, champion.

I won't spoil it, but ye best get back there as quick as ye can.

passages.title: Unlocking the Power
passages.text: Have we got somethin' fer ye, champion! Yer gonna love this.

passages.title: Return to the Heart
passages.text:
Greetings, Champion of Azeroth.

MOTHER's been monitorin' yer progress with the Heart of Azeroth, and is mighty pleased with the work you've done tae make it stronger.

At least, we think she's pleased. It's difficult tae tell at times.

Regardless, come back tae the Chamber of Heart when ye've got a chance. There's more that needs doin'.

passages.title: Return to the Heart
passages.text: The Heart o' Azeroth feels stronger than ever. I wonder what amazing powers might be locked within!

passages.title: Back to the Chamber
passages.text:
The Heart o' Azeroth is gettin' stronger every day, and it's makin' a difference.

Make yer way tae the Chamber o' Heart, champion. Yer talents are needed.

passages.title: Back to the Chamber
passages.text: The Heart o' Azeroth never ceases tae amaze me. Well done, champion!

passages.title: Unlocking the Power
passages.text:
There's somethin' special waitin' fer ye back in the Chamber of Heart, champion.

I won't spoil it, but ye best get back there as quick as ye can.

passages.title: Unlocking the Power
passages.text: Have we got somethin' fer ye, champion! Yer gonna love this.

passages.title: Whispers of N'Zoth
passages.text:
Are you curious how I came to be here, in the Chamber of Heart? 

Of course I arrived of my own volition, but there was quite a search for me, for a time.

Kalecgos remembers how it went. Speak to him, if you wish to relive the details of how I thwarted discovery by both Speaker and Old God.

passages.title: Whispers of N'Zoth
passages.text:
I knew that N'Zoth was powerful, but to reach Ebonhorn in the safety of the Chamber... 

We have to do something about this. None of us are safe.

passages.title: Go For The Gold
passages.text:
I've heard lot's of stories about dead fathers, mothers, and family treasures. Don't believe any of it. We're all here to get any pirate gold, before these mecha-fools get it first! 

If there's gold to be had here, it's in that fat chest the murlocs are guarding.

Kill their chief, empty out the chest, and we'll split it fifty-fifty, since I'm telling ya about it.

passages.title: Go For The Gold
passages.text: Go get the gold!

passages.title: Go For The Gold
passages.text: Nice working with ya, here's your share!

passages.title: Let's Fish!
passages.text:
We may need the help of some friends to land this fish!

Use the Hundred-Fathom Lure when you're ready to start.

passages.title: Let's Fish!
passages.text: Let's fish!

passages.title: Let's Fish!
passages.text: This will make a great fish story!

passages.title: The Family Jewels
passages.text:
Darn pirates stole my jewels... err, I mean my sister's... uh, mom's jewelry. Yeah, that's the story!

Point is, they stole it, and it's all out there strewn around in the mud, and treasure chests. Maybe on a few of the robots and murlocs.

My mom's not greedy, she just wants a few of the necklaces with gold and lots of diamonds. I'd pay ya for those.

passages.title: The Family Jewels
passages.text: Go steal those jewels back for my brother!

passages.title: The Family Jewels
passages.text: All these jewels for me!

passages.title: Assault: Aqir Unearthed
passages.text:
Our position is being overrun. The aqir are surging in greater numbers than I've ever seen!

I'm not sure how long we'll be able to hold the line. We need you to drive them back!

passages.title: Assault: Aqir Unearthed
passages.text: Our men can only hold out so long.

passages.title: Assault: Aqir Unearthed
passages.text:
You have saved our camp, and quite possibly our people.

Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: City of Drowned Friends
passages.text:
Champion, I have a personal favor to ask of you that I do not feel I can ask of any of my sentinels.

This... this is not on behalf of the Alliance, or the war, or even our battle against Azshara. This is a favor for me.

When I was a little girl, my city was attacked by the Legion. Many of the survivors fled here only to drown or worse. I must know their fate.

Will you help me search for signs?

passages.title: City of Drowned Friends
passages.text: He... he may be here. Janius... no.

passages.title: City of Drowned Friends
passages.text:
Champion, I have a personal favor to ask of you. This is not on behalf of the Horde or the war effort.

It has been over ten thousand years since I last walked these streets. I knew many of these people, even trained some of them.

Will you walk with me as I learn their fates? The road is dangerous, and I do not trust myself to maintain calm as I try to resurface old grief.

passages.title: City of Drowned Friends
passages.text: Sivara. Oh Sivara. She was the finest pupil I ever taught. I must find her and ensure she is not locked in eternal torment like these others.

passages.title: The Ever Drowning
passages.text:
Stay close, Champion. I have some magical items that might help us defend briefly against magic attacks, but Azshara was the greatest mage our kind has ever known.

I do not feel confident that these trinkets will hold back her power for long, or even be usable afterward.

Speak with me when you are ready.

passages.title: The Ever Drowning
passages.text: The flood has stopped for now. That is good because I do not think I have enough charge left in these items to shield us from another wave like that.

passages.title: The Ever Drowning
passages.text:
Queen Azshara has her eye on us now. We must proceed with caution.

I do not know what she may try but stay close to me. Whatever this threat is we must pass through it if we are to find Sivara.

Speak with me when you are ready to proceed.

passages.title: The Ever Drowning
passages.text: The flood has stopped for now. That is good because my power is nearly drained.

passages.title: The Warbringer
passages.text:
We are standing in the center of some very powerful magics. An echo of something Azshara did long ago.

If you are feeling brave enough to commune with this echo, I will stand guard as you do.

passages.title: The Warbringer
passages.text: Be ready for anything.

passages.title: The Warbringer
passages.text: We long suspected Azshara's choice. The question becomes, why is she showing us this? What game is she playing this time?

passages.title: The Warbringer
passages.text:
We are standing in the center of some very powerful magics. An echo of something Azshara did long ago.

If you are feeling brave enough to commune with this echo, I will stand guard as you do.

passages.title: The Warbringer
passages.text: Be ready for anything.

passages.title: The Warbringer
passages.text: We long suspected Azshara's choice. The question becomes, why is she showing us this? What game is she playing this time?

passages.title: They Made Their Choice
passages.text:
It wasn't enough for Azshara to break the world. She had to doom the rest of our people here as well!

Those who didn't choose to become naga were stuck in this horrifying half death, left to haunt these drowned ruins. 

I am almost afraid of what we will find if we do find my friend.

Wait, did you hear something?

passages.title: They Made Their Choice
passages.text: Thrice damned Azshara. Her evil knows no bounds.

passages.title: They Made Their Choice
passages.text: I cannot thank you enough for helping me say farewell to my friend, <name>. I am in your debt.

passages.title: They Made Their Choice
passages.text:
It wasn't enough for Azshara to break the world. She had to doom the rest of our people here as well!

Those who didn't choose to become naga were stuck in this horrifying half death, left to haunt these drowned ruins. 

I am almost afraid to find Sivara.

Wait, did you hear something?

passages.title: They Made Their Choice
passages.text: Thrice damned Azshara. Her evil knows no bounds.

passages.title: They Made Their Choice
passages.text:
Sivara could have defeated us at any time. Why are they toying with us? 

At any rate, champion, again I find myself in your debt. Thank you for helping me, even if the answers we found were more horrifying than I could have anticipated.

passages.title: The Quickcharge Contract
passages.text:
Wondrous news, dear test subject!

My dear brother and I have restored 65% of the functionality of our research laboratory.

We are hoping to resume our regular research schedule shortly, but require a fresh batch of brave test subjects to help us push the laws of nature and science to their limits!

If you're interested, you'll just need to agree to our standard verbal contract first...

passages.title: The Quickcharge Contract
passages.text: How can I help you, dear test subject?

passages.title: The Quickcharge Contract
passages.text:
Welcome to the Quickcharge team, dear test subject.

What a wondrous day this is!

passages.title: Saving Corin
passages.text:
My father is being tortured by that naga!

<name>, I need you to help me save him. We can't let his spirit be a slave to the naga. 

Hurry, if we don't act now he will end up like the rest of them!

passages.title: Saving Corin
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. My father and I are eternally grateful for what you did.

passages.title: Contained Alemental
passages.text:
<As the brew is returned to its natural, dormant form, a strange keg appears.

Perhaps Brewmaster Tsing knows more about such a strange occurrence.>

passages.title: Contained Alemental
passages.text:
Everything has a spirit to it. From the clouds in the sky to the worms in the ground, life is woven through the entire world.

Brew is no different. Created with such love, such care... it only requires a spark to spring to life in front of our very eyes.

passages.title: Ravenous Rescue
passages.text:
A conspiracy of ravens is preying on citizens of Rustbolt! It's most unacceptable! 

Prince Erazmin has asked me to rescue as many citizens as I can, but I could use your help. I've tracked the ravens to this hill. We blast the ravens out of the sky, and you rescue the mechagnomes.

Use my marker gun if you need help bringing the ravens down.

passages.title: Ravenous Rescue
passages.text: Let's get to it!

passages.title: Ravenous Rescue
passages.text: You've lived up to your reputation.

passages.title: Chopped Bots
passages.text:
Chopping up bots is my business. Any bots you bring to my scrapper will be broken up into useful parts. It's a win for both of us!

Use the Bot-Energizer to bring me dead bots, and we'll break them into spare parts.

passages.title: Chopped Bots
passages.text: Re-animate dead bots and bring them to me!

passages.title: Chopped Bots
passages.text: I love those spare parts! You're can grind up bots here anytime you want!

passages.title: Do Not Drink
passages.text:
These troggs watch everything we do. 

They see us pouring oil into various machines, so now they're stealing the oil and drinking it. I think they believe it's going to turn them into machines!

We need that oil back, before they drink it all!

passages.title: Do Not Drink
passages.text: Get that oil back quick!

passages.title: Do Not Drink
passages.text: Ya done good work.

passages.title: Bots Gone Wild
passages.text:
It's loose up there!

I told them not to do it, but they didn't listen. Now it's gone out of control and killed everyone up there. It's an experimental Whirlbot. They never should have built it!

You need to stop it before it comes down here looking for more victims!

Kill the Whirling Zap-O-Matic.

passages.title: Bots Gone Wild
passages.text: You need to stop it.

passages.title: Bots Gone Wild
passages.text: You performed better than those that build the bot.

passages.title: Direbrew Cog
passages.text:
<Direbrew's Dark Iron have fled, leaving behind a small piece of one of their mole machines.

Perhaps your Dark Iron allies would be interested in hearing of your victory.>

passages.title: Direbrew Cog
passages.text:
<Verra spits on the cog.>

That Direbrew is a piece o' work. He's been a contrarian since before we even joined the Alliance. I'm not surprised he's still attackin'. 

All he thinks about is brew and causin' chaos! Not to say that I don' love those things too, but there are other things in life!

Thanks for takin' care o' him.

passages.title: Ancient Technology
passages.text:
<Given the experience you've had with the naga and the power they wield, you wonder if using their own power against them might not garner you a powerful advantage.

Perhaps Instructor Ulooaka back at Mezzamere could help you repair this core and put it to use against the naga invasion.>

passages.title: Ancient Technology
passages.text:
What's this you've brought me?

<Instructor Ulooaka looks over the broken power core and arcs an eyebrow. You ask him if he thinks it could be used against the naga.>

Actually, I believe it could. But probably not in the way you think.

passages.title: An Abyssal Opportunity
passages.text:
I believe, <name>, we can use this thing to make our armor stronger. By redirecting its power, we can take the strength of our crafts to a new level.

But we're getting ahead of ourselves. The first thing we need to do is repair this device.

It'll require some powerful materials to fix it, and those are usually carried by the stronger creatures of this region.

However, Artisan Okata is great at collecting materials like the ones we need. I'd check with him to see what he's got.

passages.title: An Abyssal Opportunity
passages.text: How goes the hunt for the materials?

passages.title: An Abyssal Opportunity
passages.text: This should be plenty, <name>. I'll get started on repairing it right away.

passages.title: An Abyssal Opportunity
passages.text:
I believe, <name>, we can use this thing to make our armor stronger. By redirecting its power, we can take the strength of our crafts to a new level.

But we're getting ahead of ourselves. The first thing we need to do is repair this device.

It'll require some powerful materials to fix it, and those are usually carried by the stronger creatures of this region.

However, Finder Pruc is great at collecting materials like the ones we need. I'd check with him to see what he's got.

passages.title: An Abyssal Opportunity
passages.text: How goes the hunt for the materials?

passages.title: An Abyssal Opportunity
passages.text: This should be plenty, <name>. I'll get started on repairing it right away.

passages.title: Ancient Technology
passages.text:
<Given the experience you've had with the naga and the power they wield, you wonder if using their own power against them might not garner you a powerful advantage.

Perhaps Rolm back at Newhome could help you repair this core and put it to use against the naga invasion.>

passages.title: Ancient Technology
passages.text:
What's this ya brought me?

<Rolm looks over the broken power core and arcs an eyebrow. You ask him if he thinks it could be used against the naga.>

Actually, I believe it could. But probably not in the way ya think.

passages.title: The Eternal Palace: Queen's Gambit
passages.text:
The way is clear. The palace awaits, <name>.

Within the Vainglorious holds court with an old god. Defeating her will be no small feat. 

Make no mistake, Azshara is one of the most powerful sorceresses alive. We cannot underestimate her power or her planning, for she has had thousands of years to prepare for us. Nevertheless, she must be defeated.

We are ready when you are. Shall we finally accept her invitation?

passages.title: The Eternal Palace: Queen's Gambit
passages.text: We cannot rest easy knowing that she still holds power here.

passages.title: The Eternal Palace: Queen's Gambit
passages.text: This is only the beginning....

passages.title: The Eternal Palace: Queen's Gambit
passages.text:
We have opened the way to the palace. We must end this.

Queen Azshara is the most powerful sorceress in existence. She mastered magics thousands of years before our archmagi were even born.

Still, we must prevail. If not, she and her dark patron will remake all of Azeroth to their desires.

Champion, we must defeat Azshara. Are you with us?

passages.title: The Eternal Palace: Queen's Gambit
passages.text: Such power, brought to ruin....

passages.title: The Eternal Palace: Queen's Gambit
passages.text: She is gone, but this is far from over.

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Tidespray Linen
passages.text:
I've received an urgent request from Tinkmaster Overspark.

These supplies are needed!

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Tidespray Linen
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Your contribution has been logged in our records for posterity to appreciate!

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Tidespray Linen
passages.text:
Gazlowe's orders are in: He wants these supplies ASAP.

Ya got the goods?

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Tidespray Linen
passages.text:
Thanks for pitchin' in.

I'll make sure Gazlowe and Prince Erazmin know these came from you.

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Frenzied Fangtooth
passages.text:
I've received an urgent request from Tinkmaster Overspark.

These supplies are needed!

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Frenzied Fangtooth
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Your contribution has been logged in our records for posterity to appreciate!

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Frenzied Fangtooth
passages.text:
Gazlowe's orders are in: He wants these supplies ASAP.

Ya got the goods?

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Frenzied Fangtooth
passages.text:
Thanks for pitchin' in.

I'll make sure Gazlowe and Prince Erazmin know these came from you.

passages.title: Young Twilight Scale
passages.text:
<A partially-grown scale from a young twilight whelp.

More and more twilight dragons are appearing once again. This seems suspicious.

You should show the scale to Eryna above Grim Batol in the Wetlands, perhaps she has seen something recently.>

passages.title: Young Twilight Scale
passages.text:
Welcome, I see you noticed the whelps. They appeared recently, along with more members of the flight coming and going from the citadel. 

I have indeed been observing strange happenings down below.

I sense a great power has manifested. Something awakened in the depths, perhaps? One thing is certain -- the flight is mobilizing at someone's command.

I will continue to relay all I find to my flight and your Speaker, thank you for your assistance.

passages.title: Hozen Totem
passages.text:
<The hozen have been successfully chased away, and Brewfest saved once again.

The question asks itself, though: How did hozen get to Dun Morogh? Perhaps you should ask somebody who has experience in navigation and travel.>

passages.title: Hozen Totem
passages.text:
Just because I arrived to Azeroth on a ship that flew through the stars doesn't mean that I know how... navigation works.

I've never even seen a hozen, let alone one with wings!

Perhaps they held hands as they flew through the sky? Your guess is as good as mine.

passages.title: A Gulper Ate the Rolly
passages.text:
The bubble-eyed rolly used to be plentiful in the nearby pond. Last week they all started to vanish!

A large water elemental has been swallowing all the fish! They are still alive, just swimming around inside the elemental now.

I need you to kill that elemental, and catch three bubbly-eyed rollies so I can examine their condition.

passages.title: A Gulper Ate the Rolly
passages.text: Did you kill that elemental?

passages.title: A Gulper Ate the Rolly
passages.text: You saved a lot of Rollys today!

passages.title: A Titanic Problem
passages.text:
We've no time tae waste. 

Without the Forge of Origination, Azeroth is left vulnerable tae N'Zoth's corruption. Not tae mention it holds a weapon capable of wipin' out all life on Azeroth!

We'll need tae head over tae the forge right away. MOTHER can hold down the fort here.

Hurry on, I'll meet ye there.

passages.title: A Titanic Problem
passages.text:
Ye got here just in time, <name>.

This whole place is overrun!

passages.title: To Ramkahen
passages.text:
It looks like we're gonna have tae wait a spell while MOTHER figures out what tae do with the forge. In the meantime we'll want tae try to make sure nobody tries tae do any more damage here.

Ye should check in on the tol'vir in Ramkahen. I know ye've helped them in the past, so they might be able tae help us keep the forge out o' the wrong hands.

passages.title: To Ramkahen
passages.text:
Welcome to Uldum, <class>. 

I wish we could have offered you a warmer welcome, but I'm afraid my people find themselves once again in a dire situation.

passages.title: Surfacing Threats
passages.text:
The tol'vir take the protection of the titans' constructs here in Uldum as a sacred duty. However, our numbers have dwindled, and we face greater threats with each day.

Even with the strength of our new allies, we will only be able to hold these enemies back for so long. Should any of them surge in power, they may still be able to overwhelm us and endanger the forge. This is where your assistance is needed.

Speak to High Commander Kamses to assess our current situation.

passages.title: Surfacing Threats
passages.text:
The threat has abated... for now.

Our scouts will continue to monitor enemy movements. With any luck we should be able to keep them at bay before they can make a move on the forge.

Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: The Missing Crew
passages.text:
I can't believe it. Almost the entire fleet.. lost! 

We need to have ships out there on missions supporting our efforts, but how am I supposed to do that now?

If we are going to recover from this, I'm going to need my top people. I know the chances are low, but I need you to get out there and try to find them. Alive if possible.

passages.title: The Missing Crew
passages.text: Well, I suppose that's better than nothing. Let's get to work.

passages.title: The Missing Crew
passages.text:
I can't believe it. Almost the entire fleet... lost! 

We need to have ships out there on missions supporting our efforts, but how am I supposed to do that now?

If we are going to recover from this, I'm going to need my top people. I know the chances are low, but I need you to get out there and try to find them. Alive if possible.

passages.title: The Missing Crew
passages.text: Well, I suppose that's better than nothing. Let's get to work.

passages.title: Grounded
passages.text:
One of King Mechagon's older Aerial units is having mechanical problems and is grounded nearby. 

They're trying to get it repaired, so we need to act fast while it's vulnerable.

Destroy the Aerial Patroller XZ-2 before they can get it repaired.

passages.title: Grounded
passages.text: Did you kill the Aerial Patroller XZ-2?

passages.title: Grounded
passages.text: That's one less threat to our forces!

passages.title: Cogfrenzy's Construction Frenzy
passages.text:
You Rustbolt resisters inspire me. Tinkering, building, exploring.

Letting your imagination run wild and then chasing after it, wherever it leads, with reckless abandon!

<Walton releases a deep sigh.>

I miss those days. I hope, someday, my conscience will allow me to stay on the surface with you all permanently...

Before I return to Mechagon, we must build something incredible.

Waren and I have identified a large number of extra construction project sites for today. 

Build with boldness!

passages.title: Cogfrenzy's Construction Frenzy
passages.text: Even the greatest builders are eventually forgotten, but their creations are not.

passages.title: Cogfrenzy's Construction Frenzy
passages.text:
Clever craftsmanship, <name>.

Continue practicing your construction and you'll replace me as Chief Architect in no time. Ha!

passages.title: Discs of Norgannon
passages.text:
King Mechagon unit in possession of Norgannon disk. Data is corrupted, possession of such data is dangerous.

Please aid in the recovery of Corrupted Disk Fragments that have been discarded via Mechagon waste systems. 

Deliver recovered Corrupted Disc Fragment to Data Analyzer R33-DR for purging.

passages.title: Discs of Norgannon
passages.text: Recover Corrupted Disc Fragment.

passages.title: Discs of Norgannon
passages.text:
This data fragment is now safely eliminated. 

If you locate additional Discs, deliver them to me immediately.

passages.title: Up Against It
passages.text:
I don't like the sound of that... It sounds like an army!

We need to investigate.

Try not to draw too much attention as we take a look. If there's an army down there, we'll need to move quickly to find refuge.

passages.title: Up Against It
passages.text: These naga move with a single purpose!

passages.title: Up Against It
passages.text: These naga wear out their welcome quickly.

passages.title: Defensive in Death
passages.text: <Having handled zin'anthid for a while now, you pluck one of its tentacles from the main body. As you do, the tentacle retracts, spiraling in on itself preventing you from getting to the blooms that reside along it. Perhaps Rolm will have more insight on how to keep this herb from defending itself.>

passages.title: Defensive in Death
passages.text:
Zin'anthids are no mere plant, <name>. They are living beings and as such, know when a predator is trying to harvest them. And yes, even in death they defend themselves.
If you wish to harvest all they have to offer, you must lure them into a false sense of security. Here, let me show you a technique I know.

passages.title: Ounces of Osmenite
passages.text: <Picking away at the ore, you pick up some shards that have fallen to the ground. There ought to be a way to mine these deposits without wasting any of it. Perhaps Rolm knows of still a better way to mine this ore.>

passages.title: Ounces of Osmenite
passages.text:
Ah yes, that's due to the fragile nature of the ore. You need to adjust your style a bit.

Instead of heavy, powerful swings, try picking away at the edge of where the ore meets the rock.

Like peeling the skin off a fruit. Here, let me show you what I mean...

passages.title: Seams to be a Problem
passages.text:
<Picking away at the ore, you notice that much of it seems to turn to dust and fall to the floor at your feet. Enough even, that had it held its shape, would be enough to craft something with.

It may be worth talking to Rolm to see if there's a way to prevent this loss from happening.>

passages.title: Seams to be a Problem
passages.text:
The seams that osmenite flows through are structurally different than that of their mere deposits.

If you want to harvest the full amount of osmenite from a seam, you'll have to ignore the ore all together and go for the rock surrounding it.

It's a bit counter to how you normally mine, but trust me, you'll be pleasantly surprised with the results.

passages.title: Drowning the Alliance
passages.text: The Alliance continue to pursue us, they will not disrupt our plans any further. Drive their champions into a watery grave.

passages.title: Drowning the Alliance
passages.text: There is no way the Alliance will defeat us, even here.

passages.title: WANTED: Junkbrat and Roadtrogg
passages.text:
Responsible for a spree of mayhem and chaos throughout the Heaps, resulting in the theft of energy cells, spare parts, and the consumption of Improbable Mechano-Chicken Wings without payment.

Special caution around Roadtrogg, who has demonstrated a violent attitude towards living things.

Elimination of these two felons is of the highest priority.

passages.title: WANTED: Junkbrat and Roadtrogg
passages.text: It's about time we saw the last of those two!

passages.title: Pirates? I Hate Those Guys!
passages.text: <An old pirate hat. Seems out of place on this island, perhaps Reno Jackson will know what to make of it>

passages.title: Pirates? I Hate Those Guys!
passages.text: I suspected pirate activity here! All these strange items we're finding are their plundered loot.

passages.title: Give A Dog A Bone
passages.text:
Louison lent me Dog Bone to help uncover some marrowgrubs, but I'm busy here with the stoves. Could you be a dear and go hunting for me?

Dog Bone loves to pounce on the smaller nibblers and makes a lot of noise doing it. That'll scare the larger marrowgrubs into making a run for it. That's when you'll need to make your move.

Just use this bone to lure Dog Bone near the nibblers. Oh, and don't forget to harvest the flesh from the marrowgrubs! That's what you're really after.

passages.title: Give A Dog A Bone
passages.text: Did you collect the meat?

passages.title: Give A Dog A Bone
passages.text: Wonderful! This will make something tasty!

passages.title: The Uldum Accord
passages.text:
You seek assistance defending the Forge of Origination? It would seem that our goals align.

The Halls of Origination are but a small portion of the forge's true scope. Any threat to Uldum would be a potential threat to the forge, and Uldum has found itself with many new enemies of late.

We were about to convene the High Council when these Wastewanders arrived unannounced. Perhaps you could join us in learning about these threats?

passages.title: The Uldum Accord
passages.text: We should learn all we can about the threats facing Uldum before we proceed.

passages.title: The Uldum Accord
passages.text:
Our accord with the Wastewanders and the Explorer's League will aid us in defending Uldum. 

Yet even with our combined strength, we may not be able to hold these enemies at bay without your help.

passages.title: Restless Dead
passages.text:
Rumors are spreading of some new evil business happening in Stratholme of all places. We need you to head to Eastern Plaguelands and put an end to any new evil threats that may have taken residence there.

We have received contact from a member of the Argent Crusade who has offered their assistance to get you into Stratholme and find the source of this new evil.

passages.title: Restless Dead
passages.text:
Dead things in Stratholme isn't really a surprise anymore, but there's some new evil lurking within that we haven't seen before. 

Only the most courageous and strong willed should enter.

passages.title: Restless Dead
passages.text:
Rumors are spreading of some new evil business happening in Stratholme of all places. We need you to head to Eastern Plaguelands and put an end to any new evil threats that may have taken residence there.

We have received contact from a member of the Argent Crusade who has offered their assistance to get you into Stratholme and find the source of this new evil.

passages.title: Restless Dead
passages.text:
Dead things in Stratholme isn't really a surprise anymore, but there's some new evil lurking within that we haven't seen before. 

Only the most courageous and strong willed should enter.

passages.title: Tiny Terrors of Stratholme
passages.text:
Scourge activity inside of Stratholme has increased dramatically in the recent days. The air is thick with the stink of necromancy, and there are screams and shrieks coming from within these walls that will send chills down your spine for weeks to come.

I haven't ventured in there yet myself, but there is definitely some new evil stirring from within. I have the keys to this entrance, and can bring you in there to see for yourself.

Let me know when you are ready.

passages.title: Tiny Terrors of Stratholme
passages.text: I can open these gates and bring us in, but it will be up to you to get out safely.

passages.title: Tiny Terrors of Stratholme
passages.text: They did what to Blackmane!? Who are these people? Infusing a beast with strange necromancy powers certainly sounds like an escalation of events compared to what they have done previously. What can they possibly be doing with all of this stuff they are taking? It sounds like a showdown is imminent.

passages.title: Pet Battle Challenge: Stratholme
passages.text:
The evil presence has returned to Stratholme yet again. That's the problem with necromancy and scourge, they keep reanimating themselves and coming right back!

I can bring us in there again, but I suspect all of those evil forces have returned. Are you sure you want to go back in there? That place gives me the creeps. If you really want to head back in there, I will let you back in.

passages.title: Pet Battle Challenge: Stratholme
passages.text: I can open this service entrance, but it is up to you to safely get out of Stratholme.

passages.title: Pet Battle Challenge: Stratholme
passages.text: They did what to Blackmane!? Who are these people? Infusing a beast with strange necromancy powers certainly sounds like an escalation of events compared to what they have done previously. What can they possibly be doing with all of this stuff they are taking? It sounds like a showdown is imminent.

passages.title: A Direct Approach
passages.text:
Maokka has such a gentle heart. He is so good with the little ones, always playing games and telling stories.

We do however really dislike these Venture Co. individuals, so I suggest a more direct approach.

Try killing them all.

passages.title: A Direct Approach
passages.text: You've sent them a message they won't forget.

passages.title: The Eve of Battle
passages.text:
<name>. The time has come.

We may have defeated Azshara, but we still have to deal with Sylvanas. Though our position is not ideal, we have mobilized our available forces and stand ready to finish this war.

King Wrynn wanted me to brief you on the situation before we join him. There have been some... interesting developments.

passages.title: The Eve of Battle
passages.text: Thank you for responding with haste.

passages.title: They Move Against Us
passages.text:
The Dark Lady requests your presence in Orgrimmar, <name>. 

It seems the rats have finally come out of hiding. Which will make it all the easier to exterminate them.

Do not delay. We have waited for this moment long enough.

passages.title: They Move Against Us
passages.text: The pathetic fools.

passages.title: They Move Against Us
passages.text: These traitors will be dealt with. No more leniency. No more weakness.

passages.title: The Eve of Battle
passages.text:
<name>, we must speak of the Horde... and the warchief.

The war has proven costly, and the battle against Azshara drained what little resources we had left. The Horde is divided once more and the Alliance fares little better than we do. 

Sylvanas is now in a position to destroy everyone she considers an enemy. That means us, as well.

I had hoped that my old friend would see reason, but now...

High Overlord Saurfang is rallying those of us who remain--including some unlikely allies.

passages.title: The Eve of Battle
passages.text: We have much to do, <name>. The Banshee moves swiftly.

passages.title: Taking The Air Out
passages.text: <This box of rockets could just be used to take out the Venture Co. Balloons. That would really motivate Venture Co. to go somewhere else.>

passages.title: Taking The Air Out
passages.text: You are a generous one. You did far more than I asked.

passages.title: Wrathion's Journal
passages.text:
The whispers ceased as soon as I drank the potion. Thank you, adventurer.

Still, it is gravely concerning that N'Zoth's influence could reach me even within the Chamber of Heart. If Wrathion has found a way to resist the power of the Old Gods, then we can use it to reinforce the Chamber's defenses.

Perhaps MOTHER can glean more information from Wrathion's journal.

passages.title: Wrathion's Journal
passages.text: Awaiting information interface.

passages.title: Wrathion's Journal
passages.text:
Information from journal pages committed to memory. Formulating fortification schematics for Chamber of Heart.

All data recorded and catalogued. Physical transcription no longer required.

passages.title: Waste Not
passages.text: <There's a variety of parts around this area that might be useful to Rustbolt. You should collect them before Venture Co takes them.>

passages.title: Waste Not
passages.text: Grab what things you can!

passages.title: Waste Not
passages.text: These parts will make someone a nice upgrade!

passages.title: Vinyl: Gnomeregan Forever
passages.text:
<This pressed vinyl is surprisingly still intact. Its label says it contains the recording of a song called "Gnomeregan Forever."

You should be able to install this vinyl into the gramophone back in Rustbolt.>

passages.title: Vinyl: Gnomeregan Forever
passages.text: <The vinyl slides neatly into the gramophone's vinyl carousel. The titleboard updates automatically.>

passages.title: Vinyl: Mimiron's Brainstorm
passages.text:
<This pressed vinyl is surprisingly still intact. Its label says it contains the recording of a song called "Mimiron's Brainstorm."

You should be able to install this vinyl into the gramophone back in Rustbolt.>

passages.title: Vinyl: Mimiron's Brainstorm
passages.text: <The vinyl slides neatly into the gramophone's vinyl carousel. The titleboard updates automatically.>

passages.title: Vinyl: Battle of Gnomeregan
passages.text:
<This pressed vinyl is surprisingly still intact. Its label says it contains the recording of a song called "Battle of Gnomeragan."

You should be able to install this vinyl into the gramophone back in Rustbolt.>

passages.title: Vinyl: Battle of Gnomeregan
passages.text: <The vinyl slides neatly into the gramophone's vinyl carousel. The titleboard updates automatically.>

passages.title: Vinyl: Depths of Ulduar
passages.text:
<This pressed vinyl is surprisingly still intact. Its label says it contains the recording of a song called "Depths of Ulduar."

You should be able to install this vinyl into the gramophone back in Rustbolt.>

passages.title: Vinyl: Depths of Ulduar
passages.text: <The vinyl slides neatly into the gramophone's vinyl carousel. The titleboard updates automatically.>

passages.title: Vinyl: Triumph of Gnomeregan
passages.text:
<This pressed vinyl is surprisingly still intact. Its label says it contains the recording of a song called "Triumph of Gnomeregan."

You should be able to install this vinyl into the gramophone back in Rustbolt.>

passages.title: Vinyl: Triumph of Gnomeregan
passages.text: <The vinyl slides neatly into the gramophone's vinyl carousel. The titleboard updates automatically.>

passages.title: Nuke 'Em Norbit
passages.text:
These motospiders continue to multiply unchecked. If we don't slow them down they'll overrun Rustbolt soon.

I've modified Norbit here with adequate firepower to take the spiders head on!

Would you pilot Norbit and destroy the Reinforced Sparkweave Eggs?

passages.title: Nuke 'Em Norbit
passages.text: Norbit needs a skilled pilot!

passages.title: Nuke 'Em Norbit
passages.text: Mission accomplished!

passages.title: Worldvein Rumors
passages.text: Gather intelligence to assist SI:7 in identifying the location of the Fluctuating Worldvein.

passages.title: Worldvein Rumors
passages.text: Have you gathered enough intelligence?

passages.title: Worldvein Rumors
passages.text: This is exactly the intelligence Mathias Shaw wanted me to watch out for, I will pass it over to him immediately. I am sure he will have a Mission waiting for you.

passages.title: Worldvein Rumors
passages.text: Gather more intelligence to assist your followers in tracking down the location of the Fluctuating Worldvein.

passages.title: Worldvein Rumors
passages.text: Have you gathered enough intelligence?

passages.title: Worldvein Rumors
passages.text: Nathanos Blightcaller was looking for just this type of intelligence. I will send a runner immediately to the flagship. I am sure he will have a follow up mission for you when you arrive.

passages.title: It's Never Easy
passages.text:
The last I heard, Mogu'shan Vaults was still abandoned. 

We shouldn't have too tough of a time reachin' the engine, since we've already defeated the mogu guardians in that place.

Well, what are ye waitin' for? Let's get that engine turned on!

passages.title: It's Never Easy
passages.text: It's never easy, is it?

passages.title: It's Never Easy
passages.text:
That amber barrier looks nigh impassable.

It looks like we've hit a dead end...

passages.title: Clans of the Mogu
passages.text:
You say a mogu asked for your help? This is quite uncharacteristic. 

I'd be happy to help you uncover the origins of this sigil. To be honest, the prospect of a mogu clan that isn't openly hostile interests me greatly. Just think of the possibilities!

Let's get down to business. We'll need to consult the volumes on the various mogu clans in the vale to narrow it down.

passages.title: Clans of the Mogu
passages.text: Why are you talking to me? The knowledge you seek is in the tomes.

passages.title: Clans of the Mogu
passages.text:
If the mogu are once again following Ra-den it could mean an end to their days of war.

This is very exciting!

passages.title: Finding the Rajani
passages.text:
Now that we have an idea of who we're looking for, the next question is, where can we find them?

With the constant infighting of the mogu, it is likely that each clan would keep tabs on the whereabouts of their competitors. If we can find such information, it may just lead us to the Rajani.

Seek out the champions of the mogu. They would be the most likely to carry reports on their enemies' whereabouts.

passages.title: Finding the Rajani
passages.text: Have you found a scouting report?

passages.title: Finding the Rajani
passages.text:
Excellent. Not only might this lead us to the Rajani, but it will prove valuable to the Golden Lotus's defense efforts.

This is valuable information, indeed!

passages.title: Restored Hope
passages.text:
Your persistence fills me with hope for this world. 

Let us return to your "Chamber of Heart." As the caretaker of the Forge of Origination, I believe I can help your efforts to restore it.

Speak to me when you are ready, and I will bring us there.

passages.title: Restored Hope
passages.text:
Not only have we managed tae restore power tae the Forge of Origination, but we even brought back the Titan keeper that originally installed it!

But believe it or not, that's not the end o' the good news!

passages.title: Corpse Cleanup
passages.text:
Our friends continue to fall as these terrible insects pour of their nests and attack our camps.

It's a terrible job to ask of anyone, but we have to dispose of the corpses as quickly as possible.

We can't allow our dead to be used as fertilizer for growing their disgusting eggs.

passages.title: Corpse Cleanup
passages.text: We need to complete this task quickly and without delay.

passages.title: Corpse Cleanup
passages.text: I hope this will help keep the growth of their numbers at bay.

passages.title: Off-the-Books Brawlin'
passages.text:
Gazlowe hired you for protection too? I guess it's true that he only hires the best, eh? Ha!

Pay's great, but the rules are dung: no fightin' in town, no exceptions. Bah!

<Usha takes a big gulp of her drink.>

That tiny tender prince won't give us his tech unless he thinks we're good little angels... Ha!

But Gazlowe didn't say nothin' about fightin' outside of town.

I got my own squad on the outskirts, ready to brawl with Grumbol's guzzlers if they show their bearded faces.

You want in?

passages.title: Off-the-Books Brawlin'
passages.text:
Ha ha ha! Look at Grumbol's stupid face!

He can't believe it! Ha ha ha! Pathetic!

passages.title: A Little Side Action
passages.text:
There are only two things more fun than fighting, and the first is talking trash!

<Usha shouts an insult at Grumbol Grimhammer.>

That boar-beard runt over there's been a thorn in my backside since Alterac... Can't seem to shake him.

We got a bet going about who's the best fighter on the island.

You want to help me win this wager?

passages.title: A Little Side Action
passages.text: Ha! Looks like I owe you another drink.

passages.title: Off-the-Books Brawlin'
passages.text:
*buuuurrp* Arrrright, listen 'ere. We got ourselves a bit o' a predicament.

Besides this dump's ale tastin' like oil, that pigheaded Usha here been sayin' some unfortunate stuff about our troops.

Unfortunate FOR HER, 'cuz now *uuuuurp* gonna needya ta rough up any Horde swine ya end up runnin' into out there.

Loosely speakin' we ain't supposed to be brawlin' out 'ere, so this ain't a formal order or nothin'...

passages.title: Off-the-Books Brawlin'
passages.text: Couldn't be more proud of ya me lad! 'Ere's a little somethin' fer yer trouble.

passages.title: A Little Side Action
passages.text:
'Ey, <name>, I could be usin' yer talents fer a little bet I got goin' on with Usha.

I'm wagerin' you can beat up five 'o her pals around the island before her dog can beat up five o' ours.

Ye up fer it me $ulad:lass;? 'O course ya are, ahahaha!

passages.title: A Little Side Action
passages.text: I knew ye wouldn't be lettin' me down!

passages.title: A Curious Discovery
passages.text:
<This crystal shines with a mesmerizing light that you find difficult to avert your gaze from.

Perhaps the Unshackled would be able to tell you more about it.>

passages.title: A Curious Discovery
passages.text:
I've seen these crystals in a couple of places, often with a weird looking slime nearby. There has to be some sort of link but I've yet to discover it. 

At any rate the only use of these crystals I've found is to get tiny creatures to follow me around for a while.

Sorry, that doesn't help you much but you can have your crystal back. Let me know if you figure anything else out.

passages.title: A Curious Discovery
passages.text:
<This crystal shines with a mesmerizing light that you find difficult to avert your gaze from.

Perhaps the Ankoan would be able to tell you more about it.>

passages.title: A Curious Discovery
passages.text:
I've seen these crystals in a couple of places, often with a strange slime nearby. Clearly there is a link between the two but I have yet to discover it. 

At any rate, the only use of these crystals I have found is to hypnotize tiny creatures for a while.

Sorry, that does not help you much but you can have your crystal back. Let me know if you figure anything else out.

passages.title: The Problem with Shrinkage
passages.text: <Having skinned countless creatures, you can't help but notice how much usable leather is lost when the skin is dried and tanned. The Ankoan seem to have mastered using the material, perhaps Instructor Ulooaka could share some of his insights.>

passages.title: The Problem with Shrinkage
passages.text: Apologies. We are so used to working with these materials, I forgot to explain how to prevent that. These beasts are usually underwater all the time, and the air dries them unevenly. When you skin the beast, roll the skin as you harvest it. This will rehydrate it enough to prevent waste.

passages.title: The Problem with Shrinkage
passages.text: <Having skinned countless creatures, you can't help but notice how much usable leather is lost when the skin is dried and tanned. The Unshackled seem to have a solid understanding of using the material, perhaps Rolm could share some of his insights.>

passages.title: The Problem with Shrinkage
passages.text: Ah, yeah, sorry about that. We are so used to working with these materials, I forgot to explain how to prevent that. See, these beasts are usually underwater all the time, and the air dries them unevenly. When you skin the beast, roll the skin as you harvest it. That'll rehydrate it enough to prevent waste.

passages.title: Hanging by a Thread
passages.text: <As you peel the hide from the creature's body, you notice numerous scales break off the skin, tearing holes that render portions of the hide useless. The Ankoan seem to have mastered using the material, perhaps Instructor Ulooaka could share some of his insights.>

passages.title: Hanging by a Thread
passages.text: I have seen this many times. The scales of these beasts are not just part of the skin, but connected by tough muscle and sinew. This allows the creature to move through the crushing depths easier. When you are ready to remove the hide, do it in two passes. The first to cut these sinuous fibers, the second to flay it. You will find more of the hide will be usable.

passages.title: Hanging by a Thread
passages.text: <As you peel the hide from the creature's body, you notice numerous scales break off the skin, tearing holes that render portions of the hide useless. The Unshackled seem to have mastered using the material, perhaps Rolm could share some of his insights.>

passages.title: Hanging by a Thread
passages.text: I've seen THIS before. See, the scales of these beasts are not just part of the skin, but are connected with muscle and sinew. This allows the creature to move through the crushing depths easier. When you are ready to remove the hide, do it in two passes. The first to free the scales, the second to actually skin it. That way more of the hide will be usable.

passages.title: Work Order: Greater Flask of the Currents
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed these flasks badly.

passages.title: Toys Like Us
passages.text:
I must share the wonders of this place with all of Azeroth in a way that will entertain young and old alike. I will use the technology here to create a new line of toys unlike anything seen before!

My Quasi-Faceted scanner can help construct perfect replicas of things here on the island. 

I just need a helpful individual such as yourself to scan a few things around this area.

passages.title: Toys Like Us
passages.text: The first batch of toys is all ready to go!

passages.title: Certified Pre-Owned
passages.text:
First, let me say that you will ALWAYS be our favorite test subject.

But our experiments require far more sacrifice than a single test subject can offer. And, from time to time, some of those test subjects require new limbs.

My dear brother and I have a nascent concept for expanding the average lifespan of mechanical appendages. But we've run out of components to experiment on.

Salvage some appendages from the heap outside town so we can continue our experiments.

passages.title: Certified Pre-Owned
passages.text: Don't worry about any malfunctioning or missing parts. Gill will help us repair whatever you find.

passages.title: Certified Pre-Owned
passages.text:
Wondrous! This should last us...

<Pristy counts the appendages and scribbles in her notebook.>

...at least 3 hours. Wow, we're really churning through these appendages!

passages.title: Reflections in Amber
passages.text:
<A viscous dark ooze drips from this large chunk of amber. Attempting to wipe it off is futile, as the ooze is seemingly created by the amber itself.

As you hold it, unintelligible whispers fill the back of your mind.

The Shado-Pan will surely want to examine it.>

passages.title: Reflections in Amber
passages.text: What is it you have there, <name>?

passages.title: Once More Into Kor'vess
passages.text:
You found this on a member of the swarm? It seeps with corruption... and with power. We could be faced with a serious threat if the rest of the mantid's amber is similarly corrupted.

Far to the west in the Dread Wastes lies Kor'vess, a large kypari tree that provides the swarm with most of its amber. From there, we can determine just how much of their stores have been infused with the energy of the Old Gods.

I will meet you closer to the tree.

passages.title: Once More Into Kor'vess
passages.text: The mantid appear to be corrupting the entire tree. It is worse than I thought.

passages.title: Aqir Extermination
passages.text:
There are too many of these things flyin' around for us to make a clean getaway. 

We're liable to get swarmed the second we start up them plane engines!

These bugs are going straight back into the ground... one way or another. May as well expedite the process, know what I mean?

passages.title: Aqir Extermination
passages.text: That should help keep the runway clear for a bit!

passages.title: Crippling the Hive
passages.text:
The mantid here are working feverishly to harvest amber from the tree.

Perhaps killing a pawful of them will slow their efforts.

passages.title: Crippling the Hive
passages.text: While it is not a permanent solution, this should buy us some time.

passages.title: Rotten at the Roots
passages.text:
Underneath Kypari Kor is a large chamber where the mantid tend to the tree. That must be where the source of the corruption lies.

We need to get into that chamber and stop them. N'Zoth must not be allowed to empower the swarm.

passages.title: Rotten at the Roots
passages.text: Faceless ones? The kypari trees are sacred to the mantid... but I suppose their devotion to the Old Gods is greater.

passages.title: Amber Secrets
passages.text:
The Morrowchamber houses a small section of the Zara'thik, mantid under immediate directive of the new empress. Some of them may have been given pieces of amber like the one you found.

The Shado-Pan would be interested in any extra pieces we can acquire.

passages.title: Amber Secrets
passages.text: We always feared this day would come...

passages.title: Amber Secrets
passages.text: More of this corrupted amber. I need to bring this back to the garrison.

passages.title: Old Faces, New Problems
passages.text:
One of N'Zoth's minions appears to have taken note of our presence.

Shall we pay them a visit?

passages.title: Old Faces, New Problems
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Old Faces, New Problems
passages.text: Another agent of N'Zoth. It seems the mantid have earned his favor.

passages.title: A Unified Swarm
passages.text:
It seemed as though the mantid had been producing the corrupted amber for some time before our... intervention. It stands to reason that they are keeping a stockpile of it somewhere.

The Shado-Pan's scouts have been reporting an increased presence of the swarm's warriors in Klaxxi'vess. I would wager that they are guarding the corrupted amber.

Meet me there. If we have a chance to destroy that amber, then we need to take it.

passages.title: A Unified Swarm
passages.text: If the entire swarm were empowered by that corrupted amber, N'Zoth would have an unstoppable army under his command.

passages.title: Ashran Dominance
Ashran Dominance
Fortunate Souls
passages.text:
You and I survived the attack and have thus far evaded capture by the enemy.

Not all were as fortunate.

There are many of our allies now under the control of the naga. We must free them before they are killed or suffer an even worse fate.

passages.title: Fortunate Souls
passages.text: We are outnumbered, but we are not outclassed.

passages.title: Fortunate Souls
passages.text: Our army was devastated, but we will rebuild.

passages.title: Disruption of Power
passages.text:
The naga are tapping into some latent power, infusing the energy into some manner of device.

I do not know what purpose they have for this power, but it is surely in our interest to destroy the objects before they can be used against us.

passages.title: Disruption of Power
passages.text: Can you feel the magic in this place?

passages.title: Disruption of Power
passages.text: At times it is satisfying to break another's toys.

passages.title: In Deep
passages.text:
By now, King Greymane and Lady Proudmoore should be in the cave at which we are to meet.

Let's not keep them waiting.

passages.title: In Deep
passages.text: I already tire of this place.

passages.title: Up Against It
passages.text:
We must move quickly if we are to find safety for our people.

This cave is barely defensible, and much of our army is in an even more precarious position.

Let's search deeper.

passages.title: Up Against It
passages.text: We have been watching you. Your people seem quite capable.

passages.title: Heart of the Swarm
passages.text:
We need to know what we're up against. Before we return to the Serpent's Spine, we should take the opportunity to scout the swarm.

I will fly us over the Heart of Fear. We should be able to survey Empress Shek'zara's forces from above. Then we can determine the extent to which N'Zoth has bolstered their ranks with his own.

passages.title: Heart of the Swarm
passages.text: A close call. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: The Mantid Threat
passages.text:
The mantid have been corrupting their kypari trees to imbue their amber with power from N'Zoth. The swarm is enough of a menace on its own. N'Zoth could transform them into something even more dire.

The Shado-Pan need to hear about this. I suggest you bring this information to your other allies as well.

passages.title: The Mantid Threat
passages.text:
That the mantid would give their own kypari trees over to corruption speaks volumes of their loyalty to N'Zoth.

Thank you for bringing this to my attention.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Nazjatar
passages.text:
Our mission in Nazjatar is being compromised by the Horde incursion. 

Get into Nazjatar and take out as many as you can.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Nazjatar
passages.text: Good work, <class>.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Mechagon
passages.text:
Our mission in Mechagon is being compromised by the Horde incursion. 

Get into Mechagon and take out as many as you can.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Mechagon
passages.text: Good work, <class>.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Mechagon
passages.text:
Our objectives in Mechagon are being interrupted by the influx of Alliance scum.

Clear as many of them out of the area that you find, then report back.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Mechagon
passages.text: Good work, <class>.

passages.title: Contained Alemental
passages.text:
<As the brew is returned to its natural, dormant form, a strange keg appears.

Perhaps Brewmaster Tao knows more about such a strange occurrence.>

passages.title: Contained Alemental
passages.text:
Everything has a spirit to it. From the clouds in the sky to the worms in the ground, life is woven through the entire world.

Brew is no different. Created with such love, such care... it only requires a spark to spring to life in front of our very eyes.

passages.title: Hozen Totem
passages.text:
<The hozen have been successfully chased away, and Brewfest saved once again.

The question asks itself, though: How did hozen get to Durotar? Perhaps somebody in the Brewfest grounds has experience with them.>

passages.title: Hozen Totem
passages.text:
<Zenda spits on the hozen totem.>

Do not be fooled by deir appearance. Dese hozen are ruthless. Some chased my brother out of his own bar in Zuldazar and took it over as deir own!

I have seen dese winged ones, and dey are unwelcome wherever dey go.

passages.title: Direbrew Cog
passages.text:
<Direbrew's Dark Iron have fled, leaving behind a small piece of one of their mole machines.

You know they have attacked Brewfest before. Perhaps one of the goblins would be interested in hearing of your victory.>

passages.title: Direbrew Cog
passages.text:
So Direbrew still ain't giving up, is he?

Well, thanks for taking care of his lackeys again. Thanks to you, I still have business! Take these tokens as a reward... but be sure to come back and spend them later!

passages.title: This Ain't Mine
passages.text:
Your arrival is timely, <name>. Sylvanas's loyalists have collapsed part of the canyon path to Orgrimmar. 

We are cut off from our vanguard and I fear that they will be destroyed if we cannot reinforce them quickly. Our forces are few in number. We cannot afford to leave them stranded for long.

Tinkmaster Overspark and Gazlowe believe they have a solution. Hurry and aid them however you can.

passages.title: This Ain't Mine
passages.text: Thank the Light you were able to open the pass.

passages.title: This Ain't Mine
passages.text: We may have rejoined the vanguard, but Sylvanas's forces have been harrying our front line.

passages.title: The Power of Worship
passages.text:
I was once like them, stuck in a loop and waiting for Azshara to come and save me. Our spirits are locked to this place.

There are naga in the other parts of these ruins. They have these magical orbs... I think they are using us to fuel their arcane experiments. They draw power from our spirits and our worship of Azshara. This keeps us weakened and unable to break free.

Destroy the orbs. Breaking the connection will allow us to gain strength and move on.

passages.title: The Power of Worship
passages.text: Have you found them all?

passages.title: The Power of Worship
passages.text: Without the draw of energy, I believe that the other spirits will eventually be able to break out of their loop. They will be able to move on.

passages.title: S.P.A.R.E. Crates
passages.text:
I'm sure you agree that Pascal-K1N6 is the greatest invention you've ever seen!

If you're not convinced yet, try to push him to his limits. I don't mind!

Bring him more resources and blueprints -- he'll craft anything you need!

passages.title: S.P.A.R.E. Crates
passages.text:
Look at all those spare parts you've got in those bags! You're starting to look like a real junkyard tinkerer.

Let me give you a tip, though. Only amateurs carry 'em around all helter skelter like that.

Real experts keep 'em organized efficiently, so we can carry more.

Here, I'll show you how.

passages.title: The Spear of Destiny
passages.text:
The Javelins are some of the most powerful magical creations of Suramar, before the Sundering. This is just what we need to bring down the wards on the protector and the Tidestone.

We must hurry back to Mezzamere, Lady Proudmoore needs to know of our success.

This will change the entire course of our campaign here in Nazjatar, <name>.

passages.title: The Spear of Destiny
passages.text: This is an amazing find, <name>. With this, we can assault the guardian of the Tidestone, and secure it.

passages.title: Our Direct Line
passages.text:
I'm sure you agree that Pascal-K1N6 is the greatest invention you've ever seen!

If you're not convinced yet, try to push him to his limits. I don't mind!

Bring him more resources and blueprints -- he'll craft anything you need!

passages.title: Our Direct Line
passages.text:
Madam Goya wishes to convey her appreciation for your continued support of her operations.

She's asked me to entrust you with the blueprints for our encrypted communication network, so you can always stay in touch.

Do not share this with anyone, <name>.

We'll be watching.

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Akunda's Bite
passages.text:
I've received an urgent request from Tinkmaster Overspark.

These supplies are needed!

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Akunda's Bite
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Your contribution has been logged in our records for posterity to appreciate!

passages.title: Brewfest Chowdown
passages.text:
Mok-rah, <class>! I hope you came with an empty stomach!

Back on Draenor, we often held eating contests at our festivals as a form of celebration. When we were put in charge of Brewfest, we could think of nothing better to add to the event!

Take a seat and show us what you can eat. If you want more details before jumping in, just ask!

passages.title: Brewfest Chowdown
passages.text: Eat a sausage, drink some brew, then eat some more!

passages.title: Brewfest Chowdown
passages.text: Well eaten! Every time you win, you'll receive a token as a reward. Once you collect five, come back to me and I can award you with a beautiful trophy!

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Akunda's Bite
passages.text:
Gazlowe's orders are in: He wants these supplies ASAP.

Ya got the goods?

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Akunda's Bite
passages.text:
Thanks for pitchin' in.

I'll make sure Gazlowe and Prince Erazmin know these came from you.

passages.text:

Ya got the goods?

Thanks for pitchin' in.

I'll make sure Gazlowe and Prince Erazmin know these came from you.

passages.text:

These supplies are needed!

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Monelite Ore
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Your contribution has been logged in our records for posterity to appreciate!

passages.title: My Punkin, the Action Figure
passages.text:
Heya, <name>.

<Grizzek leans in close and whispers.>

I'm workin' on a surprise for Saffy. Hopin' you can help me out.

I overheard her beggin' Jepetto Joybuzz to make her into one of his fancy new action figures.

That ol' jerk told her no. Can you believe it? My Punkin!

Well, we don't need him. I reverse engineered a few of his toys and found out what makes them tick.

I got a blueprint ready to go. We can make Saffy's action figure ourselves and surprise her with it!

passages.title: My Punkin, the Action Figure
passages.text: You've got the spark of discovery in your eyes!

passages.title: My Punkin, the Action Figure
passages.text: <Sapphronetta's eyes light up as you hand her the action figure of herself.>

passages.text:
I've received an urgent request from Tinkmaster Overspark.

These supplies are needed!

passages.title: Rustbolt Requisitions: Winter's Kiss
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Your contribution has been logged in our records for posterity to appreciate!

passages.title: Brewfest Chowdown
passages.text:
Welcome, <class>! I hope you came with an empty stomach!

What's better, or more Brewfest, than sausage and brew? The Brewfest Chowdown is our new celebration of the things that make this festival great.

Take a seat and show us what you can eat. If you want more details before jumping in, just ask!

passages.title: Brewfest Chowdown
passages.text: Eat a sausage, drink some brew, then eat some more!

passages.title: Brewfest Chowdown
passages.text: Well eaten! Every time you win, you'll receive a token as a reward. Once you collect five, come back to me and I can award you with a beautiful trophy!

Thanks for pitchin' in.

I'll make sure Gazlowe and Prince Erazmin know these came from you.

passages.title: Work Order: Greater Flask of Endless Fathoms
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed these flasks badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Greater Flask of the Undertow
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed these flasks badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Greater Flask of the Vast Horizon
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed these flasks badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Greater Flask of the Currents
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed these flasks badly.

passages.title: Time-Lost Warriors
passages.text:
According to the scouting report ye found, the Rajani are holed up in the Silent Sanctuary, overlooking Mistfall Village. 

They are described in the report as seclusive and dangerous, so we'd had best take caution when approaching them.

I'll meet ye there.

passages.title: Time-Lost Warriors
passages.text: What is it, outsider?

passages.title: Time-Lost Warriors
passages.text:
It is of no use. The great Highkeeper is convinced of our fate.

It will take more than words to move him.

passages.title: Work Order: Greater Flask of Endless Fathoms
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed these flasks badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Greater Flask of the Vast Horizon
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed these flasks badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Greater Flask of the Undertow
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed these flasks badly.

passages.title: A Gift From The Clan
passages.text:
Speaker Utia has requested that I direct you back to Mezzamere when you have a chance, <name>.

Our clan has prepared a gift for you to show our appreciation for the courage and valor you have shown in battle against the naga.

I am sure that you will find the gift of supplies to be a valuable addition to your arsenal as you continue your campaign against Azshara.

passages.title: A Gift From The Clan
passages.text: You have brought honor to our clan, <name>. Please accept these additional supplies along with our thanks.

passages.title: A Glint in the Darkness
passages.text:
There are many treasures hidden throughout Nazjatar.

Recently, I spotted an object glinting from within a cave not far from here. It appeared to be some sort of lockbox.

I suggest we head back and investigate. There may be valuable items inside that will help us in our battle against the naga.

passages.title: A Valorous Reward
passages.text:
Your deeds on the battlefield have brought honor upon your Alliance, <class>.

Speaker Utia has requested your presence in Mezzamere to accept a reward on behalf of our clan.

You should return to Mezzamere at your soonest convenience.

It is an honor to fight at your side.

passages.title: A Valorous Reward
passages.text: Please accept this gift of supplies. May it serve you well.

passages.title: Hidden, But Dangerous
passages.text:
The naga have hidden many useful treasures throughout Nazjatar.

I have heard tell that there is a treasure hoard not far from here. It will be dangerous, but it may be worth investigating.

There may be untold valuables inside the cache that could aid us in our fight against the naga.

passages.title: Treasure In The Deep
passages.text:
There are many treasures to be found throughout the naga stronghold of Nazjatar.

Some time ago, I noticed a mysterious looking chest. The area was heavily fortified with naga troops, so whatever it contains must be valuable.

We should go back and investigate the chest. Whatever is inside is better used in our hands than the hands of the enemy.

passages.title: The Speaker's Gift
passages.text:
Speaker Utia has requested your presence in Mezzamere, <name>.

I believe that the Speaker has prepared a collection of items to aid you in your journey.

You should return to Mezzamere at your soonest convenience and accept the Speaker's gift.

passages.title: The Speaker's Gift
passages.text: Please accept this gift on behalf of our clan. May it serve you well.

passages.title: The Lambent Lockbox
passages.text:
There are many treasures to find throughout these ancient ruins.

Sometime ago, I noticed a strange looking chest in a cave not far from here.

There may be valuable items inside that can help us in our fight against Queen Azshara.

We should go back and investigate the chest.

passages.title: Helpful Provisions
passages.text:
Speaker Utia is awaiting your return to Mezzamere.

The Speaker has bundled together some helpful provisions to aid you in your journey.

Please accept this gift with the thanks of our clan.

passages.title: Helpful Provisions
passages.text: Please accept this gift of supplies. May you be well-equipped in your battles against the naga.

passages.title: The Mystic Chest
passages.text:
We have uncovered many rare treasures while exploring Nazjatar. I believe that I have found yet another cache of valuable artifacts to retrieve.

Some time ago, I noticed a strangely glowing object in the distance. I believe that it may have been a treasure chest.

We should go and investigate the object. If it is a treasure chest, its contents may prove valuable in our quest to defeat the naga!

passages.title: Naga Treasure
passages.text:
The naga have stashed away the spoils of their wars throughout Nazjatar.

Earlier while we were adventuring, I noticed a mysterious looking cache. The chest is located deep within naga territory, so I imagine that whatever is inside is most likely extremely valuable.

We should retrieve the contents of the cache. Whatever is inside is better used in our hands than the hands of the enemy.

passages.title: Additional Supplies
passages.text:
Speaker Utia has asked me to send you back to Mezzamere when you have a moment, <name>.

The Speaker has some additional supplies that might aid you in your fight against the naga.

Please return to Mezzamere at your soonest convenience and accept the Speaker's gift with the thanks of our entire clan.

passages.title: Additional Supplies
passages.text: May these additional supplies aid you in your journey, <name>.

passages.title: Reclaimed Treasure
passages.text:
The naga have filled Nazjatar with the ill-gotten spoils of war. We should reclaim whatever we come across in our effort to put an end to their tyranny once and for all.

I noticed a strange looking chest in a cave nearby. It appeared to be of naga make.

We should claim the contents of the cache. There may be valuable items inside that will help us in our battle against the naga.

passages.title: A Gift of Supplies
passages.text:
Speaker Utia has asked that I send you back to Mezzamere at your soonest convenience.

The Speaker has gathered together a gift of supplies to further aid you in your fight against the naga.

You should return to Mezzamere at your soonest convenience. Please accept this gift with the thanks of our clan.

passages.title: A Gift of Supplies
passages.text: Please accept this gift of supplies. May it serve you well.

passages.title: Treasure To Find
passages.text:
The naga have stashed away treasures all over Nazjatar.

Not long ago, I noticed an ornately crafted treasure chest hidden in plain view. The area is heavily fortified, but such minor inconveniences have not stopped us yet.

We should head back there and liberate the contents of the cache.

passages.title: Mysterious Treasure
passages.text:
We have located many treasure hoards while exploring Nazjatar. I believe that I have found yet another cache for us to liberate.

Some time ago, I noticed a mysterious looking chest. It is held in an extremely dangerous area, so whatever it contains must be valuable.

We should embark on a mission to liberate the contents of the cache. Whatever is inside is better used in our hands than the hands of the enemy.

passages.title: Work Order: Mech-Dowel's "Big Mech"
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed this food badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Baked Port Tato
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed this food badly.

passages.title: Just A Friend
passages.text:
Look, mudfoot, I need to make sure a slight current isn't going to knock you over.

I asked Atolia to see if she could pull together some things to make you a little less useless here.

After what I saw in that last fight, we should probably head back sooner rather than later.

passages.title: Just A Friend
passages.text:
As an observation, that you're still putting up with that grump is laudable.

I will see what else I can find, in case you guys are still working together later.

I'm rooting for you.

passages.title: With Friends Like You, Who Needs Anemones?
passages.text:
I sometimes amuse myself with excursions into Zanj'ir Terrace, where the naga tough guys hang out.

I grab things that could be useful and stash them somewhere I can pick them up later.

I haven't been down there in a while. 

I could have something in there you may find useful.

passages.title: With Friends Like You, Who Needs Anemones?
passages.text: <The movement of the tentacles provides a lovely breeze in this muggy terrace.>

passages.title: That's What Friends Are For
passages.text:
Hmm. I am not admitting to anything, but there is a very small chance that I could have possibly, but not definitely, been mistaken about your whole... thing.

On the off chance we were still tolerating each other, Atolia mentioned she had another delivery for you.

We should swing through Newhome.

passages.title: That's What Friends Are For
passages.text:
We Unshackled help each other. 

This has helped us grow. This has kept us strong... maybe not charming, but strong.

Vim is a good friend, especially once you get past his crustacean act.

passages.title: Friends Through Eternity
passages.text:
You may have noticed by now that me and the sea giants get along great.

They mostly just want to be left alone. They want to laugh, and they want to tell you stories that make no sense.

A simple life.

We do share one interest, aside from killing naga, that is sampling interesting brews. 

Maedin recently brought in a lovely new keg, I hid it away. When it is ready to be opened, that round will be on me!

Come, take a look!

passages.title: Friends Through Eternity
passages.text:
<There is a message carved into the wood.

"The best brews are the ones shared with friends.">

passages.title: Real Friends Help Hide Bodies
passages.text:
Bodies... treasures... 

I've seen it all, but it was a long time before I found someone worth calling friend.

I am glad I added you to that list.

So, back to those friends... I have one more place I would like you to see.

passages.title: Real Friends Help Hide Bodies
passages.text:
<A plaque reads:

Who you meet on your journey, makes the trip worth taking.
