Gorm was a good fighter.>

passages.title: We're Going To Be Friends
passages.text:
It is going to be fun getting to know you. You're not half bad!

We kinda got a little gift for you, to welcome you to the neighborhood.

I hope Atolia was able to put together something neat, she didn't have much time.

passages.title: We're Going To Be Friends
passages.text: Seems like you're fitting in well here. Keep it up, young one!

passages.title: Super Friends
passages.text:
You are a super trooper duper friend!

There is a place I go to visit some of my smaller buddies. I keep some neat things I find in a bag there.

Would you like to see it? 

What am I asking? Of course you would, let's go!

passages.title: Super Friends
passages.text: <There is a note inside the bag that reads, "Remember, Poen, every day is a chance to find the silver lining." - Poen>

passages.title: A Friend Indeed
passages.text:
My friend, every day with you is a new adventure. 

I am sorry your ships crashed, but I am so happy we met!

I heard a rumor, that Atolia found some more goods!

We should swing by and see what she has this time!

passages.title: A Friend Indeed
passages.text:
I haven't seen Poen this happy in such a long time.

You deserve this and more!

passages.title: You've Got A Friend In Me
passages.text:
There are a few spots I enjoy checking out with my friends. 

I actually found this amazing... well, I don't know what it is.

Think you could check it out with me?

passages.title: You've Got A Friend In Me
passages.text: <It is apparent Poen is a bit of a practical joker.>

passages.title: Friendship Is Magic
passages.text:
Every day with you, I feel like I am a better kelfin than I was the day before.

You have no idea how much that means to me.

I felt like I wanted to do more, be more... help more.

Now, I'm starting to be a real contributing member of the Unshackled.

It's all thanks to you.

passages.title: Friendship Is Magic
passages.text: <The motion is quite relaxing.>

passages.title: An Unexpected Friend
passages.text:
Oh, <name>, I nearly forgot!

To help you with your mission here in Nazjatar, Atolia and I put together some items you may need.

We should swing by and grab them when we have the time!

passages.title: An Unexpected Friend
passages.text:
Welcome to our lovely, and yet terrifying, little neighborhood. 

If you survive, I may be able to pull together a few more items for you!

passages.title: Anytime You Need A Friend
passages.text:
You're not that bad for a... what was it? <race>?

I like when I am reminded to look past appearances. Ha!

But, really, speaking of hiding things in plain sight, I put some things in a naga crate. It is close to one of their camps in the Spears of Azshara, so they will never suspect it belongs to me!

Let's go see if it is still there.

passages.title: Anytime You Need A Friend
passages.text: <There is a faint smell of salt and leather.>

passages.title: With A Little Help From My Friends
passages.text:
It has been so long since we have been able to trust anyone not in our little pack of survivors.

I forgot how good it feels. 

Thank you for reminding me.

Atolia should have the rest of your gift together by now. We should go check in with her!

passages.title: With A Little Help From My Friends
passages.text:
You know, if everyone on the land is as great as you, maybe we should visit once we are all free.

It isn't much, but I hope you find something useful here!

passages.title: A Kelfin's Best Friend
passages.text:
There is no better weapon in our fight than knowledge. 

Knowing you is proof of that!

I found this thing, it lets me see better than my eyes could ever do before. 

With the water gone, I can see far, too! I have been using it sometimes to see what is happening in Nazjatar.

Let me show you!

passages.title: A Kelfin's Best Friend
passages.text: <Etched into the scope, you see the faint words, "No man is an island, but should you find yourself seeking one, bring this!">

passages.title: Thank You For Being A Friend
passages.text:
Since the waterwall appeared, so much has changed here. 

There is a little spot I found, where you can feel the sea spray on your face. 

Sometimes I just ride over there and relax.

I will show it to you, if you'd like.

passages.title: Thank You For Being A Friend
passages.text: <When disturbed, these coral give off a scent of flowers and forests.>

passages.title: Work Order: Enchant Weapon - Naga Hide
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed these enchantments badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Enchant Weapon - Oceanic Restoration
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed these enchantments badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Enchant Weapon - Force Multiplier
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed these enchantments badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Enchant Weapon - Machinist's Brilliance
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed these enchantments badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Enchant Weapon - Machinist's Brilliance
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed these enchantments badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Enchant Weapon - Oceanic Restoration
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed these enchantments badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Enchant Weapon - Force Multiplier
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed these enchantments badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Enchant Weapon - Naga Hide
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, friend. We needed these enchantments badly.

passages.title: Leaders of the Horde
passages.text:
Saurfang has shown his true colors and now enlists the aid of the Alliance. 

Meet with those who have remained loyal to the Horde. They are to ready themselves for the battle against our enemies.

And as for Eitrigg... bring him to Nathanos. A quick death is too lenient a punishment for his treachery.

Go, <name>. Let us end this.

passages.title: Leaders of the Horde
passages.text: There is no honor in this battle, <name>.

passages.title: Leaders of the Horde
passages.text: So be it. Our choices have been made.

passages.title: Wounded Wastewanderers
passages.text:
Ahh, my friend, have you returned to render additional aid?

As you can see, we are still locked in battle with these creatures, with no end to their numbers in sight.

This is a war of attrition and we find ourselves at a clear disadvantage as injuries continue to mount.

Please, assist any of our wounded that you find within the ruins.

passages.title: Wounded Wastewanderers
passages.text: Do you require additional bandages?

passages.title: Wounded Wastewanderers
passages.text: Your help is greatly appreciated, my friend.

passages.title: Crown of Courage
passages.text:
I see you are a fan of pink flowers. It is a shame those that make up your crown will one day come to perish.

Perhaps I can help with that.

Though those are ordinary blossoms, I know similar flowers that bloom only during Lunar Festival. If you retrieve them for me, I can imbue them with Elune's power so that you may enjoy them throughout the year.

passages.title: Crown of Courage
passages.text: Not all flowers are equal. Those that bloom during Lunar Festival have a special bond with Elune.

passages.title: Crown of Courage
passages.text:
Such beautiful flowers! I can feel Elune's might within them.

This crown shall bring you great courage.

passages.title: Crown of Dark Blossoms
passages.text:
Such somber flowers... but they hold a beauty of their own, don't you think? If only they could last.

Allow me to lend my aid.

Every Lunar Festival, similar flowers to yours bloom around the world. They hold a special connection to Elune... one that I can empower. If you bring them to me, I can preserve them so you may enjoy them long after an ordinary flower would die.

passages.title: Crown of Dark Blossoms
passages.text: The flowers that bloom during Lunar Festival have special properties. I believe it is Elune's light watching over them.

passages.title: Crown of Dark Blossoms
passages.text:
Ah, what calming flowers. I sense a solemn peace emanating from them.

This crown shall support you with a silent grace.

passages.title: Paint Bottle: Nukular Red
passages.text: <Kram Kelada could make use of this item.>

passages.title: Paint Bottle: Nukular Red
passages.text: Good color choice!

passages.title: Paint Bottle: Goblin Green
passages.text: <Kram Kelada could make use of this item.>

passages.title: Paint Bottle: Goblin Green
passages.text: Good color choice!

passages.title: Paint Bottle: Electric Blue
passages.text: <Kram Kelada could make use of this item.>

passages.title: Paint Bottle: Electric Blue
passages.text: Good color choice!

passages.title: Saving the Siege
passages.text:
In the chaos of the rockslides, Sylvanas dispatched her saboteurs to sneak past our sentries and plant bombs on our siege weaponry. 

Several of them have already been lost. We cannot afford to lose more.

passages.title: Saving the Siege
passages.text: Our people are tired and our resources are dwindling. We need every weapon and soldier at our disposal if we are to take the city.

passages.title: Already Among Us
passages.text:
While some of the Horde have joined forces with us, many within Orgrimmar remain loyal to Sylvanas. Her saboteurs have infiltrated our ranks and are posing as our technicians. Her assassins are lurking in the shadows.

Stop any loyalists you encounter, before they can cause any harm.

passages.title: Already Among Us
passages.text: I wish this bloodshed wasn't necessary.

passages.title: Strategic Deployment
passages.text:
Saurfang maintains that the key to taking Orgrimmar is to exploit its multiple points of entry. He led the city's defenses for years, and knows its vulnerabilities better than anyone. We are spread thin as it is, but I trust his judgment in this matter.

We must also fortify Thunder Bluff in case Sylvanas plans to assault it while our forces are committed here.

Deliver these deployment orders to our officers. We will assail all of Orgrimmar's gates at once while also defending Thunder Bluff.

passages.title: Strategic Deployment
passages.text: Our forces are in place. All that is left is to begin the battle.

passages.title: Before the Gates of Orgrimmar
passages.text:
We have prepared for this battle as best we can, adventurer.

I pray that we all survive what is to come.

passages.title: Before the Gates of Orgrimmar
passages.text:
Saurfang... he gave his life so our soldiers wouldn't lose theirs.

None of us anticipated he would challenge Sylvanas directly. But perhaps she did.

<Jaina shakes her head.> 

It does us no good to debate whether this was part of her plan or if she merely took advantage of an opportunity. We must be on our guard against her schemes.

Saurfang won his final battle. I do not know what will become of the Horde, but I have hope that they will find a new path to follow.

passages.title: The Price of Victory
passages.text:
Saurfang... how could this have happened....

<Jaina takes a moment to compose herself.>

The Alliance has known High Overlord Saurfang as both a sworn enemy and an invaluable ally.

Anduin will want to honor his memory. Recall our forces and inform them of what has happened. Genn's soldiers were dispatched to the western gate. You should be able to find him there.

passages.title: The Price of Victory
passages.text: He died a warrior's death, as he always wanted. I suppose there is some comfort in that.

passages.title: The Price of Victory
passages.text: Many have lost their lives to this war. Let us hope Saurfang is the last.

passages.title: Old Soldier
passages.text:
No matter what doubts he harbored, Saurfang was an honorable soldier. 

He prevented both a civil war within the Horde and the potential destruction of the Alliance. He brought an end to Sylvanas's reign and saved many lives at the cost of his own. 

We shall honor his sacrifice.

passages.title: Old Soldier
passages.text: Thank you for coming.

passages.title: Old Soldier
passages.text:
We continue to fall into old habits of mistrust and suspicion. Of hatred and war... 

And yet, we also find ourselves banding together and rising against the forces that would destroy our world.

I pray that the day will come when we break the cycle for good.

passages.title: Create Your Own Strength
passages.text:
For something that has been sitting on the ocean floor, there is still power to be found in this item.

Take your piece of Benthic armor to Voidbinder Zorlan. He has been eyeing it with great curiosity.

Go ahead and humor the ethereal and let him have a look.

Maybe he has something to offer.

passages.title: Create Your Own Strength
passages.text:
Ancient elven magic and the ocean infusing things with her own power...

I would like to say I'm surprised, but I'm really not.

It's a good thing you brought those shiny fellows to help sort it all out.

passages.title: Create Your Own Strength
passages.text:
That Benthic armor you carry has been lost beneath the tides for too long.

There is still power within it.

Voidbinder Sturzah may be able to provide insight.

Take your find to our intrepid ethereal friend, and see what he can do with it.

passages.title: Create Your Own Strength
passages.text: Were you successful?

passages.title: Create Your Own Strength
passages.text:
There is bond formed between the ocean and what comes to rest beneath its waves.

The glowing man will be able to use the Prismatic Manapearls to improve the Benthic items.

This will prove most beneficial.

passages.title: Becoming a Friend
passages.text:
Some of our bravest kelfin have volunteered to join you on your adventures, should you ever need a friend.

You will find they each have their own special interests and they will mark your map with different opportunities every day.

Use the conch when you're ready, choose who you would like to join you, and explore Nazjatar!

Choose wisely! You may only select one friend per day.

passages.title: Becoming a Friend
passages.text:
It is good to have you here, <name>.

That was masterfully handled. You have made the Unshackled excited and hopeful. 

I really couldn't ask for more.

passages.title: Fame Waits for Gnome One
passages.text:
Tinkmaster Overspark requests your assistance on an important research expedition. 

Working with the esteemed Tinkmaster will certainly be of benefit to your career. It's done wonders for mine!

passages.title: Fame Waits for Gnome One
passages.text: Now we can begin the expedition.

passages.title: Rumors of Mechagon
passages.text:
I knew I should've taken that gig with the Greasemonkeys...

Gazlowe's crew always get paid, and no dumb risks. I heard they got somethin' big comin' up too...

passages.title: Rumors of Mechagon
passages.text: Well, ain't this a pleasant surprise.

passages.title: Old Friends, New Opportunities
passages.text:
Greetings, <name>. I have a... strange message for you from a group of goblins.

Someone named Sassy Hardwrench is asking for your help for what was described as a, "big job". 

The word "big" was mentioned several times, followed by murmuring about time and money. 

Sassy is waiting for you over in Stranglethorn Vale.

passages.title: Old Friends, New Opportunities
passages.text:
<Sassy gasps loudly.>

Look at what the cat dragged in! Do you know how long we've been looking for you?

passages.title: A Special Delivery
passages.text:
I'm glad you're finally here, <name>. I've got an important delivery to make and you're the goblin I trust most.

Yeah, yeah. I know that's not sayin' much, but it's hard to find good help these days!

This package is for Hobart Grapplehammer. He's got a workshop in Crapopolis and I need you to deliver it to him. He's been working on somethin' big lately!

Deliver the package and for the love of money... DON'T DROP IT!

You have no idea how long it took me to locate this thing!

passages.title: A Special Delivery
passages.text:
Gallywix sure has some nerve threatening me in my own laboratory!

He thinks he can just do whatever he wants to whoever he wants...

passages.title: A Special Delivery
passages.text:
Sassy Hardwrench asked you to deliver this package?

Ah! These must be the parts I ordered last month. I can finally begin the final round of testing on my latest invention!

passages.title: A Simple Experiment
passages.text:
Now that you've delivered the necessary parts, I can begin testing my latest prototype!

I call it the X-52 Personnel Armor! It will be nearly indestructible!

Gallywix has always coveted my inventions and now that he knows about the X-52 I'm sure he'll be up to no good. I've gotta complete the prototype before Gallywix comes up with a way to steal it out from under me!

I could really use an extra set of hands with the experiments.

Can I count on you, <name>?

passages.title: A Simple Experiment
passages.text: We need to complete the X-52 Personnel Armor before Gallywix finds a way to steal the prototype!

passages.title: A Simple Experiment
passages.text: Good work, <name>! The experiments were mostly successful! However, it does look like we'll need to find a new lab assistant for the explosives testing...

passages.title: Shopping For Parts
passages.text:
I'm going to need some additional components in order to complete the next phase of testing.

Right now, what we need most are thermoplugs and thermoplug adaptors! I'll explain what they're for later...

Crank Greasefuse runs a shop near the entrance of the town. Go speak with Crank and get him to fork over the necessary parts.

I don't care what they cost, just tell him to bill me later! I can't be bothered to negotiate right now. I need to prepare the modifications to the X-52 Personnel Armor!

passages.title: Shopping For Parts
passages.text: Thermoplugs, eh? Yeah I got some more here... but they ain't cheap!

passages.title: Debt Collection!
passages.text:
You need thermoplugs? Well, you came to the right place, kid.

But I ain't giving 'em to you on credit. There's way too many shlubs who haven't paid me back the money they owe. I'm in over my head here, if I don't get paid fast, I'll be out of business in no time.

<Crank Greasefuse thinks for a moment.>

Look, I tell you what... If you can muscle those no-good goons into paying me my money, I'll give you the thermoplugs as payment.

You won't find a better deal than that!

passages.title: Debt Collection!
passages.text: You got my money?

passages.title: Debt Collection!
passages.text:
<Crank Greasefuse takes a moment to count the money.>

It's all here! Good work, kid! The thermoplugs are all yours. Send my regards to Grapplehammer and tell him to name one of his inventions after me!

passages.title: I've Got What You Need
passages.text:
A deal's a deal, <name>. Here's the thermoplugs you ordered!

Be sure to let that ol' grouch Grapplehammer know that I won't be giving out anymore handouts. If he needs more thermoplugs he'd better be ready to pay up.

Anyway, it was a pleasure doing business with you...

Now get lost!

passages.title: I've Got What You Need
passages.text:
Yes! These are exactly what I need to finish the landmines for the upcoming experiment...

Oh, I didn't mention landmines?

I thought I did... oh well! I'll explain everything later! It'll be fine!

passages.title: Blunt Force Testing
passages.text:
Now that we have the thermoplugs we're ready for our next test of the prototype X-52 Personnel Armor!

Unfortunately, my lab assistants have either quit or expired. What a pity! But their loss is your gain, <name>... now YOU get to wear the X-52 Personnel Armor!

How exciting!

The next test will be conducted by my new mechanized lab assistant. Head over to the main workshop and press the big red button to begin.

Don't worry, I'll be giving you directions over the X-52's built in intercom!

passages.title: Blunt Force Testing
passages.text: Everything depends on this experiment!

passages.title: Blunt Force Testing
passages.text:
<Hobart Grapplehammer examines you closely.>

This is fantastic! You're currently suffering a moderate amount of internal bleeding, but the prototype X-52 Personnel Armor performed just as I predicted under extreme levels of repeated blunt force.

The X-52 doesn't have a scratch on it!

passages.title: Fun With Landmines
passages.text:
The prototype X-52 Personnel Armor is ready for the final test! 

How are you with loud noises and sudden bursts of concussive energy, <name>?

For the final test, we're going to strap you into the X-52 Personnel Armor and have you traverse a minefield!

I have placed a refreshing coconut beverage in the center of the minefield. Consider the drink a fitting reward for reaching the oasis and surviving the inevitable explosions in the process!

passages.title: Fun With Landmines
passages.text: Ballistic testing... IS MY FAVORITE!

passages.title: Fun With Landmines
passages.text: These goons are demolishing my workshop! We've gotta do something fast!

passages.title: Let's Rumble!
passages.text:
This is bad, <name>! Real bad!

Gallywix and his goons are destroying my workshop, but he's got another thing coming if he thinks I'm gonna hand over the X-52 Personnel Armor!

You've gotta get down there and clear out his goon squad before this place--AND ALL MY INVENTIONS--go up in flames!

passages.title: Let's Rumble!
passages.text: Hurry, <name>! Gallywix and his goons are destroying my worskshop!

passages.title: Let's Rumble!
passages.text:
Good work getting rid of Gallywix, <name>, but I've got a bad feeling about this. We need to find a buyer for the X-52 before Gallywix comes back.

Who knows what he'll try next...

passages.title: Kite Surveillance
passages.text:
We heard for ourselves that there were mogu attacking, but I had no idea it would be this many!

There must be a way to stop them before they completely overrun the Vale. Quickly, let us fly over and scout out their numbers.

We just so happen to have a kite that can carry three people. Usually it's more, but I had a big lunch.

passages.title: Kite Surveillance
passages.text:
Oh no, we went down hard. Uncle Chen can't get up! And there are mogu everywhere!

It's okay. It's fine. We'll think of something.

passages.title: Cut Off the Heads
passages.text:
Okay. We're stuck in the middle of three mogu armies, and Uncle Chen is too hurt to move yet.

It's not hopeless though. We have the chance to take out the leaders of these armies. Maybe that will slow them down or distract them long enough for us to get back to the gate!

See if you can get out there and take down the biggest, baddest mogu you can find. Those will be the commanders.

passages.title: Cut Off the Heads
passages.text: Good job. The mogu are not as strong without their leaders.

passages.title: Mogu Massacre
passages.text:
I think this is what my friends would call a "target rich environment." As a nicer way of saying "we're surrounded and probably doomed."

You know what this means. We have to kill as many of these mogu as possible! It doesn't matter how you do it, just take them out!

passages.title: Mogu Massacre
passages.text: That's a lot of mogu down. Hopefully that will thin their ranks enough for us to get out of here.

passages.title: No Brew Left Behind
passages.text:
My head is... hurting. There can be only one solution.

We flew over an abandoned brew caravan. You must go find it, and save that brew! That should help bring me back to full strength.

Plus, it would do wonders for the morale of those fighting in the Vale, if we can recover it.

passages.title: No Brew Left Behind
passages.text:
<These must be the brew barrels Chen spotted when flying over.

They are too heavy to carry on your own.>

passages.title: Yak of All Trades
passages.text:
<The brew barrels are too heavy and numerous to carry alone.

Perhaps you can find something, or someone, to help you.>

passages.title: Yak of All Trades
passages.text:
What is this? You found a yak?

And what's more, you found brew!

passages.title: Our Backs to the Gate
passages.text:
It is most fortuitous that you found this brew, and a yak to carry it on!

But we cannot remain here. Li Li has healed me up enough to travel. We can ride the yak back to the gate and hope that the mogu do not notice our passing.

Let me know when you are ready to leave.

passages.title: Our Backs to the Gate
passages.text: We got through! Now, what are we going to do about all those mogu?

passages.title: Liquid Courage
passages.text:
We have to do something about all these mogu. At least to thin their ranks before they invade the Vale!

As much as Uncle Chen loves his brew, I think we can put it to better use. Let's hop onto that yak and give the mogu something to fear!

passages.title: Liquid Courage
passages.text: Something must be done about all these mogu, or we will lose the Vale.

passages.title: Liquid Courage
passages.text:
All that lovely brew... gone.

But let us look on the bright side. There are fewer mogu to contend with now. It is time for us to report back.

passages.title: Buyers Wanted!
passages.text:
The X-52 Personnel Armor is finally complete and Gallywix has been sent packing with his tail between his legs!

I've got you to thank for this, <name>!

But we're still not done... the best part is yet to come. We're going to hold an auction and sell the X-52 Personnel Armor to the highest bidder!

Sassy Hardwrench should have a list of interested buyers ready to go. Head over to Hardwrench Hideaway and let her know we're ready for the auction!

passages.title: Buyers Wanted!
passages.text: So the invention is complete, huh? Good work, kiddo! We'll be rolling in moolah in no time!

passages.title: The VIP List
passages.text:
While you've been assisting Grapplehammer with his newest invention, I've been hard at work finding potential buyers!

This is going to be a private auction, so we're only inviting the best and the brightest, the cream of the crop, the creme de la creme... got it?

I've narrowed the potential buyers down to an 'A' list of only the wealthiest, classiest, most connected goblins around... minus Gallywix, of course!

Head out and deliver these invitations while I finish up preparations for the auction!

passages.title: The VIP List
passages.text: This will be an 'A' list event. Only Kezan's finest will be in attendance!

passages.title: The VIP List
passages.text:
You delivered the invitations? Good! We're going to need all the help we can get... I've got some bad news for you!

Did I say bad news? I meant REALLY bad news!

passages.title: Beat The Crapopolis Outta Him!
passages.text:
Boy am I glad to see you! We've got a bad situation on our hands...

While you were away delivering the invitations, Gallywix and his goons took over Crapopolis! They're holding Hobart Grapplehammer hostage until he hands over the X-52 Personnel Armor!

You have to stop Gallywix before it's too late!

passages.title: Beat The Crapopolis Outta Him!
passages.text: The X-52 Personnel Armor is ruined beyond repair... but at least Crapopolis is saved and Gallywix finally got what he deserves!

passages.title: Saving the Siege
passages.text:
The Banshee's spies were able to sneak past our guards in the chaos of the rockslides. They've been planting bombs on our siege weaponry.

Get rid of those bombs.

passages.title: Saving the Siege
passages.text: Well done. We cannot afford to lose any more of our weaponry to Sylvanas's treachery.

passages.title: Already Among Us
passages.text:
Sylvanas still commands the loyalty of many within the Horde. The war she started has blinded them with rage and hatred. She exploits that to maintain her support.

<Saurfang scowls.>

They do not yet see she will lead us to ruin, that her so-called victories are all hollow.

Some of her agents have been spotted lurking within our ranks. Kill them. They will show us no mercy, and will have none in return.

passages.title: Already Among Us
passages.text: We both have blood on our hands. Today, we will see that it has not been in vain.

passages.title: Strategic Deployment
passages.text:
For years, I guarded the gates of Orgrimmar. The city's greatest weakness has always been its multiple entrances. We should strike at all of them to seize victory.

Wrynn and I have drawn up orders for deployment. The mages will cover our flank. Greymane will close in from the west, and the elves will take the north. We will send Mayla to reinforce Thunder Bluff's defenses in case Sylvanas launches a counterattack.

Bring the orders to our commanders.

passages.title: Strategic Deployment
passages.text: No matter what our strategy, taking Orgrimmar will be no easy task. I should know.

passages.title: Before the Gates of Orgrimmar
passages.text:
It is time.

We have done all that we can to prepare. All that remains is the battle itself.

I am not one for speeches. So I will say only this.

Lok-tar ogar, <name>. Victory. Or death.

passages.title: Before the Gates of Orgrimmar
passages.text:
Saurfang... slain by dark magic... 

I have known Sylvanas for years, yet I have never seen her wield such power. Why reveal it to us now? What does she gain by abandoning the Horde?

<Lor'themar's eye narrows.>

Whatever she has planned, it would seem that she no longer requires the Horde to achieve it. We will need to be cautious, <name>. There is no telling what her next move will be.

passages.title: The Price of Victory
passages.text:
Saurfang... I...

<Lor'themar takes a moment to compose himself.>

...Thrall will wish to honor Saurfang's sacrifice. And so shall the rest of us.

Recall our forces. Let them know what has transpired. Tell them that the great warrior Varok Saurfang is dead and that the warchief has abandoned us.

Speak to Baine when you arrive in Thunder Bluff. You will find him on the Elder Rise. I am certain he will want to pay his respects to Saurfang as well. 

Let us stand as a united Horde once more.

passages.title: The Price of Victory
passages.text: He earned the warrior's death he always sought. There is honor in that.

passages.title: The Price of Victory
passages.text: Saurfang's death will not be in vain.

passages.title: Old Soldier
passages.text:
No matter what anyone says, he was an honorable orc. A legend in his own right, the ideal to which all warriors of the Horde aspired. 

He gave his life to heal the rift in the Horde and give us the chance to forge a new path forward. His was more than a death befitting a warrior. It was the death of a hero.

We shall honor his sacrifice.

passages.title: Old Soldier
passages.text:
He will be buried in Nagrand, as he would have wanted.

I do not know what lies ahead for the Horde, but I know we will face it together.

passages.title: ...And Following Seas
passages.text:
My brother Derek died in the Second War, only to be raised against his will by the Banshee Queen. If not for Baine Bloodhoof's courageous act of defiance, Derek would have been turned into a weapon against my family.

He's lived in torment since his awakening. I feared he would be lost to us, but he has received help from an old friend of mine who has also been recently raised--Calia Menethil. She has guided him back from the brink of despair.

I am on my way to pay them a visit. Care to join me?

passages.title: ...And Following Seas
passages.text:
Welcome. It's nice to have company.

Ah, Jaina has arrived.

passages.title: Traitors In Our Midst
passages.text: There is a difference between loyalty and blind obedience. I am done following the Banshee's orders!

passages.title: Traitors In Our Midst
passages.text:
The warchief has long suspected that this traitor lacks the necessary resolve.

You, on the other hand... You understand.

passages.title: Not My Warchief
passages.text:
There is little time. Sylvanas likely knows of my intentions and sent you to deal with me accordingly. I doubt she will be pleased with your decision.

We must make our way to the wyverns and take to the skies.

passages.title: Not My Warchief
passages.text:
Eitrigg told me of your escape from Orgrimmar. There may still be other dissenters within the city who are unable to leave such as you did.

All we can do for them now is end this battle before Sylvanas makes them suffer.

passages.title: Siegebreakers
passages.text:
The fools who follow Saurfang have grown bold enough to launch a direct assault. We cannot allow these pests to swarm before our gates.

Our operatives are collapsing the pass between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar as we speak. Saurfang's treasonous forces will be cut in half.

Your task is to sneak into their ranks and sabotage their siege engines. Wear this disguise, but know that it will not hold up under close examination. Slay anyone who discovers you.

passages.title: Siegebreakers
passages.text:
I weep for them. The fools.

<Nathanos smirks.>

passages.title: Propaganda Takedown
passages.text:
Recently, dissidents have been posting propaganda around the city and spreading all manner of lies.

This is no time to entertain delusion. An army of traitors and sworn enemies assembles at our gates. These ingrates would see us become pin cushions for the Alliance's archers.

<Nathanos rolls his eyes.>

Tear down the rubbish. It can only lead to panic in the streets. 

And should you encounter any... resistance... you are hereby authorized to respond with force.

passages.title: Propaganda Takedown
passages.text: Well done. I expect you faced little resistance of note.

passages.title: Militia
passages.text:
The war has proven costly and our ranks have been steadily depleted. But the Horde is nothing if not strong. Each and every citizen of Orgrimmar is worth ten Alliance weaklings on the battlefield.

Rally the citizens and form a militia! Remind them of their slain brothers and sisters!

passages.title: Militia
passages.text: Our armies swell while those of our enemies wither away.

passages.title: A Line in the Sand
passages.text:
Now that we have put our house in order, it is time to purge the filth before our gates.

How thoughtful of those traitors to gather themselves in one place, so that we may slay them all in one fell swoop.

Let us end this pitiful rebellion.

passages.title: A Line in the Sand
passages.text: I have orders for you from the Dark Lady. She instructed me to deliver them on her behalf, should things play out this way.

passages.title: Most Loyal
passages.text:
The Dark Lady anticipated this as a possible outcome. She has prepared a contingency plan to deal with it accordingly.

You are to rendezvous with her in the Ghostlands. Take this hearthstone. It is good for one more use. 

She will meet you near Windrunner Spire.

passages.title: Most Loyal
passages.text: You will be remembered for your loyal service.

passages.title: Blinding the Eye
passages.text:
Ah yes, just the <class> I wanted to see.

I can still sense his touch lingering upon you. Our victory over the god of the deep will not be complete until we remove all traces of his infection.

Through my research I have learned a less painful way of removing the infection.

Speak with me, and let's put an end to this nightmare.

passages.title: Assault: The Black Empire
passages.text:
It is just as the visions fortold. Dark forces have come to claim the Forge of Origination.

They must be stopped, or all of Azeroth will meet its end!

passages.title: Assault: The Black Empire
passages.text: The madness... it consumes!

passages.title: Assault: The Black Empire
passages.text:
The voices have stopped. The visions show me the dawn.

We will survive this day, thanks to you.

passages.title: Sense of Obligation
passages.text:
Derek is free. I have to atone for much with him.

There is a rumor of a meeting with Jaina and her brother.

Head to Seabreeze Village in Stormsong Valley. I hope there you will be able to find out... well, let's just say I am trying to keep the bigger picture in focus.

If you find out anything of interest, I would be most appreciative.

For now, let's keep this between the two of us.

passages.title: Sense of Obligation
passages.text:
Well, that is interesting...

I must act quickly.

passages.title: Re-Origination
passages.text:
If the Ramkahen haven't reached out tae sound any alarms then the anomaly must be contained within the Halls of Origination.

We best get back tae investigate, <name>.

passages.title: Re-Origination
passages.text: We won't be findin' any answers out here.

passages.title: Investigating the Halls
passages.text:
Whatever's happenin' has tae be comin' from deep within the inner chamber. If we can get tae the forge maybe we'll find some answers.

Best check yer gear 'fore headin' in, <name>. Who knows what's waitin' fer us in there.

passages.title: Investigating the Halls
passages.text:
If N'Zoth were to gain access to the forge and leverage its power the results would be... catastrophic.

I'm afraid we're short on time, <name>. If you're going to continue these investigations, you'll need protection.

And I know just the place.

passages.title: A Timely Invitation
passages.text:
The time has arrived to remember the past and celebrate our adventures across Azeroth and Beyond. 

To commemorate the occasion the Bronze Dragonflight is throwing a celebration and you are invited! 

Come to the Caverns of Time and present this ticket to gain entry to the party!

passages.title: A Timely Invitation
passages.text:
Welcome! It's that special time of year when the bronze dragonflight celebrates all that has happened over the years and you, <name>, are the guest of honor!
Come celebrate at the grand feast, get down at the "Disco of Time", or accept a quest to fend off some of Azeroth's greatest threats.

passages.title: Something in Your Mind
passages.text:
<Looking into the crystal, the light around you is slowly drowned in inky smoke. An imposing presence crushes down on you, whispering unintelligibly in your ear. Looking for the source, you see nothing, but the sensation grows. Your head begins to swim as the darkness deepens and the noise becomes deafening.

Summoning all your willpower to steel your resolve...

The light has returned, the noise silenced, and you stand with a humble crystal in your hand.

Perhaps Wrathion knows more about it...>

passages.title: Something in Your Mind
passages.text:
<Wrathion's brow furrows when he sees the crystal.>

It is fortunate you brought this to me. Impressive that you were able to handle it while retaining your sanity. In fact... this may provide us with an opportunity.

<Wrathion strokes his chin, lost in thought.>

I will not mince words, <name>. This will certainly prove dangerous. However, I have full confidence that you are up to the task. Now, let us wield N'Zoth's own power against him.

passages.title: How Things "Really" Happened...
passages.text:
You've come a long way over the years, <name>.

From humble beginnings doing odd jobs to saving Azeroth's very existence, you've done so much to ensure the safety of our world.

But why should we just stand around trying to remember things? Let's just go back in time and relive all of the exciting bits again! 

Don't worry, in all of the millions upon millions of timeways I'm sure I'll find one where you never die.

passages.title: How Things "Really" Happened...
passages.text: Hey, did we win yet? Or have we begun? I'm maybe not yet sure. Keeping the timelines straight gets a bit difficult.

passages.title: How Things "Really" Happened...
passages.text:
Yay! Wasn't that fun? And absolutely NOTHING bad happened to you, ever!

<Chromie gives you a playful wink.>

passages.title: Sail With the Tide
passages.text:
Hello, adventurer.

I have received word from Calia asking that we meet with her once again. 

She has so much to offer those who feel lost, those seeking a better way. Once she is free of doubt, she will know what must be done.

Will you join me?

passages.title: Sail With the Tide
passages.text: My death seems to have given me a new purpose.

passages.title: The Hidden Need
passages.text:
Because of Sylvanas, some members of the Horde are skeptical of the Forsaken. We must regain their trust. 

We cannot do that without accepting ourselves. So many feel lost, alone... abandoned.

I have arranged a meeting. It could be a big step... or all go horribly wrong. Either way, you should bear witness.

Meet me in Tirisfal Glades, at the Calston Estate.

passages.title: The Hidden Need
passages.text: Calia Menethil and Derek Proudmoore have come a long way to speak with us. Let's not keep them waiting any longer.

passages.title: New Allies Among Us
passages.text:
Even in times of peace, the Horde is not without its problems. 

Although they can be overwhelming at times, our struggles should never stop us from remembering what it means to be a part of the Horde. 

We don't turn people away when times get tough; we band together and endure. 

For a moment I forgot this. Burdened by the troubles facing our new allies, I hastily dismissed the vulpera. 

My only hope is that they still see as much value in the Horde as I see in them.

passages.title: New Allies Among Us
passages.text:
Vulpera within the Horde. A practical partnership, don't you agree? One that would not have been possible without your help. 

Thanks to you, <name>, we now have a home beyond the dunes.

passages.title: Waning Energy
passages.text:
Mekkatorque's pod is powering down. 

We are no longer able to hear him speak. 

His pulse has slowed, in spite of the best efforts of Kul Tiran healers.

I have an idea, but I am going to need your help.

Meet me at Proudmoore Keep. We must go soon.

passages.title: Waning Energy
passages.text:
What we're about to do may not be... uh... an approved plan. 

We will just ask for forgiveness later.

passages.title: Someone Who Can Help
passages.text:
I believe there is a way to help Mekkatorque, but some may not be a hundred percent on board... 

The mechagnomes have advanced techniques in biomechanical repair and improvements.

If there is even a chance they can help him, we have to try! There are some mechagnomes sending supplies out to the island from a dock in Hook Point. No one will notice one more piece of cargo. We need to reroute one of their homing copters.

Will you please help me get Mekkatorque's Pod to Mechagon?

passages.title: Someone Who Can Help
passages.text: How can I help?

passages.title: Someone Who Can Help
passages.text: It would be my pleasure to give aid to the most esteemed High Tinker Mekkatorque!

passages.title: The Current Schematic
passages.text:
I think I can modify one of our existing devices to give us access to Gelbin Mekkatorque without disturbing his life preserving functions.

There are some items I will need you to procure. 

From the nearby vector of the Heaps, you will find scrapbots and scraphounds. These would be a fine source of spare parts for my construction project.

The Outflow is home to some particularly slimy friends. From them, you will find excellent ingredients for the heat resistant lubricant we need.

passages.title: The Current Schematic
passages.text: Were all assets found?

passages.title: The Current Schematic
passages.text:
Yes, yes, these will do.

Excellent work, <name>!

passages.title: Voyage to Safety
passages.text:
One of our defenders saw the troggs take out the homing copter carrying Mekkatorque's pod. 

Since we started bringing goods in from Tiragarde, they have been a real thorn in our side. 

Piston, a very promising young inventor, has a vehicle able to handle this task. Meet his crew down in Bondo's yard.

Please hurry and retrieve the pod! I am not sure what will happen to Gelbin, if they break it open.

Ahem, we would not be upset if you did a little beach clean-up while you were there...

passages.title: Voyage to Safety
passages.text: Did everyone make it back in one piece?

passages.title: Voyage to Safety
passages.text: I hope the poor guy didn't get shaken around too much in there.

passages.title: Him?
passages.text:
Speak to some of the gnomes in Mechagon, enhanced or otherwise. Of my people, ask what they hope for in a leader of our kind. Of our new friends, ask what they appreciate most about their current leader.

From what I have learned thus far, the High Tinker has always led his people by necessity, he never sought or desired the crown. I believe the gnomes should be united once again. 

I seek a solution that will be most amenable to all. Will you gather the information I need?

passages.title: Him?
passages.text: Have your communications been productive?

passages.title: Him?
passages.text: Excellent, excellent, these are the results I was hoping for. You have strengthened my theory.

passages.title: Mental Attunement
passages.text:
We now have a baseline of who Mekkatorque is, looks like there could be some room for improvement. 

Your assistance is needed to get him stabilized and synchronized before removing him from his pod.

Please position yourself by the Synchroscope. I will make adjustments, you will need to fire the machine when I call.

passages.title: Mental Attunement
passages.text: Did you successfully push the button?

passages.title: Mental Attunement
passages.text:
Your button pushing skills are commendable. 

We are fortunate you were here.

passages.title: A Strong Heart
passages.text:
We saw a flare near Junkwatt Depot. 

The retrieval team has made it out with the power source. We are now forever safe from King Mechagon's Annihilo-tron, its heart will serve a new purpose.

This is great news!

However, the flare means they have company. Your help will be needed to extricate the team and retrieve the Spark Reactor.

Please move with haste, we are so close to completion.

passages.title: A Strong Heart
passages.text: Are you ready?

passages.title: A Strong Heart
passages.text:
I am quite pleased.

With a 40% chance of success, I was not sure the variables would reconcile in our favor.

It was a serendipitous sequence of events.

passages.title: The Future of Mechagon
passages.text:
Now that Mechagon City has been cleared of its remaining dangers, it may once again be a place of peace and prosperity for gnomes and mechagnomes alike.

It is time for me to speak with Prince Erazmin regarding the future of our peoples. It is my sincere hope that we will forge an alliance that will last for generations to come!

When you are ready, please join us at the High Tinkertory for a special address.

passages.title: The Future of Mechagon
passages.text: When you are ready, please join us at the High Tinkertory for a special address.

passages.title: The Future of Mechagon
passages.text: This has truly been a glorious day for both gnomes and mechagnomes! We could not have done it without you, <name>!

passages.title: Ascension
passages.text:
After everything the mechagnomes have done for us today, it is our duty to return the favor.

Let us clear out the rogue creations that remain in Mechagon. 

With their home returned, Prince Erazmin and his people will have a brilliant path forward.

With this team, we will make short work of the remaining King Mechagon loyalists.

Let me know when you are ready to roll out!

passages.title: Ascension
passages.text:
That was exciting! 

The world just got a little bigger, my friend!

passages.title: Propagate the News
passages.text:
We wanted to save a life and we have accomplished so much more!

We really couldn't have done it without you, <name>. I am so excited about the future of all gnomekind.

Head back to Stormwind and share the good news!

passages.title: Propagate the News
passages.text:
Outstanding results, <name>! 

I will share your news with the leaders of the Alliance.

I look forward to collecting some new toys...

passages.title: The Eternal Traveler
passages.text:
Hail, mortal.

For untold ages, my kind has traversed the myriad realms of reality. We have beheld phenomena that you cannot begin to comprehend. But there is much you must learn of what awaits you on the horizon.

The power of Death is on the rise. The veil weakens between your world and the Shadowlands.

When a mortal life expires, an echo of it remains behind. The most powerful mortals leave the most resonant echoes.

Bring these to me, that I might study them... to both our benefits.

passages.title: The Eternal Traveler
passages.text: One can glean so much knowledge from the mortal realm.

passages.title: The Eternal Traveler
passages.text: Mortal lives are so fragile... and yet, any one of them can alter the fabric of reality.

passages.title: Tracking Quest
Word from Orsis
passages.text:
As you can see, <name>, we have our hands full here dealing with these disgusting bugs.

Our caravans from the south have stopped arriving and we have received disturbing news from the few who've made it back recently.

I've sent a patrol toward Orsis to investigate; they are past due for a report back.

Can I ask you to check in on them for me?

passages.title: Word from Orsis
passages.text: If the sun didn't take me, the bugs surely would have. Thank you <name>.

passages.title: Search for Survivors
passages.text:
The bugs came from everywhere... There wasn't any time to react.

Many of my friends died where they stood, while others tried to fight with our meager tools.

I'm a coward. I fled in the commotion instead of trying to help.

Now, here I am, out of food and water and too scared to look for survivors.

Please, I beg you to help anyone you find left alive in Orsis...

passages.title: Search for Survivors
passages.text: I am in no shape to face those creatures right now. I appreciate your help <name>.

passages.title: Burn the Bodies
passages.text:
The bugs seem to be indiscriminately laying eggs all over the nearby corpses.

They are using them as food to spawn more of those horrible things. Disgusting!

We can mourn the dead later, but if any more bugs are allowed to hatch we may not live long enough to do so.

Burn the bodies and destroy those eggs!

passages.title: Burn the Bodies
passages.text: Grisly work to be sure, but we were left with no choice. Thank you <name>.

passages.title: To Ankhaten Harbor
passages.text:
I fear that I don't yet have the strength to ride out into the sands and face those monsters again.

Ride to the south and find Tracker Samara in the excavation camp formerly known as Schnottz's Landing.

Tell her to halt any caravans that plan to pass this way, lest others are ambushed and met with the same grisly fate.

We must get the word out across Uldum before our forces are further divided!

passages.title: To Ankhaten Harbor
passages.text: Orsis is lost you say!? This is truly worse than I feared.

passages.title: Wastewander Hosts
passages.text:
The bugs have been laying eggs in the corpses of our soldiers, it's absolutely terrifying!

Some of them are rising from the ground as putrid, bloated, hideous monstrosities.

We have to stop them before they continue to bolster their ranks with our fallen.

It's not a pleasant task... but I have to ask you to help me destroy them. Completely.

Grab some bombs behind me, if you'd like.

passages.title: Wastewander Hosts
passages.text: Blech. I can clearly see that you killed them all, thank you for bringing back that truly awful smell.

passages.title: Heroic Warfront: The Battle for Darkshore
passages.text:
Darkshore belongs to the Horde! We must hold that ground to maintain our dominance over Kalimdor.

Prepare yourselves. Battle awaits!

passages.title: Heroic Warfront: The Battle for Darkshore
passages.text: Well fought, <name>, though I'm sure it won't be long before the Alliance try to reclaim Darkshore. When they do, we will be ready to fight!

passages.title: Heroic Warfront: The Battle for Darkshore
passages.text:
We will not tolerate further Horde aggression in our territories.

The night elves will not stand alone this day. Darkshore will be theirs once more.

For the Alliance!

passages.title: Heroic Warfront: The Battle for Darkshore
passages.text:
The day is ours thanks to you, but this war is far from over.

For the Alliance!

passages.title: The Wastewandering Dead
passages.text:
Is there no end to these foul monsters!?

I cannot abide the desecration of our dead, especially not as fodder for this disgusting insect army.

Destroy as many as you can, preferably with fire!

passages.title: The Wastewandering Dead
passages.text: I hope you've been keeping count of your kills.

passages.title: The Wastewandering Dead
passages.text: There is just no end to them...

passages.title: Tend the Wounded
passages.text:
My friend, as you can see here, we are besieged by these terrible creatures.

Many of our comrades have fallen prey to the monsters, but fortunately, we have enough warriors here to keep the threat at bay... for now.

If you are able to assist us, please, tend to our wounded and help clear a path for them to escape the ruins.

passages.title: Tend the Wounded
passages.text: You are a true hero, my friend.

passages.title: Ruinator Xok'nixx
passages.text:
Ar'kali and a group of our warriors are engaged with a most behemothic creature in the heart of the ruins.

She can hold her own against nearly any foe, but I fear it is only a matter of time before this monster is able to wear them down.

Although the creature is occupied for now, if our warriors fall, the ruins will be lost to us.

Please, make haste, with your help they can surely fell this titanic foe.

passages.title: Ruinator Xok'nixx
passages.text: You are a capable fighter. Thank you for assisting our warriors!

passages.title: Ruins of Ammon
passages.text:
These things seem to be everywhere and all at once!

Either this was an organized attack, or there are far more of them than we can even comprehend.

Regardless, this is bad for us... really, really bad.

adventurer, I need you to travel to the Ruins of Ammon and find out what the situation is like over there.

If they need help, please try to lend a hand!

passages.title: Ruins of Ammon
passages.text: Seeing you here is like stumbling across an oasis in the desert, my friend!

passages.title: Obelisk of the Sun
passages.text:
I have one more thing I must ask of you, my friend. Completion of this task is critical to our survival here.

Our comrade, Zahra, has taken it upon herself to climb the plateau just east of us to secure one of the old bombers left up there.

So far, our attempts to get word back to Arik have failed. 

However, if you can help her get one of those planes working, we might just have a chance.

Hopefully they can send aid before we are overrun...

passages.title: Obelisk of the Sun
passages.text: Old man Dyrin sent you, 'eh? Well, I'm glad to have your assistance.

passages.title: All Gassed Up
passages.text:
So, I was checkin' all these planes... and you are never gonna believe this, but none of them have any fuel in the tanks!

Saw a few canisters scattered around nearby, surely some a' them have some gas left.

Was gonna collect 'em myself, but these damned bugs came outta nowhere and started swarmin' the place.

Too many here now to deal with on my own, think you'd be able to lend a hand?

passages.title: All Gassed Up
passages.text: Yo, you got them fuel cans yet?

passages.title: All Gassed Up
passages.text: Well hot damn, you did great finding all of these!

passages.title: To the Moon
passages.text:
Alright! It's time to high tail it outta here.

We gotta get back to camp and tell Arik what's been going on out here as soon as possible.

Head for the bomber and let's fuel 'er up. 

I'll letcha have the gunner seat, but I'm drivin', so let's try to blow up a few bugs on the way back!

passages.title: To the Moon
passages.text: What in the blazing sands were you doing up there!?

passages.title: More Bits, More Bits!
passages.text:
We need more Aqir samples, adventurer. As many as you can get your hands on!

I've made some fascinating discoveries already, but there's so much more to learn.

With further study and a bit of good luck, perhaps we can slowly begin to uncover some of their weaknesses.

passages.title: More Bits, More Bits!
passages.text: Have you obtained any additional samples?

passages.title: More Bits, More Bits!
passages.text: Excellent, thank you for collecting these samples.

passages.title: Destroying the Source
passages.text:
Tidecaller Nezara is running the show. If we take her out, the remaining naga will break rank, but getting to her won't be easy. She's protected by a magical barrier that's drawing power from powercells nearby. 

If we can destroy the source, we can destroy Nezara.

passages.title: Destroying the Source
passages.text: Tidecaller Nezara can't hide behind her barrier now!

passages.title: For the Horde
passages.text:
What an adventure, <class>!

There is so much to explore... so much to discover. These are such exciting times!

We'll show our allies in the Horde the value of having some clever Vulpera around.

Please meet with the ambassador at the Orgrimmar embassy. 

I'll meet you there, <name>!

passages.title: For the Horde
passages.text:
Are you the new one? I'm supposed to welcome you.

<Blackguard lets out an exasperated sigh.>

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Hi. I'm Ambassador Blackguard.

I am honored to welcome you to Orgrimmar, <race>.

<He smiles unconvincingly.>

As a lifetime of adventure unfolds before you, be assured that... uh...

You know what? I've been saying this same greeting all day. Enough's enough.

Talk to Chromie on top of the hourglass, then talk to your emissary. Run along.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: This city is huge!

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
So many options for you!

And by you, I mean us. I bet there are some fascinating curiosities to be found...

Be careful out there!

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Welcome to Stormwind, <class>. I invite you to explore our fair city. Say, you look like someone who enjoys the night life. We have many popular taverns and a vibrant music scene! 

Ah, but that can wait, a bronze dragon has asked to talk to you. She is sitting under the nearby tree, on an hourglass of all things!

After that, an emissary of the Mechagnomes is waiting to welcome you to the city. Sounds like a busy day for you!

Have a pleasant stay, <name>!

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: So, how does Stormwind suit you?

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
You will be an excellent representative of what it means to be a <race>.

Stay shiny out there, friend.

passages.title: Urgent Care
passages.text:
Excellent timing, <name>.

Kelsey Steelspark has been sending communications to the capital cities looking for aid.

Mekkatorque's condition is quite dire and time is of the essence.

Hurry to Boralus Harbor, she will be watching for you.

passages.title: Urgent Care
passages.text: You are just in time.

passages.title: Twisted Corruptors
passages.text:
While the fleshbeasts that accompany the invading forces appear to be no more than a nuisance, they carry within themselves a deep connection to the corrupting powers of the Old Gods. 

Like a pestilence, they spread the N'Zoth's corruption wherever they tread, slowly twisting the very land to their form.

They must be eradicated.

passages.title: Twisted Corruptors
passages.text: Uldum breathes a sigh of relief with each twisted manifestation of N'Zoth slain.

passages.title: Far From Home
passages.text:
The Amathet's conquest of eastern Uldum was sudden, and we were unable to reach some of our farthest settlements in time. 

Fortunately, many of the tol'vir who lived in the conquered territories were not killed, instead being put to work under the Amathet's whip. 

We must take any opportunity we can to free them and return them to their homes.

passages.title: Far From Home
passages.text:
We have seen the return of many of our people, thanks to you.

You have my gratitude.

passages.title: Guarded Secrets
passages.text:
From what we know about the Amathet, they must've been locked away in their tombs for thousands of years. Just think of what we could learn from them!

Of course, that would be a lot easier if they weren't trying to kill us. 

If you happen upon any caches of Amathet relics in your travels, let me know. I'd love to see what sort of mysteries they contain!

passages.title: Guarded Secrets
passages.text:
Fascinating find!

I can't wait until the situation here calms down enough that we can get a look into these old tombs ourselves!

passages.title: Faceless Mask of the Daredevil
passages.text: The hunter never sought to lead yet sought a challenge in life at every turn. He directed his allies with a deft hand and never shied from diving in to the melee himself. The prowess he showed made him as well as my other minions much more deadly. Return this mask to the altar of the Daredevil to challenge your own resolve in battle as your foes attacks cut even more deep.

passages.title: Faceless Mask of the Daredevil
passages.text: Place the Faceless Mask of the Daredevil on the altar.

passages.title: Faceless Mask of the Daredevil
passages.text: The path of the Daredevil is available to you if you dare.

passages.title: Faceless Mask of the Burned Bridge
passages.text: The displaced warrior is always on uneasy footing, especially one who is removed from her home world. The void makes this unsteadiness a reality where one step can lead into the abyss or drain you to your core.

passages.title: Faceless Mask of the Burned Bridge
passages.text: Place the Faceless Mask of the Burned Bridge on the altar.

passages.title: Faceless Mask of the Burned Bridge
passages.text: The treacherous path of the Burned Bridge will be available to you if you wish to tread it.

passages.title: Faceless Mask of the Dark Imagination
passages.text: These magi, twisting their magic to manipulate and conquer the world. Imagining greater power, they tread along the lines of the Void's domain. In these pursuits, this magi came to the realization that in the depths of one's imagination lie truly dark and terrible things.

passages.title: Faceless Mask of the Dark Imagination
passages.text: Place the Faceless Mask of the Dark Imagination on the altar.

passages.title: Faceless Mask of the Dark Imagination
passages.text: The risks at the edges of your sanity will now manifest if you so choose to engage them.

passages.title: Faceless Mask of the Pained
passages.text: Trading in secrets, trading in lies, operating on the fringes are all the Spymaster knows. His lost passions, lost loves are all gone, crushed under his own duty and loyalty to the crown. Nothing is left, nothing but the pain. Pain is an apt tutor and tool and one in which the void knows intimately. Return my mask if you dare to feel the many forms pain can take.

passages.title: Faceless Mask of the Pained
passages.text: Place the Faceless Mask of the Pained on the altar.

passages.title: Faceless Mask of the Pained
passages.text: As my madness and torment is not enough, feel free to invite even more pain in the future.

passages.title: Faceless Mask of the Long Night
passages.text: The endurance needed to make it this far is extraordinary and the feat of a long experienced adventurer. Yet, the longest night is nigh and with it our ultimate conquest. Those that fight the coming of eternal twilight know only futility, for in the Longest Night they will be on the edge of sanity forever.

passages.title: Faceless Mask of the Long Night
passages.text: Place the Faceless Mask of the Long Night on the altar.

passages.title: Faceless Mask of the Long Night
passages.text: Taking a step towards the Longest Night is already acknowledging the sanity you have lost. Do you risk the rest on such a fools errand?

passages.title: Heritage of the Vulpera
passages.text:
The Horde has come to truly value the Vulpera, thanks to your efforts. 

You are the most... vulperan vulpera that I know!

Visit me in the Vulpera Hideaway in Vol'dun. Kiro had me put together a small memento in appreciation of your efforts.

passages.title: Heritage of the Vulpera
passages.text:
Your sense of adventure, you skill, your drive to explore... you just make us so proud. The Horde is better for having us!

With that in mind, <name>, take this gift. You carry us with you, wherever you go.

passages.title: Heritage of the Mechagnome
passages.text:
<name>, we could not be more pleased with your progress. You represent us well with the Alliance.

Return to Mechagon City at your earliest convenience. Waren has created a gift for you.

passages.title: Heritage of the Mechagnome
passages.text:
Continue in this manner, and our people will continue to advance at a rapid pace. 

There is so much left to discover! Continue to learn and grow, <name>!

passages.title: Shadowy Showdown
passages.text: This is our time! We've found where these Shadowy Figures have been hiding, and it's time for us to take the fight to them and stop whatever their plans are. Their base of operations is in Blackrock Depths. It's all up to you.

passages.title: Shadowy Showdown
passages.text: These Shadowy Figures have been an annoyance for too long now. Get in there, and stop them.

passages.title: Shadowy Showdown
passages.text: This is our time! We've found where these Shadowy Figures have been hiding, and it's time for us to take the fight to them and stop whatever their plans are. Their base of operations is in Blackrock Depths. It's all up to you.

passages.title: Shadowy Showdown
passages.text: These Shadowy Figures have been an annoyance for too long now. Get in there, and stop them.

passages.title: Shadows of Blackrock
passages.text:
We've finally tracked those pesky Shadowy Figures down, they should all be in there. They seem highly skilled, you're going to need to bring your best teams in there if you have any chance of winning.

Let me know when you are ready.

passages.title: Shadows of Blackrock
passages.text: I can teleport you in, but after that, you're on your own.

passages.title: Shadows of Blackrock
passages.text: Amazing, you stopped them! Who knows what crazy things they would have done had we not intervened, and at just the right moment. Well done!

passages.title: Pet Battle Challenge: Blackrock Depths
passages.text: Those Shadowy Figures are up to no good again, are you sure you want to face them? If you really want to go back in there, I'm not going to stop you.

passages.title: Pet Battle Challenge: Blackrock Depths
passages.text: I can teleport you back in there, but you're on your own once you're inside. Good luck.

passages.title: Pet Battle Challenge: Blackrock Depths
passages.text: Amazing, you stopped them! Who knows what crazy things they would have done had we not intervened, and at just the right moment. Well done!

passages.title: An Unwelcome Advisor
passages.text:
<The envelope contains a message from King Anduin Wrynn.>

<name>,

Even with the forces of the Horde and Alliance working together, we still have found no trace of N'Zoth's forces. Ever since his release, the Old God has evaded us at every turn.

The Light only knows what ill he has in store for Azeroth.

Meet me in Stormwind Keep. We must put a plan together to uncover N'Zoth's schemes before it is too late!

Light grant you haste,
King Anduin Wrynn

passages.title: An Unwelcome Advisor
passages.text: What is it?

passages.title: An Unwelcome Advisor
passages.text:
It would appear that N'Zoth's corruption is already reaching its way into our minds. We have no time to waste.

Go with Magni and Wrathion and see what you can uncover. I will ensure that our forces are ready to defend against any attack.

Good luck.

passages.title: Return of the Warrior King
passages.text:
Ye've done a great deal fer Azeroth, hero, but unfortunately I'm gonna have tae ask ye tae do more. N'Zoth is on the loose, an there's no tellin' when or where he'll strike.

This battle is one ye can't face alone. When the time comes, ye'll have my hammer at yer side!

But first, we'll need tae fetch it.

passages.title: Return of the Warrior King
passages.text: Need something, champion?

passages.title: Return of the Warrior King
passages.text:
It'll be good tae be back in the action again. 

Let's get goin!

passages.title: Where the Heart Is
passages.text:
It's time we put Wrathion's plans in tae motion. 

He'll be headin' back tae the Chamber of Heart, so we should meet him there.

passages.title: Where the Heart Is
passages.text:
All right, the gang's all here. 

Let's get started!

passages.title: Return of the Black Prince
passages.text:
<The envelope contains a message from Valeera Sanguinar.>

<name>,

I have just returned from a meeting with King Wrynn in Stormwind.

We have much to discuss.

Meet me at the Great Seal with haste.

Al diel shala,
Valeera

passages.title: Return of the Black Prince
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Return of the Black Prince
passages.text:
I hope that Wrathion's expertise can lead us to the Old God.

We have precious little else to go on otherwise.

passages.title: Where the Heart Is
passages.text:
The Speaker has requested that I send you to aid him and Wrathion in their efforts.

You have proven yourself a great ally to Azeroth, and I suspect you will have a big part to play in the coming battles.

Let us hope that the rest of the Horde and Alliance can put aside their squabbles to face a common enemy.

passages.title: Where the Heart Is
passages.text:
Ah, ye made it! An' just in time!

Wrathion's got a plan on how we might be able tae outmaneuver N'Zoth. When the Old God shows his face though, we're gonna need ye tae take the hurt to 'em!

Let's get started!

passages.title: A Bit of Investigation
passages.text:
adventurer, this may be the discovery of a lifetime!

I cannot yet say with absolute certainty, but I have a suspicion that these insects are known as the aqir.

The League has few intact records, but the last mention of these creatures describes a great war waged between the C'Thraxxi, aqir, and early troll civilizations.

We had assumed they were driven to extinction, but they may have simply been... rebuilding.

Could you please collect some samples for me to examine?

passages.title: A Bit of Investigation
passages.text: Have you managed to acquire the samples?

passages.title: A Bit of Investigation
passages.text: Marvelous! Your contributions to the League will be duly noted.

passages.title: Whispers in the Dark
passages.text:
Did ye hear that as well? That cannae be good.

If N'Zoth gains access tae this chamber, we'll all be done for! 

We need tae figure out where he's accessing the chamber and shut it down, before he does more than just whisper at us!

passages.title: Whispers in the Dark
passages.text:
What have we done?

If it weren't for Ra-den's sacrifice, N'Zoth would've had the chamber, and Azeroth would've been his for the takin'.

passages.title: Into Dreams
passages.text:
I cannae believe that Ra-den sacrificed himself to save us. We cannae give up on him!

There must be a way tae find out where he went. 

Let's see if MOTHER can track him down!

passages.title: Into Dreams
passages.text: We're runnin' outta time!

passages.title: Into Dreams
passages.text:
That portal must be the entrance tae N'Zoth's realm.

This may be our only chance tae get Ra-den back and take out N'Zoth once and fer all!

passages.title: Eyes on the Amathet
passages.text:
On behalf of the Explorers' League, I'd like tae thank ye for helping establish the Uldum Accord and buying us some cooperation from Ramkahen.

In the interest of better understanding our foes, Ramkahen has allowed the exploring of the Amathet tombs. Unfortunately, though, their forces are spread too thin to provide protection.

I was hopin' ye could help out with that. 

Think ye could spare some time tae see what they're all about? We can start with an aerial look.

passages.title: Eyes on the Amathet
passages.text: To the skies!

passages.title: Eyes on the Amathet
passages.text:
So much tae take in! I just wish it wasn't so hard tae write notes on gryphon-back.

Still, I think we've only uncovered the tip of the iceberg.

passages.title: Buried History
passages.text:
Since the Amathet came from this region, it would only stand to reason that artifacts from their civilization would be left behind here, hidden beneath the sands.

It looks like it's time for a good old-fashioned dig!

The dunes near here must have covered up a large swath of the Amathet's former territory. Let's see what we can dig up there!

passages.title: Buried History
passages.text: What have ye turned up?

passages.title: Buried History
passages.text:
Yes! The markings on these artifacts confirm my hypothesis. 

There's definitely more to this than we first thought.

passages.title: Seekers of Corruption
passages.text:
If anyone would know more about the "corruption" the tablet spoke of, it would be the Suntouched that were put in charge of rooting it out.

Of course, I doubt they'll be willing to turn over any information voluntarily.

Luckily for me, you're a bit of a specialist at brute force investigation, aren't you?

passages.title: Seekers of Corruption
passages.text: Found anything from the Suntouched?

passages.title: Seekers of Corruption
passages.text:
So the Amathet aren't working with N'Zoth after all! That's a relief!

Of course, that doesn't make them any less hostile to us, but it's a start!

passages.title: Mutually Assured Destruction
passages.text:
The Amathet want tae re-take the Forge of Origination so they can use it tae end all life on Azeroth, Old God or otherwise! 

They could strike at any moment. We have tae warn the defenders of the Forge!

passages.title: Mutually Assured Destruction
passages.text:
The Amathet... charged on our position.  

We were... outmatched...

passages.title: A World Worth Saving
passages.text:
We could not stand against them. Their warriors... wreathed in the sun's flames...

They want the forge... to end all...

Go... I will... endure...

passages.title: A World Worth Saving
passages.text:
You did it! I cannae believe that we were mere moments away from the end of life as we know it!

Thank ye for yer help with my research, <class>. If ye weren't here I don't want tae know how this would've ended!

Now, if ye'll excuse me, it's goin' tae take weeks tae catalogue all we've found!

passages.title: Chew On This!
passages.text:
These mangy hyena will gnaw on anything they dig up, including priceless artifacts!

We cannae allow the history of Uldum tae go tae the dogs, so tae speak.

I'm afraid we're gonna have tae thin out their numbers.

passages.title: Chew On This!
passages.text: Did ye take care of the hyenas?

passages.title: Chew On This!
passages.text:
That was a regrettable thing, but necessary.

Thank ye, <name>.

passages.title: A Gathering of Champions
passages.text:
The leaders of the Horde are gathering together in Orgrimmar to nominate a new Warchief of the Horde.

As a champion of the Horde, your presence at the meeting has been requested. The gathering will be held at the embassy in Orgrimmar.

I will be going on ahead. Come speak with me when you arrive in Orgrimmar, I'll be waiting with the others.

Make haste, champion. The future of the Horde is about to be decided...

passages.title: A Gathering of Champions
passages.text: You got here just in time. The meeting is about to begin.

passages.title: Warchief of the Horde
passages.text:
The meeting to decide the next Warchief of the Horde is about to begin.

The other leaders of the Horde have already arrived. They are waiting for you inside the embassy.

Speak with me when you are ready, and we will greet the others together.

passages.title: Warchief of the Horde
passages.text:
It has been decided, then. There will no longer be a Warchief of the Horde.

It seems that we have been made witnesses to the beginning of a new era...

passages.title: A Gathering of Champions
passages.text:
King Wrynn has called for an audience with the Alliance leaders in Stormwind.

Your presence at the meeting has been specifically requested. The gathering will be held at the embassy.

Come speak with me when you arrive in Stormwind, I'll be waiting with the others.

Do hurry, <name>. It would be ill-advised to keep the king waiting...

passages.title: A Gathering of Champions
passages.text: You got here just in time. The king is about to begin his address.

passages.title: The Price of Peace
passages.text:
The king will be addressing us shortly with news from his diplomatic mission to the Horde.

The other leaders of the Alliance have already arrived. I am sure they are eager to hear what King Wrynn has to say.

Speak with me when you are ready, and we will greet the king together.

passages.title: The Price of Peace
passages.text: Hmm... the meeting did not seem to go quite as the king expected. We know where Genn and Tyrande stand, but I wonder what the others have to say.

passages.title: Fame Waits for Gnome One
passages.text:
Tinkmaster Overspark requests your assistance on an important research expedition. 

Working with the esteemed Tinkmaster will certainly be of benefit to your career. It's done wonders for mine!

passages.title: Fame Waits for Gnome One
passages.text: Now we can begin the expedition.

passages.title: Magni's Findings
passages.text:
As if gettin' the Forge back up and runnin' wasn't good enough, I think we may have found the key tae takin' out N'Zoth once and for all in the archives of Mogu'shan Vaults!

Ye might want tae be sittin' down for this one, champion.

passages.title: Magni's Findings
passages.text: Pay attention, champion!

passages.title: Magni's Findings
passages.text:
Looks like we got a plan!

Now tae see what Wrathion's got cookin' up tae find Ny'alotha.

passages.title: Put Your Foot Down
passages.text:
<Zahra stomps on a slimy, slug-like creature as you approach.>

You see that? Doesn't look like much, but believe it or not, those bugs grow out of these things.

They're all over the places the aqir have taken over, feeding off of our dead and growing into these monstrosities.

If you happen to see any of them, do the world a favor and take your boot to 'em.

passages.title: Put Your Foot Down
passages.text:
By the looks of your boots, I'd say you stomped out a good number of those creepy crawlies.

Don't worry, it'll clean off... eventually.

passages.title: Taking the Skies
passages.text:
I'd like to see if we can get some more of these flyers in the air to drive back the aqir, but it's nearly impossible to get back to the Obelisk of the Sun with all these bugs in the air.

I think we're going to have to thin them out on the ground before we can hope to gain aerial superiority.

Can I count on you to lend a hand?

passages.title: Taking the Skies
passages.text: How fares the bug smashing?

passages.title: Taking the Skies
passages.text:
The skies look a little clearer now, thanks to you. Hopefully it'll be enough to get our aerial efforts off the ground.

Either way, your help is appreciated.

passages.title: Enter the Void
passages.text:
<As your approach the idol, the dark shards you carry appear to melt into your hand. You are immediately overcome with unspeakable anguish. It quickly gives way to feelings of joy, serenity, and an overwhelming desire to... kill.

A hissing voice creeps into your mind.> 

My faithful servant. I will grant you but a small taste of my unimaginable power, all I ask in return is that you complete one simple task. Kill any who would oppose me, spare no one. Do not fail me...

passages.title: The Incredible Egg
passages.text:
<The aqir seem to have been in the process of empowering this egg with void magic.
