It looks to be far from hatching, so it should be safe to study to find out what they were planning to do with it. 

Someone in the Explorers' League might be interested in taking a look.>

passages.title: The Incredible Egg
passages.text:
Fascinating! You say that the aqir were trying to empower this egg?

You did the right thing by bringing this egg into my care. Just think of the wonders we'll uncover when it hatches!

You look worried.

passages.title: Match the Hatch
passages.text:
Don't fret, I'm sure no ill will become of hatching this creature. After all, the aqir can't be born evil, can they?

Of course, we have no idea how to take care of such an egg. I will need you to do some investigating.

Head back to the aqir hives and see if you can find any other, similar eggs. If we can observe how they're being treated, we might be able to apply those learnings here.

passages.title: Match the Hatch
passages.text: What have you learned among the aqir?

passages.title: Match the Hatch
passages.text:
The eggs hatched while you were studying them, you say?

That's unfortunate, but it looks like you returned in one piece! 

I will study these notes and see if I can learn more about our little friend here. We may just find something that can help in the hatching process.

passages.title: Warmth of the Sun
passages.text:
The desert nights in Uldum can get awfully cold. I fear for our little egg's ability to withstand these temperatures.

These Amathet to the East seem to have mastered the harnessing of the sun's energy. If we could borrow some of their expertise, we could use it to keep the egg nice and cozy.

Keep your eyes open for something we can use.

passages.title: Warmth of the Sun
passages.text: Did you find anything among the Amathet?

passages.title: Warmth of the Sun
passages.text:
You've found a solar collection device? Perfect!

Now our egg will be nice and toasty through the chilly nights.

passages.title: Wrapping Up
passages.text:
One oddity I have observed about this egg is that it lacks the protective webbing commonly found throughout the aqir hives. 

I believe this webbing has protective qualities, and could be beneficial to our egg if we can acquire some.

While you're out fighting the insects, see if you can't bring back some of their webbing so we can make a proper cocoon for our growing egg.

passages.title: Wrapping Up
passages.text: Did you find some suitable webbing?

passages.title: Wrapping Up
passages.text:
Oh, this sure is sticky! It should do the trick, though.

Here, give me a moment while I wrap the little guy up.

passages.title: A Shocking Technique
passages.text:
I have heard tales that the mogu use lightning to speed up the growth of their cloud serpents. I wonder if the same principle could be used for our aqir friend?

There's only one way to find out! Go to the Vale of Eternal Blossoms and see if you can get the parts together so we can create our own lightning rods. 

If they work the same as they do for the cloud serpents, it should speed up the hatching process significantly.

passages.title: A Shocking Technique
passages.text: Were you able to collect the proper components?

passages.title: A Shocking Technique
passages.text:
I hope the mogu didn't give you too much trouble.

It will all be worth it, though, once we hatch our little friend here.

passages.title: Coming Out of His Shell
passages.text:
It looks like our egg is ready to hatch! Isn't this exciting!

Come, let us welcome our new little friend to this world.

passages.title: Coming Out of His Shell
passages.text: Oh, the anticipation!

passages.title: Coming Out of His Shell
passages.text:
Isn't he marvelous?

We still have a long way to go until we have a full-grown aqir, but even in his current state he is a sight to behold!

passages.title: Action Figures
passages.text:
It occurs to me that our larva's current living situation is quite dull. We should try to find something to keep him entertained.

After all, a happy larva is a healthy larva!

I think the Amathet keep figures for worship of their gods. I'm sure they could also double as toys for our little friend here. See if you can find some!

passages.title: Action Figures
passages.text: Did you find any suitable toys?

passages.title: Action Figures
passages.text: Look how happy he is with his new toys!

passages.title: Bug Buddies
passages.text:
Is it just me or does our little friend look lonely? It would make sense that aqir are social creatures, coming from a hive and all. It must be difficult for him not being around any of his kind.

You know, maybe you could find some friends for him. Nothing big and scary, of course, but perhaps some of the smaller scarabs could be safe enough to keep him company.

What do you think?

passages.title: Bug Buddies
passages.text:
Look, they're playing! At least, I think that's what that is.

Anyway, having some friends should go a long way to keeping our larva healthy and happy. Well done!

passages.title: Super Jelly
passages.text:
My friends in the Golden Lotus have been telling me some interesting things about the new mantid swarm. Apparently they have developed a concentrated royal jelly that accelerates the growth of newly hatched mantid. 

If this jelly works on mantid, logic would suggest it would work on aqir as well!

See if you can find a sufficient sample of this jelly to help with our larva's growth.

passages.title: Super Jelly
passages.text:
This gets me thinking.

After we've raised this one, I wonder if we could hatch a mantid as well?

passages.title: Super Jelly
passages.text:
Just look at how he gobbled it up! 

Let's hope this does the trick.

passages.title: They Grow So Fast
passages.text:
Look! Our little larva friend has entered the pupa stage! 

Wait... it looks like he's ready to emerge. 

Go on, give him a hand!

passages.title: They Grow So Fast
passages.text: Take care, our friend is likely still very fragile.

passages.title: They Grow So Fast
passages.text:
Congratulations! Our little larva is now a fully-fledged aqir hatchling!

You must be very proud.

passages.title: A Custom Order
passages.text:
I think it's safe to say that our little friend is no long a hatchling, but a fully grown aqir! He's grown so much, in fact, he could even carry you into battle.

Wait, that's a marvelous idea!

You should speak with Blacksmith Abasi about getting a saddle made.

passages.title: A Custom Order
passages.text: What do you need?

passages.title: A Custom Order
passages.text:
I am certain I can craft a suitable saddle for that creature.

However, I am going to need your help with some things first.

passages.title: My Own Drone
passages.text:
The saddle is complete. I can't say I enjoyed working with that corrupted metal, but in the end I can easily say this is the finest saddle I have ever crafted.

I know it looks... aggressive, but I assure you that your aqir will find it quite comfortable.

I hope it serves you well.

passages.title: My Own Drone
passages.text: Was the blacksmith able to help?

passages.title: My Own Drone
passages.text:
I am impressed, this is beyond what I thought Abasi capable of.

It looks like our little friend is ready to fly the nest. Remember to take good care of him!

And do visit once and a while.

passages.title: Shards of Corruption
passages.text: <You feel the pull of something dark and inhuman on your mind, it's writhing tendrils digging in, tugging at your sanity. You feel compelled to collect more shards... all of them.>

passages.title: Shards of Corruption
passages.text: <The Idol tugs at your very being. Demanding you to touch it.>

passages.title: Shards of Corruption
passages.text: <You feel a foreboding presence in your mind, it seems... very pleased.>

passages.title: Curious Corruption
passages.text: <There appears to be something unusual about this particular item. Perhaps someone in the chamber can speak to its origin.>

passages.title: Curious Corruption
passages.text: Find something interesting?

passages.title: Curious Corruption
passages.text: Titanic Purification system available.

passages.title: Elements of Corruption
passages.text:
Corruption behaves in mysterious ways. It spreads beyond Azeroth herself, touching our most intimate thoughts and sometimes corrupting various relics, as you've seen firsthand.

Though I cannot speak to the effects of these matters directly, I am sure MOTHER has information surrounding these so-called items of corruption.

passages.title: Elements of Corruption
passages.text: What have you discovered?

passages.title: Elements of Corruption
passages.text: Titanic Purification system online.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Uldum
passages.text:
Our objectives in Uldum are being interrupted by the influx of Alliance scum.

Clear as many of them out of the area that you find, then report back.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Uldum
passages.text: Good work, <class>.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Uldum
passages.text:
Our mission in Uldum is being compromised by the Horde incursion. 

Get into Uldum and take out as many as you can.

passages.title: Call to Arms: Uldum
passages.text: Good work, <class>.
